tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ /glegs bam nga pa'i dkar chags bzhugs/༈glegs bam nga dum par (ka)par dkor bsrung dge bsnyen mu zi'i ba
༄༅/ /rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum/ /glegs bam nga pa'i dkar chags bzhugs/༈glegs bam nga dum par (ka)par dkor bsrung dge bsnyen mu zi'i ba

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gsung 'bum// glegs bam nga pa'i dkar chags bzhugs/ ༈glegs bam nga dum par (ka)par dkor bsrung dge bsnyen mu zi'i bangs gsol bsam don myur 'grub la shog le3(kha)par ma mgon mchod sprin mdor bsdus la shog le4(ga)par bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs sprin phung*/ gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs/ gu ru'i gsol 'debs smon lam/ rje btsun padma'i mtshan gyi zhabs brten/ tshul phu rgyal tshab rin po che'i mchog sprul gyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs dge slong bdud 'dul kun dga'i skye srid mayur gsal gyi smon lam/ rtsa gsum gsol 'debs/ ma ṇi 'khor chen gyi smon lam/ rtsa gsum sangs rgyas byang sems chos bsrung rnams la gsol 'debs/ mchog sprul myur byon gyi gsol 'debs gsol 'debs yid kyi gdung sel bcas la shog le8(nga)par sgaramathel sogs la spyi 'jog dang skyes chen rnams la zhabs brtan 'bul skabs mgo brjod ljags brtsoms la shog le18(ca)par lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i bsnyen yig zin bris dkyus byang du bkod pa la shog le9(cha)par sga pa rab bzang la gnang ba'i zhal gdams/ sgrub a rgya stag rdzong du char 'bebs la phebs skabs gnang ba ka mad sum chu ma/ 'gag pa dā nar gnang ba'i zhal gdams gzigs dpon dkon mchog yon tan 'byung gnas la gnang ba'i zhal gdams ka li sum cu shon mo'i kha 'gegs bcas la shog le6(ja)par lam bsangs phun tshogs 'dod 'jo/ gangs lha'i gsol mchod rte'u ong kyu dgon gyi gzho bdag btsan gyi gsol mchod/ klu batshan ban skyong gi bsangs gsol/ phu gu gdong gi btsan dang*/ ra pog zam lha bcas kyi bangasas gsol bcas la shog le8(nya)par khams 'ba' dgon gyi byang chen mchod rten gyi dkar chag la shog le3(ta)par lnga ldan shol dkar 'phreng ba nyams su len lugal bdon bsgrigs brjod byang zin bris la shog le12(tha)par dbal 'khor lo sdom pa lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i go ga dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun la shog le18(da)par drangs srong log tri'i gtor bzlog dkyus ma'i 'don bsgrigs nag 'gros su bkod pa la shog le13(na)par mi zad me khya'i le'u tho rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' sten la shog le12(pa)par rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyal bla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsal kunda'i 'dod 'jo la shog le126(pha)par rtsis kyi bstan pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed la shog le33(ba)par snyan ngag gi bstan bcos chen po mo long gzhung las 'phros pa'i dper brjod dri za'i rgyud mangs la shog le58(ma)par dngul gdung lha babs mthong grol chen mo byin rlabs dpal 'arab zung gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus brjod pa dad pa'i me tog la shog le41(tsa)par rang lugs cho ga chos spyod bskang gapo sogs kyi bla brgyud kha 'gengs la log le8 yod pa rnams bzhugs//

(ka) ༄༅// dkor bsrung bsten mu zi'i bsangs gsol bsam don myur 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so/ 'phag yum mgon po nā karju na nyid/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir 'jig rten gsum mgon zhes/ rgyal ba'i bstan la ston pa gnyis pa mchog yab sras brgyud par bcas la gus pas bdud/ gang de'i mdo sngags chos mdzod spol ba'i bdag /mkhan slob chos gsum grogs las mkhan tshang gi /dkor srung dge bsnyen par por bsangs gsol gyi/ 'phrin las bsam don myur 'grub 'dir 'god bya/ rin chen snod du gtor ma zur gsum sa/ sbrul dkra shis sde brgyad bshos bu ril bus bskor/ sman rakra chu gnyis nyer spyod gser skyems dngas/ phye mar bsangs sogs mthun rdzas ji snyed bsham/ bde ba'i stan 'khor skyabs sel sngon song nas/ rang nyid skad cig gsangs bdag dpa' bo'i sku/ mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje/ g.yon pa sdig mdzub don stab khro bo'i chas/ ye shes dpung 'bar ba'i klong na gsal/ rang gi kun ka'i ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ mchod rdzas ma dag nyes skyon dri ma kun/ ram yam kham gyi bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus nas/ slar yang oṃ dkar āḥdamar hūṃ mthing gis/ zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i ring bzhin can/ dpag yas bdod (2) yon nam mkha' mnyam par gyur/ ram yam kham oṃ āḥhūṃ na ma sarba tā ga ta bhyoḥbam sho sogs lan gsum gyi byin brlabs/ rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka'i hūṃ yig las/ 'od zer lcags dkyu lta bu rab 'khros pas/ dkor bsrung dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas rnams/ skad cig nyid la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ badzra sa ma dza: kyai rin chen pho brang mdzes pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ bsangs dang mchod gtor 'dod yon dwangs re spro: rnam 'byor yon mchod lhag bams dam re gtsangs/ dkor srung dge bsnyen 'khor bcas mthu re che/ dar zab ratna'i gdan mchog rab yangs par/ ma lus dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs sug sol/

sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan hoḥ sngon du rigs 'dzin padma 'byung gnas dngas/ bar du rgyal bdang skyob pa yab sras sogs/ brgyud par bcas pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dang*/ dam bca' mi gel don 'di dran mdzed la/ sgrub brgyud bstan srung rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi/ 'phrin las gang bcol myur sgrub bdag gis kyang*/ dam las mi 'da' dge bsnyen rtag mchod kyi/ dam tshig bdud rtsi gnyan po 'di rol zhig sa ma ya bitsho rakṣaḥ gtor ma yod na bdud rtsi bran cing med na dmigs pa bya/= kyai bstan bsrung dge bsnyen chon po 'khor bcas la/ dgyes pa bskong phyir mchod pa'i dam rdzas ni/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mchod yon dang*/ chu gtsang dri bzang sbyor ba'i zhabs bsal dang*/ chu dang thang skyes me tog rnam par bkra /sbyar dang rang byang chub bdug spos sprin ltar 'khrigs/ mun sel mar me nyi zla'i dpal la 'khu/ tshan dan ga bur sbyar ba'i dri chab dang*/ kadar gsum mngar gsum ro ldan lha'i zhal zas/ yid 'phro glug dbyangs rol mo'i bye brag dang*/ rmad du byang chub ba'i dam rdzas a mṛ ta/ rgyu rkyen sbyar ba'i dmar chen dmar chen rakta dang*/ bha ling rgyan ldan lhun po ltur brjed/ gzhan yang spyan gzigs long spyod dpag med par/ rab 'byams bkod pa'i dgyes mchod chen po dang*/ khyed par rtsi shing sman spos phye mar sogs/ 'bar ba me la bsrog pas dud pa'i sprin/ nam mkha' sa gzhi bar snang yongs bkang zhing*/ dud pa'i gsel nas mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs/ phyi nang gsang mchod 'dod yon dpag med dang*/ bdud rtsa'i bum bzang thog pa'i smin legs mas/ dge bsnyen 'khor bcas bsangs dang khrus kyi mchod/ de ltar bangs dang khrus kyi mchad pas mthus/ lha dang bdag la phog pa'i grib rtsog rnams/ yongs su dag cig dgyes pa rab skong nas/ rnam (3) bzhi'i lams rnams myur du grub par mdzod/ oṃ u pa si ka sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ nas/

shasta prā titstsha hūṃ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta ba lingta pu dza ma khā hiḥ kyaiḥ dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs/ bdag cag ma rigs dug lnga'i dbang gyur pas/ gsol mchod bgyang zhing 'byor tshogs zhalan pa dang*/ chad lhag nor 'khrul thugs 'gal bzod par gsol/ oṃ badzra pa twa brjod/ kyaiḥ klu btsan dge bsnyen mu zi gtum po ni/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing 'od 'bar/ sku la le brgan dmar po'i 'jol ber gsol/ phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon sa sbrul zhags 'dzin/ sbrul nag stong gi gdeng ka rab tu g.yo/ chibs su bdud rta nag po rting dkar chibs/ rlung dang thog ser 'tshub pas klong dkyil na/ mthu stobs rmad byang chub bstan pa'i dgra bgegs sgrol/ 'khor dang bka' nyan sreg gi bshan pa dang*/ ging btsan klu bdud sde brgyad tshogs dang bcas/ dpag med sprul pa yang sprul 'khor bcas la/ rnal 'byor bdag gi mchod cing bstod par 'gyis/ kyai bstan pa'i bka' bsrung dge bsnyen 'khor rnams/ sngon gyi tha tshig gnyen por nyor dgongs la/ mchod gtor sman raka bsangs dang gser skyems sogs/ 'bul gyi bzhes la 'phron las bcom ni/ dkon mchog rigan chen gsum gyi dbu 'phang bstod/ thub bstan pyi sgos dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ de 'dzin skyes bu sku mdzad 'phrin spel/ de la bar bcod log 'dren dgra bgegs thul/ rnam 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags mnga' thang sogs/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal rnams ma lus sgrub/ sdang dgra gnod byed ma lus rtsad nas chod/ mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad ba dang*/ gzhis byes lam gsum kun tu bsrung zhing skyeb/ logs sprod nyes snol gang bsam ma lus kun/ skad cig nyid la 'grub pa'i 'phril las mdzod/ 'phris bcom zhing yig brgyas chad lhag gso/ mchod mgron gshegs la bsngo smon shis brjod bya/ gtor ma 'bul zhing bsangs me rang gzhil btang*/

'di ltar dge bsnyen mu zi'i gsol mchod 'di/ kham ba dkar zhes byas bskul ba'i ngor*/ 'bri ban snyom las chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis thub bstan yang ri sgar gyi chos grwa nas/ gang shar skad cing bris pa maṅga lam/ zhu dag legs par zhus/ (4) (kha) ༄༅// ma mgon mchod 'phrin mdor bsdus bzhugs/ rtsa gsum lha la phyag bgyis nas/ klong chen chos kyi bya ra bar/ mchod sprin mdor bsdus spro ba la/ chos kyi bdag pos gnang ba rtsol*/ 'dir klong chen snying thig bka' bsrung ma mgon lcam dra gyi 'phrin las nyung ngu bgyi ba la mchod gtor sogs gzhung bzhin bsham la/ gzhung gnas dang 'brel na byin rlabs sogs dmigs gsal ma byas kyang skyon du mi 'gyur cing*/ rang nyid lha'i nga gr+yal la gnas pas/ rang gi mdun du snang srid thams cad srid pa ma mo'i dkyil 'khor khrag zhag gi bra klong rab tu 'khrugs pa'i klong du drag por bar 'jigs kyi gzhal yas khang dur khrod kyi bkod pa dang bcas pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar thod mkhar gru gsum chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbus su ro yi gdan la dpal ldan sngags kyi bdag mo 'khor 'das thams cad kyi spyi dpal mo nyid las mi zhan pa'i 'khor kha dog sna tshogs pa khro zhing gtum pa dang chags shing bzhad pa'i rnam 'gyur can gyis bskor ba/ mdor na ye shes las grub pa'i mkhro'i tshogs dpag tu med pa/ gzhan yang sku sprul ma mo bcu gnyis/ gsung sprul mkhro sde lnga*/ 'phris kyi sprul pa bstan ma (5) bcu gnyis dang bcas pa g.yas su me shes kyi mgon po sde lnga la/ dpal mgon bdun cu'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ g.yon du sgrol ging rdo rje legs pa la the'u rang stong sde dang bcas pa/ rgyalab tu gza' bdud srog gi spu gri la gza' brgyad gdong mo bzhi dang bcas pa mdun du sbas pa'i dkor bsrung ngan ne ma dmar mo ming bsring brgyad dang bcas pa mdor na da pa ma mo'i dam tshig dang thugs rje la 'khod pa thams cad rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas spyan drangs par gyur/

badzra sa ma ya dzaḥ rol mo dang bcas/ bhyo rang bzhin dbyings kyi gnas mchog nas/ kun bzang khros ma nag mo'i gdong*/ sku gung thugs yon 'phris kyi/ sprul par bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ g.yas su ma hā de wā nag /g.yon na badzra sa dhu rtsal/ rgya tu drang srong rang hu la/ mdun du ngan pa'i ngan ne ma/ so sor rang rang bran g.yogs 'khor/ sprul pa yang sprul nyid sprul bcas/ rang bzhin gnas mchog gar bzhugs kyangs/ klog ltar myur bar gshegs su gsol/ trag kaksha o ka tsa tri ma ma bhyo ma hā kā shā sa na dza tri badzra sa ma dzaḥ spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ bhyo lcam mo chen mo bzhugs su gsol/ drag po chen po bzhugs su gsol/ sbyor grol ging chen bzhugs su gsol/ 'khor dang bcas tiṣṭha lhan/ de nas mchod cing bskang ba ni saman raka bran zhing*/ bhyo ting 'dzin sprul pa'i gnas mchog 'diraḥ thugs dam skong ba'i dam rdzas ni: dngos su bshams dang yid las byang chub: byang chub sems dang a mṛ ta: myos byed dba' klong 'khrugs pa dang : srog chags mdangs kyi thugs dam bskangs: sna tshogs sha dang snying gi khrag: dkar gsum mngar gsum ro drug zas: nyer spyod bha ling gtor ma dang : spyan gzigs mchod pas thugs dam bskangs: sgrub rdzas sba dkar tshigs gsum dang : dug khrag sbyar ba gnad kyi rgyu: gson khrag rlangs pa byung ba yis/ 'dod chags can gyi thugs dam bskangs/ shes rab mtshal dang spyi blug zhwa: sha khrag snying sna ru mtshon dang ཿ rma bya'i rgyal mtshan tsitta'i togaḥ le brgan dar dang mthing nag guraḥ snel mo'i dang g.yang gzhi snying : nal bu'i khrag lug nag gsobaḥ rkang gling thod rnga ltag sprod sogs: rten rdzas rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : bya nag lugs nag khyi nag 'briḥ mi khyi rta yi bam chen dang ཿ mdos dang 'bras bu sna tshogs sa: bskang rdzas rnams kyi thugs dam bskangs: rta dang g.yag nag gri snying gis: dpal ldan mgon pa'i thugs dam bskangs:

ra yi sha khrag (6) bsur chen gyisaḥ skyes bu chen po'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ sha khrag snying sna ra mchin gyisaḥ gza' bdud 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangasaḥ dkar mngar 'o chol rte bong shasaḥ dur khrod bdag mo'i thugs dam bskangasaḥ mdaur na snang srid bcud kunaḥ dbang po drug gi spyod yul duḥ rang rang mthun pa'i dam rdzas kyisaḥ sprul 'khor yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskangasaḥ khyad par dus kyi tha laḥ srid pa'i bde sdug ma mos byedaḥ 'byung ba lnga yang yum lnga'i klong ཿ de phyir srid pa ma mor gragasaḥ dbyings la rnam rtog mi mnga' yang ཿ rtsal las sprul par shar ba'i tsheḥ legs nyes stangs 'dzin ma mo niḥ ko long ru nga gdug rtsub cheḥ rnal 'byor thabs la mimakhas shing ཿ 'jig rten rmongs pa'i dbang gyur pas/ lha mo'i dam tshig gang dang gang ཿ de kun dang du ma blangs shing ཿ dkar mngar thab dang gzhob la sogasaḥ thugs dang 'gal ba'i las bgyis paḥ khyod la mthol lo bzod par bzhesaḥ dbyings nas bka' chad ma btang zhig /sho dang dho'u ma 'grobs shigaḥ khram dang dal kha ma ston cig /tshon dru nad rkyal ma brdog cigaḥ god kha gnas 'gyur ma btang zhigaḥ thugs dam mnyan po bskangs gyur nasaḥ zhi rgyas gnyis kyi gso ba dang ཿ dbang drag rol pa'i mngon spyod skyiḥ las bzhi'i dngos grub bdag la stsolaḥ zhes mchod cing bskang la bstod cing 'phrin las bcolab ni/ kyo chad pa rgyal po ni/ ma mo yongs kyi sprul gzhi yin/ lha yi yum na mdangs ldanam/ me tog mandha ra la bstod/ bdag lta'i ru tra bsgral ba las/ byang chub sems kyi mgon po byung*/ theg dgu rdzogs pa'i dar nag gis/ 'joms ber dgu brtsegs gsol la bstod/ ging chen rdo rje legs pas skyongs/ 'jam bu gling gi mnga' bdag po/ rnam 'gyur sprul pa ci yang ston/ rdzu 'phrul bdag po khyod la bstod/ khyed par gtsug lag khang bsrung zhing*/ dam nyams srog la hur thub byed/ gri rgod 'bebs pa'i drag shul can/

gsang ba'i sgrol ging gnyis la bstod mdor na ma mgon lcam dral gyi/ bka' dang 'khor la gnas sa yi/ legs nyes stangs 'dzin 'jig rten gyi/ bdag po kun la rab tu bstod/ dngos 'byor yid kyis rab sprul du spel/ mthun rdzas mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ 'khor bcas mchod cing brten pa'i mthus/ bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis/ mi mthun bar gcod kun sel la/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor gong du spel/ bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu skyongs/ 'jig rten nad mtshon mu ge bzlog /zab mo'i chos la mel tshe mdzed/ dus gsum ldang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ skad cig nyid la brlab pa dang*/ mdor ni yid smon las bcom rnams (7) myur du 'grub pa'i 'phris mdzod/ zhes 'phrin las bcol/ de ltar klong chen snying thig bka' bsrung ma mgon gsol mchad shin tu bsdus pa 'id yang rang nyid kyi rgyun du 'don rgyur dog bde ba'i slad gter gzhung las 'gyur bcos phran bu tsam bgyis pa yang 'bri gung pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi gr+yal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o/ zhu dag (ga) /bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs sprin phung bzhugs so// na mo/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs sprin phung nyams su len pa la dang po/ na mo/ bla ma dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ bdag gzhan 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob phyir/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlab sprin khung las/ dngos grub bdud rtsi grub char 'bebs par bya/ bde ldan padma bkod pa'i zhing gi gtso// gar dbang 'od dpag med kyi thugs ka nas/ bdag gi mgon mdzad gr+yal ba 'jig rten mgon/ sras dang 'khor tshogs bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ mdun mkhar chu 'dzin 'od lnga 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ padma nyi zla dar zab so so'i khrir/ dbus su 'od dpag med dngos ratna shri/ g.yas su pad dkar 'chang ba padma'i mtshan/ na gyi phung po dkrig pa lta bur gsal/ yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba ni/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la/

lung ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ dngos 'byor yid (8) sprul mchod sprin rgyal mtshos mchod/ sgo gsum mi dge ci bgyis mthos zhing bshags/ 'gro kun zag med dge la rjes yi rang*/ bla med theg chen chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/ mya ngan mi 'da' bskal par bzhugs su gsol/ dge ba 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ zhes dang*/ 'das dus klu rigs sgron dang mar me mdzad/ ma 'ong byams sa da lta shākya thub/ klu sgrub slar sprul mnyam med rin chen dpal/ 'jig rten gsum mgon zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes brgya stong nges shes ma 'khrul bar bgrang*/ yang mtshan sngags bzla bar 'dod na/ oṃ āḥ gu ru badzra dhṛ ga mi ta bha ratna shrī padma dhwa dza dharma ge tu ma hā mu dra siddha pha la hūṃ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub bzla/ mthar 'khor tshogs 'od/ zhod sgrib pa'i tshogs dag bla mnga' 'od du bzhu/ rang thim dbang bzhi thob nas rang gi sems/ ma bcos zung 'jug khyab gdal chen por gnas/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba rnams/ myur du dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur nas/ 'gro ba sems can gcig kyang ma lus pa/ bde can gcig kyang ma lus pa/ bde can dag pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas shog /ces bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin brlabs sprin phung zhes pa 'id yang dge slong chos ldan dang*/ sga pa blo gros gnyis nas bskul ba ltar/ 'bri ban 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa kham sa dge rgan gyi bgyis pa'o// ༄༅// gsol 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so// oṃ swa nyi byin rlabs 'byung gnas rje btsun bla ma dang*/ dngos grub mchog stsol yi dam lha yi tshogs/ bar chad sel mdzad mkhar 'gro ma can la/ gsol ba 'debs so mchog mthun dngos grub stsol/ rkang gnyis gatsho bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ zhi ba chags dang braral ba dam pa'i chos/ tshogs kyi zhing mchog 'phags pa'i dge bdun la/

gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'di ltar gus sa mchog gi gsol btab mthus/ tshe 'dir 'gal rkyen bar chad ma lus zhi/ phyi ma rnam mkhyen go 'phang thob gyur nas/ don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa'i dngos grub stsol/ ces pa yang khams skyo khri chung bstan 'dzin chos dbang gis kha 'don smon lam du 'bri gung pa 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'o// ༄༅// bde chen zhing gi smon lam bsdus pa bzhugs so/

(9) na mo dkon mchog gsum gyi bden ba dang*/ chos kyi 'byung gnas smon lam mthus/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ de na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'dod dpag med/ su zhig de yi mtshan brjod na/ de ni de ru skye bar 'gyur/ 'chi ba'i dus su ston pa ni/ dge slong 'dun bcas ti mthong*/ de na bud med yod ma yin/ mngal na gnas pa'ang yod ma yin/ rin chen rnams kyi padmo las/ rdzu 'phrul chen po 'byung bar 'gyur/ zas dang gos dang smon rnams dang*/ chos gos mal cha lhung bzed rnams/ sems kyi bams ma dge 'dun bsam mi khyab/ bsam mi khyab la dad ya na/ rnam par sman pa'ang mi khyab/ rnam dag zhing du skye bar gsungs/ bdag kyang tshe 'phos gyur ma thag /zhing mchog de ru skye bar shog padmo 'dam gyi ma gos ltar*/ srid gsum dri mas ma gos shing*/ srid pa'i padma las byung ba'i/ bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces 'chi med rnga sgrī mdor sangs rgyas kyi gsungs dngos byin rlabs che ba'i kha 'gongs sham bsgyur cung zad kham pa dge rgan nas bskul ba ltar/ 'bri ban 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni bskul ba po nyid do/ ༄༅// ma hā gu ru'i gsol 'debs smon lam bcas bzhugs so// mtsho dbus ge par padma'i sdong po la/ sku lnga ye shes lhun gyi grub pa'i lha/ rang byung chen po padma yab yum ni/ 'khar 'gro'i sprin phung 'khrigs la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyi/ dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs dpa rab brtan cing*/ dge 'dun sde 'phel sdom gsum nyams len btson/ 'jig rten bde zhing bkra shis phun tshogs shog /bdag kyang bla med byang chub ma thob bar/ skye dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du/ dpal ldan bla ma mchog dang mi 'bral zhing*/ nad gdon zhi zhing mthun rkyen tsho bsod spol/ gsangs sngags bla med mchog gi sgor zhugs shing*/

smani byed dbang dang grol byed gdams pa sogs/ ma lus thob nas bskyed rdzogs lam 'jug zhing*/ sgom med rtogs pa rgyud la bskrun nas kyang*/ zung 'jug dhor 'chang go 'phang thob gyur nas/ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kun/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol ma hā gu ru'i/ go 'phang mchog la 'khod pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa yang rang re'i gar gyi grwarigs ratna rakṣi ṇa'i bskul ngor o rgyan chen po la gsol 'debs smon mal sa bcad tsam 'bri (10) ban dharma dhwa dzas rdzong gsar bkra shis tshugs kyi yang rtser re'u mig phun tshogs 'khyil par bris pa dge'o// ༄༅// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rje btsun padma'i mtshan gyis zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ mchog gsum kun 'dus 'chi med pad 'byung sogs/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras bcas dang*/ yi dam mkhro chos bsrung tshogs rnams kyi/ deng 'dir bden tshig 'grub pa'i mthun gyur mdzod*/ klu zhabs gnyis 'jig rten gsum mgon gyis/ chos kyi rgyal tsab lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs/ rje btsun bla ma bskal pa rgya mtsho'i bar/ mi 'gyur g.yu drung ltur zhabs brtan gsol/ gang sku mtshan dpe'i gzi byin dpal 'bar zhing*/ 'gag med gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu'i sgra/ zab zhi spros bral bde ba chen po'i thugs/ mi shis rdo rje gsum gyi ngo bor bzhugs/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i gnyin gcig yid bzhin dbang*/ 'gro rnams mthun mongs dngos grub re skong phyir*/ nam yang nub pa med pa'i rgyalamatshan rtser/ bde ldan zhing gi gatsho ltar zhabs brtan shog /rtsa gsum lha dang drang srong bden mthu dang*/ chos dbyings rang bzhin 'gyur ba med pa'i gshis/ chos can kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu med mthus/ gsol btab ji bzhin roe 'bras lhun grub shog /ces pa yang bkrin gsum ldan rje btsun rdo rje 'chang 'khor lo'i mgon po gang nyid zhabs dpa bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol bdebs 'brel 'byung du dam pa gang gi bka' 'bangs tha shal snyom las chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis gus pa chen pos phul ba sarba maṅga lam//

༄༅// mtshul phu rgyal tsham rin che'i mchog sprul gyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs 'debs bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ bde chen zhing gi 'dren pa snang mtha' yas/ mchog gsum bla ma yin dam zhi khro'i lha/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ bdag cig legs smon 'grub pa'i mthun gyur mdzed/ thub bstan lha lam rnam par dag pa'i ngog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'od zer stong 'phro bas/ gdul bya bzang po'i pad 'tsham bzhad mdzad pa/ dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog/ mkhon khyod mi shig rdo rje'i gdan khri la/ gr+yal mchog tshe mtha' yas kyi ngo bo ru/ zhabs zung 'khor los mtshan pa bskal brgya'i bar/ nam yang mi g.yo zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /gang gi 'phrin las bsil zer can gyi 'od/ log 'dren nam mkha'i glang pos mi 'gogs par/ rje 'jug kun dī tshal chen rgyas pa dang*/ dge legs snang bas sa gsum khyab gyur cig /ces pa yang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rgyal tsham dam pa de nyid mchog gi sprul ska rin po che zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang dam pa nyid kyi mchod dpon chos grags nas bskul ngor 'bri gung pa bstan 'dzin chos chos kyi rgyal (11) mtshan gyi bris pa sarba maṅga lam// ༄༅// dge slong bdud 'dul kun dga'i skye srid myur gsal gyi smon lam bzhugs so// rtsa brgyud bla ma bslu med dkon mchog gsum/ yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs rnams kyis/ kun dga'i skye srid myur du 'dzin pa yi/ smon lam bden tshig 'grub pa'i mthun gyur mdzod/ 'jig rten rin chen 'byung gnas khyon yangs las/ dkon pa'i mchog gyur dal rten yid bzhin dbang*/ 'gro kun dga' bde'i 'dod dgu yongs stsol ba'i/ mkhas btsun bzang ldan skye srid myur gsal shog /rgyal bstan rin chen sgor zhugs bslab gsum gyis/ rgyud brlab thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba yis/ 'gro kun rdzogs byang sa la myur dkra shi ba'i/

kun dga'i skye srid zhing 'der gsal gyur cig khyad par nges don snying po 'bri gung pa'i/ bstan pa mchog la rab gus bsgrub pa yi/ srid zhu'i dam bcab brtan po 'dzin byed pa'i/ kun dga'i skye srid ma nor myur gsal shog /gang gi skye sprul rta ljang de nyid/ bar chad chu 'dzin dang bral tshe bsod rgyas/ mkhyen rab 'od zer stong phrag spros pa yis/ 'gro kun bde skyid padmo bzhad gyur cig ces pa dge slong bdud 'dul dkon dga'i skye srid myur gsal gyi smon lam 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes gnas chen gter sgrom nas lha sding chos mdzad pas bskul ngor 'bri ban snyom las pa dharma dhwa dzas bris pa'o// ༄༅// rtsa gsum gsol 'debs bzhugs so// rgyal ba kun 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*/ dbyer med yi dam bdang chen dpa' bo'i zhabs/ gang gi yum mchog rdo rje phag mo bcas/ rtsa gsum gr+yal mtsho'i lha gsol ba 'debs/ bdag nyid skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun/ rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlobs rjes su bzung*/ yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyi nyer kyang zhing*/ bya ba ci byas chos su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab gsum rim gnyis nyams len 'thar phyin cing*/ khyad par khreg chod thod brgal brten pa'i/ snang ba bzhi zad dbyings rigs dbyer med pa'i/ gzhon nu bum skur ye sangs rgyas bar shog ces pa kham skyo zur pa'i grwa rigs chos 'jig gyi ngor 'bri gung pa dharma pya dhwa dzas so/ ༄༅// ma ṇi 'khor chen bzhengs pa'i smon lam bzhugs so// rang 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing na gshegs bzhugs kyi/ mchog gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras chos bsrung bcas/ byin brlab mthu dang khyed par gsang sngags kyi/ yang snying yig drug 'khor chen 'di bzhengs mthus/ bstan dang de 'dzin zhabs brtan 'dus sde 'phel/ 'jig rten phyi sgos mi mthun rgud pa sel/ bde skyed rdzogs ldan la spyod mkha' mnyam gyi/ 'gro rnams 'khor ba las thar rnam mkhyen gyi/

sa thob sbyin bdag gatsho byas nye 'bral rnams/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun byang 'phags pa yis/ go 'phang bde blag bde blag nyid du thob gyur cig /ces (12) pa yang rta sna'i grwa rigs dge legs dbang pos ma ṇi 'khor chen smon lam dgos tshol bzhin 'bri gung dharma dhwa dzas bris/ ༄༅// rtsa gsum sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung rnams la gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ rdo rje 'chang sogs bka' brgyud bla ma dang*/ mdo sngags bka' bstan smin grol man ngag gi /rtsa brgyud bla ma phyogs dus zhing rgyal mtshor/ gshegs bzhugs 'byon rgyur rgyal ba mchog rnams dang*/ khyad par mgon so gar gyi dbang po sogs/ des gsungs lung rtogs dam chos dge 'dun bcas/ dkon mchog rin chen gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi'i/ yi dam lha tshogs dpa'i bo mkhro dang*/ dpal mchog phyag bzhi dbyings phyug ma la sogs/ skyabs gnas dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar rtse gcig gus pas gsol btab mthus/ bdag sogs 'gro kun byang chub ma thob bar/ 'gal rkyen nad gdon sdig sgrib zhi ba dang*/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar zla ltar 'phel zhing*/ sgo gsum dge brtsen bstan dang 'gro la sman/ nam zhig tshe yi 'du byed gtor ba'i tshe/ bde ltar dag pa'i zhing mchog dam pa der/ 'od dpag med pa'i zhabs drung skye bar shog /skyes nas rgyal ba'i zhal mthong chos thos shang*/ byang chub spyod pa rlabs chen spyad nas kyangs/ sangs rgyas nyid dang yon tan mdzad 'phrin gnyis/ 'gro kun 'dren pa'i dpal du bdag gyur cig /ces pa yang mo 'khor rgyan dbu mdzad lhun grub kyi bskul ngor 'bri ban chos med snyoms las pa chos kyi rgyal mtshor mtshan gyi bris pa'o/ ༄༅// mchog sprul myur byon gsol 'debs bzhugs so// chad pa zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkhas 'gro dang*/ chos srung dam can rgya mtsho bcas rnams kyis/ re ba'i 'bra bu 'grub pa'i bden tshig rtsol/

grangs med sngon sangs rgyas kyi 'gror brtse bas/ sngon gyi dam bcas skur ston pad dkar 'chang*/ ratna shri'i bstan pa skyong ba'i slad/ rje btsun bla ma'i mchog sprul myur gsal shog /rig dang dkyil 'khor 'khor rgya mtsho'i khyab bdag che chos dbyings ngang du snyom par mi bzhugs par/ gsol 'debs rtse gcig gdung shugs kyis bskul tshe/ gzugs sku'i rnam rol gsal bar mdzad du gsol/ gdul bya'i bsod nams shar ri'i phrag gong nas thugs bskyed bsil zer bye ba 'bul 'phro bas/ rje mjug kun da'i tshal chen rgyal mdzad pa/ mchog sprul zla tshes gsar pa myur gsal shog/ sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin mchog rab lhun po'i rtser/ theg gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ mchog gi sprul sku shes bya'i spyan stong ldan/ bar chad lha min g.yul las rgyal gyur cig/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i lus can rnams/ thar lam (13) 'god cing 'bri bstan spel slad du/ thugs rje'i brtse ba chen po'i nyir dgongs te/ de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ rtsa gsum rin 'dzin dmod pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ bdag cag lhag bsam re ba yongs grub cing*/ dge legs pa gsum yongs su khyab gyur cig ces pa yang dpal ldan bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang dam pa de nyid 'dus byas rtag 'dzin can rnams kyi ngor re zhig dgongs pa chos dbyings spros 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i klong du thim tshul bstan skabs mchog gi sprul sku gsal snang myur phobs kyi gsol 'debs 'di yang gang gis slob 'bangs bsod dman dharmā dhwa dzas gsol ba rtse gcig 'debs ched kha bton dus sbyar ba'o/ sarba maṅga lam/ ༄༅// gsol 'debs yid kyi gdung sems bzhugs so// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi mkhyen brtse'i 'phrul/ ma nges sna tshogs chu zla'i gar ji bzhin/ snying po'i bstan pa spel phyir ston mkhas pa/

drin can rtsa brgyud bla mar gus phyag 'tshal/ 'jig rten gsum mgon zab chos gter gyi mdzod/ khyod kyi thugs rje'i lte mig gis phyes nas/ skal ldan 'gro rnams thar lam la 'god sa/ rin chen byang chub zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ sngon tshe 'phags pa'i yul du zhi ba 'tsho/ 'bri bstan skyong phyir slar yang nyid sprul nas/ ngos pa don gyi bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa/ rin chen seng ge'i zhabs la gsol= bsod nams tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po las/ legs 'khrungs rgyal bstan yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan rtser 'chang ba/ dkon mchog ratna'i zhabs la= rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od stong stong gis/ 'gro phan dam chos pad tshal rab rgyas nas/ smin grol sbrang rtse'i dga' ston cher 'gyed pa/ dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang por= brtse chen snying rjes thugs rgyud yongs bltims pa'i/ sbyin pa rnams bzhi'i dal 'gro'i rgyun bzang pos/ lus can nyon mongs tsha gdung sel mdzad pa/ bltas 'dzin 'gro 'dul zhabs la= dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus kun/ gsang gsum mdzad 'phrin gcig bsdus gru 'dzin dgyes/ snyigs dus rgyal kun las lhag bka' drin can/ padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol/ phyi ma'i dus kyang gar gyi dbang po yi/ spyan sngar dam bcas smin pa'i dge 'bras kyis/ 'khor ba la stongs bar du sprul pa'i gar/ bsgyur mdzad dpal ldan bla mar= mthar thugs bskal pa gr+yal mtsho 'das pa na/ rin chen yang dag bsags pa'i zhing khams su/ sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas rab 'phags pa/ dpal brtsegs rgyal por 'gyur der= de ltar rje btsun bla ma mchog nyid la/ bdag sogs rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ dngos (14) 'byor yid sprul mchod sprin gr+ya mtshos mchod/ mi dge'i las kun gnong 'gyod yid kyis bshags/ dus gsum bsags yod dge la rjes yi rangs/ rgyal ba kun la chos 'khor bskor bar bskul/

'char nus med par brtan par bzhugs gsol zhing*/ rnam dkar tshogs gnyis byang chen rgyu ru bsngo/ mgon po khyed la rtse gcig gsol btab mthus/ skye ba kun tu mi 'bras rjes 'dzin cing*/ mngon sangs rgyas tsho 'khor gyi thog ma ru/ skyes nas rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog dpal ldan bla ma khyed sku cing 'dra sogs brjod/ rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan la gsol 'debs mdor bsdus shig dgos tshul mi 'gyur bde chen gling nas dge slong spang mda' dkon mchog byang chub kyi gsol ba btab pa bzhin rje bla ma 'bri gung 'dir ji ltar byon pa'i sku'i skye srid la gsol 'debs sbya ba'adi rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi me khyi dob zla'i btso lnga phyag sam du stsal 'dug pa phyi mor phab pa'o// sarba maṅga lam/ (15) (nga) ༄༅// sgar thel sogs la spyid 'jog dang skyes chen rnams la zhabs brtan 'bul skabs mgo brjod ljags rtsoms kha shas bzhugs so// thub bstan yang ri sgar du zla ba byung ngo cog gi nyer lngar bla ma mchod pa rgyun 'dzug gi yo byad sbyor 'jags gnang skags dpyad khra rjags rtso gyi zin bris/ kha yig tu/ sgrub brgyud bstan 'gro yongs kyi rtsa lag 'phags mchog dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi zhabs pad drung du/ spyi 'jogs kyi tho chung*/ ༈sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛrta yi ge bcu bzhi pa la spyir snam grangs khri drug stong sum brgya kyang bzhi yod pa las nang mtshan nyis stong dgu brgya so gsum pa dpyid kyi thig le zhes byas pa'i srarta ras mdzes par bcings pa'o/ klu sgrubs gnyis pa'i bstan rtsa nyin phyed dbang*// bod yul lha mal rjon kun rab gsal bas// 'gro kun bde skyed pad tshal sbyor mkhas pa// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyi zhabs drung du/ gus pas tsitta'i nor 'dzin gtsang ma'i ngos// rgyu 'bras sems kyi chu rgyun bgyis bsrings pas// legs byas chu skyes 'dab stong g.yo dang ldan// yan lag mchog gi rtse mos btud de gsol// deng gi dus 'dir bu ram shing pa'i lung dang rtogs pa'i rdza rnga che// 'khor mo yug tu b.rungs pa'i snyan grags sa gsum tshogs kyi thos 'dzin dpyid// gyur mkhas drang srong gr+yal mtshan 'dzin rnams zhing 'di'i skyabs gcig nam mkha'i glang*// gdul bya kun la phan bde'i gru char zim bur stsol mdzad gtsug gi nor// rgyal ba mnyam med nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin chen spyi dang bya brag ratna shrī'i snying po'i bstan// dar zhing rgyas la nub pa med pa'i bstan 'dzin skyes bu rim byon rnams dang khyad par rdo rje slob dpon che// rigs kun gtso bo bkrin gsum ldan dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs kyi padmo mi gzhig rdo rje'i chos bdun gyis/
ngo bo nyid du bde ldan zhing gi 'dren pa dang mnyam 'pho 'gyur med pa bskal pa rgya mtshor zhabs

(16) brtan cing*/ khyad par thub bstan chos grwa'i pad tshal cher// bslab gsum rnam dag dge 'dun shra ma ra// mang 'dus nges don sbra rtse'i chos spyod nas// 'khor lo bzhi yi bde bas rol gang zhing*// de mthus 'jig rten dbyigs 'dzin khyon yangs por// phan bde'i legs byas nam mkha'i bla bres las// 'ongs pa'i rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i sbrang char gyis// bde skyid pā lu'i snye ma ldem byed cing*/ khyar par shākya'i btsun pa kho bo cag /bstan 'gror sman sems sa brtel ljon pa'i shing*/ bdud rigs mchon gyis mtshe ba med pa nas// 'gro don lo 'bras yangs por bgyed pa'i ched// skyabs gsum kun 'dus ratna shrī la// mchod cing gsol 'debs dbang bzhi len pa yi// cho ga dngos grub char 'bebs zhes byas ba/ ji srid bar du gnas 'dir rgyun 'jugs so/ de yang rgyal bstan spyi sgos dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams dang khyad par bdag cag gis rdo rje slob dpon bka' drin gsum ldan dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'izhabs pad sprid mthar brtan pa dang*/ thub bstan chos gra 'di nyid du phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun mang du 'du zhing de dag kyang sku ring zhing thugs la bslab gsum gr+yan gyis phyug cing 'khor lo bzhi'i bya bas dus 'da' ba dang*/ 'jig rten spyi dang bya brag dbur stod kyi phyogs 'dir char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo phyug rtag tu legs pa dang pad ser nad yams mu ge 'khrug rtsod sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs ming tsam yang mi 'byung zhing*/ mthun rkyen tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' ris stobs 'byor sogs dbyar mtsho dang yar ngo ltar 'phel ba dang*/ dbag shākya'i btsun pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan kyang sgo gsum gyi nyer 'tsho zhi zhing bstan 'gror sman sems ci mchis 'gegs med myur du 'grub pa'i ched// 'dus tshogs su zla ba byung ngo chog gi tshes nyer lnga la bla ma mchod pa ji srid bar rgyun 'jags kyi yo byad sogs sbyor 'jags 'bul bar bkra shis dge mtshan rmad du byung ba'i rten rab dkar lha rdzas zla zhun lang tsho ngoms pas sne drangs===bcas sbyor 'jags zhus par gong du bcad lhun gtis kyi sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig don chu gter che la thugs bskyed kyi gru gzings brtan pos brtal re re 'bras yid bzhin nor bu myur du len pa'i thugs 'dun gzhar mi chad pa zhu zhu zhu/

'di 'bad dge ba gling bzhi'i dbus na mchog rab ji bzhin rin chen dpal gyi bstan pa de/ nges don thegs mchog phyag (17) rgya chen po'i bang rim gyis mdzes 'pho 'gyur med pa srid pa 'dir/ mngon par gsal zhing gang gis chos srid grags po'i gdugs dkar sa sla'i dbyings su 'degs byed pa'i/ rdo rje slob dpon mched lcam dang bcas bskal zhabs brtan bkris dge mtshan stsol/ sa stag skyabs mgon chen mo dgung skeg la phebs skabs zhabs brtan 'bul gnang gi 'bul khra ljags brtsom mdzad pa'i zin bras/ kha yig tu/ tshang dbang lhar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon mtshungs med rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhabs kyi padmo drung du/ zhabs brtan gsol ba 'debs mtshon/ rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa lha lam du/ gcig bsdus ngo mtshar mtshan dpe'i nyin byed dbang*/ gsang chen rgyud sde'i 'od zer 'bum spro bas/ bdag blo'i dpa tsham 'byord pa'i gnyin gcig su/ khyed par bdag gi tshe rabs 'phreng ba'i mgon/ rje btsun bla ma bka' drin gsum ldan gyis/ zhabs sen bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mchog mi 'jig gdong lngas btogs pa'i khri drung du/ gus pa chen kun rtogs dang pa'i khri shing rab gus gus pa'i 'bras bzang zhing rul dang*/ dang mnyam sprul pa'i yan lag mchog gi sa la legs btud btud lha phyag sngon btang zhing*/ zhing 'di'i 'drin pa rdo rje 'chang dngos grub khyab dbag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon po mtshungs med dpal/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i drung du kun bzang mchod sprin sprin phung lta bur bkod de 'bul/ yang yang sngon nas sdig dang sgrib pa'i tshogs/ mang mang bsags dang sdom gsum dam tshig las/ 'gal 'gal nyis pa'i mun tshogs bsdug po rnams/ bshags bshags stobs bzhi'i zla bas dman par bya/ dus gsum bsags pa'i dge tshogs rnam dag khyung sngon skye kyi legs drangs pa'i/ rang gzhan kun gyi sgrub byas skya reng 'od zor brgya pa rab gsus te/

gdul bya'i mkhas 'gogs med rang gzugs blo yi padmo rab bzhad nas/ rab tu yi rang ge sar zi'u 'bru'i dga' ba'i ral par byed/ thog gsum dam pa chos kyi mgul pa g.yas/ 'khyil ba'i 'gro don skye ba lnga pa'i sgras/ mi lam mgon po dbus 'gyur gdan khri la/ ma byon de srid sgrogs dang bskor bar bskul/ mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri 'phang mthon pa'i steng*/ mi gzhom rdo rje'i chos bdun ngo bo ru/ mi dmigs lha lam zhig par ma gyur par/ mi 'gyur bde ldan mgon ltar zhabs brtag gsol/ zhes yan lag bdun gyi drug pa gsol ba 'debs pa yan tshig rkang dbang po'i grangs kyi sngon bsus nas de yang rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po che la ston pa gnyis par byon pa mnyam (18) med mgon po rin chen dpal gyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas la yun ring gnas par bya ba yang de nyid 'dzin skyong spel ba'i mgon po phyag na padmo bsam bzhin mi yi srid par ston pa bdag cag bkrin gsum ldan rje btsun bla ma dam pa nyid lags na/ snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus 'dir 'gro ba spyi mthun bson nams dman zhing*/ bdag dang bdag 'dra bar skyabs dang skyob pa med pa'i 'gro drug sems can sdug balngal gyi chu bor byi ba rnams 'phags mchog thugs rjes 'dul ba'i dus lags na/ dus da nas bzung 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stong par ma gyur gyi bar du/ bde ltar mgon po'i snang tshul ji bzhin par/ 'pho 'gyur dbri gang bral bar/ 'phrog byed gnyis 'thung legs 'gro gtsug ldan mkhas lding gimatshan pa'i 'jigs bras gdong lnga'i khri la zhabs brten par bzhugs gsol lan cig ma yin pa rnams pa kun tu 'debs pa'i snying por/ khri 'debs lha rdzas zla ba zhun ma thags su bskrun pa'i bkris brgyad kyi nyer bar mtshan pa/ stan dkar rdo rje'i re kha mtshar du dngar ba/ dngul gyi zhing khams dar sna lnga'i mdzes par srud pa/

sku gsum lhun grub chen por bzhugs gsol 'debs phyir gong ma tā ming gi gan mdzes nas mthon pa'i mdzod dkar nyin bde mas ste drangs/ sku rton chos 'od snang tshe mtha' yas pa dngul las grub pa/ longs sku 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gser zangs las grub pa/ sprul sku 'chi med padma kā ra'i sku tshab gyin can/ 'gro la mchog chos kyi 'khor lo che la rgyun mi chad par bskor ba'i gsol ba 'debs phyir ma hā tsi ni'i yul grub nas thon lha gos dbang mdog 'dom 'khor gyi sne drangs/ gsung rten mnyam med nyi ma'i mnyen gyi 'khrungs rab b.ragaya pa spod/ thams cad mkhyen pa rdzes btsun tā ra nā tha'i rnam thar spod/ brtsams pa legs bshad kyi 'khor lo bskor phyir sam bu tra gser shog ba shub byir dhog thugs mchog g.yo ba med pa nam mkha'i rdo rje rang bzhin du bzhung gsol 'debs phyir/ bar phyogs rgyal po'i khab nas byung ba'i dar ling lha lam mdangs 'dzin kyi sne drangs/ thugs rten padma sprungs pa/ dkar yon gyi yol gor dngul dkar las grub pa'i dpal be'u/ dwangs shes zur brgyad kyi sne du rang byung sgrib med kyi dha dngul stog ma sag gsum gyi khyon yangs dogs mor byed pa yon tan rin po che rgyas pa'i snyan pa kun tu khyab phyir lha gos po na'i khengs pa 'phrog pa'i sde drangs/ yon tan rtan rang byung g.yang dril 'bras bu'i dbyibs kyi sned du sman mchog rgyal po rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ sbur len lug g.yang dgar gzugs kyi snod du bilba/ rgyu gong mtshungs kyi snod du rgya long*/ 'phris rnam bzhis 'gro don rgyun chad med par bzhugs gsol 'debs phyir/ dar ljang srid du ring ba'i (19) sne drangs/ 'phris rten mar gad kyi lol gor bkris rtags rdzas brgyad dang rgyal srid rin po che bdun/ rgyal ba lnga pa'i phyag dril ngo ma gan dril gr+yu gsung shin tu legs ba shub ldan/

phyag rags thod pa la gser gyi skod bcing phra ldan phan dang shub bcas legs pa/ kheb gdan mthongs khad gsal bcas/ mi zhing rdo rje chos bdun gyi ngo bor brten bdag sogs sems can thams cad rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar 'god gsol 'debs phyir bdun mtshan bcu gsum phul ba'i mtshan dang por===chos dung dkar mo dar dkar dri med kyi mdzas pa bcas 'bul lam zhus pa gong du gsol ba 'debs pa'i don ri 'bras don smin yod pa mkhyen mkhyen*/ mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhes gsol ba 'debs pa lags/ de ltar smon pas dri gzhon gyi bskul ba'i/ rje bcu gnyis bdag po'i dkyi 'khor la/ mi mthun 'dzin sdug po mthar bskrad nas/ mtshan dpe'i gzi byin lham me zhabs brtan gsol/ 'di lta'i bdag gis lhag gsam dud dhu bhaḥ legs byas bskul gyi sgrogs pa'i rnga sgra la/ mchog gsum rje btsun bla mnga' mthun gyur bzhengs/ dge 'bras byang chen klong du sil gyur cig/ sarba maṅga lam// ༈ lcags 'brug thub bstan yang ri sgar du gser dngul gyi dbang bum rin chen sna bdun phyag dril bla bres sogs sbyor 'jags stsal skabs dpyad khra ljags brtsom mam kha yig tu/ bstan 'gro yongs kyi phan bde'i 'byung gnas dam pa 'phags mchog 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/ spyi 'jog gi tho chung*/ bstan 'gro yongs kyi phad bde'i 'byung gnas dam pa 'phags mchog 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/ rab tu gus pa'i zhu gsol de rgyal ba mnyam med nyid ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po cho spyi dang*/ bya brag klu zhabs gtis pa mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bye grag klu zhabs gnyis pa mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bstan pa rin po che 'di dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/

bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gang ji snyed 'tsho zhing bzhes pa rnams dang*/ khyad par bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje 'chang dngos bka' drin gsum ldan dam pa'i zhabs dpa bskal bagr+ya'i bu du brtan cing mdzad 'phrin yar zla ltar rgyas pa/ thub bstan chos grwa chen po 'di nyid du phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun mang du 'du zhing*/ tshangs par spyod phyir tshe mthar phyin te bslab gsum rnam dag chos spyod bcu la brtsan pa dang*/ de dag gi mthus 'jig rten spyi dang bye gra dbur stod kyi phyogs 'dir char chu dus su 'bebs shing*/ lo phyogs rtag tu legs pa nad yams 'khrug pa rtsod sad ser mu ge 'byung ba dgrar langs sogs mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi zhing*/ thams cad bde skye kyi dpal la spyod pa dang*/ khyad par bdag shākya'i dge sbyong bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan (20) gyi sgo gsum mi dge'i 'tshe ba las rgyal zhing*/ bstan 'gror pa'i lhag bsam gang mchigs gegs med yid bzhin 'grub pa sogs kyi chod du 'dus pa rgya mtshor bsnyen bkur nyin 'khyongs thog /spyi 'jogs su lha rdzas dri med med pas sne drangs bcas spyi 'jogs su 'bul lam zhus pa/ dngos dbyor pad rtsa ltar phra yang me tog mchod rdzas kyi dpe ltar dgyes pa chen pos bdag gir bzhes la gong gsol 'debs pa rnams re 'bras lhun gyi 'grub pa'i thugs 'dun nam yang mi 'dor ba ci nar mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu/ sa yos 'og min byang chub gling du phod ka/ phrag 'gel yos khug dngul rkang sogs sbyor 'jags gnang ba'i dpyad khra'i mgo brjod ljags brtsoms gnang ba/ kha yig tu thub dbang gnyis pa mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa 'phags mchog 'dus pa gr+ya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/ spyi 'jog gi tho chung*/ thub dbang gnyis pa mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bstan pa'i rtsa lag dam par gyur pa 'phags mchog 'dus sa rgya mtsho'i zhabs drung du/

rab tu gus pas zhu gsol/ deng rnam 'dren bzhi sa rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang*/ bstan pa de la ston pa gnyis par byon pa dpal ldan klu zhabs dam pa 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ ratna shrī'i bstan pa 'di nyid dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ de nyid 'dzin skyong spel gsum mdzad pa'i mgon po bla na 'phags pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bka' drin gsum ldan rdo rje 'chang drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pas dbus bstan 'dzin gyi skyos bu gang ji snyid bzhugs pa rnams zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing*/ rdo rje gdan mchog gnyis pa byang chub gling rin po che 'di nyid du phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun mang du 'du zhing*/ de dag kyang bslab sum rnam dag 'khor lo bzhi'i bya bas dus 'da' zhing bag yod bca' khrims las mi 'da' ba dang*/ de dag gi mthus 'jig rten spyi sgos su char chu dus su 'bebs shing*/ lo phyug rtag tu lesags pa/ phun tshogs 'byor dgus phyug cing*/ nad yams 'khrug rtsod mu ge sogs mi mthun rgud tshogs ming dang bral te kun kyang bde skyed rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa dang*/ khyad par bdag shākya'i btsun pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sgo gsum byang chub bsgrub pa'i bar chad dang*/ bstan 'gror sman pa'i bgyi ba mtham dag la mi mthun 'gal rkyen gyi tshogs zhi zhing*/ bdud bgegs log 'dren gyi 'tsho ba las gr+yal ste chos mthun pa'i yid 'dod lhun gyi 'grub pa sogs kyi ched du/ 'dus pa rin po cher nyid 'khyongs kyi bsnyen bkur sngon du 'gro ba'i spyi 'jogs su bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas zla ba'i mdangs (21) kyi sne drangs===bcas 'bul lam zhus pa dgyes pa chen pos bzhes la gong du gsol ba 'debs pa'i don re smin gyi thugs 'dun gzhar mi chad pa mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen zhu/ sarba maṅga lam// ༈ lcags 'brug grwa tshang du sku gsung thugs rten dngul chas cha tshang sogs sbyor 'jags gnang skabs kyi dpyad khra'i ljags brtsoms gnang ba/

kha yig tu/ phan bde'i rtsa lag dam pa 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i drung du*/ spyi 'jog tho gzhung*/ phan bde'i rtsa lag 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i drung du*/ zhu ba de gr+yal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang bye brag 'bri bstan rin po che dar zhing rgyal la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ de dag 'dzigan skyong spel ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyongs bu dam pa rnams dang*/ khyad par bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma rigs ku khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po rdo rje 'chang dongs mchog dang bcas zhabs pad bde ldan mgon po'i snang tshol 'jig bzhin par bskal pa rgyal mtsho'i bar du brtan cing*/ phyogs bcu'i dge 'dun rnams kyi bslab gsum rnag 'khor lob bzhi dang chos spyod bcu'i mdzad pas dus 'da' zhing*/ de dag gi mthu 'jig rten spyi sgos su char chu du 'bab log phyug rtag legs phun tshogs 'byor bas phyug cing bde sde rdzogs ldan gyi dpal la spyod pa dang*/ khyad rapa bdag shākya'i dge sbyorang bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sgo gsum gyi 'tsho ba mchis zhing zhing bstan 'gror smanapa'i bya ba gang yin gegs med lhun gyi grub pa sogs kyi ched du/ gong ma na rim gyi sku'i gam du gtsar ba'i 'dus tshogs rim pa tsher nyin mkhyengs bsnyen bskur gyi bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phye ba bskul nas/ spyi 'jogs su lha rdzas dri bral srid du ring bas sne drangs===bcas 'bul lam zhus par dngor 'byor padma'i dgos pa ltar phra yang dgyes bzhes ngos gosang gsol gyi don re smin gyi 'dun pa nam yang mi lhod pa zhu zhu lags/ ༈ chu rta gangs can mgon po ngag dbang blo bzang 'jam dpal bsni 'dzin tshul khrims rgyal mtshen dpal bzang po ri bo grub 'dzin gnyis pa'i 'jigs med dngong lnga'i khri chen por phebs skabs khri 'bul gyi 'bul khra ljags brtsoms mdzad pa 'di ltar/ kha yig tu

(22) ༄༅// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs ltar bcas 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon rgyal bdang phyag na padma thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po'i zhabs sen yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po'i drung du/ gus zhabs 'bri gung pa'i 'bul mtshon tho dad gsum 'gyur med puṇḍa ri ka'i do shal/ 'gro ngor sprul pa'i zlos gar nyin byed dbang*// kun snang zhabs sen yid bzhin nor bu'i drung du/ dad pa'i chu gter pha mtha' yangs pa'i sems/ lhag bsam bsamal byed dpal gyi rab phyung ba'i/ rba rlab g.yo ba lta'i grangs med lus/ yang dang sa la dud pa'i phyag bcas gsol/ ma chod pa'i yan lag gtis pa nyams kyi zan lag brgyad phyam 'tshal ba'i yan lag dang po/ ldan tshangs sras ma'i/ rig pa'i khyad par 'phrul gyi rdzing bu las/ dngos 'byor yid sprul gser gyi padmo'i 'phreng*/ mchod sprin kun bzang de zlar chas pas mchod/ bshags pa'i yan lags gsum pa/ yang yang thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ yang yang ma rig zhags pas dam 'khyurd pa'i/ yang yang sgrib gnyis las kyi bsags pa'i mun/ yang yang stobs bzhi'i bsil zer cho gas bshags/ rnam mang 'gro ba'i bsod nams legs khyung sngan kyes kyi nyer drangs pa'i/ gang nyin mo'i 'byung gnas dam pa mdzad pa'i 'od zer re rer yang*/ srid pa'i phun tshogs ma mang med pa'i/ rjes su yi rang pa'i lan lag bzhi pa/ mkhas mnyam 'gro tshogs padma'i tshal/ rang bzhan bde skyid rdzogs ldan sbyor ba'i rmad byung mdzad par rjes yi rangs/ gr+yal mtsho'i rdul snyed 'gro ba'i khams dbang bsam pa ji bzhani gang 'dul chos/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad rtsa bzhi'i dbyangs kyi mgul ba g.yas/ g.yas su 'khyil ba'i chos dung sgra dbyangs 'gogs med 'khor lo chos 'khor bar bar bskul ba'i yan lag lnga pa bskor bar gsol/ gsol btab ji bzhin lus can (23) khams 'di nam yang mi gtong rjes bzung 'tshal/ zhes yan bdun pa'i sgo nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i yan lag lnga pa yan gyi tshig rkang dbang po'i grangs kyi sngon gsus te deng rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyibastan pa rin po che la ston pa gtis par gyur pa dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse'i rang gzugs mgon po phyag na padma 'chang ba de nyid snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen du bsam bzhin sprul pa'i zlos gar sgyur te ngur smṛ gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba gang nyid gong ma ri byon gyi bsdi gnas ri bo grub 'dzin sprul pa'i gzhal med khang chen no'i chos kyi seng ge'i khri 'phang mthon por bstan pa mtha' dag gzungs su 'dzin pas mchad pa dang*/

rtsod pa dang*/ rtsom pa'i bya ba mtha' dag rang dbang du spyod pa'i rgyal thabs su phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun gyi mnga' gsol zhing*/ dkar phyogs lha rnams kyi shis pa'i me tog 'thor/ 'gro gsum dga' ba'i chos kyi rgyal rnga bar med du brdung*/ bkra shis dge ba'i dril chen rnam par bkrol ba'i sgra snyan phyogs kyi 'khor lor bgrim pa/ de ltu'i tshul la legs lam bye ba'i ji zhal dang chab cig par/ gzod ma nyid nas 'pho med dwangs ma'i sku gzhom gzhig dang bral ba ni brnyes/ mi zad rdo rje'i gsungs gi gsang mdzad bgyed pa ni mkhas/ don dam 'dus ma byas pa'i gsal ba mngon par byang chub ba la nyid tsher 'chel ba'i 'dod gsol gyi go rim ma dmigs mod kyang*/ ltar snang tsham du'ang phrog byed/ gnyis 'thung legs 'gro/ gtsug ldan mkhas lding gis mtshan pa'i 'jigs bral gdong lnga'i gdan bkod pa 'di la 'chi med mogan po'i snang tshul ji bzhin par zhabs zur rdo rje'i mdud pa nam yang mi bkrol bar gsol zhes lan gcig ma yin pa rnam pa kun tu gsol ba 'debs pa'i rten 'byung ===bcas dngos 'byor pad rtsa tar phra yang mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams rgyor dmigs te 'bul bar/ don gtanyis phun sum tshogs pa'i gzigs pa dngar ba dang*/ dad gus kyi snyom pa'i 'dod pa phyir mi gzhol ba mkhyen mkhyen mkhyen/ mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri 'phang mthon po'i steng*/ 'di gnas sho lo ka gsum bzhugs gsol 'debs pa'i yan lag drug pa/ mi gzhom rdo rje'i chosabadun ngo bo ru// mi dmigs lha lam zhig par ma gyur bar// mi 'gyur bde ldan mgon ltar zhabs brtan gsol// gzod nas 'phe med dwangs ma'i brnyes shing*/ gzhom bral rdo rje'i ngo bor dam bcas yang*/ ltar snang bskal pa brgya phrag du ma ru// rdo rje skyil krung yangs pa'i mdun ma bshig /rtse gcig gus pa'i gsol 'debs dri zhon gyis/

'gro mgon bcu gnyis bdag po'i dkyil 'khor la/ mi mthun nam mkha'i gyal mtshan phyir bsam nas/ mtshan dka'i gzig byin ldam mer 'bar gyur cig de skad legs byas lha yi dun rgyu bhiḥ lha bsam dbyu gunga'i bskul ba'i dbyangs kyi sgra/ yan lag bdun gyi rdzogs par mchod pa'i dges/ tshe rab phreng bar rjes 'dzin rgyur bsngo'o/ ༈ chu rtan skyabs mgon rgyal dbang dge ba bsngo yan lag bdun pa mchog gi yang srid khri bebs skabs skyabs mgon gr+yal tshab no min han rin po che 'bul khra zin bris/ (24) sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛrta las yi ge bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gro la rnams grangs brgyad stong chig brgya go gnyis yod pa'i nang mtshan nyis bdun brgya go rgyu 'jam pa'i gang zhes byas ba'i brastā ras legs par bcings pa'o// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse nus pa'i rang gzugs che/ 'jig rten dbang phyug bsam bzhin mtham bral ngog khams gsum 'gro ba'i dpal mgon bla na 'phags pa skyabs mchog rgyal tsham rin po che'i zhabs dpa gser gyi 'khor los mtshan pa'i dung du*/ gus phran 'bri gung pa'i 'bul tho lhag bsam yongs 'du'i me tog /sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bṛstā las yi ge bcu gsum pa shin tu skye 'gror rnam grangs brgyad stong chig brgya go gnyis las chig stong bdun brgya don gnyis snyan pa'i ngang pa zhes bya ba'i prastā ras mdzes par spud do// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun gyi gtsug tor rtser/ zhazhas sen zla ba'i me long rab bkod pa/ rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog zhabs padmor/ sgo gsum yan lag brgyad ldan mtshor// gus pa'i rba rlab lags pad kyi// mi phyed snying gar 'jug pa'i phyag// bagr+ya phrag brtsegs te gsol 'debs par// deng dus bsil ldan gsangs ri'i ljongs dbus su// 'jam mgon bla ma tshong kha pa chen pos/ chos srid bstan pa'i ba dan srid pa'i rtser/

bsgrong bar phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i khyed dbang bskur// gnam skos dga' ba brgya ldan pho brang che'i// lugs mnyams bzod dka'i 'khur chen nam mkha'i glang*// dge bcu'i bca' ba drag po'i grub char rgyun// nor 'dzin lus can ljang bde skyed sbyor/ khyad par thugs brtsen skye rengs bgyis drangs pas/ gangs can skyabs gcig nam mkha'i nor bu mchog lha lam rin chen khri 'phang mthor 'god pa'i/ bka' drin bsams bzhi gtsug tor sa la dud/ tshul 'di'i bdegs skyang lhun po'i lcog dam par/ dkar phyogs lha brgya rnam par rgyal ba'i rnga/ brkyang ba'i yon tan kun gsal mtha' dag la/ bkra shis chu 'khur ri chen dkrol 'di rmad/ de lta'i bkrin bsam na 'dzin rten khams/ rin chen bdun gyi byung bur bkang dbul kyang*/ 'khor mtha' ma mchis 'od te dngos 'byor dang*/ yid spul mchod pa'i sprin du bkod de 'bul/ zhes rdo rje dbyangs kyi gr+yal mo'i 'phrul gyis bslang pa'i baiḍūrma'i rgyus mang ches cher 'khrol ba'i dbyangs kyi mngon par zhu ba (25) deng gi dus dam pa mchag gi thugs bskyed smad po che'i mthus dus gsum gr+yal ba'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog snying rje'i gtor chen bsams bzhin mi'i srid pa bzung ba thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po'i sprul pa'i nyin byed dbang po gangs ljongs lha lam dbus kyi seng ga'i khri chen por zhabs sor gyi padmo rnams par bkod cing*/ gang gi chos srid bstan pa'i gdugs dkar nor ba'i yu ba nas 'degs par mdzad pas gang des 'dul bar bya ba'i zhing de'i gdul bya rnams bde skyi rdzogs ldan la spyod pa'i skal ba bzang po'i brtsen du gsol/ dpal ldan gyal ba'i gsang gsum 'khor lo'i dpyid/ gser mdog co paṇa 'chang ba'i bstan 'dzin rje/ mtha' yas 'gro ba'i dpal mgon dam pa mchog khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma zhabs brtan shog ris bral bstan pa'i gdugs dkar 'khor yug can/

bshad sgrub nor ba'i tog bcas srid pa'i rtser/ bsgrongs te lan bde'i bsil grib spro ba'i gnyen/ 'jigs med gdong lngu'i gdan la zhags bzhag mdzod/ gang gi byed po thog ma nyid nas khyed/ gzhom med rdo rje'i snying ser dam bca' yangs/ gdul bya'i zhing la thabs mkhas mdzad pa'i 'phrul/ ston pa de phyir bskal brgyad zhabs brtan gsol/ sarba maṅga lam/ chu lug zla tshes snyag lung chigs bsgyur skabs zhabs drung lhan rgyas la zhabs brtan zhu skabs 'bul khra ljags rtsems zin bris/ kha yig tu/ sdeb sbyor pa'i bṛsta las yi ge bcu gnyis pa la spyir rnams grangs bzhi stong go drug yod pa las nang mtshan chig stong chig brgya don gcig sa me tog 'phring ba'i srastā ra'o// (26) ngos don grub brgyud pa'i rtsa lag mtshungs med rnam badren dam pa zung gi zhabs pad gdong lnga'i btegs pa'i khri drung du// dngos 'bul cung zad kyi tho lhag bsam kunda'i chun so// rab 'byams mtha' yas zhing bzhugs rgyalakun gyi// ngo mtshar sprul snang sgyu 'phrul nyin byed dbang*// sgrub mthud bstan pa'i pad tshal rgyal mdzad pa// rnam 'dren dam pa zung gi zhabs drung du// dad pa gr+ya mtsho pha mtha' yas pa'i sems// lhag bsam zla ba'i dpal gyi bar 'phyur ba'i// rba rlabs rnams par rol pa'i dpag med lus// mngon par 'dud pa'i phyag bcas gang gsol na/ dngos 'byor yid kyi rol pa las byung ba'i// mchod pa'i prin tshogs ji snyid gang mchis kun// kun tu bzang po'i do zlar rab chas pas// stong gsum 'jig rten dog por bkang ste mchod// yang yang thob ma med ldan 'khor ba nas/ yang yang ma rig zhags pas dam 'khyud pa'i// yang yang sgrib gnyis las kyi bsags pa'i mun/ yang yang stobs bzhi'i zla bas smad par bgyis/ pha mtha' mi mngon 'gro khams rgya mtsho las// phan bzhed rgyas sras slob par bcas kun gyi// rmad byung mdzad pa kun la yid rangs shing*// rnam par dge tshogs gzhan yang de bzhin no// phyag brgyad chu rtsa bzhi'i 'gul pa yang*/

khyil ba'i mi zad skye ba la pa'i dung*// 'jig rten gsum bsrung chad pa sgra ldan pas// lus can khams 'di rjes su bzung mtshal lo// zhes yan lag bdun pas gyi tshig rkang*// grangs kyi sngon bsus nas de yang gr+yal bstan yang snying sgrub bagr+yud bstan pa'i rtsa lag rnam 'dren mtshungs med dam pa zung gi gzugs sku sa 'dzin mgon po gang nyid zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i gsol 'debs 'brel 'brel 'byung du dam pa gang gi bka' 'bangs tha shal snyom las chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi gus pa chen pos phul ba sarba maṅga lam// ༄༅// mtshur phu rgyal tshab rin po che'i mchog sprul kyi zhabs brtan gsol 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ oṃ swa sti/ bde chen zhing gi 'dren pa snang mtha' yas// mchog gsum bla ma yi dam zhe khro'i lha// mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyi/ bdag cag legs smon 'grub pa'i mthun gyur mdzod/ thugs bstan lha lam rnam par dag pa'i ngog /mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'od zer stong 'phro bas/ gdul bya bzang po'i dpa 'tshal bzhad mdzad pa/ dpal ldan bla ma bskal brgyar zhabs brtan shog /mgon khyod mi shig rdo rje'i gdan khri la/ rgyal mchog tshe mtha' yas kyi ngo bo ru// zhabs zung 'khor los mtshan pa bskal brgya'i bar/ nam yang mi g.yo zhabs pad brtan gyur cig /gang gi 'phrin las bsin las bsil zer can gyi 'od/ log 'dren nam mkha'i glang pos mi 'gogs par// rjes 'jug kun dā'i tshal chen rgyas pa dang*/ dge legs snang bas sa gsum khyab gyur cig ces pa yang 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rgyal tshab dam pa de nyid kyi mchag gi sprul sku rin po che zhabs pad brtan pa'i gsol 'debs 'di yang dam pa nyid kyi mchod dpon chos grags nas bskul ngor 'bri gung pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal// ༄༅// rtsa gsum gsol 'debs bzhugs so// ༈ rgyal ba kun 'dus mtsho skyes rdo rje dang*// dbyer med yi dam dbang chen dpa' bo'i zhabs// gang gi yum mchog rdo rje phag ma bcas// rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i lha la gsol ba 'debs/

bdag nyid skye ba 'di nas tshe rabs kun// rtsa gsum lha yi byin rlobs rjes su bzung*// yongs 'dzin dge ba'i bshes kyi nyer kyang zhing*/ bya ba ci byas chos su 'gro ba dang*/ bslab gsum rim gnyis nyams len mthar phyin cing*/ khyad par khrog ched thod brgal la brten pa'i/ snang ba bzhin zad dbyings rig dbyer med pa'i/ gzhon nu bum skur ye sangs rgyas bar shog /ces sa kham skyo zur pa'i grwa rigs chos 'dzin gyi ngor 'bri gung pa dharma sya dhwa dzas so// ༄༅// ma ṇi 'khor chen bzhengs pa'i smon lam bzhugs so// ༈ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing na gshegs bzhugs kyi/ mchog gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras chos bsrung bcas/ byin brlab mthu dang khyad par gsang sngags kyi/ yang snying yag drug 'khor chen 'di bzhings mthus/ bstan dang de 'dzin zhabs brtan 'dus sde 'phel/ 'jig rten spyi sgos mi mthun rgud pa sel/ bde skyid rdzogs ldan la spyod mkha' mnyam gyi/ 'gro rnams 'khor ba las thar rnam mkhyen gyi/ sa thob sbyinabadag gatsho byas nye 'brel rnams/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung kun byang 'phags pa yis/ go 'phang bde blag nyid du thob gyur cig /ces sprul nas/ ngos pa don gyi bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa/ rin chen seng ge'i zhabs la gsol= bson nams tshogs gnyis chu gter chen po las/ legs 'khrungs rgyal bstan yid bzhin dbang gi gyal/ mi nub chos kyi rgyal mtshan rtser 'chang ba/ dkon mchag ratna'i zhabs la= gyal ba'i 'byung gnas thugs rje'i 'od stong gis/ 'gro phan dam chos pad tshal rab rgyas nas/ smin grol sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston cher 'gyed pa/ dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang por= brtse chen snying rjes thugs rgyud yongs bltams pa'i/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi'i dam 'gro'i rgyun bzang pos/ lus can nyon mongs tsha gdungs sel mdzad pa/ bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul zhabs la= dus gsum phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ma lus kun/

gsang gsum mdzad 'phrin gcig bsdus grub 'dzin dgyes/ snyigs dus gyal kun las lhag bka' drin can/ padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs lag gsol= phyi ma'i dus kyang gar gyi bdang po yi/ spyan sngar dam bcas smin pa'i dge 'bras kyis/ 'khor ba ma stongs bar du sprul pa'i gar/ bsgyur mdzad dpal ldan bla mar= mthar thugasabaskal pa rgyal mtsho 'das pa na/ rin chen yang dag bsags pa'i zhig gams su/ sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas rab 'phags pa/ dpal brtsegs rgyal por 'gyur der= de ltar btsun bla ma mchog nyid la/ bdag sogs bar tu gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ dngos dbang po mtshan dpe'i 'od snang 'bum du g.yo ba gang nges pa lnga ldan gyi ngo bo/ rdo rje lta mi zhig pa/ g.yu drung ltu mi 'gyur ba rgyal mtshan lta bur mi nub par ji srid rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po 'jig rten du ma byon bar de srid du zhabs brtan pa dang*/ gsung gsang lan lag drug cu'i dbyangs su snyan pa de las zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos rnga bo che yang dag par 'khrol bas 'gro kun ma rig pa'i gnyid las slong bar mdzad pa dang dang*/ chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa bde ba chen pa'oi rang bzhin las byung ba'i thugs rje'i rang mdangs 'gags pa med pa'i lcags gyus lus can gaṅga'i rul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa de dag rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la sbyor zhing 'gor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur gyi bar du/ bde ldan mgon pa'i snang tshul ji bzhin par/ 'pho 'gyur dbri gang bral ba 'phrog byed/ gnyis 'thung legs 'gro/ gtsug ldan mkha' lding gi mtshan pa'i 'jigasas bral gdongs lnga'i khri la zhabs brtan par bzhugs gsol 'debs pa'i rten 'byung tsam du/ dngos 'byor nyung zad tsam zhig rab 'byams kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin du dmigs te/ sgrib bral ye shes kyi gzigs ngor 'char ba'i spyan lam rin po cher bstar ba la khri 'debs zla zhun thags su byas pa bkris ri khams bkra ba da ring thabs shes/

stan dkar rdo rje rgya gra gyi re khas sprud pa zung*/ rin chen gnyis pa'i maṇḍal lha gos sna lnga'i chun 'phyang gi brgyan pa/ sku rten 'chi med mgan pa snang mtha' yas pa'i sku brnyan/ gsung rten 'phags pa tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i mod thugs rten pad spung lam ma===bcas 'bul ba dngos 'byor pad rtse ltar pharpayang me tog mchod rdzas kyi dpe bzhin dgyes pa chen pos bdag gir bzhes pa mdzad du gsol/ sems can khams rnams yal bar mi 'dor gr+yal dang de sras rang bzhin kyang*/ snyigs ma'i mthu chen 'bar bas dkrugs pa'i 'gro la gzigs pa yol ba'i thugs/ zhig khams gzhan du dgongs pa gang zhig mya ngan mi 'da'i gdan khri la/ mya ngan las mi 'da' bar bzhugs gsol 'debs pa'i yan lag sho lo ka gsum// chos bdun ldan pa rdo rje'i ngo bor 'pho 'gyur bral bar rtag brtan gsol/ ris bral bstan pa'i gdugs dkar 'khor yug can/ ngos don snying po'i tog bcas srid rtser bsgrengs/ phan bde'i dpal yon 'bul du 'phro ba'i gnyon/ rnam 'dren zung gi zhabs pad brtan gyur cig/ de skad lhag bsam lha yi dundhu bhiḥ yan lag bdun gyi dbyug gus bskul ba'i sgras/ 'gro kun ma rig gnyid slong smin grol rgyun/ byang chub bar du rjes 'dzin rgyur bsngo'o/ sarba maṅga lam// 'di gras mang du byung bdug kyang zin bris rnams mos 'dod so so'i dad rten dpe sogs la zhus nas 'khyar ba slar 'khu bsdus kyi 'di gshi 'god dgos yod/ zhu dag legs par zhus//

(27) (ca) ༄༅// lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i bsnyen yig zin bris skyud byang du bkod pa bzhugs so// gu ru badzra dhā ra na ma/ 'dir rigs 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug gr+yan dpal 'bri gung sa rig 'dzin chos kyi grags par skyob pa nyid kyi dngos su stsal ba'i lam zab bla ma bsgrub pa'i myur lam/ tshe gcig sangs rgyas thob pa'i gdams ngag 'di nyid nyas su len par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ smin las dbang gi chu bos brgyud smin cing zab lam ma bu rnams kyi lung 'khrid man ngag rnams legs par mnos nas nyams su blang dgos te/ ci lta bus len zhes na gegs sel las phyi nang gsang ba de kho na'i/ bsgrub pa bzhi la sbyor dngos rjes/ go log dang ni gzhan dag nas/ rigs 'gres rgyas 'gob rang bzo dang*/ dmigs pa mi gsal sngags ma dgang rdzogs (28) rim mi shes brtson pa chung*/ de sogs 'bad pas spang bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin de dag spang nas nyabs su blang ba ni/ dang po phyi sgrub byin rlabs kun 'byung la gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro ni cog na nang re bzhin rigs rnams ma'i gsol 'debs byed pa'ang yod la 'grub na rung*/ stan bde bar bsam gtan chos bdun dang ldan pas/ dam 'byor rnyed par dka' ba nas/ nyes dmigs bsam yan thun bzhi ka'i mgor lanag gsum re bton nas don nges sa bya/ rang mdun gyad dang seng ge'i khrir nas chos bsrung gsal yan gyi skyabs yul rnams bsgom nas mchod bstod oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wa ra argham nas shasta'i bar gyi mchod/ rje sangs rgyas thabs cad 'dus pa'i sku nas/ bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bstod par 'os sa sogs dang*/ spro na bstod par 'os pa'i 'gor/ mgon po thugs rje sogs/ dag pa sogs grol na grol sogs/ 'jam dbyangs phyag na sogs/ mtshe ba gtsigs shing 'jig sogs/ bcom ldan 'das sogs bya/ de nas bla ma mchog gsum sogs/

skyabs 'gro dang phyag mnyam por bya/ mthun mthar skyabs yur rang par bzhag thun bzhi ka'i mthar bsngo ba ni/ bdag dang 'khor 'das ma tshar re bya/ de ltar thun bzhi re byas pa'i skyabs 'gro dang phyag gnyis la bdun gcig bya/ dhor sems bsgom bzlas kyi skabs su yang*/ thun bzhi kar mgos dam 'byor rnyed dka' nas blang*/ rang gi spyi bo nas/ dbang lha bsdim bar dang*/ mchod bstod ni/ oṃ badzra pa tā sa pā ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shasta'i bar gyi mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' che/ nas phyag 'tshal phyag na rdo rje la/ slar yang yig brgya bzlas pa'i tshe/ nas dri bral shel sgong bzhin nas/ rang lus dag pa'i ngo bor bsam bar 'don/ thun bzhi'i mthar gsol gdabs/ mgon po dbag ni mi shes nas bdag la skyabs bar lan gsum dang*/ dhor sems dgyes tshul nas rang lus dag pa'i ngo bor bsam bar 'don/ thun bzhi ka'i mjug bsngo ba gong bzhin bya ba sogs kyi zla ba gcig dang zhag dug la yig brgya 'bum phrag gcig thems pa dgos/ maṇḍal skabs su yang thun bzhi ka'i mgor/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas blang*/ skyabs 'gro (29) gsum re dang*/ dhor sems sgom bzlas kyi yig brgya bdun nam nyer gis dhor sems bsdus/ tshogs zhing sngar gyi skyabs yul lhar gsal btab gong bzhin arghaṃ nas shasta'i bar mchod/ maṇḍal so bdun ma'i tshom bu bkod de 'dod gsol lnga ldan tshar re'i mjug hūṃ hrīḥ dri med gling bzhi nas bla med mchog gi dngos glub stsal du gsol/ rab dang yan lag bdun pa/ mnyes phyir maṇḍal bzang po sogs kyi ring phyag kyang 'tshal/ thun bzhi ka'i mjug tu tshogs zhing rang la bsdu zhing bsngo ba gong ltar*/ de lta bu bdun gcig dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs su yang*/ thun bzhi kar mgos dam 'byor rnyed dka' nas blang*/ skyabs 'gro yig brgya mgos dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas blang*/ skyabs 'gro yig brgya gong ltar la/ maṇḍal tshar gcig gis tshogs zhing bsdus nas/

rang mdun gyad dang seng ge'i khrir nas/ char sprin lta bur dkrig dmigs nas/ gong bzhin argha'i nas shasta'i bar gyi mchod cing*/ mos gus rtse gcig gis/ rigs rnams kun gyi dbang phyug ye shes sku/ nas rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog yan tshar gsum bdun gang rigs mjug tu dpal ldan bla ma/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug nas/ 'bras bu stsol cig yan gang thon bya/ than bzhi ka'i mjug tu/ dpal ldan bla ma mtshan rnams kun rang bzhin nas/ 'od zhu rang gi spyi bor thim bar gyi dbang bzhi yid ches par blang zhing bsngo ba gong ltar bya/ de nas bla ma mchog gsum sogs/ skyabs 'gro dang phyag mnyam por bya/ mthun mthar skyabs yul rang sar babazhag thunag bzhi ka'i mthar bsngo ba ni/ bdag dang 'khor 'das ma tshar re bya/ de ltar thun bzhi re byas pa'i skyabs 'gro dang phyag gnyis la bdun gcig bya/ dhor sems bsgom bzlas kyi skabs su yang*/ thun bzhi ka'i mgor dal 'byor rnyed dka' nas blang ba'i snga thun de ltar la nyir/ nyin dgu dgong thun gsum la/ rang snying dbus su mumi ser por nas blang bas kyang 'thus/ rang snying dbus su mum ser po nas/ lhun gru 'od kyi sku ru gsol/ zhes pa'i bar 'don/ yang rang nyid bstan pa'i bdag po yi/ dpral bar zla dkyil= mgrin par padma dmar= āḥl mtshan sngags thugs kar nyid dkyil/ hūṃ mthar sngags 'phreng mthing gas bskor/ bar gsal btab oṃ āḥgu ru shui nas ma hā mu driddhi pha la hūṃ tshal gcig zhes bzlas dpral ba'i sngags 'phreng las/ zla 'od= 'jig rten gsum= mati mug= sku yi rdo rje sngon byas bsam= matsan sngags bagr+ya phrag gcig bzla/ de bzhin du mgrin pa snying kha'i sngags 'phreng gi dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas (30) 'gro ba'i sgrib sbyong mtshan sngags brgya re brgya re bzla/ slar yang dpral ba'i sngags 'phreng las/ zhes pa nas rang nyid kyi gnas gsum la'ang 'od zer pro ba'i dmigs pa gsal ba'i ngang nas mtshan sngags brgya re brgya re sum brgya bzla/

slar yang gnas gsum sngags rnams las/ zhes pa nas byin brlab tshe bsod rgyas par bsam bar bton nas/ skabs 'dir bsnyen pa gang thon 'bad thun bzhi ka'i mthar rdzogs rim ni/ bskal bzang tshogs rnams 'od zhu ba nas/ ci gnas mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ dge ba 'di yi bdag sogs 'gro ba rnams/ myur du dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur cig /'gro ba sems cin gcig kyang ma lus pa/ thams cad de yi sa la 'god par shog ces dang bdag 'khor ma tshar re bcas/ phyi sgrub zla ba gcig la gang thon mdzad pa phyag len yin/ ༈ gnyis pa nang sgrub 'khor 'das rang grol la gnyis las/ snga thun la phyi sgrub mgos dam 'byor rnyed dka' sogs/ thun dang pon nas thun drug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor yan bya zhing thun gzhan gsum la mi dgos/ gsang sgrub dang de kho na nyid la'ang 'dis 'gros shes bar bya/ dang po dmigs pa'i dbang gi rgyud sbyang ba ni/ nang sgrub 'gor*/ rang mdun gyad dang seng khri'i steng*/ nas hūṃ mthing gsal gdab mchod pa 'bul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de wa ḍā ki ni sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ nas shasta pra titstsha swā hāḥ bar gyi mchod cing lus kyi phyag 'tshal ba dang mnyam du/ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku dang*/ hūṃ hrāṃḥ dri med gling bzhi nas bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ nas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'gro rnams sgrol bar shog yan tshar gsum ldan bdun tsam sar bsda nas bstod pa/ rje sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sho lo ka'i gang gi drin sho lo kas bstod/ dpal ldan bla ma sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dwags po bka' brgyud nas/ 'bras bu stsol zhig bar tshar nyer gcig long bsdun bton nas gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pa'i tshe/ yab yum dpral ba'i oṃ dkar las/ bdud rtsi= dpral bar= sbyangs nas rdo rje'i ska ru bsam rim bzhin rdo rje gsum du gyur par bsam yan sngon 'gro dbang dang*/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/

rang gnas 'og min zhig khams nyid/ nas 'od kyi lus can gsal bar bsgom gyi bar dang*/ lha rnams sku las 'od 'phros pas/ nas dbang lha rnam par spyan drangs mchod/ oṃ gu ru badzra ā tsarya puṣpaṃ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu mal/ zhes pa'i gsol btab dbang lha rnams/ bum pa bdud rtsi gang thog nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ta sogs nas dbang bskur rgyas btab lha bsdim pa dang*/ slar yang lha rnams (31) bdag gyur cig /ces pa yang mo 'khor rgyan dbu mdzad lhun grub kyi bskul ngor 'bri ban chos med snyoms las sa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi bris pa'o/ ༄༅// mchog sprul myur byon gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ ༈ rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i zhing na bzhugs pa yi/ mchog gsum bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang*/ chos srung dam can rgya mtsho bcas rnams kyis/ re ba'i 'bras ba 'grub pa'i bden tshogs stsol/ grangs med sngon sangs rgyas kyang 'gror brtse bas/ sngon gyi dam bcas skur ston pad dkar 'chang*/ ratna shri'i bstan pa skyong ba'i slad/ rje btsun bla ma'i mchog sprul myur gsal shog rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgyal mtsho'i phyag bdag tshe/ chos dbyangs ngang du snyom par mi bzhugs par/ gsol 'debs rtse gcig gdung shugs kyi bskul tshe/ gzugs sku'i rnam rol gsal bar mdzad du gsol/ gdul bya'i bson nams shar ri'i phrag gong nas/ thugs bskyed bsil zare bya ba 'bul 'phro bas/ rjes mjug kun da'i tshal chen rgyas mdzad pa/ mchog sprul zla tshes gsar pa myur gsal shog sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin mchog rab lhun po'i rtser*/ theg gsum rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang du/ mchog gi sprul sku shes bya'i spyan stong ldan/ bar chad min g.yul las rgyal gyur cig /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khyams pa'i las rnams/ thar lam (32) gnas gsum du/ 'gor lo dkar dang padma dmar/ nas ma yengs rtse gcig sgom par bya'o/

yang dang slar yang dpral ba'i oṃ rnams las/ 'od dkar 'phros pa'i rang lus kyi sgrib sbyangs sprul sku thob bsam zhing*/ oṃ yig brgya rtse bzla/ de bzhin du 'grin pa snying ga'i 'don dmigs gsal nas/ āḥdang hūṃ so sor brgya re bzla/ slar yang dpral ba'i oṃ rnams las/ slar yang dpral ba'i oṃ rnams las/ 'od dkar 'phros pa'i 'gro lus kyi/ sgrib sbyangs sprul sku thob bsam zhing*/ oṃ brgya rtsa bzlas/ de bzhin du mgrin pa snying ga'i mdog dmigs sgyur nas a dang hūṃ so so brgya re bzlas/ slar yang gnas gsum yi ge las/ dkar dmar mthing ga'i 'od 'phros pas/ phyi snod 'jig rten 'og min zhing*/ nang bcud 'gro drug bla ma'i sku/ zhes bsgyur nas/ rdo rje 'chang dbang nam mkha'i mdog zhes pa nas/ 'od kyi lus can gsal bar bsgom/ yan gong bzhin 'dab skyor bya/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyis/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas/ dbang lha'i rnam par spyan drangs mchod/ oṃ gu ru badzra sogs gong bzhin dang*/ dbang bskur so sor rgyas gdab nas/ dbang lha rnams gatsho la thim/ slar yang lha rnams gsum du/ 'khor lo dkar dang padma dmar/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar oṃ yig dkar nas/ rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ yig mthing*/ kun gyi gnas gsum yi ge las/ 'od 'phros= 'gro kun = kun gyi lus= ngag nas= thugs ni mi g.yo ting 'dzin nags/ yig ge gsum ci 'grub bzla thun bzhi ka'i mthar rdzogs rim ni/ rang gi gnas gsum las spros pa'i/ nas cham badhal ye khyab ngang du bzhag dge ba 'di yi sogs dang*/ bsngo ba bdag 'khor ma tshar re bya zhing snga thun ma gtogs thun gsum ka'i mgor rang mdun gyad dang seng ge nas len/ de ltar bu'i nang sgrub zla ba gcig la gang thun bya'o/ ༈ gsum pa gsang sgrub ye shes rgya mtsho la gnyis las/ dang po 'gro bsam gtan gyi dbang ni/ snga thun la sngon 'gro gong ltar bya zhing*/

thun bzhi kar gsung gsang sgrub 'gor/ rang mdun gyad dang seng ge'i khrir/ zhes pa nas blang*/ dkar dmar mthing 'oda'abar bas mtshan/ bar song rjes/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru de ba wa ḍa ki ni sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ nas shapta'i bar mchod/ rje sangs rgyas 'dusasku'i bstod/ gsol gdab ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes pa'i sngags kyi gsol 'debs 'di badya re tsam gang 'grub bton nas/ de skad gsol ba btab pa'i mod/ bla ma yab yum snyoms zhugs pa'i/ mkha' gsang nas/ lhan skyes ye shes rtogs par byas yan gyi/ dga' bzhi'i dmigs dbang blang zhing/ slar yang gong gi sngags kyi gsol 'debs bdun nam nyer gcig tsam bton nas/ slar yang gsol ba btabs pa'i tshe/ bla ma yab yum snyom nas bde stong gnyis med mngon su du/ rtogs par bsam la 'bad par bya'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ rdo rje rin chen padma dang*/ rgya gram zhes pa nas slar yang 'od gyi rgyal ba rnams/ dbang lha rnam par spyan drangs mchod/ oṃ gur ru badzra a tsarya puṣpam pra titstsha swā hāḥ'i bar nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga te a nu rā ga ya mi sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur zhing*/ sgrib sbyangs chu lhag 'khyil ba las/ gatsho bo yab yum nas/ ci gnas yun rin gsal snang 'don/ bar dang rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ gatsho 'gor bcas pa thams cad kyi/ zhes pa nas sems ni gsar rgya bsal zhes rdor bzlas brgya tsam/ bra bar bsam zhes dhor bzlas brgya tsam/ brjed ldan 'od du 'bar ba sgom/ bar gyi spro bsdu'i dmigs pa dang*/ mjug la dhor bzlas brgya phrag sogs bzlas/ thun bzhi ka'i mthar bsdu rim ni/ rang gi gnas gsum yi ge las/ rang gi gnas gsum yi ge las/ 'od 'phros nas/ dmigs med ngang du mnyam par bzhag /bsngo bas rgyas gdab gong bzhin bya/ de ltar nyin re la thun bzhi re bya zhing*/

bzhi po re re la cha drug tu bcad nas cha dang po'i yun la mdun mkhar bla ma gsal 'debs pa dang*/ sngags kyi gsol 'debs dang*/ dga' ba bzhi'i dmigs dbang len pa sngon 'gro dang*/ cha bzhi'i yun tsham la bskyed rim gsal zhing rnag dag dran pa nga rgyal brtan pa'i gsal snang 'don/ cha gcig gi yun dhor bzlas dang rdzogs rim bsngo ba dang bcas pa'o/ de ltar gsang sgrub zla ba gcig la gang thon bya'o// ༈ bzhi pa the khe na nyid du sgrub pa spros bral mthar phyin la gnyis las/ sngon 'gro gong bzhin dang*/ dang po rang byin brlab pa ni/ de kho na nyid 'gor/ mdun mkhar gyad dang seng chen gyi/ zhes pa nas/ swa ser ha ljang gis mtshan bsam/ zhes pa'i bar dang*/ mchod pa ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta gu ru nas arghaṃ shasta'i bar gyi mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rje'i sangs rgyas 'dus sku gang rigs kyi bstod/ rje bstod par 'ong pa yang bya dad mos brtan sos gsol btab ni dpal ldan bla ma/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug/ zhes pa nas/ don gnyis lhun grub/ 'bras bu rtsol cig gi bar gsol 'debs lan gsum lnga bdun sogs bton/ de tshe lha gsum dpral ba yi oṃ

(33) dkar gsum gsum sgril/ sku yi yon tan rdzogs par bsam/ yang dpal ldan bla ma sogs kyi gsol 'debs gsum lnga bdun gang rigs bya zhing*/ slang yang gsol btab mgrin pa nas/ 'od dmar gsung gi yon tan rdzogs par= dpal ldan bla ma sogs kyi gsol 'debs gsum ldan bdun gang rigs/ slar yang gsol btab thugs ka nas/ 'od mthing = thugs ka'i yon tan rdzogs par bsam/ dpal ldan sogs kyi gsol 'debs gsum lnga bdun gang rigs/ slar yang gsol btab mus rdzogs nas/ 'od ser= yon tan dngos grub rdzogs= dpal ldan sogs kyi gsol 'debs gsum lnga bdun gang rigs/ slar yang gsol btab gsang ba nas/ 'od ljang = phrin las kyi yon tan ma mus rdzogs par bsam/ dpal ldan bla ma sogs kyi gsol 'debs gsol 'debs gsum lnga bdun gang rigs/ slar yang gus pas gsol btab tshe/ 'das dang zhes pa nas sangs rnam dang dbyer med bsam/ zhes rang byin brlab pa'o/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ seng gyad glang po rte mkha' lding*/ zhes pa nas gsal snang nges par rnyed par bya/ yan dang rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ dkar po/ rdo rje'i mtha' mar sngags 'dis bskor/ oṃ āḥgu ru badzra sogs/ mtshan sngags rnams rim par bskor ba'i 'don dmigs gsal bzhin pas/ tshul 'dus sngags 'phreng la thim bsam/ mtshan sngags sbrail nas gang thon bya zhing*/ sngags 'phreng bskor lugs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i snyed kha'i rdo rje'i phyi rol rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan sngags/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku'i phyi rol rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan sngags sbrel lusag sngon du rdo rje 'chang gi mtshan sngags dang*/ de nas 'jig rten mgon po'i mtshan sngags/ de rjes rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan sngags rjes mar byas pa'i mtshan sngags gsum ka sbrel nas bzla ba yin/ dbyangs gsal rten 'brel snying po sngags bkod pa ma gtogs ngag tu bzla mi dgos/ sbrel lugs dpare brjod na/ oṃ āḥgu ru badzra dhraṃkra ratna shridharma kirti padma dhwa dza ma hwa mu dra siddha pha la hūṃ

zhes bya ba yin 'di yan mtshan bcas rdo rje'i bslas pa'o/ mtshan med rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ sngags 'phreng spro bsdu sngar bzhin la/ sngags rnams g.yas su drag 'khor ba'i 'od kyi zhes pa nas/ thim pas gzi 'od 'bar bar bsam/ sngags rnams ngag gi mi bzla bar/ yid kyi ma yengs bzla bar bya/ yid bzlas brgya phrag gcig bzlas nas/ slar yang rdo rje hūṃ bcas las/ 'od (34) mthing bdud rtsi sogs nas/ sgrib sbyangs me long lta bu yi/ ye shes mngon du gyur pa byas/ mtshan sngags yid kyi nyer gcig bzlas/ de bzhin du/ slar yang rdo rje hūṃ= 'od zer bdud rtsi rab 'phros pas/ sogs nas/ de rnams kyi nang nga rgyal gyi/ sgrib sbyangs mnyam nyid kyi ni/ ye shes mngon du= mtshan sngags yid bzlas nyer gcig dang*/ slar yang rdo rje hūṃ= 'od dmar bdun rtsi rab= sogs nas de rnams kyi ni 'dod chags kyi/ sgrib sbyangs so sor rtogs pa yi/ yi shes mngon= mtshan sngags yid bzlas nyer gcig dang*/ slar yang rdo rje hūṃ= 'od ljang bdud rtsi= sogs= de rnams kyi ni 'dod chags kyi/ sgrib sbyangs so sor rtogs pa yi/ ye shes = mtshan sngags yid bzlas nyer gcig dang*/ slar yang rdo rje hūṃ bcas las/ 'od dkar bdud rtsi rab= rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku gang zhing*/ de yi spu'i= 'od dkar ches mang = 'jig rten gsum mgon sku nang = de yi ba spu'i khung rnams nas/ 'od dkar bgrang yas phyogs bcur 'phros/ rigs drug sems can yongs la phogs/ de rnams kyi ni gti mug gi/ sgrib sbyangs chos kyi dbyings kyi ni/ ye shes mngon du gyur pa byas/ mtshan sngags yid bzlas nyer gcig bzla zhing rigs lngar 'di ltar bsgyur dgos so/ don dam rdo rje'i bzlas pa ni/ sku dang sngags 'phreng gsal ba'i ngang*/ sos nas rang rigs bla ma'i dgos par blta/ bar 'don sgom sbrag te dar cig ma yengs par mnyam par bzhag dbyings rigs bsre ba ni
