zung 'jug rdor bzlas la/ dab gi sems nyid spros bral dang*/ sogs nas dbyer med ngang du cham gyi bzhag/ ces mnyam gzhag gang cog bya/ thun bzhi ka'i mjug tu/ rdzogs rim ni rang gnas sa bon 'od zer gyi/ zhes sogs nas/ 'dzin med bsgom pas rtogs med 'grub/ bar dang bsngo ba bdag 'khor ma'i rgyas gdab cing spyod lam la 'jug go /de lta bu'i lam zab bla ma bsgrub pa'i bsnyen pa stan thog gcig la/ sngon 'gro zla ba gnyis/ dngos gzhi phyi nang gsang ba ba dekho na bcas bsgrub pa bzhi po zla re zla re la gang thon byas pa'i yongs sdoms zla ba drug gi dus bsnyen them par bya/ gong ma'i phyag bzhes rnam par dag pa yin cing*/ snga thun la ngag byin rlabs/ dbyangs gsalaye dhar 'gyur sngags dang*/ thun mtshams rnams su 'gyur sngags/ 'phreng ba byen rlabs kyi sngags dang*/ spyod lam sogs spang blang rnams bsnyen sgrub yig chung dang mthun pa nyams su blang zhing*/ bdag bskyed rgyun 'khyer rgyas bsdus gang cag dang mdun bskyed las byang cho ga gzhung tshar re bsrang la/ tshogs byin rlabs nas tshogs lhag yan (35) bsangs pa'i grangs brgya rtsa brgyad/= bsnyen pa kha skong sbyin bsregs 'bul ba dang bcas/ bsnyen sgrub bzhin dpyis phyin la byi zhing*/ rgyun khyer rgyal bdu gang rigs dam bca' ma chag cing zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad/ bcu bco lnga nyer lnga*/ gnam gang sogs la las byang yid bzhin nor bu brten pa'i sgrub cing mchod pa dang*/ bdag 'jug tshogs mchod sog sa gang cog bya/ rtsa rlung rdo rje'i 'phreng ba dang rdzogs rim mnyam yangs mtha' yangs bla sogs zab mal ma bu rnams slob dpon gsung gi gsang ba las blang ste nyams su blang bar bya'o/ de ltuni lo rgyus las/ lam zab 'di dang phrad pa'i mis/ dam gatshang nyams len la 'bad cings thun 'dzin dam bcas ma chag na/ skye ba 'de 'og brgyud pa'i tshe/ lha mi'i go 'phang gtogs pa/

ngan song gsum dang lha min dngas*/ logs pa'i skye ba blang srid na/ dam pa nga yi 'gro ba bslus/ de phyir gces par 'dzin pa dang*/ gdams pa 'tsho shes spyad par bgyis/ des na bdag gzhan ma lus pa'i/ don gnyis 'grub la tsheg med do/ zhes gsungs pa bzhin rjes mjug rnams kyi snying la bcang nas nyams len la brtson pa 'tshal lo/ de ltar lam zab bla ma sgrub pa'i nyams len byed lugs len byed lugs zani bris 'di yang dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhal lung bzhin dharmā dhwa dzas rang gi skyud byang du bris sa lam zab nyams su len pa rnams la phan thogs par 'gyur cig/ sarba maṅgalam// (36) (cha) ༄༅// sga sa rab bzang la gnang ba'i zhal gdams bzhugs so// skyabs dkon mchog rtsa gsum ma lus pa/ yongs gcig tu bsdus pa'i bdag nyid can/ drin 'khor med padma'i mtshan can la/ yid gus pas btud de phyag bgyi'o/ khyed dad ldan dkon mchog rab bzang gi chos zhal gdams kyi yi ge 'dod na yang*/ bdag thub bstan snying po'i sgor zhugs shing*/ rje gsum ldan gyi bla mas rjes su skyang*/ las skal ba dman pa'i bstan 'gro'i don/ ming btag pa'i rnams g.yeng dkor zas kyi/ dus rtag tu spyod pa'i gzhan dag la/ lam bzang por dkri ba mi nus pa'i/ de med zhing yod rdzus gdams pa zhig /tshig bcal bcol smras nyes ltu rgyu/ yin mod kyang slob bu nan (37) ches sas/ ngo ma bzlog cung zad tsam smras na/ spyir ngan song 'khor ba mtha' med la/ lus dam 'byor thos pa nyid skar tsam/ de thob par dka' zhing 'jigs kyang sla/ long spod tshe chos la ma brtson par/ shes bzhin du sdig la spyod gyur na/ gnar med pa'i dmyal ba la sogs par/ dus bskal par bzhugs las 'os ma mchis/ tshul des na nyams len zab mor 'bung*/ blo 'khor bar zhen logs zhugs pa bzang*/ de 'on kyang 'chi ba mi rtag kho/ snying rus pa'i gting nas ma skyes na/ slar blo log 'khor bar 'jug nyan che/

chos rtse ba thun mong ma yin pas/ sngon 'gro rnams yin mod de dag kyang*/ tsheg rkam po'i bya slor ma song bas/ blo rgyud la 'dres ngos gal che zhings/ sor rab dang byang sems sngags sdom sogs/ lkog ngos tshol chos su ma song bar/ mig 'bras tar bsrung ba shin tu gces/ byams snying rje byang chub sems mchog de/ mkha' mnyam la snying nas bskyed lo ngang*/ don gnyis bshes tsham la'ang med pa mang*/ des rdzogs byang thob pa'i re thog chod lag gtam ngag 'khyam ngag 'khyal 'dres pa'i phreng shug rom/ dung mang pos brgyan yang yi re mug rje bla ba bla ma dhor 'chang dngos snyam pas/ sems 'gyur med dad pas gsol 'debs 'bung*/ rang 'gu na sangs rgyas dngos yin zer/ cung ma 'dod rang gi bden pa sgrubs/ des dam nyams las byin brlabs kyi kho thag chod/ kun hril gyi sgril na phyag rgya che/ yid 'khrul 'byam sna bskyil zhi gnas dang*/ sems rang ngo rjon lta'i lhag mthong gnyis thabs su du mas gtan la 'bebs par gces/ lar gnas 'gyu'am gang ltar yang*/ dran yongs med lhug par skyong ba zab/ deng skabs kyi sgom chen phal po ches/ sems zhi gnas brtan pa de kho na/ bsgom bzang por 'dzin kyang de nyid kyi/ sa lam dang sangs rgyas thob mi srid/ las dge ba mtshan bcas mtshan med kun/ yongs ma rgan 'gro drug rdzogs byas gi/ sar 'god pa'i bsngo smon gnad (38) smin gces/ chos khe grags ched byas don 'bras bu/ rang bde skyed tsam du smon pa yis/ tshul de 'dras dge 'bras chus zos sa/ don de phri de dag yid la gnogs/ ral snying por dril zhing gdams pa ni/ chos sang byed snang byed grabs bshes ngang*/ khong lho phyogs pas dbang med 'gugs nges pas/ chos dam khom ma byed ya'ur 'bad/ dbu phyag rdzogs zhi byed la sogs pa/ mang yod kyang dgongs mthun kha tshang ba/ lam zab mo lnga ldan khyer re bde/ sgos phyag chen dkar po gcig thub 'di/

sa myur 'grod 'chi bsod bdud rtsi'i sman/ yid mod kyang nad pa'i sman skyal dang*/ zas bzang po ka ra bu ram bzhin/ sman ma btang zhing mngar ma bzos bzhin/ nyam ma slang tshig skam dpe lus kyis/ phan srid pa dgun dus gru char bzhin/ don de rnams gang dran gang thon su/ gtam zhal gdams kyi ming gnyan btags pa de/ khyod nyin rdzong grwa rigs rab bzang gis/ dgos zer ba'i ngag mi bcog pa'i phyir/ gyi nam ba dharma'i ming gi bris/ sgru pas rgya stag ljong du char 'bebs la phebs skabs gnang ba ka smad sum cu ma bzhugs so/ ༈ ka dag gdod ma'i mgon dang mtsho skyes rdo rje'i/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir re brag rdzu 'phrul zhabs bcag byin rlabs// ga la'i gnas kyi nang mtshan byang phyogs gter sgrom brag dkar// nga cag skal ldan don gnyams dngos grub len pa'i zhing mchog /cang ti dril bu'i sgra yi ma bod dpa' bo ḍākki// cha lugs ma nges sna tshogs sprin phung lta bur thims shing*// ja ril bhandha'i brtsigs pa'i raksha srin po'i rgyal kham// nyams kyi snang ngor shar yang tha mal brag dkar bkod mdzes// ta thā gā ta gnyis pa rje btsun thod 'phreng rtsal gyi// tha dad gnas chen lha sgo'i srung mar gnyer byang gtad pas// da lta sgru yi gzhi bdag a rgya stag rdzong 'bod khyod// na ra 'jig rten 'di na mthu rtsal stobs dang ldan 'dug /pa sangs ltu'i khyod kyi bsti gnas dge bcu'i zhing sa// pha lam rdo rje'i brtsigs pa 'chi med mal du snyegs shing*/ ba gam mdzes pa'i zhol 'dab sman ljongs rtsi shing nags tshal// ma rmos rtsi thog me tog lang 'tsho'i mtshar sdug ngom zhing*// tsa ljang mar gad sa gzhir yan lag brgyad ldan chu rgyun// tsha grang nad sel bdud rtsi 'dab chags ri dwags rtsed 'dzo// dza ya'i bstan srung gding can ngo mtshar gnas mchog 'di ni/ wa gi shwa ri sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor 'dod don sgrub mdzod// zhwa bzhin khyod nyid rten na buddha'i bstan spyi dang*/

za ma tog ltar khyad par 'bri bstan rin bsrung zhing*/ 'a bur myur du khyad par yul 'dir char chen phob shig /ya mtshan cheba'i rtag mtshan sgrub mchog (39) bdag la ston mdzod// rab 'byams rgyal ba kun 'dus gu ru'i bka' bstan skyong na/ la lung gang du bgrod kyi mchod kyang mchod kho bos spros mod/ sha khrag 'gro ba'i srog la rtag tu 'tshe spong la/ sa phyogs yul khams bde ba'i bkra shis dpal yon stsol/ ha ha dge bsnyen a rgyal ngo mtshar gnas kyi bstod 'phrin/ a he ka li'i glu las 'bri ban dharmas smras so/ zhes pa sa yos zla nang sgru a rgyal char 'bebs skabs nyams mtshar gyi gnang ba lags/ ༄༅// 'gags sa dā gnang ba'i zhal gdams sta 'phring*// ka dag gdod ma'i mgon po gar gyi dbang*/ kha ba can sa'i lha gcig snying rje'i gter*/ gangs ri'i zhing 'di 'dul mdzad mtsho skyes rje/ nga yi dad pas lan brgyar phyag bgyis nas/ ca co mang du smras la dgos med kyang*/ cha lugs pa rabs bzang po'i ngang tshul can/ ja bzhin rgyun brten gam 'khod khyod nyid la/ nya mtshor gnas bzhin dkor chus myos pa ngas/ ra la'i 'dab ltar spang blang smos bgyis na/ tha dad theg pa sna tshogs sgor zhugs kyang*/ nga dung nyams len snying por ma sgril na/ na raka bsdul gzings las sgrol dka' bas/ pa sangs lta bur dkar ba'i lhag bsam bskyed/ pha mas bu la brtse ba ji bzhin du/ ba spru'i grangs las 'das pa'i 'gro ba rnams/ ma lus sangs rgyas 'dod byang sems bskyed/ tsa chu 'dzom zhing dben gnas nyams dga' bar/ tsha bzhin snying po'i dam chos yang zab dang*/ dza pir bcas kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo la/ khas gyi sgo nas bsnyen sgrub mtha' ru bskyol/ zhwa bzhi spyi bor rtag bsten bla ma la/ za bca' longs spyod dbul dang mos gus bskyed/ 'a cag byin rlabs 'jug pa'i dgos pa yod/ ya gi kun bzang sa dang 'gor ba gnyis/ rang sems 'dis byed de nyid 'dul la 'bad/

la wa pa sogs sgrub thob gong ma bzhin/ sha srog gcos 'dzin spang la 'bad gyur na/ sa mchog rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang zhig ha cang ring sopa mi thog myur thob 'gyur/ a ho da ltar bgyis pa'i dge tshogs rnams/ mi zad 'phol phyir bsngo ba'i rgyas 'debs bgyis/ de skad nye 'khor dā na'i ming can la/ 'bri bstan rin chen 'dzin pa'i tshul 'chang ba/ chos kyi rgyal po ratna'i mtshan dkar gyis/ byin rlabs rmongs brtul gyi nas bslab bya'i tshul/ mtshar mtshar ka smad sum cu'i 'phreng ba ru/ bzang bzang sprol zla'i bzang po dang po'i nyin/ bde bde bde 'dus bsgrub pa'i thun bar du/ mdzes mdzes yi ger spol ba dge gyur cig/ ༄༅// gzims dpon dkon mchog yon tan 'byung gnas la gnang ba'i zhal gdams ka yid su cu yod// ka ye gson dang dge slong yon 'byung sa/ kha ba'i ljongs 'dir dal 'byor lus rnyed nas// ga zhe 'khrul pa'i las la ma g.yengs shing*// nga bdaga'adzin pa'i dgra bo 'joms na dge/ ca ga phyi ma'i lam bzang sgrub pa'i phyir// cha lugs bzang btung mod sngags ma 'gal bar// ja sogs thun tshod bzang bca' la rol zhing*/ nya ma mgo bskor chos brgyad spangs na dge/ ta thā ta'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas/ tha mal sgo gsum yan par ma btang bar// da nas sangs rgyas go 'phang ma thob bar// na sh-i 'gyod med sgom la brtson na legs// pa pir kun rtog ma mang gcig tu sgril/ pha chos lnga ldan gdams par nyams blang nas// ba mor bcu gnyis bdag po'i 'od 'phrog bzhin// ma rigs nyon mongs rtog tshogs bcom na dge /tsa ma ri yi zhing gi bden gnas su// tsha grang khyed bsad brtson 'grus 'bad bgyis na// landha ra la sogs sgrub thob bzhin// wa ler mkha' spyod zhing khams bgrod pas dge /zhwa yi tshos la chags sdang mi bgyi zhing*// za ma nor rdzas ya ma brla bas na// 'a cag de la srid pa ṛng du dor*/ ya rab dkon mchog mchod par brtson na dge

/ha le ho le de skad chos rgyan pas// a la la te nyams mtshar smras po dge/ ༄༅// sho mo'i kha 'gengs rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston bzhugs so// ༈ gling bzhi'i mchog tu gyur pa// lho rgyal 'dzam gling lte ba// rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyis// byang phyogs bsil ldan ljongs 'dir/ rgyal ba'i lung bstan 'bri yis/ zhing 'dir bkris byin chags/ dbur ston pa'i gnas mchog /gnam rtags 'khor lo'i rtsibs ldan/ sa dpyad padma 'dabs brgyad/ phyogs mtshams bkris rtag mdzes/ phun tshogs dge bcu'i dbus su/ sum brtsen sa la 'phres pa/ bsra brten rdo rje'i pho brang*/ de na bzhugs pa'i rten gcig skyabs mchog gr+yal bu don 'grub/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma/ skyabs mgon gr+yal ba yab sras/ zhabs pad yid bzhin 'khor lo/ seng ge'i 'bri thil byang chub gling mchog khri la bzhugs yod/ ma mjal 'jig rten gsum mgon rna bas thos tshad/ thar pa'i lam la bkod song 'bral med zhal mjal gsung thos/ rang tsho'i bsod nam che ba/ dga' ba lags dang skyed pa/ dga' skyed 'dzem pa'i zhabs gro/ mchod pa'i lha mor sprul nas/ rnam 'dren nyi zla zung gis/ sku tshe'i zhabs brtan 'bul lo// mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la/ bcom ldan tshe lha'i ngo bor/ bskal brgya'i bar du zhabs pad/ brtan par gsol ba 'debs so/ gsol ba snying nas btags pas/ zhal bzhes byin brlabs

(40) gnang byung*/ bod khams yongs kyi dga' ba/ 'bri gung lung gi skyid pa/ sangs rgyas bstan pa dar song*/ 'bri bstan rin chen rgyas song*/ dga' skyid rdzogs ldan nyi ma/ 'bri gus sgos su shar byung*/ chab 'bangs padma'i tsham chen/ 'di skyid 'dab stong bzhad byung*/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum dang*/ bstan bsrung chos kyi sgrol mas/ yid smon lhun gyi 'grub nas/ bkris dge legs stsol shog ces pa 'di yang rje btsun bla ma padma'i mtshan can gyis sa yos lor ngod cig mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gdan rab gser gyi 'phreng ba'i gral du dbang bskur ba'i tshe rtse rlabs pa'i sho mo'i zlos gar bgyur ba'i kha 'gegs su 'di ltar dgos zhes dam pa gang gi zhabs 'debs la lhag bsam gyi 'khur lci shing ya bzang po'i ngang tshul la blo mig yangs sa mchod dpon ratna a mo gha'i ngor 'bri ban dharma dhwa dzas sbyar ba'o/ bkra shis/ zhu dag (ja) ༄༅// lam bsangs phun tshogs 'dod 'jo zhes pa bzhugs so// lam bsangs phun tshogs 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba ni/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ bsangs dud dang phye mar 'du byas/ skyabs sems dang tshig bdun ma sngon du song ba'i/ rang nyid padma 'byung gnas skur gsal ba'i/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan hūṃ yag las/ 'od 'phros mdun gyi rdzas rnams ma dag sbyangs/ zag med 'dod yon lha mal dang mnyam gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum a kā ro gsum sarba birgya pu ra sogs gsum/ kyaiḥ rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum yi dam lha/ chos skyong bsrung ma gzhi bdag dgra lha dang*/ rigs drug lan chags mgron rnams ma lus sa/ rang bzhin dbyings nas myur bar gnas 'dir gshegs/ dgyes (41) pa'i gdan bzhugs phyag 'os rnams la 'dud/ pu dzas tshogs bzhes rab tu gus pas bstod/ skye bsangs so shing sna'i dud sprin sman spos dar zab bsur phye mar 'dod yon nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa'i/

bsangs dang zhi ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'dis/ drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs dkon mchon rin chen gsum/ theg dgu rgyud bzhi yi dam dkyil 'khor lha/ gnas yul phyi nang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsangs/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi dbyings phyug chos kyi sgron/ tshe reng mchod lnga smug na lcam dral dang*/ rnam mang thos sras bdud mgon yab yum 'khor/ dpe har gnod sbyin gnyan chen tshangs pa bsangs/ dge bsnyen rnam bzhi mgur lha bcu gsum tshogs/ lha klu gza' skar rgyal chen phyogs skyong bcu/ yul lha spyi dang mdo kham gzhi bdag bsangs/ dgra lha yun dgu byes lam skyob pa'i lha/ sa rdo ri brag rtse shing lam 'phrang chu// 'brog dgon skyes tshal sogs la gnas pa yis/ gnyin dang sa bdag sde brgyad 'dre srin tshogs/ bsangs mchod 'bul gyi dgyes shing tshim par mdzed/ snying rje yul gyur 'gro ba rigs drug dang*/ lan chags bgegs rigs mgron kun ma lus pa/ zhi dul lems kyi bsangs mchod dam pa bzhes/ bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la/ bsrung skyob gdong grogs byes su lam 'phrang dang*/ dgra jags chom rkun gcan zan chu bo yis/ 'tshe ba kun bral yid 'dod ma lus 'grub/ bkra shis logs spyod 'dod dgu yar zla ltar/ 'phel zhing dge legs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog badzra mum/ bkra shis bsngo smon byas zhes pa lam bsangs 'dor bsdus 'di bzhin nyin rdzong dge slong dkon mchog bstan gsal ngor 'bri ban dharma dhwa dzas bsra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyor ba'o// ༄༅// gzhi bdag gangs lha rgyal po'i gsol mchod bzhugs so// ༈ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha pa'i la phyag 'tshal lo/ rnam 'byor pa gang zhig bdag gangs lha rgyal po gsol bar 'dod na/ gtor mchod sman rakra sogs mthong rgyud ltar bsham/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i/ rang nyid dbang drag thod 'phreng rtsal gyi skur gsal bar gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi bar snang la sprin dang rlung nag 'tshub pa'i nang*/ lha chen gangs lha rgyal po sku mdog dkar la dmar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'jum pha'i tshul can/ sku la dar dkar gyi ras gus lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ dbu la dar thod bcings pa/ chibs su rta mchog ngang pa rlung gi shugs ldan sga srab can la chigs pa/ myur mgyogs las la bskul phyir/ phyag g.yas sba lcags nam mkha' 'phyar ba/ sgrub la dngos grub yid bzhin stsol slad g.yon pa'i mda' dar dkar po g.yabs pa/ bya dkar du ma klad la lding zhing*/ khyi dkar mngo po ril du khrid nas/ de'i 'khor du/ yum gcig kong btsun de mo/ bdud rje zha ra ltag long*/ lha chen brgyad dang*/ lha phran 'bum gyi bran g.yogs dang bcas pa gsal ba la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phrosapas bskyed pa dang 'dra ba rang bzhin gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas spyan drangs par gyur/ kyaiḥde rig mchod pa'i gnas mchod dam pa 'dir/ bskyed pa'i mgron rigs rnams dang dbyer med bzhugs/ sngags 'chang bdag gi dwang bas bstod bgyis na/ nyams chags bskongs la 'phrin las sgrub par mdzod/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan a ti pu hoḥ sra ti dza hoḥ hūṃ sngon tshe rgyal dbang 'byung bka'/ bar du gnam lcags me 'bar lung*/ tha mar rig 'dzin brgyud pa yi/ bka' bsgom dam bcas dran mdzod cig /sa ma ya a mṛ ta khā hi na rakka na/ kyaiḥ lha chen gangs lha rgya po 'khor bcas la/ me togs bdug spongs mar me dri yi chab/ zhal zas gra snyin 'dod yon lnga la sogs/ sman gtor rakka dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*/ 'bru sna dar bza dkor nor sna tshogs pa/ mgo dgu mchod tshogs rnam 'phrul rgya mtshos bstams/ 'bul gyi thugs dam bskang phyir bzhes sug gsol/ kai la sha dāe wa rā dza sa pā ri wa ra puṣpam dhu pam o lo ke gandham nam wi rgya/ shasta ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta bha ling ta rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi

zhes mchod la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs swa bha was sbyangs stong ba'i ngang las kham las lha mi'i zhal zas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hriḥ lan gsum brjod hoḥlha rnams kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba/ lha yi rje bo gangs lha rgyal po/ lha chen brgyad dang lha phran 'bum phrag yum gcig sman btsun rdo rje de mo/ bdud rgyal zha ra ltag long la sogs pa 'khor dang yang (42) g.yogs ma lus shing lus pa med pa rnams la dam rdzas bagr+yan pa'i gtor ma dam pa 'id 'bul lo/ bzhes nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod dge bdun gyi sde skyongs/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i gdong grogs mdzod/ sdang ba'i dgra gsod gnod pa'i bgegs 'thul bar chad kyi rkyen bzlog zhi gr+yas dbang drag gi 'phris ma lus pa yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzod cig/ kyaiḥ 'jig rten kun la dbang bgyur ba/ lha chen dāe wa rā dza ni/ sku mdog phyag mtshan gzhon 'khor sogs/ gcig tu ma nges rdzu 'phrul gyi/ sprul pa'i stong khams khyab la bstod/ lha chen 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ dam rdzas gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po bsrungs/ dkon mchog rin chen dbu 'phang bstod/ rnal 'byor bdag gi gdong grogs mdzed/ khyad par dgon gnas yul ris 'dir/ mnga' thang longs spyod spel ba dang*/ rtag tu bsrung skyob mel tshe bgyis/ sngags 'chang yon mchod 'khor bcas la/ phyi nang dgra mi mthun tshogs/ skad cig thal ba'i rul dul du brlog mdor na yi la gang bsam pa/ 'bad med myur du 'grub par mdzod/ bstod cing 'phrin las 'chol la/ gtor ma gtsang par 'bul/ yi ge rgyas pas nongs pa bshags de ltar gzhi bdag gangs lha rgyal po'i gsol mchod mdor bsdus pa 'di yang shar dga' bla ma gsar rkos kyang ngor ban chos kyi rgya mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o/ ༄༅// rta'u ong skyu dgon gyi gzhi bdag btsan sgod kyi gsol mchod bzhugs so//

༈ swa sti/ rnal 'byor pa gang zhig rta'u ong skyu dgon gyi dkor bdag btsan rgod la bsangs gsol bgyi bar 'dod na/ gzhi mtshang ma'i stong du/ zangs sam snod dmar po gang rung gas chag med pa'i nang du gtor ma btsan bshes dmar po zur gsum sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i mthar bskor thebs skyu dang chang skrad ci mang gi bskor ba dang*/ ja chang bza' btung phye mar/ sman sna mda' dar sogs 'du byas la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang mthun pa dang tshig bdun mas lanag gsum gsol ba btab la/ rang nyid pad 'byung skur gsal bas/ thugs srog hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ ram yam kham gi rdzas rnams kyis/ dngos 'dzin bsregs gtor sbyangs nas slar/ zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ ram yam kham/ oṃ sarba bī rgya ya pu ra sogs gsum brjod/ kyaiḥ 'dir byon tshul gshegs dkor gyi bdag /btsan rgod grags pa mgon skyabs zhes/ sngon smon drag shul stobs ldan khyer/ dam tshig dbang gi 'dar 'bod kyis/ brag dmar gzhal yas la sogs pa'i/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og gar gnas kyang*/ ma thogs 'dir gshegs gdan (43) la bzhugs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥs ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ kyaiḥ dkor gyi srung ma mthu bo che/ grags pa mgon skyabs 'khor bcas la/ de ring gnyes pa'i bangs mchod ni/ sman spos shing sna'i dud sprin dang*/ ting 'dzin sngags brgyas byin brlab pas/ bshos gtsang dkar dmar rgyas rgyan gyi mdzas/ zas sman sna tshogs bltams pa dang*/ ro bcud ldan pa'i ja chang dang*/ dmar chen arghama'o mtshor bcas/ sa 'dzin chu gter la 'gran pas/ yid 'ong phun tshogs bsham pa la/ dgyes par rol cig pu dzaḥhoḥ gzhan yang spyan gzigs longs spyod tshogs/ khrab rmog grib mdung gos brgyan dang*/ rta g.yag ra lug mdzo 'bri sogs/ 'dod yon sna tshogs dkor gyi nor/ dngos 'byor yid gyi bar sprul te/ lha lam na kun yongs bkang nas/ matsan rgod mgon skyabs khyod la bstod/

rdzu 'phrul dbang ldan pa'i phyir/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan gos dang*/ bzhon pa 'khor g.yogs la sogs pa/ ma ngos sna tshogs ston la bstod/ kyaiḥ gson dang bsrung ma mthu chen khyod/ bsangs mchod rgya chen 'di bzhes la/ bdag cag ma rigs rmongs pa yi/ bag med bdang gi mi gtsang grib/ thabs gzhob mkhon mnol dme grib kyis/ mchod gtor 'bag rtsog gis nongs pas/ thugs dang 'gal kun bzod par gsol/ de ltar bzod tshangs rab gsol nas/ 'phrin las gnyan po bcol ba ni/ sangs bstan bsrung de 'dzin gyi/ skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin spol/ dben gnas gnyen po'i bya ra mdzed/ bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas la/ gzhi su bkra shis long spyod rgyas/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gar 'gro yang*/ la 'phrang chu dang dgra jags la/ rtag tu mel tshe ma g.yal bar/ rin 'dzin padma thod 'phreng sogs/ brgyud pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs pas/ g.yar dam gnyan po dran mdzod la/ phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrub/ bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs shog zhes gtor ma rnams gnas rten phyogs sam med tshe gtsang par dor/ bkra shis bsngo smon rgyas 'debs par bya'o/ ces pa yang rte'u gsang sngags mchog grub gling dgon gnas ong skyu gzhi bdag btsan rgod kyi bsangs gsol sbrags pa 'di yang*/ de kha'i grwa rigs zhig gis 'dod don ltar 'bri ban chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi sbyar ba'o/ maṅga lam// (44) ༄༅// gzhi bdag klu btsan ban skyong gi bsangs gsol sbrags pa mdor bsdus bzhugs so// ༈ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dpal dbang gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir gzhi bdag klu ban skyong dge bsnyen ra bsangs gsol bgyi bar 'od na rin po che'i snod gtsang mar gtor ma zur gsum 'khor drug pa theb kyu ci mang gis bskor ba gzhi gtsang ma'i khar bkod/ sman raka mchod pa bsangs dang phye mar sogs kyang 'du bar bya/ skyabs sems spri 'gro song rjes/ rang nyid dbang chen rta mchog rol pa'i skur gsal pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las ram yam khi gsum 'phros pas mchod rdzas ma dag 'bags rtsog nyes skyon thams cad bsregs gtor bkrus// slar yang oṃ āḥhūṃ rnams spros pas mchod rdzas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi 'dod yon bsam gyi mi khyab pa gzhis bdag 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyod nus pa dpag yas stong gsum gang bar gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ gsum/ oṃ sarba brgyi sogs badzra spha ra ra ṇa khaṃḥ gsum rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros gzhis bdag ban skyong 'khor bcas skad cig gi spyan drangs/ kyai de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis/ mchod sprin 'dod dgu'i longs spyod kyi/ mgron du klu btsan ban skyong che/ ma lus 'khor bcas spyan badren na/ rang gi bsti gnas gnyan po dang*/ phyog bcu'i 'jig rten gar gzhugs kyang*/ dam tshig dbang gi 'bod lags na/ smon lam shugs kyi myur du byon/ badzra pa ma dzaḥkye rin chen mdzes pa'i gzhal yas 'dir/ klu btsan ban skyong bcas rnams/ rang rang mthun pa'i gdan steng du// mi g.yo dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs/ sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan kyai klu btsan ban skyong chen po khyod/ de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag dang*/ dam tshig gnyan po gcig tu bsre/ rtag tu mi 'bral grogs mdzod cig sa ma ya i dandi na rakra kan/ kyai ban skyong chen po 'khor bcas la/ dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ yan lag brgyad ldan chu gtsang dang*/ chu dang thang skyongs me tog bkra/ sbyar dang rang byung bdug pa 'thul/ snang gsal zhun mar mdang dang ldan/ dri bzang chabs kyi rgyan chen po/ gzhan yang dgyes mchod dpag med pa/ bza' ba sna tshogs ri ltar sprungs/ btung sna tshogs mtsho ltar lta bskyil/ gyon sna tshogs mtshar du mngar/ dkor cha rnam pa sna tshogs dang*/ phye mar bsangs dang gser skyems sogs/ gzhis bdag ban skyong chen po dang*/ yam yum sras blon 'bangs 'khor dpung*/ srul pa yang sprul ma lus rnams/ gsol lo mchod de thugs dam bskangs/ (45) thugs dam gnyan pa bskang nas kyang*/ rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ mi shes gti mug dbang gyur pa'i/ khyed cag thugs dang 'gal ba rnams/ mthol zhing bshags so tshangs gyur nas/ snying po'i bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bstan 'dzin sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ mi phyugs zas nor rab spel zhing*/ bkra shis dge lags g.yang du bskyil/

kyai 'jam bu'i nyir mtshon nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ ri rgyal 'phang mtho brgyud ring lhun chags shing*/ rtse morar na bun sdug po'i gos kyi klub/ bar du dbang po'i gzhu ris rnam par bkra/ rtsa bar sman ljongs me tog gcal du bkram/ gnyis skyes ri dwags du ma bed bar spyod/ de lta bu yi ri rgyal rtse ma mo na/ shes gyi sku 'khor 'phyang gi kha bad mdzes/ dar gyi rgyan phan rin chen thel skasacan/ 'ja' zer 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ mthong bas yid 'phrog gnas dang po brang der/ bzhugs pa'i gzhi bdag dge bsnyen ban skyong che/ sku mdog chu shes mdang 'phrog dar dkar gyi/ na bza' gsol zhing zhwa dkar dbu ma mdzes/ dung rta la chibs ba dan nam mkhar 'phyar/ zhi ba'i las mdzad khrod la bdag bstod do/ gzhan yang 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i phyir/ bzhon pa gos dang phyag mtshan la sogs pa/ gcig tu ma ngas sna tshogs cho 'khrul ston/ su brgya drug bcu'i 'khor dpung 'gyed la bstod/ byed sngon tshe rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bca' bzhin du dgongs mdzod la/ deng 'dir rnal 'byor yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi/ mthun pa'i ba ling sman dka rgya mtsho dang*/ g.yag lug ra sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs pa/ phye mar bsangs dang gser skyems 'dod yon bcas/ dpag yas mchad gtor rgya chen 'di bzhes la/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen bsrung ba dang*/ de 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun 'dus sde spel/ yul rin sakaye 'gro spyi dang bdag cag la/ mgon skyabs dpung gnyen rtag tu mi g.yel zhing*/ nad gdon zhi dang tshi dpal 'byor pa rgyas/ khams gsum dbang bsdus bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ gnod pa'i dgra jag chom rkun 'tshe ba bzlog gang bcol 'phrin las lhun gyi grub pa dang*/ bkra shis bde legs phun gsum tshogs par mdzod/ ces pa 'di yang mang 'grog sbra chen dbang drag gi ngor 'bri ban dharmā dhwa dzas bras pa'o//

༄༅// 'bri ljong gi nye 'dab phu gu gdong gi btsan sgod dang rwa sog zam lha bcas kyi bsangs mchod bzhugs so// ma dang lha ga pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir 'bri ljong gi nye 'dab phu gu gdong gi btsan rgod dang ra sog zam lha bcas phyogs gcig la bangs mchod bya bar 'dod na phye mar sman sna chang phud 'od phud sogs

(46) 'du byas la/ rang nyid stan bde bar 'dug la skyabs sems dang tshig bdun ma bcas lan gsum re brjod la/ rang nyid parma 'byung gnas sug gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las ram yam kham gsum 'phros pa'i rdzas gyi nyes skyon rnams bsrog gtar sbyangs/ oṃ badzra spha ra ṇa kham/ oṃ sarba brgya pu ra sogs lan gsum brjod/ kyaiḥ de rang rnal 'byor bdag cag gi mchod phrin bsangs dud rgya mtsho yi/ mgron du btsan rgod 'bar ba dang*/ zam lha dkor po la sogs pa/ 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na/ rang rang bsti gnas gnyan po dang*/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gar gnas kyang*/ skad cig nyid la gshegs su gsol/ dgyes bde'i stan la bzhugs nas kyang*/ khyod dang rnal 'byor bdag cag gnyis/ dam tshig gnyan po gcig tu bsre/ rtag bdag gi grogs mdzod cig kyai ljong 'di'i gzhi bdag btsan rgod che/ sras dang btsatsan mo bshan pa dang*/ lcags kyi zam lha dkar po sogs/ 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i mchod pa ni/ lha shing shug pa bal lu dang*/ rtsi mar 'bru bcud sman dang spos/ phye mar 'o skom la sogs kyi/ bsangs bsur gams gsum yongs khyab pas/ mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di rol bas/ tshim zhing rang pa nyid gyur cig kyaiḥ btsan dang zam lha khyed rnams la/ shing sna bsangs du phul ba'i mthus/ mi gtsang 'bag rtsog nyams grib dang*/ thab gzhob mnol 'khor shor ba sogs/ nyes dgu thams cad bzod par bzhes/ padma thod 'phrong spyan snga ru/ khas blangs bka' las ma 'da' bar/ 'jig rten spyi dang yul phyogs 'dir/ mi phyugs nad yams kun zhi zhing*/ 'bras drug tshogs la pad dang ser/ rtsa 'bru zhi zhing char rgyun 'bebs/ mu ge'i 'jigs las thar bar bgyis/ khyad par rnal 'byor bdag cag la/ gzhis byes gar gnas gar song kyang*/ nad gdon bar chad zhi ba dang*/ dmag jags choms rkun dgra 'dre bzlog /lam 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don bgyis/ legs dang sprod la nyes dang bsnol/

'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun grub mdzod/ de ltar dam las mi g.yel bar/ rang rang rten la gshegs nas kyang*/ gang tshe spyan drangs de tshe slar/ myur du 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sbyin stobs sogs brjod la bkra shis dang bsngo smon gyi rgyas 'debs byas la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ zhes pa 'di yang rang re'i sgra grwa dkon mchog mthar phyin gyi bskul ngor 'bri ban dharma dhwa dzas 'bri ljong bkra shis tshugs kyi gzim chu phun 'khyil du mgyogs par sbyar ba'o/ sarba maṅga lam// zhu dag (47) (nya) ༄༅// kham 'ba' dgon gyi byang chen mchod rten chung ngu'i dkar chab bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ grangs med gong nas thugs bskyed rmad byung ba/ mngon par byang chub sprul pa'i rol gar bsgyur/ skal bzang 'di la rnam 'dren bzhi pa zhes/ yongs grags zas gtsang sras der mgon phyag 'tshal/ 'phags sprul mgon po klu yi srid grub zhabs/ gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir ratna shrīr zhes pa/ snyan grags gdugs dkar phyogs kyi 'dzin ma'i khyon/ 'gro ba'i bsil grib gyur der cis mi dad/ gang gis chos kyi seng khrir 'tsho bzhes nas/ gang gi bstan pa rin chen lha lam du/ gang 'dul 'gro tshogs pad 'tshal skyong mtshad pa/ gang gi gyal tshab nyid byed dbang por 'dud/ de yang bslu ba medapa'i tshad ma'i bka' dang bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dgongs 'grol dang bcas sa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snyin po can gyi mchod rten la bya ba byas pas phan yon nam mkha'i mthas kyang tshod bzung bar dka' ba lha'i bsngags brjod dang rjes su mthun par/ rgyu las (48) 'bras bu mi bslu bar 'byung ba gor ma chags par yid yongs su gtad de/ bya ba 'jug pa'i don ni/ rang re'i bu slob kham 'ba' dgon bla ma dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'phrin las de nyid 'dus sbya chos nyid kyi bya ba la gzhol ba'i dge rtsar/

'o cag gi ston pa shākya'i rgyal po nyid sngon rdo rje gdan du srid ma bdud btul tho rangs mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i dus su gnas de nyid du bzhengs pa bdud 'dul mchod rten nam/ byang chen mchod rten chung ngu 'di nyid kyi nang bzhugs dkar chabs bkod par/ thog mar tog dang bcu gsum 'khor lo bcas kyi nang de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'phale gdung dhog sran chung tsam/ gtsug tor rigs kyi gzungs dang/ chos sku'i ring bsrel dang*/ 'bri gun gdan rabs mtshan sngags dang*/ de nas bum dang ser khri yan la o rgyan rin po che'i sku ber gyi tshal pa gsum/ gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ ye she mtsho gr+yal gyi phyag bris dam rdzas a dam ma bram ze skye ba bdun pa'i sku sha ril bu/ thang stong rgyal po'i na bza'/ mnga' bdag myang gi gdung rus/ chos rgyal srong mtshan sgam po'i na bza'/ rje bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi gdung sha ri ram dang*/ dbu lo na bza'arje chos kyi nyi ma'i gdung sha ri ram dub lo na bza'/ rje karma rang byung rdo rje'i snam sbyar/ sgrub chen thar pa rgyal mtshan gyi ja tshags/ rgyud sde bzhi'i gzungs sngags ji snyed gzungs chen gra lnga sogs gzungs sngags khung dag gang mang*/ 'bri gung rje na rim gyi dadung chu ri ram las grub pa'i rje bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi phyag tsha slob dpon gtso 'khor gsum pa/ rje chos kyi nyi ma'i phyag bzo dhor sems ba so las grub pa/ smri ti'i phyag tsha tshe dpag/ gsang 'dus kyi sku gcig/ gzungs kyi sku nyes pa sel byed/ rigs pa phun ron gyi gzungs dang*/ yi dhra gyi me tog/ sman sna dri bzang sogs dang*/ seng khri'i nang la gnod sbyin pho 'khor mo 'khor gnod sbyin dgyes pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ rin po che'i rags sna tshogs dang*/ 'bru sna dar zab sogs mkho rgu yo byed ji snyed pa/ ba gam dang sa stegs bcas la lha ldan/ bsam yas kyi dubs gnas chen gyi sa

(49) sna dho sna shing sogs dang*/ gzhan yang dus 'khrug zhi phyir gri dang khab sogs mtshon cha'i rnam pa dang*/ zhabs sdoms sna tshogs rdo rje dang bcas te bzhugs so/ 'di ltar bskrun pa'i dge tshogs shar ri las/ mthon pa'i mthu phyin ga bur 'jag pa'i dbyid/ mos ldan ku mud ta yi tsham chen po/ bde skyid 'dab brgya'i lang 'tsho brtan pa dang*/ 'di snang sor ba bstan 'dzin 'phrin las kyi/ skye dgon gnas mnga' thang dbyar mtsho yar zla bzhin/ 'phale zhing rgyas pa'i dge mtshan 'arab gyur cig /ces pa 'ba' dgon pa'i byang chen mchod rten chung ngu'i dkar chab tu 'bri ban chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis bris dge bar gyur cig/ sarba maṅgalam// zhu dag/ a mtshe lags/ (da) ༄༅// drang srong log tri'i gtor bzlog dkyus ma'i 'don bsgrigs ti thug nag 'gros su bstod pa bzhugs so/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha dri med dge ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ 'dir drang srong log tri pā la'i sgo nas gtor ma la brten pa'i bsrung bzlog bsad gsum dkyus ma'i bca' 'don ti thug nag 'gros su bkod pa la/ dang po bca' gzhi ni/ sgrub zhag dgu gtor lta bu la mtshon na/ tshes bcu dgu'i nyin sngo bar gnas khang byi der dang yol ba bla brais sogs kyis mdzes par brgyan cing*/ go yul dang bsdun pa'i drang srong zhi khro bris sku sogs bkram/ stegs bu khebs ldan gyi khar nang gtor cha lnga spyi ltar la/ cha lnga'i yi dam dor ba'i mal du'am/ yang na cha lnga'i yi dam gyi g.yas su yi dam 'di nyid kyi zhing gtor padma 'dab bzhis bskor ba dpe ris ltar la/ dkar gsum ngar gsum sh-ing tog sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa dang*/ de zlar drag gtor zur gsum thad rgyag sman raka rgyun lam dang 'khor rang 'dra brgyad kyis bskor ba'i mtshams su mtheb kyu sha brgyan dang bcas pa/ mdun du bka' bsrung bzhi (50) nas dge bsnyen bzhi'i bar gyi bskang phran gtor ma tshang ba 'chos/

sman rakra chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga/ brten skyong mator ma zur gsum mthel kyu bcu gnyis pa/ tshogs bka' brgyad cha gsum/ gtor bsos ong skyu/ 'ban tshogs sogs ji ltar dgos pa thams cad ma lus shin ma 'tsheb pa gatshang sbra dang ldan pa bsags/ thog na nas sam dgu gtor ltar na tshes nyer gnyis nyin phyi gtor bca' ba ni/ lha thabs rdo rje'i mdud bkrol ltar lag len snying po phyung bar/ sgrub gang gi dubs sam gang bde zhing tu/ stegs bu gdug pa'i sa snag gsum gyis byugs pa'i khar 'bru nag khrag chang gis sbol ba'i tshom bu dpus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du bkod cing*/ dbus ma phyogs mtshams kyi tshom bu las sum 'gyur gyi che ba bya/ de'i steng mañdzi'i khar gtor chen ni/ lcags snod du 'bru nag ngar btags kyi phye la/ 'bru sna lnga'i phye bsres pa dang*/ khyad par gyi rdzas/ sngar gyi gtor zan rnying pa chos sman btsan dug /sha chen khrag chen lnga bsre zhing*/ khra chang gis rdzis pa'i zan gyi stegs bu gru gsum steng*/ gter chen khru gang zur gsum rno dpal can dkyil dmar mtha' nag sa/ 'khor ste brgyad la phyogs mtshams brgyad du zur gsum brgyad dang*/ khrag kong spol ba bar mtshams ong skyu bcad kha phyir bstan ci mang gis bskor zhing khrag gis dmar nag tu byug/ rtse khra sogs kadar dmar gyis brgyan/ gtor gzugs drag sngags thel can gatsho bo la sgril sngags/ 'khor brgyad la sde brgyad so sor thim sbyar ba sngags kyi go rim bzhi mdun na g.yas bskor kyi rim par/ mgon po/ sa bdag klu ma mo btsan bdud/ gza' rgyal po rnams rims par 'jug rtse mor bslung bzlog 'khor lo rab gnas can phyag len ltar lteb pa gtor gdugs 'og tu btags shing*/ bris sku dang mtsho yungs 'jug /mtha' bskor du skyer rtsang srin mo 'gros su bskor zhing*/ rtsang de dag la liṅka kha sbub skyon pa/

bsad sha dmar po/ rgyu rlon sogs kyis brgyan/ zor rdzas rig gsum 'dus pa'i sa dang*/ dur khrod g.yul bkye 'phung shul sogs gdug pa'i sa sna gang 'dzom la/ dug khrag gis brjis pa'i gong bu zur gsum gr+ya dang dpang gnyis por bzhi pa'i nang du brus pa gri khrag btsag gis dmar po dang*/ phyir ro sol dug khrag bsres pa'i nag por byug pa'i nang du (51) khrag sna yungs dkar nag zangs lcags kyi phye rbab ngur gyi dho phyi shangs mtsho thal chen dug sna dregs pa'i sa bon rnams bslug cing rtsang bsnol mtshe yungs kyi bagr+yan pa logs gsum du bhyoḥbazlog rbad bris pa'i kong zor bzhi/ ngur khrod du skyes pa'i snyug gam/ skyer pa sogs dug shing gang rigs kyi mda'/ bya bug srin gsum gyi sgro dang dug shing gi mdo'u/ drag sngags them nas sbrul 'khyud du bkris pa/ dug khra gi ngar btags pa'i mda' zor bzhi/ kong bu zur gsum khrag sna tshe yungs rtsang gisabargyan pa'i gtor zare bzhi rnams gtor chen gyi phyogs mtshams su bskor/ zor bzhu dang tshon skud kyi 'ur dho mi spags kyi mthil/ yug skra'i lcags can kyang bkod/ mdud du g.yon nas mgo byas pa'i/ khrag chen bsros pa'i chu gnyis/ dbang po'i me tog bcos ma dang 'bru nag gi me tog/ sha chen gu gul sbyor ba'i spos/ 'bru mar rkang mar tshil chen gyis sbags pa'i mar me/ mkhris chen chang dang sbyar ba'i dri chab/ sha khrag rus pas sbags pa'i lha bshos rnams sbyengs tshar dang*/ sman raka rdzas ldan bcas bshams/ gtor chen mdun nam nye logs su nyin lta bsgral rgyu'i nya'o khyud gang pa/ dug khrag gis byug pa dgra bgegs dmigs yul yod na ming byang rjas sogs lhan thabs ltar bya zhing*/ 'phung re'am zam nag gis bka' sgrol chas pho rog dang 'ug pa'i dang sgro dbye rdzas gu gul rgod thod pa mtshan ngan gyi nang du yungs dkar nag skye mtsho shangs mtsho

rbab dho lcags zangs kyi phyie ma dug khrag gis ngar btags pa'i thun rdzas/ gtso phur las phur sgrol gri gtun dang gtun bu gal che skabs rta rmig 'khor lo g.yab dar dang bcas pa thun gtor snga dro bsrung bar dkar rtsam la zur gsum mtheb kyu sha dug gyi brgyan pa/ dgong re 'phang rgyu'i thun gtor ngar phye zur gsum mtheb kyu sha phrag mtshe yungs rtsang gi brgyan pa dang*/ dgongs thun dang smad las bzlog gzhung skabs 'bul rlu mtheb kyu sha dum mang tsam sogs yo byed thams cad tshang rab bya ba ni bca' gzhi'i mim pa'o/ ༈ gnyis pa 'don bsgrig ni sgrub zhag gdug gtor lta bu mtshon na thog mar tshes bcu dgī nuspagaral 'dzin la bsgrub pa po rnams stan bde bar 'khod nas/ bdag sdang ma ji snyed su dag bla ma sku gsum las byang gdug pa tshar gcod kyi dub nas brgyud 'debs gsang ba'i bdag po bya zhing*/ skyabs yul dmigs pa dang (52) bcas skyabs 'gro rtsa gsum kun 'dus sems bskyed 'gro kun yan lag b.ragayad pa rdo rje slob dpon rnams rnga med tshar gsum re/ rang nyid skad cing nas gsal bar gyur bar brjod nas bka' brgyad cha gsum byin brlabs nas sarba bhu gatstshaḥbar dang*/ mtshams gcod bka' brgyad ltar nyis brdung lan yod kyis/ hūṃ bka' brgyad ltar 'geb nyon cig bgegs dang nas bsnyen sngags dang sum bha ni rnga dang bcas mthar sum b.rung lan yod kyis/ hūṃ bka' brgyad chig gdangs 'gebs bdag nyid khro rgyal nas rakṣa hūṃ phaṭāḥ mthar mtshams gcod 'og la rgyab la rnga mtshams bcad/ bshags pa hūṃ gshin rje ltar rnga med dam shar gdangs bdag gi tshe rabs/ byin 'bebs hūṃ 'og shar gdangs min chos dbyings gnyis shar gdangs bcas 'don/ mchod mchod pa byin rlabs kyi argham shasta la ḍā dril bya/ bdud rtsi rakta zhi drag gi gtor ma byin brlab rnams rim par 'don dngos gzhi lha bskyed pa rang lus tha mal nas bsnyen sngags oṃ tri du bar lob dpon gyis gsung zhang thams cad bsnyen pa bzla/

grangs brgya rtsa tsam song nasabasnyen mtshanams bcad/ zhabs brtan sna gnyis gsum dang bsngo smon thor bu byas la nyal lo/ ༈ phyis nas snga bar bla ma sku gsum dang*/ brgyud 'debs nas rim par zhi bsnyen triṃ snga nub bzhin byas la/ bsnyen pa sngon ngam brgya tsam bzlas sngags mtshanams bcad/ slob dpon gyis rang nyid drang srong zhi ba 'od du zhu ba nas nag 'ded kyis trang du dzaḥdzaḥbar gsung*/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi phyi bo nas sbub chol kha 'thab cing dal bur sib la sum b.rung lan yod kyis spyan 'dren/ hūṃ gshin rjesa'i spyan 'dren 'gegs dad pa dang ni dam tshig nas sa ma ya dza dza'i mjug gsum b.rung lan can byas nas bzhugs gsol/ hūṃ mgon po'i rakta dug sna 'geb bdag cig bsod nams/ phyag 'tshal/ hūṃ bka' brgyad chig gdang slob dopan dri med/ zhi mchod oṃ 'o ma chu gtsang 'gebs sangs rgyas thams cad nas shasta'i bar bcas sngags mtshams la gong bzhin sum b.rung lan cag re bya drag mchod/ hūṃ a phyi'i ji srid byang chub 'geb zhe sdang rdo rje nas bzhes su gsol zhes rnga sib 'og ma hā ri ṣi kro dha rā dza sogs sngags rnams 'don cing sum brdung lan yod kyis sman mchod/ hūṃ bka' brgyad ltar sarba pañtsa yang sbyar rtsa brgyad yan lag nas kha ram khā hi bar bton nas rnga mtshams bcad/ dngos glu blang ba oṃ āḥhūṃ dpal ldan rdo rje rnga med kyi tsitta siddhi hūṃ bar dang yang rnga dang bcas rakta 'bul ba hūṃ zhing skyong dmar chen khrag gi arghaṃ 'geb nyon mongs 'khor ba/ gtor ma hūṃ zhing skyong sngon gsang bdag 'geb stong gsum dang mnyam gnyis kyi sngags mjung sum brdung lan yod dang*/ sbyor sgrol hūṃ mtshan zhing skyong dkyil 'khor slob dpon 'geb ldan bzung ma mjug bzhes su gsol zhes rnga siba'og ma hā ri

(53) sogs sngags rnams bton nas sum brdung lan yod kyi zhi bstod/ hūṃ sangs rgyas thams cad nas bdag la stsol bar dang*/ khro bstod hūṃ zhing skyong khraud rag bzhugs 'geb drang srong chen po dri med/ thugs dam bskal hūṃ mgon gzhung sangs rgyas 'dus skyu 'geb sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba nas mjug dgra bgegs bsgrol ba'i dus la babs zhes rnga mtshams bcad/ nga rgyal bskyed pa rang gi lce nas dang*/ gzu dpang gsol ba hūṃ sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ bzlas dmigs rang gi lce nas gdan du byas par gyur bar/ sngags tshar gcig bcas slob dpon gyis gsung*/ de nas thams cad kyi rtsa sngags brgya bskor sogs ji 'os bzlas nas mtshams bcad bsrung dmigs rang gi thugs ka nas sde brgyad kyi gnod pa las skyob par gyur bar slob dpon gyis gsung*/ thams cad kyis gsung sngags chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bzlas/ nyi ma dros chen tsam la chab rig bas phug gtor zhi ba ong skyu dang*/ drag po 'ban tshogs kyis kha gsos/ zhi gtor chu gtsang sbran/ bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i tsam la chab ril bas phug gtor zhi ba ong skyu dang*/ drag po 'ban tshogs kyis kha gsos/ zhi gtor chu gtsang sbran bsangs sbyangs stong pa'i nga las rin po che'i snod du nas kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes zhi ba'i gtor ma brlab bsngo dang*/ drag gtor sman raka sbran zhing ram yam kham nas gtor ma brlab 'bul dang bsrung shar sbyar zhing sum brdung lan yod kyi zhi drag bstod pa/ hūṃ thabs mchog bde chen 'geb rgya gar lho phyogs ma bang sharam can mjug rnga sib 'og rtsa brgyud bla ma dang mtshan ldan bla ma gnyis 'jug yi ge brgya pa bcas dang*/ bstod pa'i bzhi brdung rgyab ma mgon bstod gang bde ma nyin ltar bsgrig ma dang*/ gzhan dpal chen mgon po/ bdud tshogs ma*/ bskal pa me ltar/ byang shar nags tshal hūṃ skyes ma lnga po nas re re nyin ltar mos dang*/

yum bstod gsum/ mkhro bagr+yad bstod/ chos dbyings skye med/ myur mdzad bcas nyin ltar dang*/ bong bstod gum re mos kyi re re nam mkha' khams dpal bzhi la gnyis nyin ltar/ bka' bsrung gsum ha ra a phyi 'phrin las myur ma mgyogs/ bai rig chen/ nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khyab 'jug chen po/ dugar bgegs log 'dren/ rang bzhin rnam dag /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung sub cu rtsa gsum chos dbyings rnam dag rnam mang thos sras bar lha gnyan po gang zhig yid dran bar spyi ltar bya zhing rnga mtshams bcad/ sngar bzhin nyin gungabar bsrung sngags bzla nyin gung las byang gi tshogs bsangs sbyangs nas ha ho hri bar rnga med kyis byin brlabs nas rnga spyan 'dren ltar sib nas sum brdung lan yod kyis/ hūṃ skyes bu chen po 'geb chos dbyings bde chen nas/ dge bsnyen bzhi'i bshags pa 'geb na mo rtsa brgyubla ma sogs bskang bshags mjug dngos grub stsol ces rnga 'og yig bagr+ya dang bcas rnga mtshams bcad/ slob dpon gyi tshogs ling la dgug gzhug bya zhing rnga theng sib kyis oṃ log tri pa la nan dzaḥ zhes (54) dgugs sngags dang*/ nri tri de wa'i lha dbye bcas sib nas sum brdung lan yod kyis bsgral ba/ hūṃ stes bya drag bskul 'geg rdo rje phur pa kī la nas dbyings su drongs rnga rgyob sod kyi rnga 'og sngags bdon cing bsgral nas rnga sib su brdung lan yod kyis/ hūṃ bka' brgyad btab bo 'geb chos dbyings ngang las nas kha rim khā hi mjug yural ring rnga 'og rtsa sngags la btag sbel ba 'od rnga mtshams bcad/ tshogs lhag byin rlabs o āḥhūṃ ā kā ro gsum brjod nas rnga bcas kyi*/ hūṃ zhing skyong ma hā kā la 'geb 'don yon zag med nas dngos grub stsol ces sngags bcas sib nas rang mtshams bcad/ sngar bzhin bsrung sngags bzlas dgong mo mtshams 'jog khar/ zhi drag mchod gtor dpe bzhin kha gsol sman rag sgron sha gul bdug me tog 'thor zhing gsang ga gsol 'debs/

hoḥ dgongs su gsol nas pha la hoḥbar lan gsum gyi rjes ma'i skyabs spyan 'dren lta bur rnga sib sum brdung gis/ mnga' gsol hūṃ traṃ a phyi'i mnga' gsol 'geb khro bor sngan tsha rgyal ba 'geb chos kyi dbyings nas/ khro bo'i mjug sgrub par mdzod bar lan gsum gyi rjes ma'i mjug rnga sib nas sum brdung lan yod kyi bskul hūṃ a phyi'i shar gshegs ring thung 'geb sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba chad mod hūṃ a phyi'i chad mdo 'geb sngon tshe lcang lo sogs nas 'phrin las mdzod/ zhes rnga dgu 'theng byas la brtan skyongs/ hūṃ gang zhi yid dran thung 'then 'geb bstan pa skyong mdzad nas phyogs rnams bzlog bar dbyangs bcas mjug mtshams gcod bka' brgyad ltar byed/ rta bro nyis 'debs rnga med hūṃ drang srong 'khor bcas nas ma ra ya rbad bar dang*/ mchod pa hūṃ gsang bdag zhi khro nas dngos grub stsol zhes ḍā dril byed/ de nas dril bsil dang bcas bstod pa/ hūṃ sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ bzod gsol hūṃ drang srong zhi khro nas yig bagr+ya bcas dang*/ smon lam hūṃ bdag gzhan nas thob par shogabar dang gshegs bsdu/ hūṃ da ni bsam gtan nas/ spyod lam mo bar bzhag nas shing brjod/ hūṃ mkhyen pa'i ye shes nas bkris gun khyab shog bar shar gdangs bya/ de rjes zhabs brtan bsngo man byas la nyal lo/ bsrung ba'i ring gong ltar la tshes nyer gnyis nyin gter chen bzhengs khyad snga tsham dbu 'jug nas/ nyi dris kyi thun mjug yig brgya 'don pa'i bar snga nur gyi bton nas mtshams bzhag gtor chen bzhengs nas khror 'don zhing phyi gtor bca' gzhi bzhin legs par bsgrigs nas me rlung chu sogs sbyangs gtsang bar byas/ zin nas bstan kha sbub gos mgo mjug slog /drag zhur 'then rkang badha' btang sgrub po rnams stan la 'okhad nas/ bzlog pa'i mgor yod pa ltar zor bskyed bsangs sbyangs nas/ zor gtor cig stong pa'i ngang zhes pa nas stong khams gang ba'i dpung du gyur bar dang las byang gi lha tshogs

(55) thams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po nas dzaḥdzaḥbar slob dkon gyis gung zhing*/ oṃ dkar po nas sbub chol kha 'thab cing dal bur sib/ 'di skabs rkang dung btang*/ sum brdul gis hūṃ dad pa ngad ni sogs spyan 'dren/ bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal mchod pa sman mchod raka mchod gtor mchod sbyor sgrol mchod pa bstod pa bskul nga gr+yal bskyed pa gzung dpang bzla dmigs bar bsrung ba'i skabs ltar dang*/ bzlas pa ji 'os bzla zhing de rjes gang gi bde gshegs nas gang zhing yid dran bar sngar bzhin dang*/ de mus tshogs byin brlabs tshogs lhag mjug bar btang nas bzhag 'di nyin nas tshogs ling tshogs lhag thun gtor rnams la rkang gling btang*/ de nas bsrung sngags rang la 'bad nas/ nod nub mtshams 'jog khar khasang ba gsol 'debs nas bang sman shings brjod bar snga nub bzhin bya'o/ phyi nas tshos nyis gsum la sngar bzhin las byang rim par gyer ba'i lha bskyed skyabs gur sgom pa'i mjug gzhom gzhig dang bral bar gyur*/ zhes pa'i bar 'dir zor bskyod bangs sbyangs nas/ sung du gyur bar dang*/ yang las byang gi lha tshogs thams cad nas bsrung sngags bar nyin ltar bzhin dang*/ nyi shar skabs zhi ba'i gtor 'bul song nas thun gtor rakta sbran slob dpon gyi dgug gzhugs gcig mthar nga sib 'og ram yam kham nas gtor ma byin brlabs 'bul ba dang 'od gsol bsrung sham can mthar sum brdul lan yod kyi bstod pa gr+ya gar lha phyogs bsrung sham can mjug 'dod gsol smon lam yig brgyang ba'i skabs ltar bya zhing de mus gang bde nas gang zhig yid dran bar nyin ltar bzhin byas nas mtshams bcad*/ de nas stan kha sbub gos mgo mjug slog drag zhur 'then nas slob dpon gyis bzlog dmigs rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i tha ma'i phyag gnyis nas bhyo bzlog bar gsung*/ thams cad kyi bzlog sngags la 'bad nyid gung sngags mtshams bcad nas

slob dpon gyis thal dhob dmigs pa rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i nas brlag par gyar bar gsung thams cad kyi na mo bla ma tshig phrad bsgyur ba lan gsum dang*/ gzhug gi mdod pa bka' ltar mi byed nas bzlog tu nan bar lan gcig gis thal mo badhab/ thun sngags ring mo tshar gsum lnga bdun tsam zhar la drag sngags chem can kyang bdun tsam bzlas nas/ gdab las kyi yo byad rnams zhal phu 'grim gong du bzlog pa'i skabs ltar thal dhob bya/ lcags sno du sha zan lnga bdun dgu sogs bshams ka rakta sbran slob (56) dpon gyi dgugs gzhug gsum gyi rjes ma'i rnga 'og drag gtor byin rlabs ram kham nas brlab bsngo dang bzlog sham yang bzlog ltar sbyar zhing sum brdung lan yod kyi bstod bskul/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi rnam 'phrul nas/ rang gshed rang la phob bar dang rnga sib 'og dgra bgegs gdug pa dang hūṃ gtum chen sogs 'don rnga mtshams bcad/ bsgral las kyi rkang badha' btang*/ gdab las yo byad rnams slob dpon mdun du bshams/ gser skyems sngags drug gi brlabs rnga sib nas ma brdung lan yod kyis/ hūṃ phyogs gsum kunpādus la phyogs bcu nam mkha' 'geb 'phros la bzlog rnga bcas 'phrin las mdzod bar dang*/ sum brdung lan yod kyi gzu dpang*/ hūṃ rtsa brgyud bla ma ya yongs kyi bskur ba 'geb mi 'then tshe bzlog rnga bcas las mdzod cing*/ zhes tshar gsum mjug rnga mtshams bcad la phaṭāḥrgyab stong pa'i ngang las rang nas ngo bor gyur bar hrug 'don byed/ slob dpon gyis dbugs gzhug gsum bya/ gsum ka'i rnga 'og 'gugs sngags brjod cing*/ rta rmig 'kho lo yod na g.yug rje mar sum brdung gi bskul/ hūṃ sangs rgyas bstan pa nas nyi 'debs rnga yod kyi dus la babs zhes rnga mtshams bcad/ nga rgyal bskyed pa rang nyid sdang rdo rje'i nas mi shes par gyur hrug 'don gyi rnga sib nas sum brdung lan can gyis

hūṃ nga ni ma mo nyis 'debs rnga yod kyis las rnams khyed kyi sgrubs zhes rnga mtshams bcad/ slar yang lce rdo rje hrug 'don gyis bsgrub par gyur ces rnga sib nas drag bskul/ bhyoḥ mchod bstod bsnyen cing la khyung spyan 'dren dang*/ bla 'gugs ring thung re mos kyi gdangs 'phros bzlog rnga bcas/ mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho zhes pa'i skabs sha zan dgu tsam yod pa phul nas/ mjug guṇḍa hoḥ rnga sib nas 'jog 'gug pa rang gi lce rdo rje nas dngos su yod par gyur bar hrug 'don gyis 'gugs sngags rnga med kyi tshar bdun nam bco lnga nyer gcig gang 'os ri slob dkon gyis rte rmig chad med g.yug lha dbye rang gi lce rdo rje'i nas 'dug par gyur bar hrug 'don gy-is rnga sib nas/ hūṃ dam nyams dgra bgegs la lha dbye rag gdangs kyi mjug sib nas sum brdung gis nyes bsgrags/ hūṃ dug lnga'i dbang gyur la nyis 'debs rnga yod kyis khyod smon cig zhes rnga mtshams bcad thun dha mtshams bcad thun dhog pa thun rdzos rnams nas zos par gyur bar hrug 'don/ rnga sib nas sum brdung gis hūṃ nga ni zhes sdang rdo rje nyis 'debs rnga yod thun bskul bhyoḥ sna tshogs thun rdzas la nyis 'debs rnga yod mjug rgyob sod yun ring 'og thun sngags rang mos thun brgyab/ nyi zla thal dhob rang zhe sdang rdo rje nas lceb lceb zos par gyur hrug 'don bzlog sngags tshar (57) bdun thugs sngags ring mo tshar gcig gi rjes su dmod pa/ bka' ltar byed sil 'don thal dheb byed/ yang bzlog sngags mgo slang ba'i de 'dre tshar gcig khyon gsum bya/ gnas spar rang gi lag pa nas/ mthu dang par gyur bar hrug 'don/ e ma khams gsum nyis 'debs rnga med/ hūṃ ye shes rtsal ldan de kha'i mus/ hūṃ dgra gdon khyod kyi nyis 'debs rnga med thung ba sam ha ṇa hūṃ bar dang phur gdab hūṃ rdo rje phur pa nyis med rnga med kyi brlag par mdzod bar dang*/

hūṃ dam nyams sdig can la chig 'debs rnga med mjug rgyab sod kyis bsgral nas sib 'jog gtun brdung hūṃ brdung shig rdo rje yang de kha'i mus mjug rgyob sod kyi bsdung nas sib cing btab bo/ hūṃ chos dbyings ngang dang bhyo dregs 'dul khro rgyal/ bhyo khro rgyal zhi sdang rdo rje gsum ka nyis 'debs rnga med dam bzlog rnga re mos kyi mjug sib nas 'jog dmod pa bka' ltar mi byed nas bzlog tu nan bar lan gsum gyi thal mo badhab/ rnga sib nas bskul hūṃ mchog gsum kun 'dus la nyes byas drag bskul gdangs 'phros la bzlog rnga de bas dam rdzas pa ling zhes pa'i skabs sha zan lnga tsam phul/ bhyoḥ dregs pa sde brgyad mtshan nyid la snang gsal ba'i gdangs bka' 'phros bzlog rnga*/ sha khrag rgyan ldan skabs sha zan lnga tsam phul/ myur du grub ces dang sde brgyad bskul tshe de kha'i mus/ sde brgyad bskul la sha zad brgyad phul bzlog bsgyur hūṃ bhyoḥ dregs 'dul drang srong bzlog rnga dam rdzas gtor ma'i skabs sha bdun tsam phul/ sgrub par mdzod mjug rnga sib mtshams bcad/ bzlog sngags tshar bdun dmod pa bka' ltar mi byed nas/ bzlog tu nan bar tshar gsum gyis thal mo badhab/ gsang ba gsol 'debs dang mnga' gsol tshar gsum mjug rnga 'og 'dod gsol/ rtsa brgyud bla ma mtshan ldan bla ma bya tshogs lhag bskul chad tho brtan skyong rnams rim par 'don brtan skyongs mjug mtshams gcod mi bya bar sib nas 'jog /bzlog sngags la 'bad de nub mtshams 'jog khar na mo bla ma dang bka' ltar mi byed gnyis gung thun ltar bya/ thun gtor rakta sbran/ slob dpon gyi dgug gzhug tshar gsum gyi rjes mi mjug sman raka sbran cing*/ rnga 'og ram yam kham nas byin rlabs gtor 'bul bzlog sham can mjug sub brdung lan yod kyis/ bstod bskul hūṃ rgyalab kun gyi rnam 'phrul nas thugs dam gnad nas bskul la sa ma ya bar dang

dregs 'dul khro rgyal la gru gsum mthing nag 'geb nas rang gshed rang la phob bar dang*/ lcags si bhandha tshig phrad bsgyur ba'i thun gtor 'phang la mtshams gcod rgyab ring*/ slob dpon gyis bzlog sngags thel can ci rigs mthar*/ na mo bla ma gsum dang bka' ltar mi byed tshar gcig gis thal dheb mdzad/ bro brdung nas bkris bar bsrung ba'i skabs ltar bya'o/ ༈ tshes nyer dgu'i nyin snga tsam dub tshugs shing tshogs lhag bar nyin ltar bzhin song rjes/ zor rdzas rnams la drag sngags thel can gyi zhal phu 'grim/ sgrub khang sdeng rgya lcog khebs ldan khar mchod pa/ gser skyems dpar gathor gnyis sogs dang*/ zar gdan g.yang gzhi gang rung khar zor rnams yol go lta bur bkod/ bsgrub po po rnams drag zhur zhwa phod drag cas su zhugs nas stong du phyin/ thebs phyogs kha gtad nas gzhi bdag dkar gtor btang phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad ma'i gser skyems phul mjug rnga sib nas/ zer gyi gling bzhi bhyo dang po zare byung la rgyal chen bzhi bskul gyis/ dang po sngags zar de ltar byung bar 'then/ de 'okha bar gyi bskal sa nas sil 'don gyis/ mo ltar rmi lam mtshan lngas dgra la bhyoḥ zhes lcags sam bhandha'i rnga rgya nas slob dpon dang char ril ba zor khyer te thebs phyogs ngos su phyin/ bhyo khro rgyal zhes sdang rdo rje nas brlag par mdzod bar lcags sam bhandha'i byangs gyer zhing*/ rnga rgyob sod kyi kong zar bzhi drag sngags thems dang bcas pa'i slob dpon gyi phyogs so sor 'phang pa'i stang dang bcas chab rigal bas thebs phyogs su 'phang*/ de ltar bus mda' zor khrag zor rdo zor gtor zor bcas gong bzhin 'phang*/ gtor zor mjug rnga rgyob sod yun ring bya/ de'i ring slob dpon gyis thun sngags ring mo tshar gcig 'jug na mo bla ma tshar gsum dang*/ bka' ltar mi byed tshar gcig gis thal mo badhab/ slob dpon tshul byon nas rnga sib mtshams bcad/

phyi mar rol zhi sgrub khang du byon/ mdos lam bris/ gtor chen zhal bsgyur sha zan rakta sbran dgug gzhug gcig mthar sman raka sbran/ ram yam kham nas byin rlabs gtor bsngos bzlog sham sbyo raba'i mthar/ las byang gi bskul hūṃ sangs rgyas bstan pa ched mdo dang bstan skyong bathang zhing mjug rnga sib 'jog dang*/ gtor ma dpag slar yang slob dpon gyis/ oṃ ma hā ri ṣi kro dha rā dza sa pa ri ri arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hāḥ nas shusta'i bar dang gong sngags wa ranga'i mthar sman raka gtor ma'i sngas kyi mchod/ bstod par 'os pas bstod cing*/ gtor chen gyi lha ye shes pa rten la bstim zhing dam tshig sems dpa' rang nyid la thim par gyur/ slar yang drag gtor de nyid nas/ rlung gi 'phyag par bsam bar slob dpon gyis dmigs pa sprad nas/ 'phyar dar dgar gtor gyi sna drangs rol mo dang bcas drag sngags bzla bzhin sgo phyir dpags la/ bzlog byang drag gtor de nyid nas/ rlung gis 'phyag par bsam bar slob dpon gyis dmigs pa sprad nas/ 'phyar dar dkar gtor gyi sna drangs rol mo dang bcas drag sngags bzla bzhin sgo phyir dpags la/ bzlog byang hūṃ bhyo drogs 'dul drang srong nas drag pos 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod bar tshar gsum/ bzlog sngags tshar bdun gyis sran chan brab/ gtor chen la sha zan rakta sbran/ slob dkon gyis dgus gzhug rgyas pa tshar gsum gyi

(58) rjes ma'i mjug sman raka sbran cing ram yam kham sogs byin rlabs gtor bsngos bzlog sharam can mjug su brdung lan yod kyi/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun nas sil 'don sa ma ya bar dang*/ dregs 'dul khro rgyal nas grub gsum mthing dbyings bka' pa'i rang la phob bar 'then 'jug /gtor ma me chu sogs su 'phang*/ slob dpon gyi thun sngags ring mo tshar gsum dang*/ na mo bla ma dang bka' ltar mi byed tshar gsum gyi mo badhab/ nam mkha' med pa brjod/ sa la chos 'byung rig gsum rtse mo 'phang phyogasasu bstan pa'i dbus su nri tri mgo slob dpon la bstan pa bris/ slob dpon gyasi dgug gzhug gcig gis gtor gzhong sbub/ de shul du me sbar la slob dpon gyis bden stobs gcig gis med dgra chus bsad/ de steng bsgrub pa po rnams lag g.yon stong du byas te lug ga brgyud du sbrel la/ las byang gi bre brdung hūṃ drang srong nas ma ra ya rbad bar dang dang po dpal chen sbyar ba'i mjug oṃ log dri pā la nan nan sogs mnan sngags tshar gsum brjod nas gtor snod gyen la 'brus bkang*/ nri tri steng du mtho brtsigs slob dpon gyis mtho zhe sdang rdo rjer gsal ba la/ g.yas bskor dgu byas pas nang sang sangs rgyas kyi byas pa'i ngan sbyor zhing par bsam*/ zhes dmigs pa sprad nas g.yas bskor dgu bya/ yang g.yonabaskor dgu byas pas phyi pa mu stegs kyi byas pa'i ngan sbyor zhig par bsam zhes brjod nas g.yonabaskor dgu bya/ spra brtags phyis bye ma'i ri mo dgu 'then la dgutsa lung dgu bsgral nas rang yul du log par bsams la bsrung sngags bzla bzhin nang du log chas su zhugs pa yin na chas gos phud gral ma 'khod nas tshe sgrub rang nyid sreng dre med nas rigs 'dzani thob par gyur bar slob dpon gyis gsung thams cad kyis tshe dzapra brgya sogs cig 'grub bzlas nas/ 'dod gsol chos logs sprul sku tshar gsum kun gyis bton nas thag bcad do/

༈ de nub bam phyis nang zhi dga gi gathor ma snod du blangs la dpal 'bar 'dzug zhi gtor brlab bsngo dang de rjes slob dpon gyi drag gtor dgug gzhug byas zhing sman rakra sbran byin brlab gtor bsngos bsrung sharam 'jug sum brdung gis bstod pa rgya gar ma bsrung sham can gyi thog tu 'bul zhing rnga 'og 'dod gsol smon lam bya zhing*/ gtang rag mchod pa hūṃ gsang bdag drang srong nas shi brjod mjug bar dkyus bzhin bya zhabs brtan dang bsod nams gr+yas par bsngo bdaga'akhor ma tshar nas slob dpon gyi gshogs bsdu hūṃ da ni bsam gtan nas spyod lam mo bar gsung bkris zung 'jug khyab bdag dang thub bstan phyogs brgyar bka' brgyu bla ma bcas kyis grol lo/ ༈ yang gtor bzlog zhag bdun nam lnga bu'am tshe phyi nang gnyis ka'i gtor ma thams cad tshugs nyin rang bzhengs nas/ de nub bdag sdang ma nas zhing bsnyen bar gong gi nub dang po bzhin la khro bo bskyod pa nas rtsa sngags oṃ log tri pā la nan bar sbrel nas 'don zhing rtse sngags ci 'grub bzlas nas sngags mtshams bcad*/ zhabs brtan bsod nams spyi ltar bsngo zhing nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug sa dang*/ phyis nang nas 'don lugs thams cad tshes nyes gsum ltar byas na 'grigs par 'gyur bas thugs la 'dog pa 'tshal lo/ ༈ yang sngags la brten pa'i bsrung bzlog byed na phyi nang gi bca' gzhi thams cad gong ltar la*/ nyin lta bsgral rgyu'i nya'o dang phun nun sogs bsgral las kyi yo byad rnams mi dgos/ de gtor sha zan sogs de rtsis byas/ 'don las ni sgrub zhag ji ltar byed kyang gral 'dzin nub mo 'don lugs ni gong dang 'dra phyis nang nas gong gi tshes nyer gsum nang bzhin dbu 'jug nas nyi shar thun skabs phyi nang gi gtor bsos zhi bar chu gatshang dang drag por sman rakra sbran/ zhi ba'i gtor 'bul song nas thun gtor rakta sbran/ slob dpon gyasi dgug gzhug gcig mthar rang sib 'og

ram yam kham nas byin brlab gtor bsngos bsrung sharam can mthar su brdung lan yod kyis bstod pa rgya gar ma bsrung sham can mjug rnga 'og rtsa brgyud bla ma mtshan ldan bla ma yig bagr+ya bcas gong ltar dang de mtshams gang bde nas/ gang yid dran bar gyi bstod thung rnams btang nas slar yang bsrung sngags rang la 'bad slar nyin gung thun sprod lugs kyang gong gi nyi shar ltar byas zhing yig brgya bzla ba'i mjug tshogs mchod byin brlabs nas btab so yan btang mtshams bzhag bsgrub pa po rnams gdan kha sbrub gos mgo mjug slog drag zhur 'then slob dpon gyib bzlog dmigs rang nyid zhing sdang rdo rje'i tha ma'i phyag gnyis nas bhyo bzlog bar gsung*/ thams cad kyi bzlog sngags la 'bad dgong thun nyi ma grib so gug mtshams sngags mtshams bcad/ slob dpon gyi thal dhob dmigs pa rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i nas brlag par gyur par gsungs thams cad kyis na mo bla ma tshig phrad bsgyur ba gsum dang*/ bka' ltar mi byed lan gsum gyi thal mo badhab/ gtor ma gso sman raka sbran thun gtor sha zan lag rakna sbran slob dpon gyi dgug gzhug drag po gsum gyi mthar ram yam kham gtor ma byin brlabs bsngo zhing yang bzlog ltar bzlog sham sbyar ba'i 'dod gsol mthar sum brdung lan yod kyi/ hūṃ rgyal ba kun gyi rnam 'phrul nas/ rang gshed rang la phob bar dang*/ rnga sib 'og dgra bgegs gdug pa hūṃ gtum chen dang 'dod gsol smon lam bya zhing rga mtshams bcad gsang ba gsol 'debs dang mnga' gsol rnams tshar gsum re*/ tshogs lhag bskul chad mdo brtan skyongs (59) rnams bya zhing mtshams gcod mi rgyab par bzhag slar yang bzlog sngags rang la 'bad de nub mtshams 'jog kha srod thun la sngags mtshams bcad/ slob dpon gyi bsad dmigs mdun du brub khung nas zos par gyur bar gsung*/ thams cad kyi spu gri'i sngags rkyang pa tshar bdun dang*/

spu gri'i drag sngags ring mo tshar gsum dang*/ slob dpon gyis thal dheb/ dmigs pa rang nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i nas brlag par gyur par gsung thams cad kyis na mo bla mtshar gsum dang bka' ltar mi byed tshar gsum gyis thal dheb dgos thun ltar bya/ gtor ma gso zhing sman raka sbran thun gtor ma rakta sbran slob dpon gyasi dgus gzhug tshar gsum gyi rjes mi'i mjug sman raka gnyis ka sbran cing rnga 'og ram yam kham nas byin brlabs gtor 'bulabazlog sham can mjug sum brdung lan yod kyis bstod bskul hūṃ rgyal ba kun nas sa ma ya bar dang dregs 'dul drang srong la gru gsum mthing nag dbyangs 'gaib nas/ rang la phob bar dang*/ lcags sam bhandha tshig phrad bsgyur ba gyer ba'i thun gtar 'phang la mtshams gcod rgyal b.ring slob dpon gyis bzlog sngags thel can ci rigs mthar*/ na mo bla ma gsum dang bka' ltar mi byed tsar gcig gis thal dheb mdzad cing brdung nas shis brjod bar gong gi tshig bzlog skabs dang 'dra gtor ma 'phang rgyu'i nyin nyi shar thun mjug bstod thung rnams 'don la bzlog dmigs bsgyur nas nyin gung snga zur tsam bar bzlog sngags dang*/ de mus bsad dmigs bsgyur zhing spu gri'i sngags kyang bdun dang*/ spu gri'i drag sngags ring mo gsum thal dheb dmigs pa dang bcas/ na mo bla ma bka' ltar mi byed dgug gzhug gtor ma brlabs bsngo bstod bskul rnams dgong thun ltar bya rjes tshogs byin brlab nas lhag gtor ba'i rigs pa rnams nag 'ded kyis bya zhing*/ skabs 'dir drag sngags thel can bzla ba'i zor rdzas rnams zhal phu 'grim mo de phyin thogs stong gser skyebs sogs nas gtor 'bul mjug chog gi bar rnams gong du tshig bzlog skabs bshad pa ltar bya bas mthus par 'gyur zhing 'on kyang zhib mo'i blo yis legs par brtag cing cho ga phyag len kun kyang ma shes shes brdzu sogs rtsing por spyod pa spongs la som nyi za ba'i mtshon la dris rtsad bcad cing rtog zhib mthar tshod byas na nyos ltung mi 'byung zhing 'di phyi 'i don ldan du 'gyur bas go bar byes shig

zhu dag (60) (pa) ༄༅// rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kunda'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sdeb sbyor mnyam pa'i bri rta las yi ge bcu gnyis pa skye 'gro la spyir snam grangs bzhi stong dgu bcu go drug yod pa las/ uddhiṣṭaḥchig stong brgya don gcig naṣṭa ri ba tsa tur grangs ltar rkang bzhi sdoms pa'i watnazhes brgyad lci ba so gnyis yang ba bcu gsum phyi mo brgyad cu a dhwa phrid la nyir gsum/ stong 'og la brgyad stong chig brgya dgu bcu go gcig sa me tog phreng ba'i sras sta ra'o// 'jig rten gsum na gr+yal bstan kun gsal khyon// de 'dzin rgyu skra dbus na mngon mtho'i mgon// phyag na padma'i sgyu 'phrul nyin byed dbang*// phyogs las rnal rgyal mtshan snyan spyi bos bsten// 'khyen dang brtse ba nus pa'i mnga' bdag rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi nam mkha' la/ de'i gsung snying po zhi ba chags bral dam chos rlung gi rgyal mtshan can*/ phan dang bde ba'i 'od mdangs yongs 'tsher rig grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun sogs/ mi bslu gtan gyi skyabs gnas bla med kon mchog rin chen gatshug na rgyal/ gdod nas 'gyur bral kun tu bzang po'i mkha' klong las/ sprul pa'i zlos gar mngon par bsgyur ba rtan bdun dbang*/ 'gro kun phan dang bde ba'i 'dab stong rgyas mdzad pa/ rtsa gsum kun 'dus padma 'byung gnas bdag sogs skyongs/ bde chen lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzugs sku'i mkha'/ stong gsal sna tshogs lha mo'i dbang gzhus 'khyud/ gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba sgyu ma mkhan/ zung 'jug dus kyi 'khor lo phyag gi gnas/ tshogs gnyis chu gter che las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ 'jam dpal rdo rje rnon po bsil sbyan mkhan rmad byung (61) mkhyen dang brtse ba'i 'od zer gyis/ blo yi kunda rgyas mdzad dad pa'i yulba mdzes mdzes lta bas mi ngos 'jo sgog nyams/ snyan snyan tumbu ra yi sgra dpal sbyin/

yang yang gsol ba 'debs na shes bya'i don/ mang mang thogs med stsol cig sgra dbyangs lha/ ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i grong khyer shambha lar/ gsang chen theg mchog bdud rtse'i za ma tog skal ldan kun la ster ba mi yi rje/ chos gr+yal re bo'i grangs kyi dge legs stsol/ ya mtshan rkang 'thung 'phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i dbus/ 'gro kun yid sim ha ri dra'i sdong po/ phul byung rgyud don dri bsrung rab 'phro ba/ rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngas bdag skyongs shig byang phyogs rgyal khab rin chen gling mchog tu/ rdzu 'phrul snying stobs kyis 'grod rgyud 'grel kun/ thugs 'dzin nor bu'i zor mang 'phags yul du/ drangs mkhas paṇa chen rnam gnyis phyag gi gnas/ phyi nang gzhan gsum gser gyi shing rta che/ ring lugs bod 'ulpar rab 'dren mdzad pa/ rwa 'gro shong dpang lo paṇa mdzad bzang kun/ sabam tshe lag pa'i padma snying khar zum/ rnam dag phug lugs gzhung bzang chu gter las/ mi dbang pā ri'i mkhyen pa'i bum bzang du/ yongs gtams rin chen yol gor baiḍār dkar/ mngon par 'gengs pa'i legs bshad 'di nyid kyang*/ 'dor byed grangs mang brtsegs pa'i bla mkhyen kun/ mjub mo ngal ba'i nyams len ches dkon pas/ des na baiḍār dkar po'i 'o ma'i mtsho/ bsrubs pa'i skra rts-is snying por grub pa'i bcud/ rtsis kyi bstan bcos shar ri'i phrag gong nas/ lhag bsam nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyis/ blo gsar kunda'i tshogs rnam ma lus sa/ 'dod pa 'dzo byed pal 'di kho bos sbyin/ bstan bcos rgya mtsho che las ri mo yi/ lag len chu thig khol byung bris pa la/ ma dag rnyog pa'i rjing bur zla ba'i gzugs/ 'char 'dod 'khrul pa ci mchis mkhas la bshags/ tshul 'di rtsis gzhung zla ba'i ma ma cher/ blo dman gsar bur phan sems gru rjong gis/ legs bskyod lag len bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal/ rgyal mtshan rtser bkod 'dod 'byung 'di longs shing*/

༈ sngon 'gro bya ba'i rigs pa ni rgyas pa baiḍār dkar po sogs/ sngon byin mkhas pas gsal bas na/ 'dir ni sa bcad tsam zhig 'bri*/ de (62) nas lo 'go 'dzin tshul ni/ bzhed tshul mi 'dra mang mchas kyang*/ gnyis med dpal ldan dus 'khor lo/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs mchod rten cher/ gsungs pa'i dus zla yin pa sogs/ lo yi thog ma rab byung dang*/ nag zla dkar po'i tshes gcig gi ris gza' nyi ma rgyu skar dbyug lug khyim la sogs dus gcig tu/ 'dzom phyir nag pa'i zla ba nyid/ lo 'gor 'dzin pa 'khrul med lugs/ rgya nag 'khrul gyi rtsis gzhung las/ hor gyi zla ba bcu gnyis pa/ dpyid ra stag la bzhed pa 'dir/ rang lugs mdzad cing phug lugs kyi/ yongs grags hor zla bcu gcig stag /nam langs yos nas lo 'og 'dzin/ zhes bshad mgo zla stag thog ma/ yin phyir stag yos 'brug sbrul dang*/ rta tshugs spre'u dang bya khyi phag byi ba glang bcas rigs pa bzhin/ pho lo mo lo'i rnam gzhag ste/ de la shing me sa lcags chus/ gnyis gnyis 'byung bas zin pa de/ lo rgan drug cur grags sa yin/ de yi spros pa 'phags yul du/ me yos rab byung don gcig pa'i/ rab byung rnam byung dkar po dang*/ rab myos skyes bdag aṅgi ra/ dpal dgon dngos po na tshed ldan/ 'dzin byed dbang yug 'bru mang po/ myos ldan rnam gnon khyu mchog dang*/ sna tshogs nyi ma nyi sgrol byed/ sa skyong mizad thams cad 'dul kun 'dzin 'gal ba rnam 'gyur dang*/ bod bu dga' ba rnam rgyal nyid/ rgyal ba smyos byed gdong ngan sa/ gser 'phying rnam 'phyang sgyur byed dang*/ kun ldan 'phar ba dge byed dang*/ mdzes byed khro mo sna tshogs dbyig zil gnon spri'u phun bu dang*/ zhi ba mthun mong 'gal byed dang*/ yongs 'dzin bag med kun dga' dang*/ srin po me dang dmar ser can/ dus kyipho nya den grub drag blo ngan rnga chen khrag sgyug pa/ mig dmar khro bo zad pa'o/

de rnams bsags pas bskal pa ste/ rdzogs ldan gsum ldan gnyis ldan dang*/ rtse ldan zhes su grags pa yin/ lo re ya yang da dus drug/ dpyed sos dbyar dgun stod smad/ dri zhim ldan dang drod phebs dang*/ me tog ldan rnams dpyid du grags/ nges srog tsha gdung can dang ni/ tshad cad dro 'ong so gar 'dod/ chu bo gzhung rgyas sprin gyi dus/ bsgyur byed char dus dbyer zhes grags/ dga' skyed 'bras ldan mda' sbyin dang*/ dus kyi snga ston ka'o/ kha dus dgun stod grang dus smad*/ de yang zla ba'i 'phel 'grib gnyis/ tshes zhag sum cur 'khor ba ste/ lo yi yan lag lo'i cha shas/ dbugs skyes lo yi mdzod ces dang*/ zhag gi phung po zla ba ste so so'i da ba hor lugs kyi/ dang po nas bzung 'di bzhin te/ mchu zla mā gha rta pa zla dka' thub zla ba 'du byed dang*/ cho 'phrul kam sa dang po'o/ khra zla dbe zla 'bras ldan zla/ re hi ra dang (63) phalgu ṇa/ sbo zla rnam shes gnyis pa'i ming*/ nag zla sbrang zla myos par byed/ dri zhim ldan dang yid srubs zla/ 'dod dus zla dang ming gzugs zla/ tsi tra mo ha ti gsum pa dang*/ sa ga zla ba med tog ldan/ sgrub byed me tog sbrang rtsi bskyed/ be sha kha dang bha dra dang*/ skye mched zla ba bzhi par 'dod/ snron zla nges srog 'dod 'phel ba/ reg pa ri ṣa bha dag byed dzyeṣṭha gatshang ma lnga par brjod/ chu stod can dang gtsang ma'i zla/ ā ṣā dhā ste tshor ba dang*/ kurma zla ba drug pa'o/ gro bzhin zla ba ma ka ra/ nam mkha'i thod ldan myos zla dang*/ da shu ba ṇa nor ldan khyu mchog can/ bzang zla regs pa ba glang rkang*/ bha dra pa dang sprin bzang can/ len pa daṇḍa brgyad pa'o/ tha skar ltad sbyor rtsi tog zla/ a shī ni ste mi ki re/ klu dbyangs srid pa rgod ma can/ ltad mo'i zla ba dgu par 'dod/ smin drug zla ba mang so 'dzin/ karti ka dngamago las skyes/ skye ba bitta sa ga skyes/

bcu pa'i mang du brjod pa dang*/ mgo zla mṛ ga shirṣa dang*/ ri dwags mgo dang smal po'i zla/ tshim byed rga shi byaku li/ bkod ldan nus ldan bcu gcig pa/ rgyal zla tshim byed po'o ṣa/ mṛ swasan me tog ldan/ nus zla bcu gcig pa yi ming bden don yan lag bcu gnyas po/ mtshon phyir zla ba bcu gnyis zhes/ khyim ni nag zla nas bzung ste/ lug glang 'khrigs pa karka ṭa/ seng gi bu mo srang sdig gzhu/ chu srid bum sa nya rnams so/ 'dul mngon mar ngo sngon 'gro dang*/ tshes ni dbyangs 'char ma gtogs par/ gcig nas bco lnga'i bar dag tu/ dkar phyogs zhas drags zla tshes dang*/ zhi dang rgyas pa'i phyogs yar ngo*/ phyogs kyi dang po zla mngon lo'i/ bcu drug nas bzung nag phyogs te/ dmar phyogs 'byung 'du dam can 'du/ phyogs kyi phyi ma zhes pa dang*/ dbang dang drangag po'i phyogs mar ngo*/ zla rer phyogs gnyis grub pa yi/ lo gcig su brgya drug cu ste/ de la phyag bdag du 'khor nas/ dbyangs gsal 'dod yon la sogs pa/ rang byung lo dang zhal chu tshed/ la sogs spros pa ji snyed cing*/ tshes lha 'char ba'i tshul tsam du/ lagus 'byung lugs ldog bcas pa yi/ sde sa ri yis zla ba gnyis/ mtshon pa'i nag pa zla ba yi/ tshes gcig lha mo nya rdo rje*/ karṭa'i tshes gcig pa rdo rje/ la sogs sgrub thabs le'ur bshad/ 'jig rten khams kyi le'u nas/ dbyangs gsal 'char tshul lugs gcig la/ zla ba bcu gnyis kun gyi tshes/ gcig nas a i ṛ yu l̥/ drug nas ar e al/ ha ya ra ba la rim bzhin/ dkar phyogs 'char la nag phyogs kyi/ bcu gcig nas bzung lā wā rā/ tshes lha su brgya drug

(64) ā l̥̄ ū ṝ ī ā rnams/ rim lin sdud pas 'char ba la/ srog gi dbyangs zhes bshad pa dang*/ gsal byed chu srid khyim zla la/ ka kha nga gha nga lnga la/ gong gi dkar phyogs nag phyogs kyi/ dbyangs rnams ma nyams bzhin bzhugs pa'i/ ka khi gṛ ghu ngli zhes dang*/ ka khe gar gho nga la kaha/ khya gra ghwa dang*/ rla klā khwā ste/ grā ghyā kā la/ 'khor gar ghai dā klī khū gṝ ghī dā sogs zla kun gyi/ dbyangs rnams gsal byed la zhug tshul/ khyad med de la yi ge'i dbyangs/ gsal byed bum par chu srin gyi/ de dag ldog ste nga gha ga kha ka lnga so drug skor du/ dbyangs ldan chu srid ji bzhin 'char/ nyi la tsa sde'i gsal byed drug chu sarid ji bzhin lugs la ldog de bzhin ṭa sde kling khyim la/ chu srid bzhin 'char 'khrig par ldog pa sde karṭar cha srin bzhin/ seng ge ldog ste 'char ba dang*/ ta ste bu mo chu srin ltar/ srang la ldog ste 'char ba dang*/ sa pa ṣa ka lnga po/ sdig par chu srin bzhin 'char ba/ gzhu la ldog ste 'char bar dang*/ yang na dbyangs gsal gong bshad la/ dkar cha'i zla ba thig les brgyan/ dmar cha sgrib pas par bcad/ ldan pa gsal byed zhugs tshul sogs/ sngon ma ji ltar mtshungs pa yin/ gzhan yang khyim zhal la sbyar ba'i/ tshes lha sum brgya drug cu yi/ sa bon ji bzhin 'char yang yod/ nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa/ sgra reg ro dri sna lnga/ dkar po'i phyogs la lan gsum 'khor/ nag phyogs sa chu me rlung dang*/ nam mkha' drigazugs ro reg sgra/ gsum skor rim bzhin 'char bar bzhed/ gtsug na zla ba'i legs bshad las/ dzanma ha ni la sogs pa'i/ tshes la 'char ba'i tshul mang yang*/ grags che dkar nag phyogs ldog pa'i/ ā ī ū ai au lnga/ 'byung ba sa chu me rlung mkha'/ dri re ru pa reg sgra rnams/ dkar po'i phyogs la lan gsum 'khor/ gsal byed nga ṇa gsum po/ spangs pa'i ka nas da'i bar 'char/ nag phyogs i u e o/

gsal byed dha nas ha'i bar du/ rim par tshes rer 'char 'gyur zhing*/ 'byung ba 'dod yon dkar phyogs ltar/ gsum skor rim 'char dga' ba dang*/ bzang po rgyal stong rdzogs pa lnga/ phyog rer gsum skor mtshungs par 'char/ nam langs skyes bu'i lag pa'i ris/ mgon pa nas bzung ri rtse yi/ nyi nub lag ris nub pi bar/ nyin mo'i rnam gzhag yin pa ste/ mdangs gsar gsal snang padma bzhad/ mun sel snang ba ldan rnams so/ nyi nub nas bzung tho rengs bar/ mtshan mo yin no de yi ming*/ nges nyal mun bcas nyal ba'i dus/ (65) thun gsum ku mud bzhad rnams so/ nyin mtshan dus tshod drug la/ nyi ma gang yod rags pa la/ nag langs nas drangs dus sbyor ro/ gzhan yang gtsug lag nag rtsis nas/ nam langs yos la nyi shar 'brug nyi dres sbrul la nyi phyed rta/ phyed yol lug la nyi myur sprel/ de bzhin nyi nub sa sros dang*/ srod 'khor nam phyed phyed yol ba/ tho rengs bar la rigs pas 'gro/ res gza' bdun dang gzhan yang ni/ sgra gcan dus me mjug rings bcas/ spyir btang gza' ni bcu ru 'dod/ me sbyin skyes dang tsha zer can/ padma'i gnyis dang ku mud dgra/ rte 'dun rgyal po 'od stong ldan/ nam mkha'i nor bu rta ljang can/ nyin byed mo'i dbang phyug rnams/ nyi ma'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ mtshan mo'i mgon po rgyu skra bdag bsal zer can dang ku mud gnyen/ rgya mtsho skyes dang 'od kar can/ padma'i dgra dang ri bong 'dzin/ zla ba'i ming gi rnam grangs so/ bkra shis sa skyes dmar por 'khyog/ gzhon nu lus dmar sa lha'i bu/ yan lag dmar dang dmag dpon rnams/ mi dmar ming gi rnam grangs so/ zla skyes zla sras zla ba'i bu/ lha mtshams skyes sogs lhag pa'i ming*/ phur bu bla ma lha'i bla ma/ blo ldan sgra mkhan slob dpon no/ pa sangs khu ba nab so skyes/ sbyin byed kar po lha min blon/ spen pa gnyis skyes nyi ma'i bu/ zhi 'gro dal bar 'gro zhes zer/

sgra gcan skabs gsum 'jigs byed dang*/ srid gsum rnam rgyal nyi zla za/ drag po'i gzugs can mig sman mdog mjung mar me dang dus me zer/ mjug ring du ba ke tu dbal/ gza' rnams 'dren pazhes brjod de/ sgrol byed 'phur byed skar ma ste/ rgyu skar ma nyi shub brgyad/ 'on kyang byi bzhin gro bzhin gnyis/ logs spyod gcig pas bsdu ba na/ rtsa bdun yin no rgyu skar rer/ skar chung re yi rjes 'brang po rgyal/ phal pa'i skar ma dung phyur gnyis/ bye ba brgyad dang sa ya lnga/ yod pa 'khrul med gzhung las bshad/ rgyu ba'i skar ma'i tha snyan ni/ tha skar bra nye smin drug dang*/ snar ma mgo lag nab so rgyal/ skag mchu gre bo me zhi nag se ri sa ga lha mtshams snron/ snubs dang chu smad dang*/ gro bzhin mon dre mon gru dang*/ khrul stoms smad nam gru ste/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa bdun yin/ byi bzhin zhes pa gro bzhin mthar/ sbyar na nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'byung*/ yul phyogs la la'i tha snyad la/ tha skra la ni dbyug pa dang*/ smin drug la ni spun drug dang*/ snar mar bel lji mgor smal po/ nab por rgyal stod rgyal (66) rgyal smad/ skag wa mchu la rte chen dang*/ gro la rte chung dob la khra/ bya ma me bzhi byi'u nag pa/ sa gnyis nam gong nam 'og zer/ lha mtshams lag ser snron gdu bu/ snrubs la sogs pa'i ming du 'bod/ chu stod gro la chu smad phul/ gro bzhin la ni bya pho dang*/ byi bzhin bya gzhug mon dre la/ sgrog stod mon grur sgrog smad de/ nam gru la ni she sar 'bod/ 'phrod ni nyer brgyad 'di lta ste/ kun dga' dus kyi dbyig pa dang*/ dul ba skye rgu gzhon bya rog rgyal mtshan dpal be'u rdo rje tho/ gdugs grogs yid 'dod 'gal me dang*/ rtsa bton 'chi bdag mda' grub pa/ mdung dang bdud rtsi gtun shing dang*/ glang po stan myos zad g.yo brtan/ 'phel bas 'phrod do sbyor ba ni/

sel ba mdza' bo tshe ldan dang*/ skal bzang bzang po shin tu skrangs/ las bzang 'dzin pa gzer 'bras 'phel/ nges pa kun 'dzoms dga' ba dang*/ rdo rje dngos grub kun tu brdung*/ dpa' bo yongs bsnun zhi grub pa/ bsgrub bya dge ba dkar tshangs pa dbang po 'khor 'dzin no/ byed pa bcu gcig 'di bzhin te/ gdab pa byis pa rig pa can/ til rdung khyim skyes tshong biṣṭi/ tshes gcig phyi cha nas bzung ste/ nyer dgu'i snga char bar byed/ shaṅku ni dang rkang bzhi klu/ mi sdug bzhi sde nyer dgu yi*/ phyi cha nas bzung tshes gcig bar/ tshes grangs phyed la bdag pa yin/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis zla ba yi/ sgang 'ded che chung bya lugs rnams/ shog khra bzhin byas 'grub pa ste/ ma rig 'du byed rnam par shes/ ming gzugs skye mched reg pa dang*/ tsher ba sred pa len pa dang*/ srid pa skye ba rga shi'o/ gcig nas bcu gnyis bar dag gi/ 'khor 'das ma lus shes pa yin/ grangs kyi mgon brjod mtha' klas kyang*/ rtsis la nyer mkho ri bong dang*/ zla ba gzugs dang 'od dkar can/ bse ru rnams ni gcig gi ming*/ 'khrig bgrod mtshe ma thabs shes dang*/ lag mig zung rnams gnyis kyi ming*/ 'jig rten tsha ba rtse mo me/ yon tan srid pa gsum gyi ming*/ rgya mtsho chu bo rigs byed dang*/ bdud dang sde pa chu gter bzhi/ 'dod yon nyer spyod dbang po dang*/ mda' dang 'byung ba lnga yi ming*/ ro dus mtshams dang bre ba dang*/ rgyan dang bzang po drug tu grags/ rin chen pa 'dzin thub pa dang*/ ri bo drang srong gzang rta bdun/ bkra shis lha klu nor gdongs can/ srid pa lto 'gro brgyad kyi ming*/ rtsa dang srin po bu ga dang*/ gter rnams dgu yi ming yin la/ khro bo 'byor pa phyogs 'jug pa/ stobs dang ser mo bcu ru 'dod/ bde byed bde 'byung dbang phyug drag byed pa bcu gcig ming yin la/ snyi ma rten 'brel khyim (67) bcu gnyis/ 'dod pa lus med myos byed dang*/

gdug rim sna tshogs bcu gsum grags/ srid yid ma nu shed bu rnams/ bcu bzhi'i ming du mkhas rnams smra/ tshes dang nyin zhag bco lngar grags/ mi bdag rgyal po bcu gsum la/ nyes skyon khams rnams bco brgyad ming*/ rgyal ba yul ni nyer bzhir brjod/ de nyid nyi shu rtsa lnga ste/ 'khor lo skar ma nyer bdun ming*/ so dang gnyis skyes sub cu gnyis/ stong pa nam mkha' ni thig grangs kyi ming gi mngon brjod 'di/ rdo rje'i tshig don sbas tshul du/ brjod par rjes grub btags pa'i phyir/ tshad du bzung bar mi nus kyi/ grags che nyer mkho de tsam mo/ mo 'go'i 'dzin tshul lugs mang gi/ bshad tshul rnam grangs ji snyed dang*/ gza' skar lo zla'i ming gi grangs/ ha cang mang zhing brjod mi lang*/ 'on kyang mngon brjod khungs thub nas/ ma bldabs skabs 'dir mkho rnams bsdus/ gcig bcu brgya satong khri 'bum dang*/ sa ya bya ba dung phyur rnams/ rkyang pa'i grangs shes par bya/ ther 'bul khra khrig rab bkram dang*/ gtams dkrigs mi 'khrugs khyad 'byin dang*/ spang rten ded 'dren mtha' snang dang*/ rgyu rigs 'od mdzes dpa' bo dang*/ legs 'byin rtogs 'gro 'bying rdul dang*/ rgya stabs stobs 'khor badha shes dang*/ rnam 'byung stobs mig khyad 'byin dang*/ byams pa snying rje dga' ba dang*/ bting snyoms rnams ni chen por bcas/ gnyis gnyis grangs med tha ma ste/ bcu 'gyur rig pas bsgre ba yin/ gong rnams rtogs par bya ba la/ thog mar dgu mtha'i nges pa nas/ bsgyur bgod ri mo'i lag len rnams/ byang chub shes par bya dgos pas/ dgu gcig gcig dgu dgu rang la/ dgu gnyis gnyis dgu bco brgyad/ dgu gsum gsum dgu nyid shu bdun/ dgu bzhi bzhi dgu su bcu drug/ dgu lnga lnga dug bzhi bcu lnga/ dgu drug drug dgu lnga bcu bzhi/ dbu bdun bdun dgu drug cu gsum/ dug brgyad brgyad dgu bdun cu gnyis/
