brgyad lnga lnga brgyad bzhi bcu tham/ brgyad drug brgyad bzhi bcu brgyad/ brgyad bdud 'dun brgyad lnga bcu drug brgyad brgyad drug cu rtsa bzhi'o/ bdun gcig gcig bdun bdun rang yin/ bdun gnyis gnyis bdun bcu bzhi la/ bdun gsum gsum bdun nyi shu gcig/ bdun bzhi bzhi bdun nyi shu brgyad/ bdun lnga lnga bdud sum cu lnga*/ bdun drug drug bdun bzhazi bcu gnyis/ bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ drug gcig gcig drug drug rang yin// drug gnyis gnyis drung bcu gnyis te// drug gsum gsum drug bco brgyad do// drug bzhi bzhi drug nyi shu bzhi// drug lnga lnga drug sum tham// drug drug sum cu so drug go /lnga gcig gcig lnga lnga nyid de// lnga gnyis gnyis lnga bcu tham pa// lnga gsum gsum lnga bco lnga la// lnga bzhi bzhi lnga nyi shu tham// lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga'o// bzhi gcig gcig bzhi bzhi rang yin/ bzhi gnyis bzhi brgyad rang yin// bzhi gsum gsum bzhi bcu gnyis so// bzhi bzhi bcu drug dag tu 'dod// gsum gcig gcig gsum gsum nyid do// gsum gnyis gnyis gsum drug yin la// gsum gsum dgur ru grags pa nyid// gnyis gcig gcig gnyis gnyis yin la/ gnyis gnyis dang la mazhes grags// gcig gcig gcig ni gcig nyid do// 'bri dang bgrang ba g.yas nas brtsams// bsgyur dang bgod pa g.yon phyogs nas// sgyur byed mtha' yi thig lo rnams/ bsgyur bya de yi gral mthar dgod// bsgyur bya stongs par bsgyur rgyu med// sgyur byed stongs na bsgyur bzhi dbyi// bsgyur ba'i don ni gang yin pa// gang bsgyur grangs su spel ba'o// gc-ig bsgyur ba la mang nyung med// gnyis sogs kyis bsguyar gong du 'phel// bgod byed mtha' dbus thig le ni// rang gnas 'dzin las bgod nus med// ma thob nos skal thig le byin/ bokad la rkyang sa sbrags ma gnyis// rkyang bgod ji tsam thob thob 'khyir/

sbrags bgod la ni 'og ma gtso/ bgod pa'i don ni bgod byed kyi/ grangs su sdud pa'i cho ga yin/ gong du gcig 'phar bcur 'gyur te// brgya sogs rigs pas shes par nusba /gsil dus bcu sogs rim par phab/ lhag de rang rang gnas su bzhag /thig le gral 'gor 'byug mi srid// rab 'byams shes bya kun rtsi yang*// bsgyur bgod thams de ltar yin/ gza' dang byed pa'i 'khor lo bdun// skar sbyor gnyis ni nyer bdun te/ chu tshod chu srang drug cu la// dbugs drug cha shas mang nyung dang*// gnas la nges pa med pa yin/ rang rang 'khor lo gang longs pa/ phud pa'i nod de gong mar bsre// gnas gong thob nor shas che dor// bsre ba ster ba phul ba dang*/ sbyin pa 'bul dang khan pa dang*/ bsnan pa bsnon pa nor du 'gyur// ldan pa 'di bcu don gcig yin// 'phri dang sbyang dang 'phrog pa dang*/ zhu dang 'phral dang dor ba dang*/ 'brid pa dman pa bu lon 'gyur/ dben pa 'di bcu don gcig yin/ bsgyur dang bsnun dang spel ba dang*/ bsgres dang gsil lnga don gcig la/ bgo dang phye dang bsal ba dang*/ bcad pa 'di bzhi don gcig yin/ phyis pa dbyi ba bsug pa dang*// don ba rnams ni don gcig ste// nor de dor bas go shugs kyis// bgod la dor ba'ang 'jugs pa yod// rnyed pa thob pa nor dang gsum// don gcig tu ni shes par bya// zhes rtses kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las baiḍūr dkar po'i sngon 'gro nas bsdu ba byas pa'i sarga dang po'o// ༈ //lung rigs mkhyen pa lha yi lam yangs por/ dkar nag rtsis rig rgyu skra bdag po'i 'od/ gtsug lag bstan pa'i kun dan rgyas mdzad mgon/ dpal ldan phug pa yab sras phyag gca gnas/ rtsis rigs smra 'dod blo gsar ye mkhyen rnams/ lo yi nges pa yan lag brgyad ldan mtshor/ rnam dpyod yol gos bcus pa'i bstan rtsi rgyun/

rnam dag 'di ko nyi reg cis mi bya/ de yang ston pa'i 'khrungs lo dang*/ shambha la ru rigs ldan bcas/ 'phags bod paṇa grub phebs lo sogs/ bstan bcos baiḍūr dkar po las/ cung zad dbri bsnan byas te bkod/ me klu ri zung lo tshogs la/ rab byung ma nu'i nang tshan gyi/ sna tshogs chu rte'i 'das lo byin/ stod 'grol don grub pa lug gi /sprin dus chu stod nya tshes la/ kun mkhyen mnyam med nyi ma'i gnyin/ dga' ldan gnas nas gzigs pa lngas/ ser skyar zas gtsang sgyur 'phrul ma'i/ lhums su zhugs pa phyin gyi lo/ de la bse rus dman pa yin/ lcags sprol sa ga'i tshes bdun la/ lumbi'i tshal du sku bltams lo// de la klu lag 'phrol ba yi/ sa byir grags 'dzin bcun mo la/ rdor sems thugs kyi rang gzugs sashig /sras kyi tshul du byin brlabs shing*/ rol mo'i sgras bskul sgo bzhir phebs/ rga na 'chi dang dge slong dag /gzigs pas srid spangs bar byung lo/ de la mtshams sbyangs shin pho rta'i/ sa ga zla ba'i bco lnga la/ byang chub shing drung du gshegs nas/ rdo rje'i skyil krung thun gcig gis/ bdud dmag srod la tsham bcad de/ nam gyi cha stod bsam gtan bzhi/ dgung la mngon shes lnga bskyod de/ rdo rje'i rnal 'byor bzhes pa nas/ tho rengs rgal rnga brduba'i tshe/ mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas shing*/ sgra gcan 'dzin dang kun dga' bo/ bltams shing bdun phrag bdun gyi mthar/ chu stod tshes bzhir tshings pa dang*/ brgya byin gsol ngor lnga sde la/ bde bzhi'i chos 'khor thog ma'i lo/ gzugs mig 'phro ba'i shing yos la/ mu stegs ston drug so sogs/ chos 'phrul du mas btul phyin la/ de la mda' mig 'phri ba yi/ lcags 'brug nag nyar 'bras spungs suja/ du 'khor gsungs shing sa ga zla'i/ bco lngar rtsa grong thub pa'i dbang*/ gzugs sku'i rnam pa bsdus nas long*/ de la zlas dman lcags sbrul la/ chos rgyal zla bzang rtsa rgyud bsdus/

de la zung 'phri chu lug la/ zla bzang longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs/ de la gzugs sbyangs shing sprol lo'i/ sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyi shar dus/ snang mtha'i gsang gsum 'od lnga bcas/ dha na ko sha'i mtsho gling gi/ pad sdong ze'u 'brur 'phegs pa las/ zhing 'dir 'bros bu'i theg pa yi/ gsang sngags nyi lam zab mo nyid/ ston mdzad rgyal dbang padma 'byung*/ brdzus te bltams pa phyin gyi lo/ de la mkha' mtshos phri ba yi/ shing byi mgo zla'i tshes bco lngar/ rgya nag kun rdzob bden rtsis kyi/ 'dul phyir 'jam dbyangs byis pa'i tshul/ ngo mtshar ri bo rtse lnga'i gnas/ trikṣa'i shing go lba ba las/ brdzus te gser ltar bltams pa'i lo/ de la dus bug gig gis 'phrog /drag po zhes pa lcags sprel lor/ grub chen sa ra ha la bltams/ de la thig rol sbyangs pa na/ lcags sprel bai dha'i yul gru cher/ klu sgrub rje rigs 'khrungs nas lo/ de la mtsho mkha' lag pas zhu/ shing sprel rigs ldan 'jam dbyangs grags/ rgyal sar byon nas bsdus rgyud bstan/ de la mkha' me dmas dor bas/ dngos po zhes pa shing khyi lor// gangs ljongs chos rgyal thog ma rje/ tho ri gnyan btsan yul bur 'khrungs/ de la bug ris 'phri ba yi/ chu sbrul mdo sde za ba ma tog /babs pa bstan pa snga dar 'go /de la mkha' chus 'phral ba na/ chu byar tho ri gnyan btsan gshegs/ de la ri mtsho lag pas phri/ lcags 'brug 'bras bstan dus gsum rdzogs/ sgrub pa'i bstan pa'i thog mar slobs/ de la mtsho yis dbri ba yi/ nyi sgrol shing sprol bde 'byung khrir/ rgya mtsho rnams rgyal phebs pa dang*/ ma gar mu stegs byed pa zhugs/ me mkha' rgya mtsho thog ma 'dren/ de la 'byung bas dman pa yi/ sa glang gangs can mgon gcig pu/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po bltams/ de la nyi mas 'phri ba yi/ lcags glang spror thag nag rtsis kyi/ snga 'gyur thog ma skyes dang bcas/

'phags ma'i rang gzugs kong jo yang*/ pur rgyal mi rje'i mgron du khugs/ de la nyis sbyangs chu glang lor/ lha ldan 'phrul snag gzugs lag btab/ de la thub ris 'phrog pa na/ lcags rtar 'jam mgon khri srong bltams/ rtsa zla dman pa'i sa glang la/ dus gsum mkhyen padma 'byung*/ bsil ldan 'gro ba'i mgon du phebs/ de la lag zhus lcags pos lor/ zan g.yang mi 'gyar lhun grub btab/ de la ri mes phri ba yis/ sa 'brug 'jam dbyangs khri srong gshegs/ rgyal pos dman pa'i shing sprel la/ pad 'byung lho nub srin 'dul gshegs/ zung dman me khyir rtsis 'go zug /de la ri mdas sbyangs pa yi/ chu lugs gnod sbyin log smon 'bras/ me tog mda' can glang dar btsas/ de la me phri khyi khyi lor/ khri raral 'khrungs shing de nyid la/ 'byung mes phri ba'i lcags bya rol/ glang dar srid gzug zla drug nas/ smon lam dbang gi dam chos bsnubs/ de la gajugs phri rnga chen lor/ zla ba phyed bdun lon pa'i tshe/ lha lung dpal gyi rdo rje yis/ nyan 'khrul gyis glang dar bsgral/ de nas ya brtan 'od sprungs sogs/ khol bu darang btsan bsgyur ba las/ bod spyir dbang ba'i rgyal po med/ de la dus mig phri ba yi/ sa byir tilli shes bzang 'khrungs/ de la kluplag gis sbyangs pas/ me 'brug na ro paṇa chen 'khrug /de la drag sbyangs me yos de/ bcis 'go zug nas gsum pa'i thog /'di khongs lho phyogs 'phags yul du/ gsang chen khyab bdag dus 'khor lo/ tsi lu paṇa chen dus zhabs pas/ thugs 'dzin mdad nas spyad drangs lo/ dus dman chu byar phyi dar 'go /bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa bzhed/ de la mdas dbrog sa stag la/ phyi dar thog mar 'brom stom bzhed/ mnyam med dī pam kā 'khrungs/ de la lag mig phri ba yi/ shing 'brug 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ mi yi srid bzung 'brom ston 'khrungs/ klu yis sbyangs pa'i chu khyi la/

sgra bsgyur mar pa cho tsā 'khrungs/ de la ma nus dman pa yi/ me stag me mkha' rgya mtsho rdzogs/ de la gzugs phri me yos la/ rab byung thog mar rtsis pa dang*/ gnyis med dus 'khor bod du phebs/ de la 'dod phri lcags 'brug la/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la dngas/ ba ri lo tsā 'khrungs phyin lo/ de la yid sbyangs shing rta la/ mnyam med jo bo dag zhing gshegs/ srid dman me byar rwa bsgrang btab/ de lam mig zhus pa phag la/ rngog lo blo ldan shis rab 'khrungs/ de la ma nus 'phri ba yi/ chu gling gsang phu la skya btab/ de la dus dman pa lug la/ bka' brgyud yongs kyitsug rgyan tshe/ sgam po 'dzam gling grags pa 'khrungs/ de la 'byung shing byi lor ras chung rdo rje grags pa 'khrungs/ rtse mos phri ba'i me yos la/ rang byung gnyis pa'i thog ma yin/ de la mdas phrog chu sprel la sa chen kun dga' snying po bltams/ skyon sbyangs lcags stag 'gro ba'i mgon/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa 'khrungs/ de la phyogs zhus kun ldan lor/ lha mthong sgom pa'i dus rdzogasashing*/ lnga pa ting 'dzin bsgoms 'go tshugs/ mes sbyangs chu yos g.yu brags bltams/ de la mtshos brog me lug la/ paṇa chen shākya shrī 'khrungs/ bug dman me 'brug chos kyi rje/ mnga' ldan btab cig lha ldan dang*/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo btsug de la ris sbyangs me sprel la/ 'dus 'dzin bkra shis dpal ldan gyis/ 'bras dkar yungs pa'i chos sde btab/ rtsis phri sa phag byams chen rjes/ se ra theg chen chos sde btab/ lag zhus lcags mo gling gi lor/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang 'khrungs/ zung dman chu yos thams cad mkhyen/ dus zhabs nor bzang rgya mtsho bltams/ de la skyon phri lcags bya la/ lo chen chos skyong bzang po 'khrungs/ mtshams sbyangs me yos rab brgyad kyi/ thog mar dpal ldan phug pa bas/ padma dkar po'i zhal lung brtsams/ chag lo 'khrungs shing bkras lhun btab/

drag pos sbyangs pa'i shing lug la/ rgyal dbang skyob pa gnyis pa che/ kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang bltams/ gzugs phri me sprel gru 'dzin bdag/ paṇa chen dge 'dun rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ zla mes phrog pa'i me yos la/ rab byung dgu pa'i thog ma 'dren/ mig sbyangs pa mo sbrul gyi lor/ bstan gnyis srol 'dzin zab gter bdag rgyal dbang rin chen phun tshogs 'khrungs/ de la phyogs sbyangs pa yos la/ rin chen rnams rgyal bltams/ kun mkhyen bsod nams rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ de la chus sbyangs me lug lor/ rgyal sras lha rje'i sgyur 'phrul gar/ mnyam med chos rgyal phun tshogs 'khrungs/ mkha' mig 'phral ba'i me yos la/ rab byung bcu pa'i thog mar slebs/ srid pas phri ba'i lcags rta la/ phyogs las rnam rgyal gdan sar phebs/ mtsho yis sbyangs pa'i shing khyi la/ nā ro bkra shis phun tshogs 'khrungs/ de la tshes sbyangs pa glang la/ rgyal ba yon tan rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ gzugs kyis phri ba'i lcags stag la/ rje btsun dkon mchog rin chen 'khrungs/ mdas 'brid shing khams lug gi lor/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi gtsug rgyan che/ khyab bdag dharma kirti bltams/ de la lag gis bden pa yis/ mi sbrul rgyal dbang thags mkhyen/ ngag dbang blo bang rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ de la mes phri lcags sprel la/ lnga pa ting 'dzin bsgoms rdzogs shing/ phrig drug tshul khrims gnas 'go tshugs/ de la ris phri me mos yos/ rab byung bcu gcig thog ma dang*/ rigs ldan seng ge khrir phebs lo/ ma nus zhus pa'i lcags sbrul lor/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po yi/ bod khams yongs la mnga' dbang bsgyur/ de la gzugs sbyangs chu rta la/ gro shrī'i bod ljongs mnga' 'bangs kun/ gong ma kun gzigs lnga pa la/ 'bul zhing mchod yon dbu tshugs lo/ de la mes phri shing mo byar/ rgyal khab lo brang so ta la/ sa btul rmang bting mdzad pa'i lo/ ris dor chu 'brug rgyal ba'i dbang*/

gong ma shun rtsis spyan drangs shin/ rgya bod bstan pa yug gcig gi/ bdag song las bsngags gzos 'bul/ bse rus sbyangs pa'i chu sbrul lor/ mi dbang sangs rgyas mtsho 'khrungs/ srid dman me phe spre'u lor/ 'phags mchog gru 'dzin dgyes mchog /dkon mchog 'phyin las bzang po 'khrungs/ me mig zhus pa'i sa lug la/ 'jam mgon mi yi srid bzung ba/ chos rgyal pā sar phebs/ de la mtshos dman chu phag la/ rgyal dbang blo bzang rin chen 'khrungs/ rgyal mtshos dor ba'i me yos la/ rab byung bcu gnyis thog ma dang*/ bstan bcos baiḍūr dpar po yi/ rtsis 'go 'dzin pa phyin gyi lo/ ri zla zhus pa'i shing sprol la/ don grub chos kyi rgyal po 'khrungs/ sde pas don ba'i sa byi la/ rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ srid pos sbyangs pa'i me bya la/ 'bri rdzong bkris tshubs bskrun no/ de la ris dman shing 'brug la/ snying rje'i gter dngos 'gro 'dus bltams/ tshes sbyangs pa mo lug gi lor/ gzhu smad theg mchog rdo rje'i yo'i/ gtsug lag rmang gting mdzad pa'i lo/ lto 'gros don ba'i me yos rab byung bcu gsum thog ma 'dzin/ de la bkra shis zhus pa yi/ shing phang rharma su rya 'khrungs/ me yis 'phral ba'i sa stag la/ rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ nyi mas dbri ba'i lcags lcags stag la/ rigs kun khyab bdag dpa dkar chang/ bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan bltams/ me mig dor ba'i chu glang la/ 'di brtsams byed po snyoms las pa/ dharma dha dza'i ming can btsas/ de la drag sbyangs shing byi la/ rje btsun padma'i rgyal mtshan nyid/ bya phyogs 'gro rnams sgrol slad du/ gnam mtsho phyug pho'i bskor ba la/ zhabs zung bskyod cing 'gon du/ tshogs chen 'dus pa'i smin 'grau dang*/ 'brong dgon bka' brgyad sgrub chen sogs/ bstan 'gror sman yon chen po mdzad/ de la mi sbyangs me stag la/ rgyal ba lung rtogs rgyal mtsho bltams/

de lagazugs sbyangs me yos 'di/ rgyal bstan lnga brgya phrag bcu ru/ gsungs pa'i lnga brgya phrag drug pa'i/ steng nas lag thig mig 'das shing*/ sgrub pa'i dus kyi smad yin la/ rab byung bcu bzhi'i thog ma yin/ 'od dkar dman pa'i sa 'brugs la/ rje btsun padma'i mtshan can gyi/ rin chen gsum gyi rgyur grub cing*/ nor sna'i phra rgyan dpag med bcas/ tshe mtha' yas kyi snang brnyan che/ byin rlabs char 'bebs grags pa bzhengs/ de la klus dben me byi la/ lung bstan dus babs ji bzhin du/ bsam yas dbu rtse mes 'jig cing*/ rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho 'khrungs/ bse rus sbyangs pa'i me glang la/ gzhung sa mchog nas thugs brtson gyis/ bsam yas dbu rtse bzhengs 'og tshugs/ mtshon dman lcags mo sbrul gyi lor/ zan g.yang dbu rtse rigs gsum sogs/ legs grub gnas mdzad pa'i lo/ de la gzugs sbyangs chu rte lor/ legs bshad baiḍūr dkar po las/ rtsis kyi bstan bcos khol phyung ba'i/ nyi rgyal zla ba'i dkyil 'khor mchog /slong gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo yi/ rtsis 'go'i 'das lo bzung ba'i mtshams/ zhes rtsis kyi bstan nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las bstan rtsis skor bai dkar la cung zad dbri bsnan bgyis te bkod pa'i parga gnyis pa'o/ 'gru rgyal kai la sha yi sa 'dzin spor/ gnam sbyi dpar po'i rigs las gdongs lnga'i dbang*/ mdo sngags chos sgral log smra'i wa skyes tshogs/ 'joms mdzad rig 'dzin dharma kirtis skyongs/ rnam dag dgongs don nor 'dzin gtsang ma'i ngogs/ ngo mtshar rtsis gzhi sa brtol ljon pa'i dbang*/ lag len gsar bsgrun kun dga'i 'bras bzang 'di/ blo ldan ro 'dzin longs spyod dpal du sbyin/ de ltar grub rtsis dhru wa ni/ khyad 'phangs ma dang byad grub kyi/ rtsis 'phro ma gtogs lnga bsdus sogs/ bai dkar gzhungs bzhin khor phyung bkod/

de yang rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i/ sna tshogs la sogs da'as pa'i lo/ nyi mas bsgyur la nag pa sogs/ 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag/ 'og ma mig bsgyur 'dod yon brgyan/ dbang mtshams kyis thob steng du 'phangs/ zla ba rnam par dag pa'o/ zla dag me klu srin nor brgyan/ ri dbang dus klus bsgyur ba la/ mig bug mda' rtsa mes thob pa/ dor la lhag ma ri yis bsgyur/ mig bug mda' rtsa mes thob pa/ gza' yin lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur/ bgod byed kyis thob dbyu gu ste/ slar yang mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ bgod byed thob pa srang yin la/ dus bsgyur bgod byed thob pa dbugs/ ri mkha' ris bsgyur bgod byed kyis/ thob pa cha ste gza' rgyu dag /ril char zla ba dag pa la/ drag po 'khor los brgyan par bya/ me dbang lag pas bsgyur ba la/ klu lag 'byung mes thob pa dor/ slar yang nor lag gis bsgyur la/ klu lag 'byung mes thob pa de/ ril po'o lhag ma dus nyis bsgyur/ klu lag 'byung mes thob pa de/ cha shas yin no lhag med 'char/ nyi rgyu'i don du zla dag la/ zla ba ri me byin pa de/ mda' ros bsgyur la chu mkha' klus/ dor lhag 'khor los bsgyur ba la/ chu mkha' klus thob skar nas te/ lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ chu mkha' klus thob dbyu gu ste/ yang lhag mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ bgod byed kyis thob chu srang te/ lhag ma dus bsgyur na zla dag de/ dgus so slar lhag ri ro yis/ 'asgyur la 'god byed kyis thob sa/ che de lhag med rnam dag 'byung/ de ni sgrub tshul khyad 'phags shing*/ ngo mtshar skyas pa'i rgyu wa yin/ spyi 'gred bsgrub na zla dag de/ gnas lnga steng nas gzugs dang ni/ zlo yon mkha' dbang stong pa dang*/ mkha' nor chu bos rim bsgyur la/ gzugs tshes dus mtsho lag pa dang*/ mtsho dbang 'dod yon brgyan pa la/ ri mkha' ri dang dus mkha' ro/ thig mtshams thub pas dor ba'i lhag /gza' yi rgyu wa rnam par dag

/zla dag gnas gnyis stong ma lag /'og ma gzugs kyis bsgyur ba la/ ril por dbang phyug char mda' ro/ byin lang dus phyi no lag gi/ bsgral bas ris cha'i rgyu wa 'grub/ zla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin/ mig phyogs klu dbang gzugs dang ni/ gza' zlas bsgyur la dus mig dang*/ bug mtsho mda' rtse mo dang*/ srin pos brgyan la ri ro dus/ mkha' ro thig mtshams 'khor lo yis/ dor bas nyi ma'i rgyu wa 'grub/ snga dhru rang rang sgyur byed byin/ phyi ma'i rgyu ba tshegs med 'char/ nyin re'i rtsis la 'jug pa'i phyir/ gza' rgyur chu tshod bug mda' dang*/ srang yon dbugs chu cha mi bdag /nyi dhru dbyug mtsho zla zung srang*/ dbugs 'byung me chu shas te/ tshes bsgyur pas gza' dang nyi/ gnyis ka'i bar pa 'grub pa ste/ ril por tshes bsres ma nus bgo/ rnyed nor gzugs me mi mnyam zhing*/ thig mig mtsho rnams mnyam pa'o/ lhag des zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*/ dbang dbyung mda' yon 'khrig gzugs/ lhag pa dang bcas yid gnas/ snga rkang zos zin sdom bya zhing*/ phyi rkang la ni za rgyu sdom/ de yang mar go bde'i phyir/ g.yon phyogs grangs kyi ri mo ste/ bse ru 'dod sa dag la mda'/ zung dang khyim la phyogs sdom zhing*/ me dang drag por tshes sdom la/ rgya mtsho phyogs la bu ga gzugs/ mda' dang bu gar lag gis ste/ ro dang nor la rgyal ba yin/ drang srong de nyid stong la stong*/ rkang bzung gdong mas cha shas bsgyur/ ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur/ dus khyim thob pa yang dag rgyu/ lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang/ dus khyim thob pas rnam par dag yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod de/ snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phri/ de ni gza' bar longs spyod du/ nor mnyam bsnan la mi mnyam phri/ de yang nyi dang shes mnyam ched/ cha shas ri ros bsgyur ba la/ ris mkha' ris thob lnga pa/ lhag ste cha shas drug pa yin// nyi bar gnas gnyis gcig la ni/ skar mtshams chu tshod 'byung chus sbyangs/

ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la sbyangs/ sbyangs shul 'dod pa mkha' me de/ longs na dor la lhag ma ni/ mkha' ros bsgyur la chu tshod bcug/ 'byung me zlas thob rkang bzung*/ ro mtsho bse ru snga rkang ste/ ldog pa dang bcas dus kyi gnas/ snga phyi zos dang ma zos ldom/ g.yon bgrangs mda' dag la dus/ mig chu phyogs la me drag ldom/ stong la stong pa rnam par dag /rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur/ ma zin tshe na dang pos bsgyur 'byung me zla thob yang rgyu yin/ (chu srang sogs kyi rang cha lu ga pa go pa'i shugs skyi rigs 'gri'o) lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang/ dus bsgyur dbugs su shes pa ste/ ri ros bsgyur thob cha shas yin/ snga rkang bsna la phyi rkang bsnam la phyi rkang phri/ gza' dang nyi ma'i longs spyod du/ 'dod pa mkha' me dor ba na/ bsnan la ma dor dbri ba ste/ gza' dang nyi ma dag pa yin/ zla skar ched la nyid dag gcig /chu tshod mtsho dang tshes bsgyur byin/ tshes 'khyud zla ba'i skar ma dag /de la gza' longs man gyis sbyangs/ res grogs zla skar 'grub pa yin/ nyi zla bsres pas sbyor ba 'grub/ byed pa tshes grangs 'khrigs pas bsgyur/ gzugs dman ri yis bgos pa'i lhag phyi cha'i byed pa yin pa ste/ gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa lnga /yan lag lnga ru bzhed pa yin/ bsdus pa'i rgyukyi rjes 'brangs pa'i/ byed pa'i rtsis ni bstan pa la/ rang byung bcu bzhi 'i nang tshan gyis/ chu rta la sogs 'das pa'i lo/ nyi mas bsgyur la nag pa sogs/ 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma mig bsgyur srin po bsnan/ mda' ros thob pa zla dag go /de nyid 'phar na lugs 'dir bshol/ 'dir yang bsgrub lugs mi 'dra ba/ yod kyang da tsham dkyis ltar du/ zla dag gnas gsum steng rim bzhin/ bse ru zla me mkha' 'byung bsgyur/ steng nas ro dang chu tshod thig mkha' mes phri la mkha' ros mnyis/ thub pas dor lhag gza' dhru'o/

zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma mig /'og ma gzugs kyis bsgyur ba la/ rel sor mi bdag char ri mtsho/ phri la dus khyim klu lag gis/ dor lhag ril cha'i dhru ba'o/ zla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin/ mi phyogs klu dbang lag phyogs bsgyur/ skar gnas dus mig chu tshod du/ ri lag 'dod pa chu srang yin/ dbugs 'byung cha las gzugs kyis phri/ 'dod ro mkha' ro dang*/ 'khor los dor lhag nyi dhru'o/ kun la sbyang bar ma ldang na/ so so'i 'khor lo bsnan par bya/ snga dhrur rang rang bsgyur byed byin/ rim bzhin phyi ma'i dhru ba 'char/ de nas nyin rtsis bya ba la/ gza' dhrur chu tshod rtsa dbang dang*/ srang yon dbugs chu cha thig dang*/ nyi dhrur dbyugs mtsho zla mig srang*/ dbugs dbang cha shas bu ga rnams tshes kyi bsgyur ram rtag longs dag /so sor byin pas gza' nyi gnyis/ bar pa 'grub bo ril cha'i dhrur/ ril por tshes bsres yid kyis bgo /thob nor zla yon mi mnyam zhing*/ mkha' lag rigs byed mnyam pa'o/ lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*/ lnga gsum bzhi dang gsum gnyis gcig /ldog pa dang bcas bcu bzhi'i gnas/ snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom/ rkang bzung sngun mas cha shas 'asgyur/ ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur/ dus khyim gyis thob yang rgyu ste/ lhag ma thig ro dus dang ni/ 'dod pas bsgyur ba cha shas te/ lhag med 'dod na ma nu'o/ rang gi yang rgyu sang rkang bsnan/ phyi rkang rim phri gza' bar la/ nor mnyam bsnan la mi mnyam phri/ nyi bar gcig la skar drug dang*/ zhe lngas sbyangs la ma ldan na/ 'khor lo bsnan la 'khor phyod dor/ lhag ma'i skar ma thig ros bsgyur/ chu tshod bcu la 'byung me zlas/ bgos thon nor gyi nyi rkang bzung*/ ros mtsho bse ru snga rkang ste/ ldog pa dang bcas dus kyi gnas/ snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom/ rkang bzung sngun mas cha shas bsgyur/ ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur/ dus khyim gyis thob yang rgyu ste/

lhag ma thig ro dus dang ni/ 'dod pas bsgyur shas te/ lhag med 'dod na ma nu'o/ rang gi yang rgyu snga rkang bsnan/ phyi rkang rim phri gza' bar la/ nor mnyam bsnan la mi mnyam phri/ nyi bar gcig la skar drug dang*/ zhes lngas sbyangs la ma ldang na/ 'khor lo bsnan la 'khor phyed dor/ lhag ma'i sku ma thig ros bsgyur/ chu tshod bcug la 'byung me zlas/ bgos thob nor gyi nyi rkang bzung*/ ro mtsho bse ru snga rkang ste/ ldog pa dang bcas dus kyi gan/ snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom/ rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur/ ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur/ 'byung med zlas thob yang dag rgyu/ lhag ma thig ros dus 'dod pa/ lhag med 'dod na mkha' ri mig bsgyur rang rang gi cha go ba'i shugs kyis 'jug /thog snga rkang bsnan pa dang*/ phyi rkang phri ba'i longs spyod de/ gza' nyi bar gnyis pa ka la/ 'khor phyed dor bsnan ma dor phri/ de yis gza' dang nyi ma dag /nyi dag gnas gnyis gcig la ni/ chu tshod mtsho dbang tshes bsgyur byin/ gza' yi longs spyod man gyis sbyangs/ re grogs zla ba'i skar ma yin/ nyi zla gnyis bsres sbyor ba 'grub/ dhru pa tshes grangs mig bsgyur la/ gzugs phri thub pas dor ba de la dbang po chu tshod du/ zla chu srang la ri 'byung ba/ dbugs khrig nyi gnas stong pa dang*/ chu tshod klu dang srang dus me/ dbugs la rtse mo 'dod char gzugs/ phri la gzhan la spyi ltar byas/ rab yid chu rta'i byed pa yi/ rtsis 'phro skyon 'don yin na'angs/ rim bzhin skyon cher 'gro ba sogs/ zhal lung ma bur gsungs pa'i phyir/ dkyis bzhin bya las sha cang gi /dgos don che ba'i gnad ma mchis/ zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcol nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las grub rtsis kyi dhru wa khyad 'phags ma dang byed grub lnga bsdus skor rtsis 'phro ma gtogs bai dkar sor gzhag bgyis pa'i parga gsum pa'o/

mod dhrud rig byed dka' gnad che gter cher/ 'khyen bar gru gzings kyis bskyod rang rang blor/ 'tshams pa'i legs bshad nor bu sbyin mkha' pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub mtshan snyan dad pa'i yul/ rgyud rgyal dgongs don longs spyod 'khor lo nas/ sgra gcan rtsis gzhung g.yas 'khyil dung dkar po/ ma rig gnyis salong lag len zab mo'i dbyangs/ 'khrul med skye ba lnga pa 'di na snang/ de ltar dpal ldan sgra gcan dang*/ lo gza' rgyal blon kar myang rtsis/ khyim gza' bcu gnyis la sogs pa/ bai dkar khol phyung 'dir 'god bya/ rang byung bcu bzhi'i sna tshogs kyi/ zla ba rnam par dag pa la/ bu ga yon tan brgyad pa de/ mkha' mes bsgyur la gang brtse yi/ tshes grangs bsres la gnas lnga bzhag /steng nas rim bzhin nam mkha' dang*/ stong pa ma nu dbugs thag le/ cha shas nyi mas bsgyur byas la/ me mig ro dang srang mkha' ro/ thig mtshams 'khor los dor ba'i lhag /bsod nams ldan pa'i bul ba dag /de yi 'khor los phri ba yi/ gdong gnas skar dang longs spyod shar/ de la 'khor phyed ster ram dman/ mjug gam dus me rnam par dag /yang na zla ba dag pa la/ bu ga bzang po lag ldan pa/ mig bsgyur nya gzugs stong mig byin/ mkha' dus chu bos thob pa dor/ lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba la/ mkha' dus chu bos thob pa dor/ lhag ma skra mas bsgyur ba la/ byang kyang bul ba gong bzhin 'char/ ༈ khyim gnas ji ltar blta ba'i phyir/ skar gnas mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ chu tshod bsres la 'byung me zlas/ thob pa 'das pa'i khyim yin cing*/ lhag rnams dbang ri mda' yis bsgyur/ 'byung me zlas thob 'das pa'i zhag /gdong mjug gnyis ni ma 'ongs zhag /thob pa'i lhag de mkha' ros bsgyur/ 'ayang me zlas thob tshod la/ yang lhag mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*/ slar lhag dus bsgyur thob pa dbugs/ de lhag me mig gis bsgyur bar/ 'byung me zlas thob cha shas te/ gdong mjug dbang ri 'byung bar sbyangs/

lhag de khyim der 'das zhag yin/ gzhan yang gro bzhin byi bzhin gnyis/ longs spyod phyed pa'i bdag nyid de/ phral ba'i rgyu skar nyi shu brgyad/ phyogs re ri bo'i grangs la/ rgyu skar phyen lus kyis khyab/ smin drug nas bzung g.yon la 'khor/ gdong mjug skar ma gang gnas bzhag lo 'gros nas rtsis ltar gnas pa'i/ nyis skar dus tshod dag dang bsdun/ gdong sa g.yon dang mjug ma g.yas/ rang nyid ltor gnas blta phyogs la/ g.yul 'jug gshags bgyed rtsal sprod dang*/ rgyan dang cho lo mdos gtor sogs/ las kun rang nyid rgyal zhing dge/ zhib par bshad na 'di bzhin te/ rang nyid gdong nas skar ma yi/ tshu tshod phyed nas g.yas 'khor ba'i/ skar bzhi'i khyon bar mthong phyi dang g.yon du 'khor ba'i skar bzhi'i bar/ dus me'i mthong snga spang pa yin/ mjug ma de lta g.yas g.yon brtse/ lto ba'i phyed drug rang gnas sa/ lta ba'i phyed drug mtha' skar la/ yin pa mkha' pa'i srol la bshad/ drag gza' lto ba'i char gnas shing*/ zla ba blta ba'i phyogs gnas na/ khyad par can gyi stobs nyid che/ yang na sgra gcan nyi mas sbyangs/ ma ldangs skar ma bsnan la sbyangs/ sbyangs lhag mkha' ros bsgyur ba la/ 'byung me zla bas thog pa bgo /phyed lhag nor la gcig phyin bya/ nor nas g.yon skor rtses pa'i par/ gdong pa gnas so des shes 'gyur/ 'di yang thun mong lugs gcig yin/ gzhan yang sgra gcin gdong sogs la/ nyi dag skar mas sbyangs bar bya/ ma ldangs 'khor lo bsnan la phri/ lhag ma'i skar ma mkha' nyis bsgyur/ chu tshod zung bsgyur bsres pa la/ 'byung mkha' mtsho yis mgos thob pa/ shes nas rim bzhin phyogs bzhi dang*/ mtshams bzhir skye rengs shar nas bzung*/ nyin tshad mtshos bgos du bzhi dang*/ mtshan tshad chus bgos dus bzhi ru/ phye par nyi ma yod par bzhed/ de nas bgrangs pa'i thob nor par/ khams gsum snang byed bdag po gnas/ thob nor stongs na gza' nyi 'grogs/

gcig thob snga dre phyed nas 'char/ gnyis la nyin gsum dgongs phyed/ bzhi thob mun mtshims lnga srod phyed/ drug la nam gung bdun tho rengs/ shar ri'i rtse nas sgra gcan 'char/ de ltar rtse ba'i sgra gcan gyi rtsis gzhi rnam par dag pa dang*/ mdos gtor la sogs thebs phyogs kyi/ brtse tshal rags tsam me ger sprel/ zhir na rwa ru gzhan bdud dang*/ gang rtsi'i lo zla tshes gza' skar/ gang zag dang bsdun pa sogs/ rgyal par dbyangs 'char rgyudatha nyid du/ bstan ma mkha' rnams zhib gzigs mdzod/ ༈ /grub pa'i lo yi bdag po'i gza'/ nyi ma nya rdzogs lug khyim du/ slob pa'i zhad de'i grub gza' yi/ res gza' lo yi bdag po dang*/ lug tu sleb pa'i nyin zhag der/ lha yi bla ma longs spyod pa'i/ skar ma gang yin lo skar ro/ ༈ /byed pa lo yi bdag po ni/ rab byung ma nu'i chu rta nas/ gang rtse'i 'das lo gnas lngar bzhag /gzugs tshes gzugs me ri bong can/ gzugs nyis bsgyur la steng rim bzhin/ me dang lag mig bug mda' mtsho/ ris byed skar byin mas nas yar/ ri zla yon tan dus mkha' ro/ thig ro thub pas dor ba yis/ byed pa lo 'pho 'grub pa yin/ zhal lung lo 'pho rnam ni/ gong gi lo 'pho gnas so sor/ steng nas zung dang mkha' me dang*/ klu dbang dbugs mig cha shas la/ mtshe ma ri lag brgyan pa yis/ lo grangs stong pa bzang po'i rab/ skyon 'don rnam par dag pa yin/ ༈ /rgyal blon ched du 'das pa'i lo/ mes bsgyur gnas gnyis stong ma la/ zung dang 'og la 'byung bas brgyan/ ri yis bgos nor so sor ro/ stong ma rgyal dang 'og blon po/ chu yis phri'i mes brgyan na/ phyi ma'i rgyal blor rim bzhin 'char/ ༈ /nai pa la yis mkha'as bzhed pa'i/ kar myang rtsi la mtsho chu dang*/ ri zla lo la rab yid kyis/ sna tshogs nas bzung gang brtsi'i bar/ lo bsres shā ka'i 'das lor grags/ de nyid mes bsgyur drags srong bgo /thob nor logs bzhag lhag ma de/

char gyi don du mi gis bsgyur/ 'byung ba byen pa char 'bras yin/ sngon gyi thob nor me yis bsgyur/ ris bgod la sogs lag brgyad byang*/ 'bru rtsā bsil drong rlung 'phel zad/ 'khrug rnams rim pa bzhin du shes/ nyung mtha' 'byang ba mang mtha' la/ ri zla 'bring po nyi ma yin/ so sor mang nyung 'bras bu byin/ yang ni shā ka'i 'das lo de/ dbang phyug sbyangs la lhag ma de/ mtshoyis dor lhag gzugs shar na/ rdz-ing bur 'jug ces than pa che/ gnyis pa yan lag 'jug ces pa/ yul grub la lar char 'babs cing*/ la ras mi 'bab 'bru tshogs nyams/ me shar kun 'jug ces zer te/ yul kna khyab par sbrang char 'bab/ thig le zhod che chu bo rgyas/ dbang phyug mjal phrad ces bgyi ba/ byed pa lo bdag gza' dbyug gnyis/ gnas ni bcu gnyis bkod byas te/ gza' la zla ba ri dbang phyug /lug khyim don du byin par bya/ chu dang me dbang glang la byin/ ri bong ri gzugs 'khrigs pa ste/ rgya mtsho me mda' karka ṭa/ zla ba mig bgrod seng ge la/ chu gtor rgyal ba bu mo ste/ dus dang gzugs dbang srang gi don/ zla ba ri mtsho sdig pa la/ me dang rgyal po gzhu la ste/ mtsho dang gza' yon chu srin yin/ dus dang rgya bum pa la/ nam mkha' mig dbyung nyam la bsre/ so sor ma nor bsnan pa la/ mkha' ro thub pas bsgril pa'i lhag /gang shar khyim gza' bcu gnyis yin/ rtses rtsis kyi bstan bcos nyi rgyal zla ba'i dkyi 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las sgra gcan bsgror rtsis 'phro ma gtogs bai dkar dkyis bzhin dang*/ zhar byung byed grub lo gza' zad gsal zhing rgyal blon kar myang dbang phyug yub yum khyim gza' sgrub lugs bcas khor phyung bkod pa'i parga bzhi pa'o/ ༈ /dkon mchog gsum gyis gsang gsum mtha' bral ngogs/ cha rdzogs 'phyin las 'od dkar skyes dgu yi/ nyon mongs mun 'joms bzang po'i bsali zer can/ khyab bdag mtshan mo'i mgon la snying nas dad/

'khrul bral rtsis kyi gzhung gzang dbyar gyi rngas/ nyer bskul sngon med legs bshad gtsug phun can/ tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i char makun bsags pa'i sgro/ gza' lnga gsum gyi rnam bkra'i kha dog 'bar/ de yang legs ldan gza' lnga po/ nyin zhag phyog la spyod pa dang*/ tshes la spyod dang khyin la spyod pa dang*/ tshes la spyod dang khyim zhal bcas/ lag len snying por phyung ste bkod/ rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang tshan gyi/ sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo/ mig gzugs bsgyur la nag pa sogs/ 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma zung bsgyur dbang por brgyan/ 'byung ros thob pa steng du 'phang*/ bla ba rnam pad dag pa'o/ zla dag thig yon gyis bsgyur la/ gang brtsi'i tshes bsre gnas gsum bzhag /bar du ri mtsho 'og ma la/ me dang nyi ma la nam mkha' mtsho/ ri mkha' ri dang chu ros yis/ brnyed nor stong sbyangs nyi zhig gam/ spyi zhal ces su grags pa yin/ nyin zhag dhru ba'i don du/ tshes grangs ma bsres spyi zhag de/ gnas lngar bzhags la nam mkha' mtsho/ dus mig thig dang chas shas la/ dus tshes mi bug gis bsgyur bar/ steng nas dus mig me dbang dang*/ bde 'byung yon tan cha shas la/ phug med dbang klu yid byin nam/ yang na stong nas thig dang ro/ klu mtsho lag pa cha shas la/ nam mkha' ri ros sbyang bal/ mas rim bug mkha' mig bug yid/ mtshams dang mkha' ros thig ro dang*/ 'khor los dor lhag nyi dhru'o/ de nas drag gsum dal bar dang*/ zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin don du du/ gang brtsi'i tshes bsres spyi zhag de/ gnas lnga ṛm pas tshar lnga bzhag dang po bkris dal bar don/ thig mig zla zung 'khrigs pa dang*/ de nas drag gsum dal bar dang*/ zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin don de du/ gang brtsi'i tshes bsres spyi zhag do/ gnas lnga rim pas tshar lnga bzhag /dang po bkra shis dal bar don/ thig mig zla zung 'khrig pa dang*/ klu mkha' mtshe mas bsgyur byas la/ steng nas dbang phyug 'byung mtsho dang*/

rtse mo 'dod yon cha shas la/ 'jig rten rtse mo 'od dkar byin/ bug mig lag dang dus mkha' ro/ thig ro 'khor los bsgril ba'i lhag /bkra shis dal bar rnam par dag /gnyis pa zla bu'i don nyid la/ stong pa skyon dang rgyal ba mda'/ ri klud dus mtshos bsgyur byas la/ steng ri zla zung me dbang dang*/ drag po nyer spyod cha shas la/ me dbang dus klu byin pa la/ mas rim ri bug ri klu dus/ mkha' ros thig mtshams 'khor los dor/ zla bu'i rkang 'dzin lo spyod 'grub/ gsum pa bla ma'i don ched la/ nam mkha' stong pa lag mig dang*/ dbugs zung dus mig mtshe mas bsgyur/ steng nas bse ru klu mtsho dang*/ dus mig 'byung ba cha shas la/ srin po bug gzugs byin la yar/ gzugs dus me dang dus mkha' ro/ thig ro 'khor lor dor ba'i lhag /blo ldan dal bar rnam par dag /bzhi pa dkar po'i ched nyid la/ thig ri nyi ma dbugs me dang*/ cha shas mda' mtsho me yis bsgyur/ stong nas ma nus mig mda' dang*/ rtse me stong pa nyes skyon byin/ mas yar rim bzhin bug mtsho ri/ dus dang mkha' ros thig mtshis dang*/ 'khor lor dor ba'i lhag ma de/ dkar po'i skar 'dzin longs spyod yin/ lnga pa nyi bu'i don du/ thig stong bu ga nam mkha' dang*/ skyon rtse bsgyur la ste rim bzhin/ nam mkha' klu me 'dod pa gzugs/ rtse stong ri zla byin la yar/ me klu me mda' dus thig mtshams/ mkha' ro 'khor los bsgril ba yis/ nyi bu'i dmal bar longs spyod sogs/ drag gsum dmal ba bar pa dang*/ zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin logs spyod 'grub/ zhi gnyis dal ba bar pa dang*/ drag gsum rkang 'dzin longs spyod ched/ nyin zhag nyi ma'i rgyu wa la/ chu tshod rig byed srang dus zung*/ dbugs thig dus tshos me bug cha/ gang brtsi'i tshes bsgyur re'u mig byin/ zhing gnyis dal bar drag gsum gyi/ rkang 'dzin longs spyod rnam par dag /de nas so so'i dal bar rnams/

tshar gnyis byas la skyes khyim sbyangs/ mi dmar mkha' me bu ga dang*/ lhag pa phyed bcas mi bdag ste/ phur bur khyim dang pa sangs dus/ spen pa gdengs zla dag gis sbyangs/ ma ldangs skar ma bsnan pa dang*/ sbyangs shul 'khor phyed lhag na dor/ lhag ma'i skar de mkha' ros bsgyur/ chu tshod bcug la mda' yon zlas/ bgos nor gyi dal rkang bzung*/ bkris mda' mig skyon thub pa/ zla ba phyogs bu phyogs gza' rtse mo can/ bla ma bde byed rtsa me dang*/ dkar po dbang chu ri bong can/ nyi bu mig zung tshes dang dus/ ldog pa dang bcas bro ba'i gnas/ snga rkang zos zin sdom bya zhing*/ phyi rkang la ni za rgyu sdom/ rkang bzung gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyar/ ma zin rkang pa thog mas bsgyur/ mda' yon zlas thob yang dag rgyu/ lhag ma thig ros bsgyur ba la/ srang bcug thob pa chu srang ste/ dus bsgyur thob pa dbugs yin lhag /rang rang cha shas kyis bsgyur bar/ cha bcug thob pa chas shas te/ lhag med rnam dag ri lo 'char/ snga rkang bsna la phyi rkang phri/ rang rang dal bar gcig shos la/ de yis dal ba dag par 'gyur/ de nas myur ba dag pa'i don/ dal dag rkang 'dzin cha shas rnams/ shed snyoms phyir la gang nyung gis/ bsgyur ba mang bas bgos thob pa/ nor de nyung cha lhag rang cha/ yin no gnas drug spel la/ so so'i dal ba dag pa yis/ drag gsum rkang 'dzin nyi bar dang*/ zhig gnyis so so'i rkang 'dzin dman/ ma ldangs 'khor lo bsnan la sbyangs/ 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya/ lhag ma'i skar mas myur rkang bzung*/ 'khor phyed dor na rim min dang*/ ma dor rim pa bzung byas la/ rim min rkang 'dzin thig le la/ chu tshod mkha' mer longs mtshams nas/ rim min kun la mkha' me bsre/ rim pa'i rkang 'dzin bcu gsum pa dang rim min rkang 'dzin thig le shar ba'i tshe/ chu tshod gcig gnyis sogs nas nyer gu'i bar mang nyung gang byung yang*/ rkang longs mkha' mes bgo dgos/

rkang 'dzin thig la chu tshod sum cu yan 'byung mtshams nas bzung ste/ rim min rkang 'dzin bcu gsum dang chu tshod nyer dgu'i bar/ ci tsam byung yang de bar gyi rim min thams cad la chu tshod dus mkha' me bsres nas drug chu lo su na skar gnas su phud/ de slar rkang pa bzung skyor byas nas rkang bzung sngon mas bsgyur chu tshod bar du rang 'khor bsgril nas mkha' ros bgo bar bya'o/ longs na rkang 'dzin phud des bzung*// myur ba'i rkang pa 'di bzhin te// sa skyes rgyal ba yon lag gsum// zla mig gnyis dang skyon tshes drag /me 'od rtsa bar bde 'byung dang*// skyu me mkha' klu me mda' 'o// zla bur rgyal po gnyis tshes dang*// yid 'dod bde 'byung gza' dbang mkha'// rtsa bar chu dang drag po dang*// mkha' mig nor lag chu 'dzig rten// bla mar phyogs gnyis bug nor dus// mtshams zung ri bo rtsa bar me// ro bug dbang phyug mi bdag ri// dkar por de nyid tshar gsum dang*// rgyal ba lag mig gnyis gnyis ste// skyon tshes nor dang rtsa bar dus// mkha' me rtsa gtor me ri'o// nyi bur ro dmang mnga' chu mtsho// mig lag thig le rtsa bar zung*// chu dbang ro nor yon tan no// snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom// rkang bzung sngon mas lhag rnams bsgyur// thag ros thob pa chu tshod yin// lhag ma thig ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcug thog sa chu srang yin// lhag ma thig ros bsgyur la// srang bcu thob chu srang yin// de lhag ros bsgyur dbugs bcug par// thob pa dbugs yin de lhag de// rang rang cha shas kyis bsgyur la// cha bcug thob pa cha shas te// slar lhag bug mkha' mig bu ga /yid bsgyur rang gi cha bcug par// mkha' ros thob lhag med 'char// rim pa'i phyi rkang tha ma dang*/ rim min snga rkang por yi// chu tshod su cu tshon chad la// rkang sngon 'phogs tshe mkha' mes bgo// yang na lhag ma'i gnas thams cad// mi gis bsgyur la mkha' ros bgo

/rim pa'i rkang 'dzin bcu gsum min rkang 'dzin thig li babs pa'i tshe/ chu tshod gcig gnyis sogs nas ker gu'i bar du mkha' mis bgo ba dang*/ yang na ma'i gnas thams cad mig gi bsgyur rang rang 'khor los gong du phud pa'i lhag de rnams/ slar yang rkang pa'i bsgyur phyed sngon mas bsgyur rang 'khor bsgril lhag rnams dkyus ltar mkha' ros bgo ba sogs byed par don la de dag gang bdebyas kyang khyad par med do/ rim rkang tha ma dang rim min rkang po gnyis rkang pa skang po gcig la brtse dgos pa'i don gyis so/ lhag pa spen pa'i rkang pa de// stong par babs nas bsgyur bya phyis// yang rgyu la sogs rkang long med// snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phri// longs na skar mar bsgril ba rnams/ rim pa bsnan la rim min phri// dbri bya nyung na de nyid kyis/ dbri byed dbri bar bya ba'am// skar ma bsnan la phri ba yis// lugs sdog lugs 'byung ri mo 'char// rim sa'i snga rkang myur 'gros shar// phyi rkang dal 'gros lho ru byed// rim min snga rkang 'khyog 'gros nus// phyi rkang bzung ba'i 'gros te bya// de yang ma 'ongs rtsis 'phro dang*// myur rtsi lorags byas ba'i ched// so so'i sgos zhag sgrub lugs la// tshes grangs bsres pa'i spyi zhag dor// mig dmar rtse srin lags pa dang*// phur bu nam mkha' bug lag ste// spen pa rig byed de nyid byin/ lhag pa brgyas bsgyur gzugs 'dod ri// pa sangs phyogs bsgyur gdeng can me// mtsho ma zla bas brgyan pa la// de la rang rang dkyil 'khor gyis/ bog bo mig dmar ri klu ro// zla bu thub bug ri nor dang*/ phur bu so yon rig byed ste/ pa sangs drang srong rgyal ba mig /spen pa ros dus thob phyogs kyis/ thob pa dor lhag so so yi// sgos kyi zhag go de nyid ni// 'khor lo nas bzung rang cha'i bar/ rim bsgyur dkyil 'khor thob pa ste// dal ba rkang 'dzin don chod du// spyi mthun sgrub pa'i bya lugs yin// nyin zhag nyi dhru spyi mthun lugs/

tshes grangs ma bsres spya zhag de// mig klu me skyon gyis bsgyur la// bkra shis bug zla dus nor mtshams// dus byi mda' mkha' mtsho yid ri// mtshams kyi dor la skar ma nas// bug mkha' mig bug chas shas bar// bsgyur la mda' mkha' mtsho yid dang*// ri mtshams mgos thob nyin zhag rgyu// spyi mthun tshegs med 'grub par 'gyur// gzhan yang khyim nags blta ba'i tshed// so so'i dal dag skar ma'i gnas// mkha' ros bsgyur la chu tshod bcug /mda' yon zlas thob 'das pa'i khyim// lhag rnams so sosa'i char 'gyur phyir// bkra shis bug mig lag pas bsgyur// mkha' mtsho mda' thob 'das pa'i zhag /phur bu zla ros me yis bsgyur/ 'byung me zlas thobs 'das pa'i zhag /spen pa me nor me mdas bsgyur/ mkha' gzugs klus thob 'das pa'i zhag /zhig gnyis me ris bsgyur byas la// rgyal ba mes thob 'das pa'i zhag /thob lhag so so mkha' ros bsgyur/ rang rang bgod byed kyis thob dbyug /yang lhag mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcug thob pa chu srang ste// ros bsgyur dbugs bcu thob pa dbugs// lhag rnams so so'i bogad byed kyis// bsgyur la 'og gi cha rnams bsres// thobs pa so so'i cha ru 'gyur// zhib na shed mtshungs gnas spar sogs// gong du rim bstan rig pas shes// de rnams so so'i phyim de la/ 'das pa'i zhag dang longs spyod yin// rang rang 'das zhag gang shar gyis// mig dmar ri mda' dbyug tshes sbyangs// phur bu gzugs dus me zhag sbyangs// spen pa ri bug klu zhag dang*// dbyu gu phyogs la sbyang bar bya// zhi gnyis mkha' me' zhag dang ni// dbyu gu nyer lngar sbyangs lhag gis// so so'i khyi der ma 'ongs tshed// de ltar ma 'ongs mngon sum la// ston phyari drang srong gza' lnga yi// 'gros bzhi khyim skar gang gnas sogs// 'di la brten nas brtag pa'i phyir// gza' lnga'i yon tan mtha' yas pa// zhi par dbyangs 'char rgyud du gsal// de skad legs ldan gza' lnga po// nyid zhag dag la spyod pa'i tshul// sgos zhag la sogs mi dgos par// sgrub tshul sngon chad ma grags shing// gab sbas mi gsal zab gnad cig

/yin zhes tshig brjod tsam min par// don blangs yig ge'i lab du spel/ ༈ /de nas dpal ldan gza' lnga po// tshes kyi zhag la spyod pa'i tshul// 'jam mgon pā ra'i mkhyen bar las// gsar byung mthun dang mthun min bshad// de yang rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo// phyi gyis bsgyur la nag pa sogs// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma zung bsgyur dbang po bsnan// 'byung ros thob pa steng 'phangs pa'i// zla ba rnam par dag pa de// dmar lhag phur sangs spen lnga'i ched// gnas drug tshan pa lnga bzhag la// dang por skar zla chu tshod rtse// klu me srang la dbugs thig ste// mtsho ri bse ru cha 'og ma// nor dang drang srong gis bsgyur la// ri mkha' ri dang bug gig lag /dus dang thig ro mkha' ro dang*// 'khor los thob lhag pa skyes kyi// rtsi 'phro bral ba'i rgyu ba ka /de bzhin gnyis par skar bu ga /chu tshod rtse mo chu srang du// klu dang rigs byed dbugs dbang dang*// rang cha mig 'byung ri klung dang*// 'og ma gtor mtshams bsgyur ba der// mas nas ri mkha' ri dang ni// ri bug ragi klu dus mkha' ro// thig dus skar mas dor ba'i lhag /zla bu'i 'phro bral rgyu ba 'grub// gsum par thig dang chu tshod drag /srang mig dbugs me dbang phyug lag /dus mtsho ri yis bsgyur ba la// ma nu yid dang gzugs dus me// ro dang mkha' ro thig mtshams skar// dor lhag bla ma'i rgyu ba 'grub// bzhi par me so mtsho dbang srang*// dbugs zla dus dbang yon tan dang*// me ris bsgyur la ri mkha' ri// bug mtsho ri dang dus mkha' ro// thig ros skar dor dkar po'i rgyu// lnga par thig dang dbyug mtsho srang*/ dus mig dbugs me lag pa dang*// mkha' ri rtse mo cha 'og ma// ri bo dbang phyug gis bsgyur la// mas nas ri mkha' ri dang ni// me klu me mda' dus mkha' ro// thig mtshams 'khor los dor ba'i lhag

/nyi bu'i 'phro bral rgyu ba 'grub// so so'i 'phro bral rgyu ba der/ khyed par rtag longs 'di lta ste// bkra shis tshes yid zla mig dang*// dbugs thig skyon gzugs dus mig 'byung*// lhag par dbang 'khrig ma nu dang*// dbugs mtsho gza' chu thig ri dang*// bu ga myos byed bla ma la// de nyid drag 'khor me klu dbang*// cha 'og me dus lag pa dang*// dkar por nyi ma 'byung ba dang*// mkha' mtsho dbugs la nam mkha' ste// ri dang mi bdag drag rtse'o// nyi bu dus mi zla zung dang*/ chu mtsho dbugs me klu dbang tshes/ zung dang gdeng can bcas pa la// so so'i tshes zhag rtag long de// gang brtsi sngon ma'i tshes bsgyur des/ khyad 'phags rtag longs phri ba'am/ khyad 'phags rtag longs ri'u mi gis// rgyu bar phri ba drag gsum gyis// dal bar zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin 'grub// drag gsum rkang 'dzin longs spyod dang*// zhi gnyis dmal ba bar pa'i tshed// gong gi mda' ro'i lhag de rnams// gnas lnga bzhag pa steng rim bzhin// nam mkha' mig thig 'byung ba dang*// de nyid kyis ni bsgyur ba la// ri ro dus dang mkha' ro dang*// thig ro 'khor los dor lhag gis// lug sogs zla ba so so yi// khyi gyi 'khor lo la dor lhag /nyi ma'i rgyu ba rnam dag der// dbyug mtsho chu srang zla mig dang*// dbugs dbang me mtsho'i cha bcas pa// tshes bsgyur ster ram re'u mig byi// drag gsum rkang 'dzin zhig gnyis kyi// dal bar bar pa 'grub pa yin// de nas rang rang dal dag ched// so so'i dal bar gnas gnyis bzhag /bkra shis la ni khyed bcas dgu// lhag pa rgyal po mkha' me'o// phur bu nyi ma pa sangs dus// spen pa skyon gyi sbyangs pa la// ma ldangs 'khor lo bsnan la sbyangs// lhag na 'dod mkha' me dor// lhag de thig mtshams kyis bsgyur la/ chu tshod dang ldan 'byung med zlas// bgos thob nor gyi dal rkang bzung*// sa skyes de nyid skyon drang srong*// lhag pa phyogs ri yon tan dang*// bla ma dbang phyug bug me dang*// snyan ngag mkhan la dbang mtsho gzugs// nyi bu lag mig tshes ro ste// ldog pa dang bcas mtshams gyi gnas// snga rkang zos zin sdom bya zhing phyi rkang la ni za bya sdom// rkang bzang gdong mas lhag rnamams bsgyur// ma zin rkang pa thog mas bsgyur// 'byung me zlas thob yang rgyu'o// lhag ma thig ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcug thob pa chu srang ste// dus bsgyur thob pa dbugs yin la// cha gong rang rang chas bsgyur la// 'og ma gzhan rnams ri mkha' ri// bla ma ma nu yid kyis bsgyur// so so'i cha shas gong 'og bcug

/'byung me zlas thog gnas drug bcas// lhag med rnams dag ri mo 'char// snga rkang bsnan la phyi rkang phyi/ rang rang dal bar cig shos la/ 'khor phyed der bsnan la dor phri// de yi dal ba dag par 'gyur// de nas myur ba dag pa'i don// rkang 'dzin dal dag cha shas rnams// drag gza' gsum gyi la dag dang*/ zhi gza' gnyis kyi rkang 'dzin gyi cha shas gnas 'og ma gnyis ka ri ros bsgyur la/ gnas 'og ma rig mkha' ri bgo /nor di cha shas gong ma la byin/ de yang rang rang cha shas kyi 'khor los gong du bsgril ltag rang cha dang*/ nor gang thob ri ro'i cha la bzhag ste gnas bdun du byid pa yin no/ shed snyoms phyir la gang nyung gis// bsgyur ba mang bas thob pa'i nor// nyung cha lhag de bgod byed cha// de nas so so'i dal dag gis// drag gsum rkang 'dzin nyi bar dang*// lhag sangs so so'i rkang 'dzin phri// ma ldangs 'khor lo bsnan la sbyangs// 'dod pa mkha' me longs na dor// lhag ma'i skur mas myur rkang bzung*// dor na rim min ma dor rim// bzung bya rim min rkang 'dzin stong*// chu tshod phyed la long mtshams nas// rim min rnams la thig yon byin// chu tshod longs na phud des bzung*// de yang rkang pa 'di bzhin te// bkra shis rgyal ba me zung gsum// gzugs lag gnyis dang skyon tshes drag /me 'o rtsa bar dbang phyug dang*// nor yon mkha' klu me 'byung ngo*// lhag pa mi bdag gnyis dbang gzugs// yid 'dod bed byed ri 'byung thig /rtsa bar mtsho dang drag po dang*// mkha' mig nor lag chu 'jig rten// phur bu phyogs gnyis rtsa gdengs mtshams// bro ba lag zla rtsa bar me// ro gtor drag po mi bdag ri// dkar po dbang mig tshar gsum dang*// rgyal ba mig zung gnyis gnyis te// nyes tshes klu dang rtsa bar ro// thig yon srin bug me thug bo// spen pa ro dbang mda' chu mtsho// mig 'khrig thig le rtsa bar zung*// mtsho mda' dus klu yon tan na// snga phyi zos dang ma zos sdom// rkang bzang gdong mas lhag rnams bsgyur// ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur// thig ros thob pa chu tshod de// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcug thob pa chu srang ste// lhag ma ros bsgyur dbugs bcug par// mkha' ros thob pa dbugs yin la// slar lhag rang rang cha yis bsgyur// gong du ri ro'i cha ston pa'i gnas bdun yod na ri ros bsgyur// ri ro'i cha bcug mkha' ros thog pa cha lnga pa dang*/

lhag ma gza' so so'i rang chas bsgyur bcug thob pa cha drug pa yang ltag gza' gzhan ri mkha' ri dang bla ma ma nus yid kyis bsgyur bcug thob pa'i cha bdun pa ste rnam dag song na dang*// ma song de ltag byung na bgos byed kyi cha zhes mkha' me stabs su gang babs kyis bsgyur bas thob pa nags brgyad 'ong ste lhag med rnam dag ri mo 'char slob dpon mkha' pa'i phyag len ltar ro/ cha bcug thig ros thob pa cha// yang lhag gza' gzhan ri mkha' ri// bla mar ma nus yid kyis bsgyur// cha bcug mkha' mtshams thob cha de// lhag med rnam dag ri mo 'char// rim pa'i phyi rkang tha ma dang*// rim min snga rkang dang po la// chu tshod phyod pa ma longs bar// rkang sngon phog tshe lhag gnas kun// mig gis bsgres la thig ros bgo /khyed par zla bu nyi bu gnyis/ rkang pa stongs na bsgyur bya phyis// yang rgyu la sogs rkang longs med// snga rkang banan la phyi rkang phri/ 'bri bya nyung na de nyid kyis/ dbri byed dbri bar bya ba'am/ 'khor lo bsnan la phri ba yis// lugs 'byung lugs ldog ri mo 'char// rim pa'i snga rkang myur 'gros shar/ khyi rkang dal ba'i 'gros te lho// rim min snga rkang 'khyog 'gros nub// phyi rkang 'byung 'gros byang dus byed// nyin zhag tshes zhag khyim zhag gsum// ri mo'i rnam pa mi 'dri las// don du rigs pas dpyod shes na// gza' rnams skar mar longs spyod lugs// tshe chung med do don khyed med/ khyim rnams nyin zhag bshad dang mtshungs// de yang tshes spyod rnam dag gi// ri mo dkyus bzhin byab la// gong gis zla dag gnas drug pa/ tshar drug bsgrigs la rang rang gi// sgyur byed nyid mar lags phyogs dang*// klu dbang gzugs dang thub zla ba// sa skyes zla bug klu me thig// mtsho gza' zla ba nor drang srong*/ lhag pa rtsa yon nor mtsho dbang*// mig dbang klu bug ro dang*// bla mar thig drag mig yon tan/

dbang phyug lag dang dus mtsho ri// dkar por me so mtsho dbang gzugs// dus mda' rtse mo re ri dang*// nyi bur thig mtsho dus mig me// mig mkha' ri yon gza' drag pos// bsgyur la nyi mar dus mig dang*// bug mtsho mda' dbang me srin po// mig dmar bde byed me mtsho dang*// bug mda' dbugs rtse dus bug gzugs// cha 'og ri me brgyan dang*// lhag par zla zung bug me dang*// ri yon 'jig rten rang gi char// 'byor pa dbang rtse cha 'og mar// 'byung gter rgya mtsho ster ba dang*// bla mar bse ru klu mtsho phyogs// dbugs zung rang char tshes 'od dkar// 'og ma mig gza' yon tan byin// dkar por yid dang chu tshod du// ri chu ma nu dbugs nam mkha'// rang cha mtsho bug bza' po dang*// 'og ma stong ri yon brgyan// nyi bur thig dang klu me dang*// dus dang tshe ba rang cha la// mtshams nor mkha' mig cha 'og mar// bu ga thig mtshos brgyan pa la// rang rang 'khor los gong bzhi bsgril// so so'i rgyu ba ka de 'char// snga rgyur rang gi sgyur byed byin// phyi ma rim bzhin 'char ba yin// rtag pa'i longs spyod 'di lta ste// bkra shis thig mig bug gzugs srang*// gzugs dang rang cha me yid dang*// 'og ma chu dang ma nu'o// lhag par thig skyon ri yi srang*// me dang rang cha dus me dang*// thig gza' 'og ma me drang srang*// phur bur thig lag mig srang*/ nam mkha' rang cha ri klu gzugs// 'og ma bug gza' thug pa'o// dkar por thig ri 'byung ba srang*// mtsho dang rang cha dus me ro// 'og ma dus lag gnyi ma'i bur// nam mkha' thig dang chu srang klu// 'byung ba rang cha nor me dang*// ri gzugs yog ma rgyal po 'khrig /tshes bsgyur ster ram re'u mig ster// de yis drag gsum dal bar dang*// zhig gnyis rkang 'dzin grub pa ste// de nas bya tshul gong dang mtshungs// de ltar drang srong gza' lnga po// tshes zhag dag la spyod pa'i tshul// bya slu'i ched du 'dod char bsdus/

bcu phrag drug tug skyon 'don pa'i// thun mong rim mo'i tshul tsham zhig /mkha' pa don dbang bar dag tu// phyag len tsham du mtshad pa dang*// gzhan yang skyid phug mkha' rtse zhes// rkang chag gza' lnga'i char gtogs pa'i// phyogs mtshams rtogs pa'i lag lanag las// tshes spyod 'khrul pa'i dri bral zhing*// ji srid bar du skyon gsog pa// mi 'byung lag len nying khu 'di// sngon chad gud du sbas pa ste// sā ri'i skal ba'i ched du thob/ ༈ /lo lo'i bde sdug 'bras bu sogs// rtogs byed dbyangs 'char lag len la// nyer mkho med du mi rung ba// khyim zhag gza' lnga'i ri mo bshad// rab byung ma nu'i sna tshogs sogs// 'das lo nyi mas bsgyur ba la// lug sogs 'das khyim yod na bsre/ khyim zla rnams par dag pa yin// gza' lnga so so'i don gyi phyir*// zla dag gnas drug tshar lnga bris// bkra shis gzugs drag dus mtsho chu// rgyal ba dus tshos rgyal mtshos bsgyur// skar drag klu mtsho zla cha thig /mkha' 'byung dus me rtse nor byin// mas nas rim bzhani gzugs bug dang*// gzugs bug bug mig lag pa dang*// mkha' ros dang ni thig mtshams dang*// 'khor los bsgril pa'i lhag ma de// mig dmar rgyu ba 'grab pa yin// zla bur bu ga mkha' mig so// dbang po dus nyi ri bo dang*// 'byung ba gzugs mkha' ros yis bsgyur// steng nas lag mig bse ru zung*// 'gor lo dbugs bung mtsho rgyal klu// bskris chu nor rgyal byas la// mas nas gzugs bug gzugs bug dang*// ri bug ri klu dus mkha' ro// thig mtshams 'khor los dor ba'i lhag /lhag pa'i rgyu wa rnam par dag /sgra mkhan thig drag lag mig dbang*// bug so klu ri mkha' zung gis// bsgyur la skar gzugs bug mtsho dang*// bse ru mig dang bkra shis mtsho// nor tshams zla chus brgyan pa la// mas nas mig klu me skyon dang*// gzugs dus me dang dus mkha' ro// thig ro 'khor los bsgril ba'i lhag

/phur bu'i rgyu wa dag par 'char// dkar por yon tan rtsa me skar// bse ru ri bug 'byung ba dang*// bro ba bug ga ri mtshos bsgyur// skur tshes me dang dus yon dang*// sde sa bug mtsho dbang po dang*// gzugs chu dus kyi brgyan pa la// mas rim gzugs bug gzugs bug dang*// bug mtsho ri dang dus mkha' ro// mkha' dus 'khor los phyi ba'i lhag /sa wa sangs kyi rgyu wa yin// nyi bur mkha' chu rig byed me// sde sa mig bug dbyig chu dang*// mtsho me lags pa dus kyi bsgyur// nam mkha' klu me gza' mig dang*// thig dang gzugs ri me mig dang*// myos byed me dang rtse mo dag /byin la gzugs bug gzugs bug dang*// me klu me ma'ad dus thig mtshams/ mkha' ros 'khor los bgos pa'i lhag /spen pa'i rgyu wa rnam par dag /de yang drag gsum dal bar dang*// zhig gnyis rkang 'dzin rgyu wa yin// snga rgyur rang rang bsgyur byed byin// so so'i 'khor los phud pa'i lhag /phyi ma'i rgyu wa rim bzhin 'char/ ༈ /de nas zla dag gnas gsum bzhag /mi tshes nam mkha' dag gis bsgyur// mkha' ro thig ro 'khor los dor// zhig gnyis dal ba bar pa dang*// drag gsum rkang 'dzin rgyu ba 'grub/ yang nas mthun mong khyil zhag nyi rgyu ni khyim zla snga ma rdzogs tshad gang yin snams phyi ma'i yin/ de yang 'khor lo rdzogs na// lug gi khyim zla'i rgyu ba yin// de'i lte du skar gnas ma mig dang chu tshod dus tshes dbugs su thig phyin la pa gling gi khyi zla'i rgyu ba dang/ de nas ri bzhin de nyid ka khyim bar du spel bas phyi zla so so'i rgyu ba 'grub pa yin la// da lam mar du bya sla ba'i phyi du ri'u mig/ bsgyur byed byin na phyi rgyur 'char/ ༈ /'on kyang khyim gyi zla zhag dag /gar yod brtag phyir khyim 'khor nas/ gcig phab 'og tu ri ro 'char// byas la rang rang grub rtsis kyi zla bshol 'phros// sbyangs lhag mkha' mes bsgyur ba la// gang brtsi'i tshes khyam gyi slob tshad dang bstun pa'i grangs zla du bstod nas mda' ros yis// bsgyur ba bsres gong gi mkha' mes bsgyur ba'i lteng du la ri ros bgo

/rnyed pa zhig yin lhag ma de/ mkha' ro mkha' ro dus ri ros// rim bsgyur ri ros thob pa brtsegs// zhal la mkha' mes thob pa'i nor// steng bsres de yang nyi mas dor// rim bzhin steng nas don khyim dngas// 'das zhag dbyug srang dbugs cha ston// de yis tshod zir bar pa'i ched// gza' lnga nyi mar bcas pa yi// tshes bsgyur rtag longs grangs bsdun sbyin// gza' lnga'i dal myur bar pa ni// 'grab mod drag gsum dal bar dang*// zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin rgyu ba la// sbyin bya'i rtag longs 'di lta ste// bkra shis mkha' zung dper na 'das khyim gsum dang 'das zhag bdun ltu byung nang lug gling 'khrig sum 'das// karṭa'i rgyu wa la 'das zhag bdun yin de 'das par brtsis tshes skyi rtag longs sbyin dgos pa sogs rigs 'gri yin/ me mig rtse// thub ri chu ro 'dod pa'o// lhag par thig skyon gzugs mtsho mkha'// zung mig lag pa dbang po dang*// dus bug drang srong rgya mtsho'o// phur bu mkha' thig lag mig mtsho// tshos mig me ri klu bug ste// pa sangs thig skyon 'byung dang*// rgya mtsho rig byed rtse mo ste// bug mtsho chu tshod sde pa'o// spen par stong pa thig bug mkha'// ri klu bse ru dbang po dang*// dus mtsho nam mkha' lag pa'o// so so'i gnas la ma nor byin// rang rang 'khor lo phud pa'i lhag /drag gsum dal ba bar pa dang*// zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin 'grub pa yin// zhig gnyis dal bar drag gsum gyi// rkang 'dzin rgyu ba'i rtag longs ni// nam mkha' rgya mtsho thig yon rnams// gang brtse'i tshes bsgyur re'u mig de// gong gi nyi ma'i rgyu ba la// byin nas rang 'khor bsgril ba'i lhag /zhi gnyis dal ba bar pa dang*// drag gsum rkang 'dzin longs spyod 'grub/ ༈ /de nas dal ba dag pa'i ched// so so'i dal bar tshar drag gsum so sa'i dal rgyur rtag long sbyin pas dal bar dang*/

zhi gnyis nyid rgyur rtag longs sbyin pas dal bar lnga po so so/ gnyis bzhag /skar gnas chu tshod gnyis po la// mig dmar rig gzugs mkha' yon dang*// lhag par phyogs dang nam mkha' me// phur bur de bzhin tshos thig le// pa sangs skar mar zla ba mig /spen par skar gnas bu gas brgyan// mkha' ro 'khor lo longs na phud// 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// der dang ma dor mtshan ma gces// lhag ma'i skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur// chu tshod bcu la mda' yon zlas// thob pa'i nor gyis dal rkang bzung*// rkang bzung phyi la rkang sdom bri// de ltar bzung bya'i rkang pa ni// mi dmar de nyid skyon ri bo// lhag par phyogs dang thub pa med// phur bu drag po bug rtse dang*// pa sangs la ni dbang chu gzugs// spen par mig zung tshes dang dus// ldog pa dang bcas dus kyi gnas// snga rkang la ni spyan zin dang*// phyi rkang la ni spyod rgyu sdom// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// mi zin rkang pa thob mas bsgyur// mas nas rang rang 'khor los bsgril// mda' yon zlas thob yang dag rgyu// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcu thob pa chu srang dang*// de lhag ros bsgyur dbugs bcug par// thopa dbugs yin lhag ma de// phurpabur gzugs dus me dang ni// rang bzhin rang gnyis so bsre// phyi rkang rim bzhin yang rgyu dang*// rjes 'brangs bcas pas rkang sdom sbyangs// rang rang dal bar cig shos la// 'khor phyed dor bsnan ma dor phri// de yis dal ba dag pa yin/ ༈ /de nas myur ba dag pa'i don// dal drag gza' gsum gyi dal dag dang zhi gza' gnyis kyi rkang 'dzin la gnas 'og ma gnyis ka ri ros bsgyur ma 'og ma gnyis ka ri ros bsgyur 'og ma phur phu mig klu me skyon dang gzhan bzhi gzugs bug gzugs bug gis bgo nor bar ma la byin// bar ma de yang*/ mir la dpare mtshon na bug mig lag pa dang*/

gzhan bzhi rang rang gi cha shas 'khor los gong du phyed/ nor gang thob ri ro'i la la bzhag par gnas bdun dang*/ myur dag skab su gnas brgyad 'ong ba ni/ ri'i ri tho phug lugs thi yi 'da'i nor bu'i bang mdzod la ra sprad pa yin pas dag par yod/ dag rkang 'dzin cha shas rnams// shed mnyam phyir na ri ro yis// bsgyur la mang bas bgos thob pa// nor de ri cha lhag rang cha// yin no gnas bdun spel ba dag /rang rang dal dag tshar gnyis bzhag /gcig gis so so'i rkang 'dzin sbyangs// 'on kyang ma ldangs 'khor lo bsnan// sbyangs shul 'khor phyed lhag na dor// dor na rim min ma dor tsho// rim pa nges pa'i mtshan ma bya// lhag pa'i skar mas myur rkang 'dzin// rim min zhabs nas bgrang ba dang*/ rim pa dbu nas bgrangs te 'dzin// rim min skar ma'i gnas stongs shing*// dbyug gur mkha' me longs pa nas// ji srid rim min ma rdzogs bar// de srid dbyug gu mkha' me bsre// mkha' ro longs tshe phud des bzung*// rkang pa bzung rjes skar ma dbyi// de yi mal du rkang sdom bri// 'dzin cha myur rkang 'di bzhin te// mig dmar rgyal ba med lag gsum// gzugs mig gnyis dang skyon tshes drag /yon tan rtsa bar drag po dang*// klu me mkha' klu me dbang po// lhag par rgyal po gnyis 'byung gzugs// yid 'dod drag po gza' dbang thig /rtsa bar mtsho drag nam mkha' mig /klu lag rgya mtsho yon tan no// phur bur phyogs gnyis bug nor dus// bro ba mig gzugs rtsa bar me// dus bug drag po mi bdag gza'// pa sangs de nyid tshar gsum dang*// rgyal ba mig lag gnyis gnyis te// skyon tshes dgengs can rtsa bar dus// mkha' me gter bug me ri'o// spon par dus 'byung dbang chu mtsho// mig zung nam mkha' rtse bar bgrod// mtsho 'byung dus klu yon tan no// snga rkang spyad zin rnams sdom zhing*// phyi rkang spyad byar gyur rnams sdom// rkang bzung mdun mas lhag rnams bsgyur*// ma zin tshe na dang po bsgyur// 'og nas rim bzhin rang 'khor bsgril// mkha' ros thob pa yang dag rgyu// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcu thob pa chu srang ste// ros bsgyur bdugs bcu thob pa dbugs// de lhag ri ros bsgyur ba la// cha bcug thob pa ri ro'i cha// yang lhag rang rang 'khor los bsgyur// so so'i cha bcug thob pa ni/

rang rang char bzhag slar lhag de// phur bur mig klu me skyon dang*// gzhan bzhi gzugs bug gzugs bug gis// bsgyur la so so'i cha shas bcug /mkha' ros thob pa lhag med 'char// snga rkang chu tshod gnyis so bsre// phyi rkang rim bzhin yang rgyu nas// mkha' ro'i cha bar rkang sdom las// ma nor phab la sbyang bar bya// dbyug gur mkha' ros longs gyur na/ skar ma'i gnas su 'bud par bgyi// rim pa'i phyi rkang tha ma dang*// rim min snga rkang dang po la// rkang sngun pho tshe mkha' ro'i tshab// mkha' mes rkang longs 'god par bya// rim pa'i phyi rkang tha ma dang*/ rim min snga rkang dang po la 'ab tshe/ chu tshod gcig gnyis sogs nas nyer dgu bar du mkha' mes bgo /yang na gnas thams mig gi bsgyur rang 'khor bsgril// slar bzung gdong mas bsgyur chu chod bar du rang rang 'khor los phud// de nas dkyus ltar mkha' ros bgos bar bya// rim min rtang 'dzin thig la chu tshod mum yan byung mtshos nas bzung ste// rim min 'khor phyed ma longs bar du rim yin kun la mkha' me bsres nas mkha' ro longs tshe gong la phud nas/ slar rkang ba bzung bldab bya dgos pa ni rkang pa phyed pa yin pa'i skyon gyis so/ spyi zhag gsum ga'i gza' lnga'i rkang pa sgang po ma btog phyed pa'i skabs 'di so sa'i gnas kyi mang kung tsam ma gtogs cho gi lag len byed lugs 'dra ba yin/ yang na gnas kun mig gis bsgyur// mkha' ros bgod sogs gang 'dod bya// lhag pa spen pa'i rkang pa de// stongs par babs na bsgyur bya phyis// yang rgyu la sogs rkang longs med// rang rang dal dag cig shos la// rim pa bsnan la rim min phri// phri bya nyung na de nyid kyis// dbri byed phri bar bya ba'am// 'khor lo bsna nas sbyangs pa na// lusag 'byung lugs ldomag ri mo 'char// rim pa'i snga rkang myur 'gros shar// phyi rkang dal 'gros lho ru byed// rim min snga rkang 'khyog 'gros nub// phyi rkang 'byung 'gros bya du'o// de yang zhag gsum gza' lnga'i skabs// gza' lnga so so'i dal myur gyi// rkang pa gcig car gnas pa yin// dper na mig dpar lta bu la// nyin zhag dal rkang gcig nas zin// de bzhin tshes zhag khyim zhag gi

/dal rkang gcig nas zin par 'gyur// des mtshon nyin zhag myur rkang gis// khyi tshes gnyis kyang gsum nas zin// gza' bzhi de yis rigs 'gre'o// nyi mas khyim ni bcu gnyis la// gang sleb zhag gsum gza' lnga po// ri mo cig car rgyal pa'i tshes 'gros bzhi spyod pa yin// nyin zhag tshes zhag khyim zhag gsum// rim min rkang 'dzin thig shar na// cho tshod sum cu yan chad nas// rim min 'khor phyed ma longs bar// chu tshod gnas su mkha' me bsres// drug cha longs na skar gnas su// mkha' ros phud de rkang pa bzung*// de sogs zhag gsum kun la sbyar// zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las dpal ldan gza' lnga nyin zhag dang tshes spyod bai dkar sor gzhag dang gza' lnga khyim zhag gsar bsnan gyi sgrub lugs bshad pa'i parga lnga pa'o/ ༈ /mkhyen bar khyung sngon skyes kyis nyer drangs pa'i// bcu phrag rig pa rta bdun snang ba ches// lnga rig bstan pa'i 'dab brgya bzhad mdzad pa// mu ne'i rnam 'khrul sangs rgya mtshos skyongs// rnam dag legs bshad baiḍār dkar po las/ rnam mang snang srid gsal bar ston nus pa'i// rnam gsal dus sbyor me long drangs pa'i ngogs// rnam bkra'i blang dor gzugs brnyen ce yang shar// dka' gnad dus sbyor ri mo ni// sngon med legs bshad bai dkar bzhin// lag lan bde phyir phor phyung nas// blo gsar rnam kyi don du bkod// de yang pa 'di 'os pa yi// dus kyi sbyor ba bshad pa la// thog mar khyim gyi nyin tshad kyi// tshad bshad nya dang bu mo ni// nyin mtshan chu tshod mkha' mer mnyam// chu tshod zla yon srang phyogs ni// lug seng nyin tshad chu tshod do// chu srang mkha' mig glang karṭa'i// nyin mo'i tshad yin chu tshod du// yon tan rtse mo thig le'i srang*// 'khrig pa'i nyin mo'i tsha yin la// chu tshod nor lag mkha' mda' srangs// bum srang gnyis kyi nyin tshad yin// chu tshod thub mig mkha' mtshos srang*// cha srin sdig pa'i nyi mo'i tshad// mtshams mig chu tshod mkha' me'i srang*// gzhu yi nyin mo'i tshad yin la// de rnams thig mtshams sbyangs pa yin// so so'i mtshan mo'i dzad du 'gyur// de nas gang brtse'i tshes de yi// rnam dag grub rtsis nyi bar gyi// skar gnas mkha' rosabasgyur ba la// 'og gi chu tshod steng du gzhug

/mda' yon zlas thob 'das pa'i khyim// lhag rnams mkha' mes bsgyur ba la// mda' yon zlas thob ngo thog gi /khyi de'i 'das pa'i zhag po yin// lhag ma'i gnas kun mkha' ros bsgyur// 'khor los bsgril ma mda' yon zlas// thob pa dbyug go slar lhag gi /gnas rnams mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*// yang lhag gnas kun dus kyi bsgyur// thob pa dbugs yin ri ro yis// gnas kun bsgyur ba 'khor los bsgril// mda' yon zla bas thob pa de// cha shas yin no lhag med 'char// rnam dag 'di ni bar nub kyang*// shes brtson gyis da lam spel// de ni don gyi khyim pho yin// 'das zhag steng nas ri yis phri// ma ldangs khyim phab de yis ni// 'khor los rdzogs na bsnan par bya// lhag de 'das pa'i khyim zla'i grangs// ngo thog rang gi khyim dus 'dzin// de ni phyed pa sla phyir yin// ri yis dman pa'i zhag lhag de// gnas gnyis byas la gnyis ka yang*// mig bsgyur 'og ma dus kyi bgos// steng byin thig ros thob nor gyis// rang rang ngo thog khyim de yi// 'khrig sogs lho bgrod nyin mor dor// gzhu sogs byang bgrod nyin mos byin// nyin de'i nyin tshad 'khrul med yin// de yis thig ros phri ba yis// mtshan mo'i tshad de rtogs par 'gyur// chu srang 'byung med mkha' ri ste// byang bgrod 'khrig pa'i chu srang ste// glang dang karṭar 'byung mig ri// lug seng gnyis la mkha' klu 'dod// nya dang bu mor 'byung ro dang*// bu ga zla ba byin par bya// mkha' klu rgyal ba bum pa srang*// 'byung mig bug lag chu srin sdig /gzhug la mkha' stong me 'on byin// so so'i bgod gzhi rags de la// thur ma'i rag grig bdun po dang*// btsugs pa'i grib ma bsdoms pa yin// bgos pas thob pa chu srang yin// ros bsgyur thob pa dbugs yin te// srang la thig ros thob pa'i nor// chu tshod gnas su bzhag pa yis// snga dro 'das pa phyi dro la// ma 'ongs chu tshod rjes 'brangs tshad// de yis nyin mo'i tshad la dor// lhag de snga dro ma 'ongs pa// phyi dro 'das pa'i tshad yin la// de rnams so so'i srang tshad ni// 'byung mkha' rtse mo nyi yi tshad// thig bug lag pa lug gi tshad// mkha' stong mtshe ma glung gi tshad// stong pa ri mig 'khrig pa la// nam mkha' dus me karka ṭa// dbang ri mo rnams seng ge'i tshad// bu mo la sogs ldog par bya// ri yis phri ba'i zhag lhag de// rang gi srang gis bsgyur ba la// mkha' mes thob pa chu srang 'das// de yis so so'i chu srang la// sbyangs pa'i lhag mas ma 'ongs shes// tatkāl gang yin brtag pa'i ched// thur btsal nyin der 'das pa yi// chu tshod thig ros bsgyur byas la// 'og gi chu srang steng du bsnan// de la rang gi ma 'ongs srang*// thog mar byas la rim bzhin phri// nya sogs drug la lusag 'byung dang*// bu mo la sogs ldog par bya// bgod par ma ldangs tatkāl la// phri ba'i lhag de thig yon bsgyur// de la tatkā la chu srang gis// bgos pas thob pa cha shas yin// de lhag thig ros bsgyur ba la// chu srang gis thob chu tshod do// yang lhag thig ros dus kyi bar// bsgyur bgod byas pas so so'i cha// tatkāl dang bcas gnas lnga'o// de nyid brtag tshul gzhan yang ni// gnas lnga'i tatkāl cha srang ni// thig mes bsgyur la cha shas gzhug

/de yang mkha' ros bsgyur byas la// 'og gi cha tshod dang ldan par// nam mkha' thig klu gzugs kyis bgo /thos pa dus sbyor tatkā la/ khyad med 'byung ba gcig pa zhes// des nas mi mnyam mnyam pa yi// dum lnga'i dus sbyor bshad par bya// de la dus kyis sbyor ba la// yon tan 'bum ldan 'bras bu rnams// brjod kyis lang bar ma yin kyang*// de dag la rtogs rtsis mkhan rnams// 'di yi ri mo rtogs tsam las// dgos don ma rtogs stongs 'dra// de phyir dum lnga'i dmigs bsal gyi// dgos don thor bu dang bcas bkod// cha shas mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// chu tshod dang ldan spyi rgyu yin// dus sbyor phyed pa brtags pa'i ched// de la mkha' mkha' rtse yis bgo /rnyed pa yod dam med kyang rung*// 'di man dus lnga mtha' dag la// lhag ma byung na gzugs kyis brgyan// rnyed nor mig las lhag mi srid// gcig gi bdag po nyi ma ste// gnyis kyi bgad po zla ba yin// 'di nyid srid cha gtso ba ste// nyi mar bu skye zla ba la// bu mo skye bar bshad pa yin// dus sbyor gsum cha 'di bzhin te// spyi yi rgyu ba mkha' mkha' ros// thob nor gsum mas mang mi srid// 'di ni gtso bo don brtag ste// gcig byung ro 'bras zhing bdag gza'// gnyis byung dogs pa'i 'bras 'byung ba// tatkāl bgrangs pa'i lnga pa'i gza'// gsum gyis re dgos gang ying med// tarkā nas bgrangs dgu pa'i gza'// dus ni nam 'grub brtag pa la// thob nor mkha' mkha' dus kyis bsgyur// de nyin res gza'i grangs kyang bsre// mkha' mes bgos thob zla grangs dang*// lhag ma zhag gi grangs yin la// de yang myur 'grub las yin na// mkha' mes bgos thob zhag so ste// lhag ma chu tshod grangs su nges// dgu cha'i dus sbyor 'di lta ste// spyi rgyu mkha' stong mig gis bgo /thob nor tatkāl gang yin nas// gzung la dgu cha brtag pa de// lug seng gzhu rnams lug nas bgrangs// chu srin gling dang bu mo ni// chu srin nyin nas 'dren par bya// 'khrigs pa bum pa srang nas 'dren// karka sdig nya karṭa badren// 'di nyin skun ma la sogs pa// brtag thabs mngon shis mang yod kyang*// yi ges 'jig dang gsal drag pas// chu srin nyin nas 'dren par bya// 'khrig pa bum pa srang nas 'dren// karka sdig nya karṭa 'dren/

'di nyin rkun ma la sogs sa// brtag thabs mngon shes mang yod kyang*// yi ges 'jig dang gsal drag pas// cu zad gung du sbas pa dang*// gzhon nu spyo ba bskyod pa'i phyir// brkus sam sbas sam khyer ba yi// ngag tu ma brjod ma mthong ba'i// dngos po 'di zhes brjod 'dod na// lugs sing sdig pa'i dus sbyor la// bdun par nyi mig 'dzom pa'am// re re shar kyi rdzas de ni// lcags gser dngul zangs la sogs pa// bzhu ru btub pa'i rdzas shig dang*// g.yu dang byu ru mu men dang*// mu tig la sogs mi btub yin// bu mo chu srin 'khrig bum pa// shar nas de grangs bdun pa la// lhag spen 'dzom mam re re shar// ras gos shing lo la sogs pa// rtse dang bar grub ces grags// srang gzhu nyi glang karṭa shar// bdun par zla phur sangs 'dzom mal// re re yod kyang sha rus khrag /pags sam srog chags rim yin brjod// kha dog rags pa gza' mdog ste// phur seng nyi ma dmar skya'i mdog /mig dmar dmar nag sgra gcan sngo// bla ba dkar ser spen pa nag /lhag pa lnga dang sngo bar gnas// sa sangs kha dogs nges med yin// de nas dbyibs dang rku shor na// mi yi mig grangs gang nye sogs// yod kyang gu du sbas nas bzhag /bcu gnyis cha la spyi rgyu de// mkha' dbang gzugs kyis bgod par bya// thob nor tatkāl nas bgrangs pa'i/ khyim gyibadag po'i 'bras buma'// tshong dang gdos don nad pa'i phyir// gcig byung bdag so k-iṣṇa dang*// gnyis shar bdag po 'dzom pa ste// gsum sogs bzang po mdzes can dang*// ba glang sna nam dkar po dang*// thog dang sdug bsngal rnam mdzes dang*// skal can gangs bdag drag po dang*// thig shar nye ba'i ri bo yin// de yis bdag po'i gza' brtag par// zhig bdag nasabagrangs nyin drug 'khor// mtshan mo lnga 'khor gangang yin la// bcu gnyis cha thob nor de// nyin la lnga dang mtshan mtshoms bsgyur// zhig bdag gza' grangs bsnan pa la// thub pas dor lhag bdag po'i gza'// tshong nad dgos don la sogs pa// 'bras bu bdag po'i ming yig la// brten nas zhib shes na yang*// ha cang mang dang gsal drag pas// tho longs tsam las ma bkod do// su cu cha la spyi rgyu la// mkha' ros bsgos ma dmag dpon dang*// nyi bu zla ma zla ba'i bu// dkar po rim par bzhag byas la// 'byung ba mda' klu ri dbang dkon// lug sogs mi mnyam rim pa g.yas// glung sogs mnyam ste rim min g.yon// grangs mthun thad ka'i gza' 'bras// lug 'khrig seng ge srang gzhu bum// mi mnyam rnyed nor gzugs mda' bar// mig dmar dus nas phyogs bar spen// drag po nyes pa'i bar du phur// bug gzugs de nyid bar lhag pa// dus mig mkha' me'i bar pa sangs// de yis 'bras bu bzang ngan ston// glang dang karṭa bu mo sdig

/chu srin nyi bcas mnyam pa drug /gzugs nas mda' bar pa wa sangs// ro san khyim bar lhag pa ste// 'dod pa mkha' mig bar phur bu// zla zung de nyid bar spen pa// dus mig mkha' me'i bar mig dmar// 'di nam 'dre byed dar gud brtag /de yi bshad pa mangs pa dang*// dgos don ha cang mi che bas// 'di la ma bkod rgyu nas longs// mnyam na nyin zhag phrugs gcig la// dus kyi sbyor ba bcu gnyis 'char// nyis khri chig stong drug brgya dbugs// khyim khyi thob pa'i nor de ni// dus sbyor gcig pa'i longs spyod yin// nor la mig rtse bug nyi ma mkha' me rnams kyis rim par ni// bgos pa'i thob nor so so yin// longs spyod du shes par bya// dus sbyor mdo tsam bstan na yang*// 'di yis 'bras bu yon tan ni// 'bum gyi grangs su brjod pa dang*// 'phral dus bzang tshes skar sbyor kyangs// tatkā la dus sbyor 'di yis bsgyur// zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nyi rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las gar bu rnams la be bum rgyas pa gr+yas pa 'byor dkar gshis dus sbyor bai dkar sor gzhag 'khor phyung bkod pa'i parga drug pa'o/ ༈ /chos kun gsal ba thugs kyi me long du// mdo sngags rigs lam gzugs brnyan rab bkod cing*// gang 'dul 'od kyis sa gsum 'gengs mdzad pa// lo chen dharma shri phyog gi gnas// 'jam mgon pas ri'i mkhyen rab lha mal du// myong byang zin tig chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las// lkog gyur dngos ston sngon med grub char rgyun// blo gsal kun rtog zhing sa brlan par bya// nya stong nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor la// srid gsum rnam rgyal 'jug pa'i tshul// legs bshad bai ḍūr dkar po las// lag len bde phyir khol byung bkod// 'on kyang sgrib 'di'i rgyu rkyen gyi// lo rgyus drag nges rnam bcu rnams// yi ges ngal bas 'dir ma bkod// dgos pa skabs den be bum gzigs// de yang byed pa la sogs par// bltos min rnam dag grub rtsis kyi// gtan du mi bslu nges pa la// ri mo sgo bsdun mi dgos pa'i// zab pa'i man ngag mchis na'ang*// 'di ni cung zad gsal tsam las// bsdus rgyud dang bstund spyi 'gre la// bshad do de yang so so yi// 'dzin tshul sa bcad bcu ru bshad// thog mar spyi ru gces pa la// rtse ba'i rgyu kyi rjes 'brangs pa'i// rnam dag grub rtsis lugs gsum dang*// sgra gcan bsdus pa'i rgyud bcas pa// rtsa grub skyon med nges pa gces// rnam dag grub rtses chad lhag dang*// dum drug dus sbyor gzhung ltar gyi// nyin mtshan chu tshod zhib cha dang*// sgra 'di nyi maphyang bgrod dus zar drug zhe lnga dang lho bgrod kar mda' me mig dang nyin mtshan mnyam dus zar mda' dus kyis sbyang dgos gcan dang ni zla ba dag

khyim gcig 'dzom dang mi 'dzom dang*// stong la nyi zla lhan cig tu// gnas sam bar khyed zhugs ma zhugs// lung ston ba'i yul de yi// shar nub ri bo'i mtho dma' dang*// ri dang sa khad nyi 'gyangs dang*// nya zla ba'i ming yi 'od dkar bdag po dang*// nam mkha'i nor bu 'char nub dus// nyin mtshan chu ji ltar tshod re yod dang khyim tsam sleb sogs// zhib tu brtags nas ma smras na// mkhas rloms byed pa'i rtsis mkhan 'ga'// 'dzin tshul kha dmar logs pa mang*// dang po zla ba sngar bzung nas// zla drug 'dzin ces spyir btang las// mthong ba'i nges pa che ba med// zla ba phyed drug phyed bdun dang*// lnga mas nye bar 'byung mi srid// khyim ni sngar bzung drug nas 'dzin// nya la za bzung rjes su// stong la nyi ma 'dzin pa'ang srid// stong la nyi ma bzung rjes su// nya la zla ba 'dzin pa srid// nyi 'dzin snga phyi gang rung la// zla 'dzin med tshe gnam stong la// nyid 'dzin 'byung ba mi srid do// lo skor bar du nyi ma yang*// mi 'dzin srid phyari nyi 'dzin dkon// 'dzin tshad mthong ba ma yin te// snga phyi'i chu tshod dag la rag /spyir na nyi zla g.yon skor dang*// sgra gcan g.yas skor 'gro ba ste// gdong 'dzin nyi zla longs spyod ming*// mjug la sgra gcan mang ba la// ma ldog ces grags ga 'jol med// che bar 'dzin par spyir btang bzhed/ ༈ /dang po bsil zer 'dzin tshul ni// zla rer 'gros bzhina'i mtshan ma ston// de phyir rel sor tshes bsres la// ma nus bgos lhag zla rkang bzung*// rnyed mnyam snga rkang myur 'gros shar// phyir rkang dal 'gros lho ru byed// mi mnyam snga rkang 'khyog 'gros nub// phyi rkang 'byung 'gros byed de byang*// nya yi zla ba shar dus su// mtshan tshad thog ma 'dzin pa la// nam du'ang 'phyugs pa med sogs nas// bco lnga nam dang mnyam zer bar// sngon gyi mkha' pa phal chen ni// nges pa che bar mi mdzad pa// yul gyis sa khad 'gyangs dog dang*// zla ba'i 'char nu ba snga phyi bcas// cung zad 'khrul ba bden srid kyang*// nyin re'i rgya skur rjes 'brangs phyir// snga phyi'i tshad la 'phyugs pa med// 'on kyang zla ba 'char nub phyed pa'i tshul// ldo 'grod 'phyi nus pa snga// byang 'gro 'char snga nub 'phyi// dang po 'dzin dang mi 'dzin ni// bsdu pa'i rgyud kyi nyi dag la// 'dod pa mkha' me byin pa de// tshes 'khyud zla skar zhes grags dang*// sgra gcan gdong 'jug gang nye gnyis// skar ma gcig la gnas pa'am// gcig khyed 'dug kyang brtag par bya// nyung gis mang sbyangs lhag ma de// sgra gcan zla ba'i bar khyed yin// zla bar gdong sbyangs lhag ma ru// ri dbang man chad 'dzin pa de// gdong la zla bas sbyangs pa dang*// dus me zla bas sbyangs pa la// mkha' 'byung man shar 'ashin par nges// zla bdus me sbyangs pa'i tshes// 'byung mtsho man chad 'dzin pa yin// spyir ni chu tshod nyung bzhed kyang*// gnyis ka stogs na 'dzin mi 'gyur// zla 'dzin chu tshod mang bzhed kyang*// gdong 'dzin klu dang lhag pa dang*// mjug la 'byung mda' bsgral ba na// mthong bar gyur pa ma yin no// gnyis pa dus tshod bstan pa ni// nyi yin tshes rdzogs bcu drug gi

/thog mar sgra gcan 'jug na yang*// gnam pa bar khyed khyams tshes ba'i// rnam dag grub rtsis byang bgro dus// skar drug chu tshod zhe lnga dang*// lho bgrod skar mda' me mig dor// zla ba'i bgrod pa 'bring po dang*// gdong pas zla sbyangs ril sos sgrib// rdzogs ma thag tu 'dzin pa de// lha byang mthar thug zla ba bsnan// rang du chu srang mkha' me byin// de nyid zad ma thag tu 'dzin// cha rer chu srang mkha' mig gis// 'dzin 'gor bas rigs 'gros kyi/ phyaid 'dzin chu tshod lag pa dang*// chu srang mkha' me bsnan pa yi// longs spyod tshe 'dzin pa yin// de yi rig pas cha gzhan shes// zla bas gdong dus mes zla// sbyangs tshes ril sgrib bgrod pa bzhung*// chu tshod me byin rdzogs tshe 'dzin// lho byang mthar thug mtsho byin la// bar du chu srang mkha' me ste// cha shas 'dzin pa'i dus yin na// cha rer chu srang mtsho mig gis// 'dzi pa 'khor bas ca 'gros brtse// dus mer zla bas sbyangs pa'i tshe// ril sgrib bgrod pa dbus yin na// 'byung ba bsnan pa rdzogs mtshams 'dzin// lho byang mthar thug dus dman zhing*// bar du chu tshod 'byung ba dang*// mkha' me'i chu srang pa de// cha 'dzin chu srang mig me yis// cha res 'dzi sa bul ba yin// de yang tshes 'khyud zla skar la// dus sbyor gzhung bzhin bsgrubs pa yis// zla grib thub ma'i grib ma yi// snga phyi mi bslu tshad rnams ston// gsum pa 'dzin phyogs bstan pa ni// gdong 'dzin tshes 'khyud zla skar la// gdong gis sbyangs shing 'jug 'dzin dus// tshes 'khyud dus mes sbyangs byas la// ma ldangs byung na 'khor la bsnan// sbyangs lhag 'don pa las mang na// nam stod byang smad phyed dbang ldan// tho rengs shar stod nas 'dzin cing*// sbyangs rjes me zla las nyung na// nam stod shar smad nam phyed dus// me lha tho rengs lho stod 'dzin// nub dang byang stod lho smad nas// 'dzin par da par 'gyur ba min/
