phrad ri mo rnams// bzhengs bzhugs kha byang 'bras bu 'dri// nyi stong zla nyi sgra gcan gyis// sgrib tshe dus tshod cha yun dang*// bzang ngan la sogs snying po 'dri// ṛ ṣi zhag bdun chu klung rnams// yan lag brgyad ldan 'gyur ba dang*// dur phag shing la 'dzogs pa'i 'bras// zhag bdun chu rnams dug 'gyur tshul// du ba mjug ring 'char ba na// 'di la 'char zhes tshes la sogs// mdor na kun gyi mi rtog pa'i// mtshan ma bzang ngan gang yod kyang*// 'di yon zer ba'i dmar gdags// de nas zhags gsumagang yin kyang*// nya stong gzang lnga'i dal myur dang*// zla ba de yi sgor rgyur wa// yod na bkod par bya ba dang*// byed grub so so'i rgyu wa dang*// nya ston gra gcan ni mo bkod// de nas so so'i tshes khongs la// rnam par dag pa'i grub rtsis dang*// byed rtsis gnyis ka gnas lnga 'am// ma 'grub gnas sum mi no ba'i// mtshan ma dang bcas bkod pa dang*// dbugs thob khyim 'pho sgang tshad sogs// tshes khongs gang yado ri mo dang*/ kha byang bcas pa ma nor bkod// 'grol ba'i go rim 'di lta ste// thog mar tshes kyis aṅgi dang*// de rjes dus 'khor dbyangs 'char gnyis// mthun pa'i dgaya bzang rgyal stong rdzogs// rim par drug skor de nas ni// dus 'khor dbyangs gsal so so dang*// 'byung ba 'dod yon de bzhin du// dbyangs 'char dbyangs gsal 'byung ba dang*// 'dod yon la sogs 'char tshul rnams// sngon 'gro le'u gnyis pa dang*// gtan ler bkod ltar ma nor bar// dus 'khor snag tshad dbyangs 'char rnams// mi nor ma dang bcas 'dri// dus 'khor dbyangs 'char gnyis ka'ang*// mthun pa'i tshes ni dar gud ni// byis gzhon lang tsho rgan po smin// zla rer drug sgor skor 'dri bar bya// de nas grub pa'i res gza' dang*// rags nas par re grogs zla skar bcas// rang rang ri mo bkod pa la// sngon mar 'pho ba khyim ming de// sngon ma'i tshes khongs 'dri bar bya// de nas sel ba la sogs pa// sbyor ba ri mo bzhin du bkod// sbyor ba mchongs na sngon mar gnyis// bldabs pa'i tshe na gnyis ka 'dri// de nas ba la sogs pa// sbyor ba ri mo bzhin du bkod// sbyor ba ri mo bzhin du bkod// sbyor ba mchongs na sngon mar gnyis// bldamams tshi na gnyis ka 'dri// de nas biṣṭi'i 'pho mtshis ni// mtsho drag skyon dang de nyid phyi// klu tshes lag mig bug gzugs snga// de phyi snga chas tshes snga mar// shas tsher phyin mang phyin mang phyi chas kyang*// snga mar pa srid pa yin// tshes longs sngon mas mkha' ro la// phri lhag nam langs gong du 'das// lhag dang da ltar long spyod gnyis// bsres la zung gis phyi ba'i nor// biṣṭi rgyu ba'i yul tshad yin yin// snga phyi 'char bar logs spyod de// rim bzhin tshogs dang rdzogs nas 'jug

/bdud nyi bsreg 'chi sbyor dang*// 'grub sbyor la sogs gang 'dug pa// rang rang 'phrod kyi rjes nyid du// 'dri'o de yang 'di bzhin te// nyi ma me bzhi lhag mtshis mchu// smin drug snub dang pa ga sgrog /zla ba gro bzhin smin pa ga /dbo dang byi bzhin snron khrums smad// mir 'byu gu mon grub lag /skag dang khrums smad ni gru khrums// lhag pa lha mtshis dbyu gu snubs// bri smin me bzhin bra nyi dang*// phur bu rgyal mgo mon dre mgo /nabs so snar ma lhag mtshams te// dkar po ni grub snar ma snar// rgyal gre namaso mchu dang ni// spen sna me bzhi chu ste// mo na gru pa ri bra nyi dang*// nam grub rnams ni rim pa bzhin// 'grur ro 'chi sbyor bsreg sbyor dang*// bdun nyi bdun rgyal 'jigs pa'i nyi// mi mthun nyi ma zhes su grags// tshas dang gza' 'jom bsroeg tshes ni// nyi ma bcu gnyis nyi shu bdun// zla ba bcu gcig nyi shu drug /mi bcu dang nyi shu lnga*// 'gror 'chi sbyor bsreg sbyor dang*// bdud nyi bdud rgyal 'jig pa'i nyi// mi mthun nyi mi zhes su grags// tshes dang gza' 'dzom bsreg tshes ni// nyi ma bcu gnyis bdun// zla ba bcu gnyis drug mi bcu dang nyi shu lnga*// lhag pa gsum dang bco brgyad de// phur bu drug dang nyi shi gcig /pa sangs gnyis dang bcu 'dun te// spen pa bdun dang nyi shu gnyis// 'di dag 'dzom tshes sregs 'dri// de yang dper na tshes bcu la// res gza' bla ba'i tshes longs de// nyin mde ma longs nyung ba na// bcu gcig tshang ba'i badha cha du nga tha mar zhabs skyi ldan par 'bri/ ༈ /ni nyi ma gang yin 'bri// de rjes spang kha'i yi ge dang*// gshi du sme ba'i yang bkod par// yar sme tshes la 'char tshul ni// stag rta khyi gsum li yis tshes// khal lug yos gsum zin gyis tshes// byi 'brug spel gsum khyi gyi tshes// bya glang sbrul gsum dwa yi tshes// sme ba ra bzhi gcig dkar tshes// 'bring bzhi bzhi ljong mtha' bzhi bdun// de nas rim bzhin shes par bya// klu dang sde brgyad thobs bzlogs dang*// gnam sgo gnyis pa snag tsha dang*// dkyus rnams mtshal sogs mtshan mar bcas*// nag rtsis pa bdag khri ma sogs// shog khri ji bzhin bkod pas 'grub// zla gcig chad lhag bzhi lnga yang*// srid la tshes gcig lhag pa dang*// gnyis chad la sogs nges mid yongs// rang rang skar ma'i mgo thog tu// lnga sgra nyi mi bcas pa yi// gdong tshugs g.yas g.yon mche ba bcas// zla gcig chad lhag bzhi yang*// de yang nyi stong rim mo yi// bar nas skar ma'i 'pho mtshams rnams// 'ol tshod mun mda' phebal pa las// lnga sgra nyi mi bcas pa yi// gdong tshugs g.yas g.yon mtshe bcas// rkang brgyu'i re'u mig ji bzhin 'akod// de yang nyi stong mi ma yi// bar nas skar ma'i 'pho mtshams rnams// 'og tshod mun mda' 'phen pa las// rtogs dka' rags tsam skad cig la// shes 'dod sngan ma'i dal myur gyis// rjes ma'i dal myur phri ba'i lhag

/tshes kyi bgos nor zhag re yis// yul gyis spyod pa'i longs spyod de// sngon ma'i steng du rtsam bsnan pa'i// grangs kyi skar gnas longs na 'pho// de ni dal myur rkang pa ni// ma 'phos dus su rnam dag dang*// 'phos tshe chu tshod man rags pa// aṅki'i g.yas gyogs biṣṭi dang*// rkang brgya'i g.yon mche g.yon phyogs la// zla skar spyod tshad rkang brgya'i mtshe// g.yas pa bcas pa 'god pa yin// de yang bla ba 'phar ba'i tshe// gang 'phangar zla ba'i ming dang ni// zla 'phor rags zhig gza' dar gud// lha lnga lha dus chen dang*// nag rtsis pa bdag la sogs pa// gang 'phar ldams nas 'dri ba gnad// che chung gza' tshes la sogs pa// ri mo ltar du mi 'dra 'char// 'bri so'i le'u tho bya ba ni// gong gi nyin mtshan ring thung la// ri bo gsangs ldan 'phyugs pa yis// dus sbyor sogs dang mi 'grigs pas// kho bos bshad bzhin bya ba las// gzhan ma'i stod smad bar gsum gyi// le'u tho'i bya lugs che pha kun// mkhas dbang don grub dbang rgyal gyis// skar nag zung sbyor nas bshad dang*// sngon ma ma nyams bshus pa la// brtsams pa'i rin chen phra tshoms dang*// paṇa chen dkon mchog chos grags kyis// ldan thabs rgyu skar 'phreng ba gsum// gang rung nang bzhin bgyis pa yis// don la khyed med 'grub pa'i phyir// sngon ma nyams bshus pa// dgos don ha cang mi che bas pas// 'di la ma bkod gzhan nas long*// bsdus pa'i le'u tho bya ba la// dus kyi 'khor lo phyog bya ba'i// tshegs su bcad pa rkang bzhi'am// legs sbyar sam skri'i skad bsgyur ba// gang bde byas nas lo bshad kyi// mdo sde gsal ba nas bzung ste// kar myang rtsigs kyi bar dag tu// so so'i bshad bzhin bshu ba'am// yang na nor bu bshu ba dang*// med pa la sogs gang bde yin// sme ba lo 'khor thun phyed dang*// phyed grub khyi drug spyi nor te// gnyis ka 'dri'i grub pa rang*// 'dri ba gang bde bya ba dang*// lo gza' lo rgyal blon dang*// kar myang la sogs 'grub na rab// ma 'grub shad pas 'thun pa ste// gza' lnga'i rgyu'i spyi nor sogs// 'bri 'am mi 'dri skabs dang bsdun// de nas rang rang zla 'khor dang*// ṛ ṣi phag zhag sogs bzhag pa'i// zla ba'ibashad pa 'bring po ltar// byed grub rgyu sgra gcan 'bri// tshes khongs dbyangs nasabartsams pa ste// 'bring po ltar brisapa la// sgra gcan me dud sol gsum dang*// gza' lnga'i mche zugs ma byung mthus// byed grug gnyis ka 'bri ba'am// grub pa gang rigs gnas gnyis dang*// spyod khra 'bring po bzhin du 'debs/

༈ /de na le'u thog rgyas pa'i skabs// nyer kho dbyangs brgyad phye ba la// mgo bo shar bstan rkang lag bzhi// mtshams la sbo gnyis lho byang dang*// snying ga dbus la mjug ma nub// bstan par smin drug nas brtsams te// snying ga mgo bo lag g.yon dang*// sbo g.yon rkang g.yon mjug ma dang*// rkang g.yas sbo g.yas lag g.yas rnams// gsam gsum bkod la gza' dgu yi// gnas lugs la brten 'bras 'byin phyir// rgyu skar gang gnas gza' 'grems bya// de yang spyir na drag gza' ngan// zhing gzha' bde ster 'dres ma yis// 'bras bu sna tshogs zhi drag med// 'bras bu sna tshogs zhi drag med// gza' ngan med par spyi bshad kyang*// zhing bar gnas phyogs su// char med than pa 'byung ba dang*// spen pa gnas pa mu ge che// mig dmar gdong mjug 'thab rtsod 'byung*// sa sangs phur bus rgyal po'i// yul de bde bar byed pa yin// lhag pa gnas na lo tog bzang*// zla bas char pa ran par 'bebs// de yang stobs kyi ched chu brtag /skar mar gnas pa'i mgyogs dal gyis// mig phur spen pa gdong mjug rnams// 'bras bu nges la nyi lhag sangs// 'bring la zla ba rtsol ba'i phyir// nges med la sogs zhi brtsis nas/ kha dmar ma ldog lung ston bya/ ༈ /seng ge gdan gyi 'khor lo la// brten nas dbus lho byang gi /rgyal po gatshor gyur bzang ngan brtag /tha skar nas bzang skag gis bar// dgu po dbus skar mchu nas ni// snron bar lho phyogs snubs nas bzung*// nasam gru'i bar du byang phyogs bzhag /nor rta dang gdugs rnga ma// seng gdan glung chen pu sti dang gser dang chos sku rim par sbyor// mgo dang nag pa bya gzhugs gsum// thad kar seng gdan byung ba ni// rgyal pa'o'i bde sdug ston pa ste// nag par spen gnas lho phyogs dang*// mon dro spen gnas byang phyogs dang*// mgo spen gnas na dbus kyi ni// rgyal po srog dang dbra bar brjod// gdugs dang rnga yab spen gnas na// gang gnas rgyal po nad kyi 'dzin// rta dang glung sor spen gnas na// gang nags srog chags nad mnar nas// de nas srog dang 'bral bar 'gyur// nor bu gser chos por sti sogs// spen pa gang gnas zod de ni// pul der dkon par 'gyur ba yin// seng ge gdan la gza' gzhan song*// mig dpar rgyal phran rtson pa dang*// rā hu yod na dus 'khrug 'byung*// dus mes dan rims nyi ma yis// mu ge zla lhag gnas pa na// mnga' thang 'phel dang phur bus chos// 'phel la dkar pos bud med 'du// 'dres mas 'bras bu 'dres mar 'byung*/

༈ /dbus dang shar nub rgyal po yi// bzang ngan brtag phyir gdugs 'khor bshad// rtsi bzhi ldan pa'i lhon pa'i lhon pa'i lto 'gro 'khyog /gsum yad 'phyog res gdugs ri btsugs// tha skar nas bzung rtsa bzhir 'khyog /mgo dang nag pa mon dri gsum// gdugs kyi yu bar re re gnas// nyi ma sgra gzan mig dmar dang*// spen pa bzhi'i gang rung gcig /mgo yi steng nas phur bu yang*// lhag cig yod na shar phyogs kyi// rgyal po dan gyis thebs par 'gyur// drag gza' nag par gnas pa dang*// lhag pa phun bu bzhin 'gyur pa// dbus kyi rgyal po shar bzhin no// drag gza' mon dror gnas pa dang*// zla ba phur bu bzhin gyar ba'i// nub kyi rgyal po sngar bzhin no// gdugs kyi yu ba'i skar gsum la// bsod nams bzhi'am gsum mam gnyis// gcig ni gnas par gyur gan// gang gnas rgyal po yul 'khor skyid/ ༈ /gzhan yang mkhar rdzong yul sde dang*// gang zag skyes ming la sogs par// bde dang bde brtag pa'i phyir// phan tshun tshen po'i 'khor lo bshad// smin drug nas bzung skar nyer brgyad// 'dab bdun la char bar bkod// 'dab rer nyi zla sangs phur dang*// mig lhag spen dang rā hu gnyis// lhan cig gnas pa rā hu la/ khrumams smad nam grub spen pa la// tha skar bra nye rtsis pa yi// so so thad dkar blta tshul ni// nyi ma mig dpar thad bltas dang*// zla lhag phur spen thad bltas te// sa sangs rā hu thad bltas yin// dpare na smin drug snar ma mgo /lag bzhi gang rung nyi ma gnas// de thad snubs dang chu stod// chu smad gro bzhin mig dmar gnas// nyi mig thad kar bltas pa yis// skar ma brgyad po'i yi ge ni// so gnyis thom mar byas pa yis// yul ljong gang zag la sogs pa'i// ming ldan ma ngan yul rjong gi /phyugs brlug lo tog ngan pa dang*// gnyer brlag rin chen med par 'gyur// de sogs kun la rigs 'gre brtsi// char pa dkon mod brtag pa ni// dbyar ra dus su gang brtsi yi// dus su skar ma'i khams 'byed tshul// skar rtsis bzhin la gza' kun rnams// chu skar spyod la khyed par du/

༈ /char pa dkon mod brtag ni// dbyar ra'i dus su gang brtsi yi// dus su skar ma'i khams 'byed tshul// skar rtsis bzhin la gza' kun rnams// chu skar spyod la khyed par du*// yang ngo'i tshes na zhi gza' rnams// chu khams skar gnas zla ba yang*// chu yi skar mar spyod pa'i tshe// char pa 'bab yang ngo tshe na zhi gza' rnams// chu khams skar gnas zla ba yang*// chu yi skar mar spyod pa'i tshe// char pa 'bab cing phebs kyang sla// nyi mi spen gsum chu skar du// 'jom na ser ba rgod pa yis// sa skar stong 'jom cung zad tsam// 'babs kyang 'atsub chen po ldan ba dang*// me wa sangs dang phur zla gsum// chu skar steng 'dzom char chen 'bebs// sa skar 'dzom cung zad tsam// 'babs kyang rlangs 'tshub gtor bar byed// rlung skar steng du 'tshoms pa ma// rlung 'tshub chen po ldang ba dang*// me skar 'than pa 'byung ba yin// sa wa sangs dang phur zla gsum// chu skar 'dzom char chen 'bebs// sa skar 'dzom na lo legs shing*// me rlung steng 'dzom nam 'khor tsam// lhag pa gang gi steng yod kyang*// phan mnod 'bras bu che ba med// 'on kyang chur phyin na ngan// me rlung rlung 'tshub shas cher ldang*// gza' kun skar ma gang yod kyang*// sgra gcad dang ni lhan cig 'dzom// rlung ngam zhod ser shin tu rgod// zhi gza' chu skar steng na yod// drag gza' gang rung slebs ma thag /char pa 'bab par 'gyur ba yin// nus pa snga gyi 'byin tshul ni// nyi mi gnyis so slebs ma thag /lhag sangs phur gsum skar dkyil gnas// spen zla chu skar 'pho kha ru// rang rang nus pa 'byin pa yin// de kun spyi yi char rtags te// yul sde so so'i char cher che chung*// tha skar nas bzung yul de yi// ming skar yan chad gcig tu bsre// gang brtsi'i khyim 'pho'i zla skar// de nyin res gza'i grangs kyis 'phri// de la 'khor los bags lhag ma// chu skar shar na yul sde der/

khyim de'i ring la char pa che// sa skar cung 'bab rlung skur shar// rlung ldang me skar than pa che// la sogs ma nor brtsis pas rtogs/ ༈ /dge dang mi dge brtags pa'i phyir// tshangs pa'i 'khol la 'di bzhan te// dgus khrag gsum du tshar gsum bkod// brtsi bya'i skyes mi nas brtsams te// skyes pa phun tshogs zad pa dang*// so so dang ni grub bya dang*// nges sbyin byams dang pha rol byams// kun 'jug ces bya dgu po rnams// skar ma gsum gsum dbang bar byed// las dang bya ba gang sgrub kyang*// skyes pa'i skar gsum la brtsams na// bya ba thams cad bkra shis byed// phun tshogs skar gsum la brtsams na// nor rnams phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// zad pa'i skar gsum nor zad 'gyur// so so'i skar gsum don nyams shing*// gnyen bshes rnams ni 'bye bar 'gyur// grub bya'i skar gsum ci yang 'grub// nges sbyin skar gsum lus nad 'byung*// byams skar gsum la gnyen bshes byams// pha mo rol byams pa gsum po la// zhan gyis 'khur ba'i gnas thob bo// kun 'jug skar gsum kun dang mthun// skyes ming skar ma gsum po la// drag gza' bzhi yi gdong btsugs na// steng 'og gnyis kyis 'chi bar byed// g.yas g.yon sdug bsngal nor nyams 'gyur// bsod rnams gza' yis dge bar byed// 'dres mas 'a bu 'dres mar ston// rkang pa brgya pa brgyad cu gcig /gnyis ka 'thus pa'i 'khor lo ni// gyen 'phrod thig bcus bcad pa yis// phyogs rer gang brtsis gling dgu ru// grub pa'i ri'i mig brgyad chu gcig /de yi zur du dbyangs yin rnams// 'god pa'i tshul ni 'di bzhin te// rim par byang shar shar lho dang*// lho nub nub byang phyi rim bzhin// a ā i ī u ū dang*// ṛ ṛ l̥ l̥̄ e ai ste// e au aṃ aḥbacas pa dang*// phyogs su rim bzhin phyi rim la// rgyu skar 'god tshul 'di bzhin te// smin drug nas bzang shar skar bdun// shar rang de bzhin phyogs gzhan la// rang rang skar ma bdun bdun te// skar ma so sor bdag pa'i ming*// smin drug a dang i u e// snang nas bzung shar sgra bdun// shar dang de bzhin phyogs gzhan la// rang rang skar ma bdun bdun te// skar ma so sor bdag pa'i ming*// smin drug a dang i u e// snar ma o wa wi wu dang*// mgo la we wo ka ki ste// lag tu ku gha nga tsha zhes// nabs so ke ke ha hi la// gyal smad hu ho ḍi ḍu ḍe dang*// rta chen ma mi mu me ste// gre la mo ṭa ṭi ṭur brjod// dbo la ṭe ṭo pa pi dang*// me bzhir pu ṣa ṇa tha'o// nag pa se so ra ri la// sa ri ru re re ta'o// sa ga ti tu te to ste// lha mtshams na ni nu ne'o// snron la no ya yi yu dang*// snubs la yi mo bha bhi'o// chu stod bhu dha pha ḍha ste// chu smad bhe bho dza ji dang*// gro bzhin dzu dze dzo kha'o// byi bzhin khi khu khe kho dang*// mon dri ga gi gu ge'o// man gru go sa si su dang*/

khyums stod so sa da di ste// khrums smad du tha dzha nya la// nam gru de do tsa tsi zhes// tha skur tsu tso la dang*// bra nyi mi lu le lo'o// rang nari gnyis par shar phyogs// a wa ka ha ḍa dang lhor// ma ṭa pa ra ta nub phyogs// na ya bha dza byang phyogs// ga sa da rtsal rnams bkod// gsum par shar du glang dang 'khrig /karka ṭa dang lho phyog la// seng ge bu mo srang na phyogs// sdig gzhu chu srin byang bum nya// lug dang bzhi pa shar phyogs su// dga' ba lho bzang nub rgyal// byang stad dbus su rdzogs pa ste// mche ba'i gdon pa brtag pa'i phyir// skar ma dbyangs dang gsal byed sogs// so so'i thad du btab pa yi// gang gzhal thig grangs bcu drug 'debs// 'di la brten pa'i 'bras bu rnams// zhi bar brjod kyi mi lang yang*// nyer 'kho rags tsam 'di bzhin te// skyes bu'i skyes skar mchog yin te// de min ming skar 'tshom ba ste// phul ba rnams kyi dbus ma bzung*// sangs zhes bya ba'i sa bzung sogs// mdor na mig 'ig dang po'i sgra// gang yin de nyid bzung ba gnad// bod yig ca cha ja gsum so// tsa tsha dza la bsdu ba dang*// za pa zha sha 'a a la// bsdus pa brtsi bar bya ba dang*// ka ba'i yi ge bzhi so la// ka la gha nga tsha bsdu zhing*// sa la ṣa ṇa tha bsda la// da la tha dzha nya bsdu ste// bha la dha pha dha bsdu'o// de lta'i skyes ming skar ma yi// yi ger sol ba 'khyud pa bzhin// du ba gdong dang mthong pa zhes// gnod pa lnga po brtags byas te// dper smani drug rkang dang por// sdig gza' nyi ma gnas pa na// smin drug 'khyud pa yin pa ste// rags pa bra nye sol ba dang*// snra ma du ba byi bzhin gdong*// sgra gcan g.yas skor spyad pas na// gdang mjug du sol ldog sde brtsi// mthong ba'i pa yang skur nas 'dren// zhib par a yig 'khyud pa dang*// i yi yi ge du bar dran// byag gi lo yig los ba ste// nub kyi kho yig gdong tshugs so// mthong ba drag gza' g.yas phyogs dang*// zhi gza' g.yon du brtsi ba ste// nyi ma rang gnas bcu gnyis pa// yi ge ki ni mthong ba yis// de bzhin mig dmar gsum pa dang*// spen pa brgyad du 'dod pa yin// zhi gza' sgra gcan g.yon skor te// smin drug rkang dang zla ba gnas// byang phyags su yig mthong ba dang*// de bzhin lhag pa'i bdun pa dang*// phur bu drag dang sa sangs lnga*// sgra gcan dgu ru brtsi ba yin// de yang sgra gcan ma gtogs pa'i// rnams myur dal 'byung 'gros kyi// dbang 'gyis nas bshad pa ste// 'khyog po'i 'gros su spyod pa'i tshe// zhi drag g.yas g.yon go lho ldog brtsi// gnod pa sog bas 'chi ba dang*// 'khyud pas nad 'byung du ba yis// bsams pas don ni 'grub mi 'gyur// gdong tshugs 'jigs pa 'phog par 'gyur// nyi ma'i mthong pas nor rnams 'dzad// migad ra rā hu spen pa yis/

'chi 'am kha smra drag po 'byung*// phur bus gnyen rnams brlags cing 'chi// sa wa sangs kyi don mi 'grub// gza' lhag dgra 'byung zong mi lon// zlabs 'jigs pa chen po bskyed// spyi bstan de yang so sor phye// gnod pa lnga po de dag las// mig dmar rwa hu'i gdong tshugs ngan*// spen pa nus me sol ba dang*// 'khyud pa gnyis la ngan pa rabashad// nyi ma'i mthong par khyed par ngan// skyes ming skar mar drag so'i gza'// bzhi ga'i gnod sa dus gcig babs// 'chi'am na tsha drag po 'debs// gnyis kyis nor gnyen brlags par byed// gcig gis don med kha zas 'phongs// 'dres mas nor zad rims nad dang*// dgra dang rtsod pa la sogs 'byung*// bsod nams gza' yi du sol dang*// 'khyud pa lin gnod pa med// gza' rnams rang rang bdag sgar ni// smin drug mchu dang lha mtshams dang*// man dri mig dbar bdag pa la// snar ma gre snran mo gra lhag /phur bu mgo bo snrubs khrums stod// pa sangs lag dang me bzhi bre/ khrums smad smad yan pa nabs po nag// chu sman nam gru nyi ma la// rgyal dang sa ri bzhin dbyug /zla skabs pa ga gyi bzhin dang*// bri nyer rang gi bad po ste// bres b.rod la sogs las la// gnod lngī skyon med bed ba 'byin// rang rang skyes skar de la yang// gnod lnga'i nus pa sbyin mi nus// mtsha ba'i brtsi tshul smin drug la// gza' gnas g.yas pa bra nyi dang*// g.yon pal a yig glang khyim dang*// dga' bzang srang khyim ta yig dang*// sa ga mdun gyi bya sbo la// gdong tshugs zhes sug grags pa yin// skyes ming skar mar drag gza'i mche// gcig zug don nyams gnyis kyis nad// 'byung la gsum gyi 'chi ba dang*// zhi gza' gcig gnyis zas sgom med// gsum byung rims dang nor rnams nyams// bye byed 'gro 'dug byed pa'i dus// tshes khyim gsal dbyangs rnams la// drag gza'i mche dgong nges par spang*// gzhan yang gnod pa drug 'dzin brtag

/skyes ming gang yin sakayes pa de// 'di la mchi zug nad 'byung zhing*// nor zad kha smras dgra dang 'thab// g.yas skor bcus la las kyi par// mcho sogs gnod lnga'i skyon yod na// grogs rtsod bzas byas gla med sogs// bya ba'i las ni 'grub mi 'gyur// bcu drug rnam dgyis zhes bya la// mcho gzugs grogs dang gnyen bshes dang*// bza' tsho 'du 'bral yongs bar byed// bco brgyad rgya can sa ru ni// mche zug bsams pa'i las mi 'grub// nyer gsum bi na sha ga la// mche ba zug na bsod nams nyams// nyer lnga yid can mche ba'i gnod// sems la sdug bsngal chen po 'byung*// skye pa nas bgrags bcu dgu par// a nanta zhes bya ba ste// mche zug rims 'khrugs drag nad 'byung*/ khyad par skyes la las kyi pa// bi na sha gar drag po'i gza'// gsum 'dzom skyes bu 'chi bar byed// rgyal smad rgyal rigs smin drug ni// bri ze'i rigs yin nam gru ni// rje rigs me bzhid dmangs rigs yin// bod du rang rang rigs rus la// rigs kyi skar ma shes par bya// rang gnas yal gyi ming skar dang*// rang rang gdan pa'i bya bar brkos/ khang 'gram 'ding dus skar ma la// drag gza'i gnod pa lnga po dang*// mche ba'i gnod pa sa ba gcos// rigs kyi skar mar mche ba zug /rang rang gis ni nyams par bshad// yul bzung yul ni 'jig la thug /bla dpon la sogs bya ba la// dbang bskur skar mar mche ba zug /rang rigs ya ba gang yin nyams// de ltar gdong tshugs gnod pa de// zla skar shar dus su ni// bsod nams gza' yi mdu sbyor dang*// drag gza' mdung chen sbyor ba ste// mdung dang mdung chen sbyor ba la// bu tsha skyes na myur du 'chi// byes phyil zla ba gnyis nas 'gum// dgra brgal tshul ni 'pham par byed// donaganyer don ni mi 'grub pas// sems ni nyon mongs cad du gyur// de sogs mdudang dang mdung chen dag// bya ba kun la spang ba gnad// khyedapar bag ma mdun sbyar phyin// 'bras bu nges par brlags pa ste// nyi ma'i thad kas khyo 'chi zhing*// mig dmar bu med byung yang 'chi// lhag pas bzang btung med par byed// bla mas nor ni nyams pa dang*// sngon med pa'i sdug bsngal 'byung*// pa sangs khyon ni spangs nas su// bcutsan ma la sogs mgo rog byed// spen gnas thad kar smad 'tshong 'gyur// sgra gcan thad ka'i bag ma des// gnyen bshes rnams dang dbye bar 'gyur/

༈ /gzhan yang yang ṭa mi ni// nyi ma gang gnas phyogs de yi// skyes mi skur ma'i gang zag dang*// skar ma dbayangs dang gsal byed dang*/ khyim sogs tshes la 'char ba yi// nus pa nyams pa'i gnod pa ste// dpar na skar bdun gnas na// smin drug nas bzung skag bar gyi// shar skar bdun dang de phyogs kyi// gsal byed la a ka ha ṭa// gling dang 'khrigs karṭa'i khyim// dga' ba dra yi dbyangs a dang*// u li thung du o ka sha// med pa rnams ni nyams pa yis// byes 'gro ma gtogs gang yang spang*// gzhan yang nye gza' brgyan ni// glog dang shu la 'brug du mjug /rtso thog pa g.yos gtun shing zhes// nyi ma gang gnas rkang pa nas// bgrangs pa'i la gnas pa ste// smin drug rkang dang ni ma gnas// lnga pa snra ma'i dang po la/ glag gnas de bzhin brgyad pa la// shu la bcu bzhi 'grug gnas ma// bco brgyad du mjug nyi shu la// btso 'char nyer gnyis thog gnas la nyer gsum pa g.yas zhes bya gnas// nyer bzhi gtun shing gnas pa yi// de ltar gnas pa'i skar ma yi// de ltar gnas pa'i skar ma yi// skyes ming la sogs mig dge ste// glog la gzer 'thams sgyugs pa dang*// bshal ba zas zos rgyu gzer dang*// zug rngu res 'byung res mi 'byung*// rkang lag bshal 'gyur chom rkun 'byung*// mal du zhugs na lam rgol 'byung*// shu la 'chin dan skrangs 'bur 'ong*// gag lhog snying mchin gzer ba dang*// mig longs lus 'gul dkar ba dang*// don med kha mchur 'byung bar bshad// 'brug la shu 'bras g.yas lhung ba// rma dang skangs 'bur 'gyel ba dang*// g.yang du lhung ba nma ba 'on// sems nyams blo med don nyams 'byung*// du mjug kha zhas ngan pa rnyed// skyugs bshal zas mi 'ju ba dang*// lus nyams rim thebs rkang lag bshal// btson du zin dang 'byung po gnod// btso la gsus la 'khrol ba dang*// rma dang skrangs 'bur lus sems nyams// g.yul 'pham gzhan gyis mi snyen brjod// mthu 'byung po'i gnod pa 'byung*// thog la 'khol bur na zhing 'dar// drags nyams brgyal dang 'grel lhung ba// lus 'dar khol bur na ba dang*// gnam lcags babs nas 'chi ba 'ong*// sa g.yos smyo brjod bog pa 'byung*// mgo na lus 'dar sems lheb lheb// gtun shing badhabs g.yang du lhung*// mgo chag snying ga khal bur na// 'byung pos zin dang yid mi bde// yid du mi 'ong gzhan gyis smos// lu sadang sems 'gag gnas la nyams// nye ba'i gza' brgyad gnas pa de'i// skar ma de yang drag po yi// skar ma'i su bzhed pa yin// de dag rnams la gza' kun gyi// dgra grogs stobs kyi khyed par che// nyi ma'i grogs po phur bu ste// zla ba'i grogs po phur lhag gnyis// mig dmar lhag sangs gnyis kyi grogs// zla mir phur sangs spen pa lnga// gza' lhag gi ni grogs por grags// nyi zla pa sangs spen pa bzhin// phur ba grogs por shes par bya// mig lhag phur grogs por shis par bya// mig ga phur spen bzhi pa yang*// pa wa sangs kyi grogs po yin// lhag phur pa sangs gsum po ni// spen pa'i grogs su shes par bya// grogs las gzhan ni rang rang dgra// sgra gcan gza' kun rgyal po yin// de phyir 'di la dgra grogs med// srin po'i dbang phyug 'di yin pas// gza' kun gyi ni dgra yin no// gang zag skyes khyim tatkā ma'i// mthong ba'i pa ni rnam pa bdun// gsum dang bcu la rkang pa gcig

/bzhi dang brgyad la rkang pa gsum// lnga dang dgu dang dgu la rkang pa gnyis// bdun la thams cad rdzogs par mthong*// de nyid gatsho zhing rim pa ltar// bzhi brgyad lnga dgu gsum gcig sogs// rkang pa'i grangs kyi kyis shis par 'gyur// rags pa'i stobs ni 'di bzhin te// spen pa gcig la mig dmar gnyis// lhag gsum phur bzhi pa sangs lnga// zla ba drug dang nyi ma bdun// sgra gcan stobs brgyad rim pa bzhin// gong nas gong du re re 'phel// rigs kyi stobs ni 'di bzhin te// nyi mir phur bu kyes pa'i gza'// zla ba sa sangs bud med gza'// lhag spen ma nig gza' zhes grags// rigs ni nyid dmar rgyal po'i rigs// phun sangs bram ze'i rigs yin la// zla ba rje rigs lhag dmangs rigs// sgra gcan spen pa gdol ba'i rigs// yang ni nyi ma rgyal pa'i gza'// sa sangs blon po zla ba ni// btsun mo zlas sangs bud med gapha'// phur bu ban den skyes pa'i gza'// gza' lhag rgyal po'i bu yig gza'// mig mdar dmakhag dpon bdag por grags// spen pa bshan rigs bran gyi gza'// rang rangi gas dang rang rang gi// gza' yin las kun shis pa yis// 'gros bzhi stobs kyi che chung ni// lha phur gnyis po myur 'gros cho// mig dpar 'khyogs 'gros stobs che zhing*// sangs spen gnyis po dal 'gros che// gzhan yang khyim stobs che chung ni// spyir na zla sangs mo khyim stobs// gzhan rnams pho khyim stobs dang ldan// de yang nyi lug khyim dngas// zla ba glang lhag bu mo// mig dmar chu srin phur karṭa// pa sangs nya la spen srang khyim// stobs ldan de nyidar rags pa ste// zhib par so so'i khyim thog nas// nyi ma lug khyim khyim zhag bcu// zla ba glang khyim zhag gsum dang*// mig dmar chung srin zhag klu lag /lhag pa bu mo'i khyi zhag tshes// phur bu karṭa'i khyi zhag lnga// pa sangs nya khyim 'khor lo'i zhag

/spen pa srang khyimab zhag shi shur// dge zhang bkra shis stobs dang ldan// rang rang khyi nas bgrangs pa yi// bdun pa'i zhag grangs gong bzhin la// mi dge shin tu nub par bzhid// phyogs kyi stobs kyi che chung ni// nyi zla mig dmar pa wa sangs// sgra gcan spen lhag phur bu rnams// g.yas bar rim pa shar phyogs nas// dbang ldan bar du rim stobs ldan// phyogs gnyis stobs ni gang che ni// zla ba phur bu pa sangs gsum// dkar phyogs dag la stobs che zhing*// nyi spen gnyis po nag phyogs stobs// mig lhag sgra gcan gnyis ka stobs// bgrod pa dag pa stobs cha ba// nyi zla byang bgrod mig lhag phur// sangs spen sgra gcan lho bgrod che// nyin mtshan gang la stobs che ni// lhag pa nyin mtshan khyed par med// phur sangs nyi nyin mo stobs// zla mir sgra gcan spen pa bzhin// mtshan mo stobs ni che bar bzhed// las bzhi'i stobs ni gang che ni// nyi zla ba zhi ba la// lhag pa rgyas pa sangs dbang*// mig dmar dgug las phural bu skrad// spen pa sgra gcan bsad las la// stobs cher shar bar bya ba yin// rigpabayed bzhi la gang stobs tshe// gtor ma tshogs 'khor sbyin gtong sogs// mchod sbyin ni rig byed yin// rtsa rlung mang ngag sgom pa sogs nges brjod rim byed yin par brjod// byis btsa' gso dang spel ba sogs// srid srung rig byed yin par bzung*// sdeb sbyor tshigs bcad tshig rgyan sogs// /snyan ngag gi ri rin byed do// de yi rib bzhin phur bu dang*// pa sangs mig dmar lhag pa bzhid// bdag so'i gza' ru shes par bya// rang rang bdag po rang rang las// grub par 'gyur bar bshad pa yin// de nas dus sbyor phyed pa yi// lha dang gza' re 'char ba'i tshul// mi 'dra brtsi tshul gnyis yod de// nyin tshad khyim khyim gyis gos pa yi// tshar res lhag re gza' re 'char// zhi bar tatkāl dus sbyor ba// gang yin chu srang brtsi ba ste// phyed res lha dang gza' re 'char// nam langs chu srang tsam 'das brtag

/gza' ni res gza' gang yin nas// 'go bzung nyin mo drug skor dang*// mtshan mo lnga skor bya ba ste// 'bras bu brtag pa'i phyed grangs nas// gzugs phri nyi 'ayang ba dang*// mtshan mo mtsho yi bsgyur ba la// brtsi nyin ros gza' grangs kyi byin// ris phye lhag mas dus de yis// dus sbyar phyed pa'i gzang de ston// dus sbyor lha ni 'di bzhin te// lug la drag po bsod nam gnyis// glang la matsigs can brtan pa dang*// 'khrig pa yangs pa yangs byed ma// karka ṭa la 'chi ba dgra /song ge dge ba gdag pa ste// bu mo matug mo smin dug dang*// srang bcud rnyi drus mtshad pa// sdig pa drag byed bi ṭa ya// gzhu la sgra byed ghau ha ta// chu srin ma'i 'od zer chen// srog 'phrog bum par mya na dang*// 'char ma ste nya dwa ha// kun thas ma ste rim bzhin 'char// de yi 'bras bu 'di lta ste// drag pa dang ni gtsigs pa can// 'chi ba de bzhin dgra dang ni// dus mtshan rgyu ma chen po dang*// srog 'phro bum par myang ngan dang*// 'char ba ma ste ste nya dā ha// kun thas ma ste rim bzhin 'char// de yi 'bras bu 'di lta ste// drag po dang ni gtsigs pa can// 'chi ba di bzhani dgra dang ni// dus mtshan rgyu ma chen po dang*// skrag byed ma dang srog 'phrog ma// mya ngan ma dang dwa ha ma// bco po rtsab pa'i bdag mo yin// de rnams las byas 'jigs pa 'byung*// gzhan yang dus sbyor phyed pa la// kha ni gyen bltas thur bltas dang*// 'phrad bltas rnam pa gsum du yod// dpare brjod lug khyim slebs pa na// lug gi dus sbyor sngon ma 'phrod// nyi yi phyi ma gyen bltas dang*// lug gi phyi ma thur bltas zhes// de gsum gang yang spang ba de// 'phrod bltas dus sbyar phyed pa yis// dgra dang rma yongs 'khor rnams mdzad*// gyen bltas rang phyogs dgra yis 'joms// thugs bltas rang gi dmag dpung ni// pha ros dgra yis pham par byed// dgra rgol la sogs drag las la// thun mtshams rā hu zhes bya ba// nyin bzhi mtshan bzhi dag tu phye// de la res gza' nyi ma la// bzhi pa'i dubs nas chu tshod lnga// zla ba bdun dubs chu tshod bzhi// dmag dpon gnyis chu tshod drug

/lhag pa lnga thog chu tshod gsum// phur bu thun brgyad dubs nas ni// chu tshod bdun sapayod pa wa sangs// gsum gyi ma'i chu tshod bzhi// spen pa drug mtha' chu tshod gcig /so so'i thun mtshams yul de spyod// de bar dg+ra las ma gtogs pa'i// las gzhan thun mtshams der spang bya// nyi ma'i thun la dgra bo badheg /mig dmar bsad dang spen pa la// dus sbyor la sogs 'bras bu 'byin// mig dmar ra hu zhes pa ni// thun phyed bzhin du brtag pa ste// ris gza' dmag dpon thun khyed thog /phur bu bzhi pa lhags bdun// sa ngas gnyis dang spel pa lnga// zla ba rgyad dang nyi ma drug /de la bdun kyi ki kang nag /la sogs ming 'dogs ming 'dongs ba yin// de 'char dus las drag las las// bzhi ba'i las kun spang ba dang*// gzhan yang smin bdun longs spyod ces// nyi dag 'khor phyed bsres sa la// mkha' ros bsgyar la sogs su yang*// gang brtsi'i tshes grangs thub pas bsgyur// de la res gza'i grangs kyang 'byin// de dag lhag bsres mtshams kyi bsgyur// ri yi phyi ba'i lhag ma la// smin bdun longs spyod rdzogs par 'char// de lhag res gza' dang gcig na// bsreg dang dbang phyug sgrub pa dang*// bskrad pa'i las la mchog tu shis// de min zhi las 'dzem pa gnad// phan tshun bden rdzun 'gran pa la// zla ba'i snyigs ma rtsil ste// zla skar man ngag ltar 'atsal ba'am// rnam dag skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur// dbugs bcu 'byung me zlas thob pa'i/ khyim nas bgrang lugs 'di lta ste// lugs dang sra ba si sbyar nas// rim bzhin so so bzung ba ste// rags pa yin gyi zhib par na// gong gi khyi lta lhag ma yi// chu tshod la sogs gnas rnams kun// nyi mas bsgyur la 'khor los bsgril// mda' yon zla bas thob nor la// lhag ma lus na gcig byin pa// rang rang khyim gyi bdag po nas// rim par brtsis ba'i 'bras bu byin// sra ba yi yis mi shis ngan// bde legs kyis ni phun tshogs byed// 'chi bdag gis knga bdag nyid 'chi// triṣṇi zhes bya dge ba yin// skye bas nor ni thob par byed// 'bar pas dbag nyin gzhan gyis gsod// dga' bas dge ste spyod pa ngan// nges pas dgra ni 'byung bar byed// gr+yal bas bdag nyid rgyal ba ste// su pa ta yis bdag nyin 'chi// les so zhes dge ba yin// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo nas// gsungs pa'i rnam 'byor lha mo brgyad// 'char tshul rims pa 'id yin te// zla ba bcu gnyis kun gyi ni// tshes gcig dgu dang bcu drug dang*// nyer bzhi shar du tshangs ma gnas// gnyis bcu 'dun nyer lnga la// byang du drag mo sum cu gcig

/bco brgyad shar lho la// gzhon nu ma dang bzhi bcu gnyis// bcu dgu nyer bdun lho nu la/ khyab 'jug bcu gsum lnga nyi shu// nyer bagr+yad lho la phag mo gnas// drug dang bcu'i nyer gcig dang*// nyer dgu nub dbang mo ste// bdun dang nyer gnyis nya stong phyed// lnga la nubyang rtsa muṇa ḍā// brgyad dang nyer gsum nya stong gi khyed phyi byang sho dpal mo gnas// de yang losang longs phyed snga phyi// brgyad kyis phye ba'i chu tshod sogs// tshes de'i bcu drug cha ru 'gyur// rnal 'byor ma re'i thun tshad de// dang po dgu pa gnyis bcu pa// gsum dang bcu gcig bzhi bcu gnyis// lnga dang bcu gsum drug cu bzhi// bdun dang bco lnga brgyad cu drug /rang rang tshes kyi bdag po yi// thog ma nas bzung tshangs ma'i tshes// dper mtshon tshangs ma rgya mo dang*// gzhon nu ma dang khyab 'jug ma// phag mo dbang mo tsa muṇḍa// dpal mo ltar du ramim bzhin gyi// rang dang g.yas phyogs gnas pa nas// mdun dang g.yon phyogs thebs su bzhed// biṣṭi'i gnas lugs tshes bzhi dang*// bco brgyad brgyad dang nyi shu gnyis// bcu gcig nyer lnga dang*// nyer dgu rnams la rim pa ltar// shar nas shar lho lho lho nub// nub dang nub byang byang byang shar// gnas pa'i rang rang phyogs nas ni// gong bzhin brtsis pas las stobs rgyas// dbyangs 'char gzhung nas bshad pa yin// rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo ni// shar nas rim bzhin a ka tsa// ṭa ta pa ya sha rnams nas// phyog mtshams brgyad du gnas par bzhid// de la tshangs ma gzhon nu ma// dbang phyug ma dang khyab 'jug ma /phag mo dbang mo rgan ma// sgeg mo la sogs rim pa ltar// gnas ra tshes grangs gcig dgu dang*// bcu drug nyer bzhi tshangs ma'i bdag /gnyis bcu bdun nyer lnga rnams// gzhon nu ma ste gsum cu gcig /bco brgyad nyer drug dbang phyug ma// bzhi dang bcu gnyis bcu dgu dang*// nyer bdun khyab 'jug lnga bcu gsum// nyi shu nyer brgyad phag mo ste// drug dang bcu bzhi nyer gcig dang*// nyer dgu dbang mo bdun bco lnga// nyer gnyis rgan byed nya stong gi

/phyed snga rgan byed phyi ma dang*// brgyad ngad nyer gsum sgeg mo ste// rang rang gnas pa'i phyogs nas ni// thegs pa'i tshul ni spyi dang mthun/ ༈ /biṣṭi 'char tshul shar rim bzhin// phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshes dang ming*// bco brgyad bco lnga bcu gcig brgyad// bzhi dang nyer dgu nyer lnga dang*// nyer gnyis rnam la rim pa ltar// ka ra la dang 'bar ba can// dus kyi lce dang ma hā ma ri// bi ta bā la ma hā ji ka /bkra shis ma hā gho ra gnas// gzhan yang shar nas rims pa ltar// so sor thun bar brgyad phye ba las// nyer dgu ḍha dang thun po// a dang brgyad dzā thun gnyis par// ā dang nyir gnyis tstsha dang*// thun gsum li dang bco lnga ṇi// thun bzhi ī ru shes par bya// bzhi dang ghu dang thun lnga u// nyer lnga nye dang thun bdun e// bcu gcig ṭai dang thun bagr+yad ai// bco brgyad ghu dang thun drug ū// gsal byed tshes dang dbyangs thun thog /rang rang phyogs nas thebs par bzhed// dus mtshan 'khor lo nub phyogs nas// rim par g.yon bskor phyogs mtshams la// stong gi bar gyi tshes grangs bkad// rang rang tshes grangs phyogs la gnas// gzhan yang tshes grangs mtsho bsres la// klu thob lhag mas g.yon bskor nas// rim par bya'i thog la gnas// nyin mtshan tshad ni brgyad kyis bgos// res gza' nas bzung g.yon skor la// 'khor ba'i dus 'khor thun da 'char/ ༈ /dbyangs 'char thun phyed 'khor lo ni// dkar phyogs nyin mo g.yas bskor dang*// mtshan g.yon skor nag phyogs ldog /nyin mtshan tshad ni klu yis bgos// rang rang phyogs nas bskor bas shes// shar nas rim par khyi bcu gnyis// bum pa bzhi la rims pa ru// bkod pas nyi ma gang gnas pa// bum stong gnas pa'i sa phyogs yin// tshes grangs so'i aṅki dag /bkod pa'i phyogs la sde brgyad thebs/ ༈ /sgra gcan nu ralu dus rgyu gnyis// dpe'u chung ltar spang blangs bya// zhes rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las le'u thog rgyas 'bring bsdu gsum sbyor tshul dang*/

de dag la nye bar mkho ba'i dbyangs 'char rgyud nas gsungs pa'i 'khoralo rnams dang*// dus 'khor lugs kyi rnal 'byor ma bagr+yad dang biṣṭi sogs 'jug je'i rigs khol 'don gyis bkod pa'i sarga bcu pa'o/ ༈ /brgya phrag nyi ma'i dpal 'dzin zhal 'jum las// 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs kun gyi ro skong mgon// sbyin pa'i pha ros byin byed ngal gsos bus// gatshug lag bstan pa spel la bka' 'di bsrung*// phug lugs rtsis kyi gzhung bzang mtho ris chab// thugs brtson hub gyis 'thung la mi ngal bas// 'jam mgon mi rjesa'i tshul bzung dza hnus// zhag gsum gaṅga chang med spel// slar skyus zhag gsum rnam dbye dang*// rtsis 'phro spo dang zhag gsum kyis// 'khor lo phud pa'i grangs stong par// zhugs tshul rim pa phyogs gcig bshad// de yang grub mtha' tshul mthun pa'i// tshes zhag nyin zhag khyim zhag gi /rnam dbye'i go ba bskyed pa'i phyir// cung zad brjod kyasi rna ba blogs// thogs mar so so'i ngos 'dzin ni// zla ba'i 'phel grib bco lnga cha'i// cha re rdzogs tshes tshes zhag yin// ni yangs lag rigs mthong ba nas// rjes ma'i lag rigs mthong ba'i bar// nyin kyi zhag po phrugs gcig yin// nyi mas khyi gcig spyod pa'i yun// su cur phye ba khyim zhag brjod// gza' rnams rang rang so so la// lo zla zhag rnams dbye ba yod// sum brgyu drug bcu'i nyi ma yi/ khyim lo gcig gam khyim zhag gi /dkyil 'khor grangs su nges pa yin// de yi rigs 'gres gzhan kun shes// nyi ma'i khyim dkyil mkha' dus me// gnas gnyis bzhag pa'i 'og ma ni// mig bsgyur mda' ros thob pa'i nor// steng mar ldan pa zhag po yin// lhag ma mkha' mtshams bsgyar ba la// mda' ros thob pa chu tshod de// mkha' ros dus dang 'dod pa'i bar// rim bzhin bsgyur thob tshes dkyil 'grub// tshes dkyil zhag gnas thig ros 'asgyur// chu tshod bcu gcig la slar rim bzhin// mkha' ro dus dang lus med kyis// dgyir la rang rang cha bcug pa'i// tshogs de ri mkha' ri mkhar ris bsgyur la// gnas gsum bzhag pa'i 'og ma ni// thub mkha' ri bos bgos pa'i nor// bar byin chu ros thob pa yis// steng mar phri ba'i lhag ma gang*// ri mkha' ris bgos lhag lus pa// bgod byed cha yin nor 'dod pas/

khyer lhag 'dod cha rnyed pa de// dus bgos lhag dbugs thob nor la// mkha' ros bgos lhag chu srang yin// mkha' mtshams kyis thob lhag chu tshod// nor de zhag gi gnas yin la// de yis nyin zhag dkyil 'khor 'grub// dkyil 'khor so so'i zhag rnams kyi// dus kyi logs spyod 'tshol ba'i lugs// lugs 'byung lugs ldog rnam gnyis las// lugs ldogs rim min 'di lta ste// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dbugs// dus dang thig ros chu tshod du// bsgril bas nyin zhag rtag longs so// dbugs grangs de nyid ri mkha' ris// bsgyur ba gnas gsum 'og ma la// ri mkha' roi thob bar la byin// de la chu ros phye ba'i nor// steng mar phri ba'i lhag ma rnams// thub mkha' ri dang mtshams thig ros// bsgril ba'i lhag ma tshes zhag go// tshes zhag de las khyim zhag gi /rtag longs 'tshol na mkha' ro dang*// mtshams dang ri mkha' thub rim pas// bsgyur la rang rang cha kun gzhug /de nyid gnas gnyis 'og ma la// mig bsgyur dbang mtshams phye nor de// steng mar byin la ri mkha' ri// dus dang thig ros stong du bsgril// de ni khyim zhag dus longs 'dod// lugs 'byung rim pa khyim dkyis gyis// nyin dkyil la bcad lhag ma'i tshogs// mkha' ro mkha' ro dus dang ni// 'dod pa ri mkha' ri yi bar// rim par bsgyur la rang chi bcug /mkha' dus me yis bgos thob pa// ri mor cung zhig khyed mchis kyang*// nyin dkyil la bcad lhag ma'i tshogs// mkha' ro mkha' ro dus dang ni// 'dod ri mkha' ri yi bar// rim par bsgyur la rang cha bcug /mkha' du me yis bgos thob pa// ri mo cung zhig khyad mchis kyang*// don la khyed par med pa yin// de dag rim mkha' ri'i bar bshig /gnas gnyis 'og ma zung gis bsgyur// thub ros bgos nor steng phrog lhag /thub mkha' ri dang myos byed dus// mkha' ros bsgril bas tshis zhag 'char// de nyid mkha' ri'i bar gsil// gnas bzhi mas nas ri bzhid du// 'byung 'dod grag pos phye ba'i nor// rang steng la dus bug ros// bog zhing rnyed pa steng la byin// de la me res bgos pa'i nor// stong mar ldan pa ri mkha' ri// 'dod pa dus dang thig ro yis// dbyu gur bsgali ba nyin zhag tshad// gza' kun bgrod yur gyu skur gyi// 'khor lo nyid yis skar khongs rer// chu tshod thig ror bcas pa yi// stong dang drug brgya nyi shu 'byung*// de la dkyil 'khor so so yis// phyi ba'i zhag gi gang yin de'i// yul gyi rtag longs 'grub 'gyur bas/

khyim zhag dkyil 'khor mkha' dus mes// rgyu skar chu tshod la bgos dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyar thob srang*// lhag med khyim zhag yul longs 'char// tshes dkyil gnas rnams 'dod pas bsgyur// 'og nas rang rang 'khor los bsgril// zhag par rgyalab klu mtsho 'ong*// de yis rgya skar chu tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs 'dod bgyur bgos thob dbyug /yang lhag mkha' ro dus dang ni// ri ro'i bar du rim bsgyur la/ khyim zhag dkyil 'khor mkha' dus mes// rgyu skar chu tshod la bgos dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*// lhag med khyim zhag yul longs 'char// tshes dkyil gnas rnams 'dod pas bsgyur// 'og nas rang rang 'khor los bsgril// zhag par rgyal ba klu mtsho 'ong*// de yis rgyu skar chu tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs 'dod bsgyur bgos thob dbyug /yang lhag lhag mkha' ro dus dang ni// ri ro'i bar du ri ma bsgyur la// bgos byed kyis thob tshes zhag yin// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor gnas rnams kun*// mig klu me skyon gyis bsgyur te// rang rang 'khor los bsgril ba yis// yang lhag mkha' ro dus dang ni// ri ro'i bar du rim bsgyur la// bgos byed kyis thob tshes zhag yin// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor gnas rnams kun// mig klu me skyon gyis bsgyur te// rang rang 'khor los bsgril ba yis// mda' mkha' mtsho yid ri mtshams 'ong*// de yis rgyu skar chu tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs de la bgos thob dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ro dus dang ni// bug mkha' mig bug yid rnams kyis// rim gyi bsgyur la bgos thog pa// nyin zhag rtag pa'i longs spyo yin// de nas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// longs spyod bcas pa 'di lta ste// nyi ma'i tshes zla'i yul longs spyod// rjes 'brang dang bcas rgyu skar gyi// chu tshod stong du bsnan pa la// mkha' me bgos thob chu tshod yin// mkha' ro dus dang ri ro yis// rim bsgyur rang rang cha bcug pa// bgos thob zla ba'i tshes longs 'grub// tshes longs gnas kun mtsho 'dod kyis// bsgyur ba 'og nas rim pa ltar// ri ro dus dang mkha' ro bsgril// zla zung nor ri 'ong ba des// rgyu skar chu tshod mtsho 'dod kyis// shid mtshungs bsgyur te bgos thob zhag

/lhag ma mkha' ro mkha' ro dang*// dus dang bug ro klu yi bar// rim par bsgyur la bgos thob pa// de yis zla ba'i tshes dkyil 'grub// de dag nags lnga gnas gnyis su// bsdu bar 'dod na 'di bzhin te// chu tshod man chad bug ro klus// bsgyur ra rang rang 'khor los bsgril// de la mkha' ros bgos thob pa// tshes zhag dkyali'akhor gnas gnyis 'grub// zhag gnasabug ro klus bsgyur la// cha shas dang ldan gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma mig bsgyur ri ro bgos// nor gyi steng phri lhag ma rnams// bug ro klus bgos thob nor zhag /lhag ma bgod byed cha yin te// zla ba'i khyim zhag dkyil 'khor 'grub// tshes dkyil gnas gnyis bug ro klu'i// char bshig gnas gsum 'og ma de// lag bsgyur yid dang ma nus bgo// rnyed pa bar mar byin pa de// chu dus phye ba'i rnyed nor gyis// steng mar phri lhag bug ro klus// khyer lhag gnas nas gcig phab ste// chu bayur te de nas slar// gcig phab yid dang ma nu ru// gyur ba de la sngon ma yi// lhag ma gnyis sos so sor sbyangs// zla ba'i nyi zhag dkyil 'khor yin// de yi gnas bzhi gnas gnyis su// bsdu phyi bu ga dus klu yis// cha shas man chad dus mtshams ri// nor lag khyim gyis bsgyur ba la// mas nas na mu yid kyis bgos// rnyed pa ste byin chu ros bgong*// thob nor ste byin bug ro klus/ khyer ba'i lhag med rnyed pa'i tshogs// dus mtshams thub klu zung khyim 'char// 'gyur ro zla ba'i nyin dkyali 'dod// khyi zhag dkyil 'khor bug ro klur// gsil rgyu skar chu tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs byas pa la bgod pa'i// rnyed pa chu tshod lhag ma yang*// mkha' ro dus dang mda' ro yis rang rang rim bzhin bsgyur ba la// bathos thob khyim zhag yul longs yin// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor ro mtshams thub// nor mig khyim gyi cha dag tu// bshig la rgyu skar chu tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs byas sa la bgos dbyug

/lhag ma mkha' ro dus dang ni// bug mkha' mig bug yid kyi bar// so so rim par bsgyar ba dang*// bgos thob nyin zhag yul longs 'grub// de nas bsod nams ldan pa yi// dkyil 'khor drug stong dgu brgya yis// de la mkha' mes bgos thob sa// tshes zla ril po'i dkyali 'khor dang*// dkyil 'khor bco lngas bgos thob// tshes zla phyed pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// drug stong dgu brgya'i dkyil 'khor de// gnas gnyis 'og ma gr+ya mtshos bsgyur// mtsho 'dod kyis bgos rnyed pa de// steng mar phri ba'i lhag ma nas// phal chu 'dod char gyur pa// de la 'og ma'i lhag gis sbyangs// slar lhag thig ro mkha' ro dang*// dus dang ri ro'i bar dag tu// bsgyur la thog pa khyim dkyil yin// tshes dkyali gnas gnyis bkod pa la// 'og ma thub ri zla bas bsgyur*// nyi ma 'dod zlas bgos thob pas// ston nas phri ba'i lhag ma nas// gcig phab nyi ma 'dod zlar bsgyur// de la 'og ma'i lhag gis sbyangs// lhag ma klu mig klu lag gis// bsgyur pa nyi ma 'dod zlas bgos// lhag med rnyed pa mkha' ro dang*// thig mtshams dus dang ri mkha' ris// rim bsgyur klu mig klu lag gis// bgos thob nyin zhag dkyil 'khor 'grub// de nas rgyu skar chu tshod la// tshes dkyil zla rim zla phyed kyis// so sor bgos thob dbyu gu ste// lhag ma mkha' ro dus dang ni// me mig bar du rim bsgyur bar// so so'i dkyil 'kho bgos thob pa// tshes zhag tshes zla zla phyed kyi// rtag pa'i laungs rnam dag yin/ khyim dkyil gnas kun ri ro yis// bsgyur la 'khor lo zhag par bsgril// de yis rgyu skar chu tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs byas rim pa bzhin// bsgyur bgod kyim zhag rtag longs 'char// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor gnas rnams kun// klu mig klu lag gis bsgyur ba// 'khor los gur bsgril ba yis// rgyu skar chu tshod shed mtshungs par// bgos thob dbyug go gig ro dus// cha shas dbang phyosag dus mda' dang*// mig bar rim bsgyur bgos thob pa// nyin zhag rtag pa'i longs spyod yin// zla ba'i tshes zhag longs spyod la// nyi ma'i tshes zhag longs spyod byin// sbyor ba'i tshes zhag longs yin// gnas kun ri ros bsgyur ba la// 'khor los dbyug par bsgril ba yis// rgyu sku chu tshod shed mtshungs par// bgos thob zhag go lhag ma rnams// mkha' ro mkha' ro dus dang ni// dbang mkha' thig ris bsgyur pa// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor dag par 'dod// tshes zhag dus kyi longs spyod de// mig gis bgos pa'i thob nor de// byed pa'i tshes zhag longs spyod yin// de yi gnas rnams thams cad kyang*// tshams dbang mtshams dbang bsgyur byas la// mas nas ri mkha' ri la sogs// 'khor los zhag sar bsgril ba yis// rgyu skra chu tshod shed mtshungs par// rim par bgos pas byed pa yi// tshes dkyil rnams dag pa 'char// sbyor byed nyin zhag khyim zhag gi

/dkyil 'khor longs spyod sgrub tshul sogs// gzhan gyi rigs 'grel rtogs par 'gyur// de nas drang srong gza' lnga yi// dkyil 'khor longs spyod sgrub tshul rnams// drag gsum mig mdar gyi mtshon pa'i// phur spen gnyis po zhar rtogs phyir*// thog mar nyin dkyil bshad par bya// bkra shis ri klu ro dang ni// bla ma so me rgya mtsho dang*// nyi bu dus mtshams ri phyogs sogs// cha shas mig dmar 'ug mig lag /phur bu gzugs dus med dang ni// spen pa me klu me mda'o// tshes zhag longs spyod gnas drug tu// byas pa'i 'og ma gza' kun la// ri mkha' ri dang lha'i bla mar// ma nu yid byas rnam dag yin/ khyim zhag rang rang bgod byed char// gud sbas phug pa'i phyag gyun du// da lta'i bar lus re zhig bzhag /mig dmar nyin zhag dkyil 'khor de// gnas gnyis byas la 'og ma ni// me tshes lag pas bsgyar ba la bug mkha' mig bugayid kyi bgo// nor gyi steng nas bu lon phrogs// slar yang gcig phab lhag ma yis// sbyangs pas khyim zhag dkyil 'khor 'grub// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma thub ri zla bas bsgyur// 'byung 'dod rag pos bgos thob pa// stong mar ldan pa tshes dkyil yin// de nas zhag dkyil 'khor gyis// rgyu skar chu tshod bgos thob dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ro dus dang ni// bug mig lag pa'i bar dag tu// bsgyur bgod byas pa'i ri mo rnams// nyin zhag gcig gi rtag longs yin/ khyim zhag dkyil 'khor phug sogs char// gsil ba'i rgyu skar tshod kyang*// shed mtshungs bgos thob dbyu gu ste// lhag ma mkha' ro dus bsgyur bar// bgod byed kyis thob cha shas ni// bgod byed cha ru byas pa yis/ khyim zhag yul longs rnam dag yin// tshes dkyil 'byung 'dod drag char gsil// rgyu skar chu tshod shed mtshungs par// bgos thob dbyug go lhag ma rnams// mkha' ro dus dang bug mig lag// rim mkha' ri yi rim bsgyur la// bgos tshes longs rnam dag yin// de yi phur spen rigs bas 'gre// zhi gnyis brgya cha bcu cha'i khyad// gong dang dbye ba cung zad yo// zhag grangs brgyad cu rtsa bdun dang*// brgya go bdun lhag pa yin// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor yin no de'i// zhag grangs brgyas bsgyur brgya cha gzhug

/re bug ri klu 'byung ba yin// gzha grangs nyin bagr+ya nyer bzhi dang*// bcu cha bdun ni sa sangs kyi// nyin zhag dkyil 'khor yin par 'dod// zhag pa bcus bsgyur bcu cha bsres// ri rgyal mig tu gyur pa yin// cha shas ri bug ri klu dang*// bug mtsho ri ru shes par bya// ri bug ri klu gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma me tshes lag pas bsgyur// bug mkha' mig bug yid kyis bgos// nor gyi steng sbyangs lhag ma nas// gcig phab lhag mas sbyang bar bya// gnas gnyis ste ma byar yis bgos// nor steng bzhag zha lhag pa yi// tshes zhag sgrub tshul mig dmar bzhin// bgyis la steng ma brgya yis bcad// tshes zhag dkyil 'khor dag par bya// rgyu skar chu tshod brgyas bsgyur la// ri bug ri klus bgos thob dgyug /cha shas ri bug ri klu'i bar// bsgyur bgod nyin zhag rtag longs yin/ khyim zhag dkyil 'khor gnas thams cad// bug mkha' mig bug yid la sogs// brgyas bsgyur de yis spel ba la// rang rang 'khor los stong du bsgril// rgyu skar chu tshod shed mtshungs par// rim bgos khyim zhag rtag longs yin// tshes zhag dkyil 'khor gnas rnams kun// 'byung 'dod drag po brgyas bsgyur mas// spel la 'khor los dbyug par bsgril// rgyu skar chu tshod shed mtshungs par// rim par bsgyur bgod byas pa yis// tshes zhag rtag longs rnam dag 'char*// pa sangs de yis zhar byung rtogs// gzhan yang nyin tshes khyim zhag gi /dkyil 'khor rtag longs so so yi// bar khyad rtogs pas skad cig tu// gcig la gcig shes bya sla la// don bzang mkhas pa'i man ngag bzhin// rig pa'i rtsil gyis 'dir brjod bya/ khyim tshes gang yin mang ba las// nyung ba 'tshol na tshar gnyis bya// gcig gi gnas kun mig gis bsgyur// de la ri ros bgos thob pa// cig shol la ni phri bas 'char// nyung las mang ba 'tsharol bas na// tshar gnyis byas la phyogs gcig gi

/gnasakun mig bsgyur sngar bzhin bya// de la mda' ros bgos thob pa// cig shos la ni byin pas 'grub// nyin tshes cung las mang 'tshor na// tshar gnyis byas la phyogs gcig gi /gnas kun thub ri zla bas 'asgyur// 'byung 'dod drag pos bgos thob pa// cig shos la ni byis pas 'grub// mang las nyung ba 'tshol ba'i tshe// thub ri zlas bsgyur la sogs sa// sngon ma ji bzhin byas pa la// nyi ma 'dod zlas bgos thob sa// cig shes la ni phri bas 'grub/ khyim nyin mang las nyung 'tshol na// tshar gnyis byas la phyogs gcig gi /gnasakun me tshes lags pas bsgyur// bug mkha' mig bug yid kyis bgo /thob nor gcig shos 'phri bas 'grub// nyung las mang ba 'tshol 'dod na// me tshes lag pas bsgyur de la// dus mda' mkha' ri yid kyis bgo /nor de gcig shos byin pas 'grub// gzhan yang cung zad dka' ba yi/ khyim tshes gnas gnyis la sogs pa// gnas gcig mig bsgyur sngon ma ltar// steng ma rang rang bgod byed kyis// thab pa'i lhag ma 'og ma'i cha// gang yin de yis bsgyur ba la// rang gi cha bsres bgod byid kyis// bgos pa'i lhag ma bgod byed cha// yin no nador gyi 'bri sder de// sngon ma'i gzhung bzhin byas pa la// rang rang bgod byed cha gnyis ka// gang 'don cha yis bsgyur ba la// 'khor los so sor bsgril ba yis// gang 'don cha de 'khrul med 'grub// gnas drug spra dang lngar bsdu sogs// rig pas ma nor dpyad pa na// rnam dag 'grub bo zab khyad cig /yin min blo gros ldan rnams kyis// dpyad na gsal sor rtogs pa yin// de ltar zhag gsum rnam par dbye// mkhas dbang phug pa'i phyag bzhes kyi// don kun ma 'khrul gtan phab cing*// sngon ma ji bzhin bsdus min par*// ngag rgyun zab gnad kyis brgyan 'di// gnyis bsrung lag dal tshul du bris/ ༈ /de nas stong 'jug dgongs don ni// lag len dkyus su bshad pa la// de yang dkyil 'khor thob ma nas// 'byung ba med thub bug ri gzugs// dbang mtsho bug dus mtshams skar ma// 'dod ro thub pa 'khor lo klu// 'char sde gnas ni mkha' mig ste// rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang tshan las// sna tshogs phan gyi stong chen gyi// 'das pa'i lo tshogs rnam dag ste// gang spyo'i bar gyi 'das lo bsres// nyi mas bsgyur la gnas gnyis bzhag 'og ma 'khrig bsgyur dbang mtshams bgo

/nor de gong ldan spo bya'i yul// bla ba rnams par dag par bzhed// dbang mtshams ldag de gang spo'i lo'i// zla dag bsgrub pa'i rtsis 'phro yin// lnga bsdus med du gza' rgyu la// zla ba dag pa gnas lnga bzhag /bse ru zla yon thig dbang dang*// nam mkha' thig nor mtsho yis bsgyur// ri mkha' ri dang dus mkha' ro// mkha' ro thub pas dor ba'i lhag /gza' rgyu'i rtsis 'phro rnam par dag /gnas gnyis steng mig 'og ma gzugs// bgayur ba mtshams khyim nor mig gis// rim bsgril ril cha'i rtsis 'phro 'char// nyi rgyu'i ched du zla dag de// gnas lnga 'khrig phyogs nor 'ayang dang*// bse ru thub gzugs bsgyur ba la// thub ro dus dang mkha' ro gnyis// 'khar los dor ba'i nyi rgyu yi// rtsis 'phro rnam par dag pa 'char// de ni dkyus kyis bsgrub pa'i tshul// yin gyi sngon med legs bshad kyi// bsgrub lugs rang blos btsal ba ltar// 'dod gong gi gang spe'i lo'i// zla dag mig bugamada' rtse mes// dor ba'i lhag ma rtsis spo'i lo'i// gza' rgyu'i rtsis 'phro rnam par dag// zla dag klu lag 'byung med dor// ril cha'i rtsis 'phro dag par 'gyur// nyi rgyu rgya mtsho mkha' klu dor// lhag de nyid rgyu'i rtsi 'phro de// rim bzhin bsgyur bgod la sogs pa// de lta ji bzhin byas pas rnam par dag// bsdus rgyu byed pa'i rtsis 'phro la// rigs brtags stong 'jug btsal ba dang*// byed grub lhad 'don la sogs pa// sgrub tshul nges 'ga' mchis kyang*// rim bzhin lhad du 'gyur ba'i phyir// sna tshogs nas bzung gang spo yi// nag zla'i zla dag mda' ro'i lhag /gar pa'i zla dag rtsis 'phro dang*// nag zla'i gza' nyi cha ril gyi// rgyu ba kaḥde gsar spo ba'i// rtsis 'phro'i nges par bzung bar bya// de la byed pa'i skyon 'don na// byed grub rnam par 'byed pa dang*// sna tshogs gsar spos rtses 'phror gsal// sgra gcan ched du zla dag de// mkha' dus chus dang mkha' me lag

/gang rung bgos pa'i lhag ma de// zla ril zla phyed so so yi// rtsis 'phro'i nges pa 'phyugs med yin// de yang gnas bsgrigs bsgrub 'don na// rtsis 'phro de yang gang spo yi// nag pa'i bul ba de ga yin// byed pa yo bdag spo ba na// gang spo'i lo yi byed lo de// spo ba'i rtsis 'phro rnam dag yin// rgyal blon spo yang de dang 'dra// kar myang rtsis la rigs byed chu// ri gzugs lo la rab yid kyis// nang tshan sna tshogs chu rta nas// gang brtsi yan gyi lo tshags de// sha ka'i lo ru grags pa yin// legs ldan gza' lnga nyin zhag ma// spyi mthun spo na stong 'jug gi /gong bshad zla dag mkha' mes bsgyur// gnas gsum bzhag la mas rim bzhin// ri mkha' ri dang chu ros bsgril// so so'i lhag de so so'i 'phro// rnyed pas steng sbyangs spyi zhag der// rang rang dkyil 'khor dor ba'i lhag /so so'i sgos zhag rtsis 'phro yin// spyi zhag mig klu me skyon bsgyur// mda' mkha' mtsho yid ri mtshams dor// lhag de nyin zhag rgyu ba'i 'phro// sngon med sgrub tshul khyed 'phags pa'i// rtsis 'phro rang rang dal bar te// de yang stong 'jug spyi zhag la// rtag longs skyis bsgyur rang rang gi// 'khor los phud pa'i lhag de yin// de nas sngon chad mkhas kun gyis// ma rig tshes spyod rnam dag gi// rtsis gzhi spo bar bzhed pa na/ gong gi stong chen zla dag de// lnga bsdus rgyu ba ji bzhin par// rang rang tshes zhag sum cu yi// rtag pa'i langs spyod kyis bsgyur mar// so so'i 'khor lo phud pa de// spo ba'i lo yi rtsi 'phro yin// de yang mi 'drar sgrub 'dod na// tshes zhag rtag pa'i longs spyod dang*// rtsis 'phro rims bzhan bsres pa yis// cho ga rtsa sgrub bzhin byas pas// ya mtshan sgrub lugs gong bzhin 'char// kun gyi rtsis 'phro ster byed kyis// rang rang 'khor los sbyangs pa'i lhag

/dbri bas rtsis 'phro 'phyugs med 'char// gzhan yang ston lo tshogs la// gza' nyi cha ril lnga sgra bcas// lo mtshams drug cu skor la sogs// rang rang dag pa'i la tshogs kyis// bgos lhag lo la gong ji bzhin// dgos kyang don la khyed me par// bya slo'i ri ro 'char bar bzhed// gzhan yang zhag khyed la sogs par// nyin tshes 'khor los 'khor ba'i grangs// shin tu gces phyir bar yid kyi// nang 'char phur bur dbang phyug dang*// dbang chu ri thub drang srong ste// sa sangs dbang mtshams bro dus me// mtshams phyogs nyi byed mtsho// nor rtsa mig ri klu lag 'char// de yi rgyu mtshan nyin zhag las// tshes zhag sgrub lugs 'di bzhin te// gang stong chen lo tshogs la// lo mtshams dag pas bgos pa'i lhag /de la zla dag spyi zhag dang*// sgos zhag sgrub nor 'khor lo'i grangs// rab yid mtshon na gong bzhi 'char// de la tshes zhag bsgrub pa'i phyir// de nyid rang rang kyi 'khor bsgyur// de la sgos zhag byin pa'i yi// glu ba rnam par dag pa 'char// de las myur bar bsgrub pa'i lugs// yul dus ri mo'i rigs yis// man ngag 'ga' zhig logs su bstan// de yis nyi zla sgra gcan sogs// rim gyis rtogs par 'gyur ba yin// rab byung ma nu'i chu rta nas// brtsis pa'i ma 'ogs lo tshogs mda'// dus klu mkha' gzugs rtsa dus dbang*// tshes dang nor lag mig klu bug /gdengs dbang chu 'dod 'khor lo'i grangs// rdzogs te kun kyang ston par 'jug /gzhan yang nges par slog tshul// gang slog lon nas brtsi byi yi// bar gyi 'das pa'i lo gang yod/ khyim gyis bsgyur la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma mig bsgyur dbang ros bgo /lhag mas slog lo'i dbang ro lhag /sbyangs shing ma ldangs dbang ro bsnan// bsnan tshe ro du gzugs bsre zhing*// stong mar lhag pa bzla ba dag /lhag des brtsis bya'i lo de yis// dbang ro'i lhag ma g.yas bar 'gyur// de nas lnga bsdus rgyu ba ni// sngon med gsar 'atsal slog pa'i tshul// gang slog la nas brtsi bya'i lor// zla dag sngar bzhin bsgrab de yis// slog lo'i gza' nyi ril che yi// so so zla mtshams 'khor 'phros la// phri lhag brtsi lo'i rtsis 'phro 'grub// de nas gzhung bzhin bsgrubs pa yis// rgyu ba rnam par dag pa'o// dkyus bzhan bya ba'i rim pa la// zla dag gnas lnga gnas gnyis dang*// nyi mar gnas lnga bcas pa bkod

/rang rang bsgyur byed so sos bsgyur// rtsis phro bral ba'i rgyu ba 'grub// de yis slog lo'i rgyu bar sbyangs// gang brtsi'i lo yi rgyu ba ston/ de bzhin byed pa'i rgyu bar yang*/ rtsis 'go zug pa tshun la mtshungs/ de phan tshul bzhin mi rtog pa/ byed grub rnam par 'byed pa yi/ dgongs don logs kyi yi ger gsal/ de nas dpal ldan sgra gcan yang*/ zla dag mkha' mes bsgyur ba nyid/ gnas lngar bzhag rang nyid kyi/ sgyur byed rnams kyis rim par bsgyur/ 'khor los so sor steng du bsgril/ de yi slog lo'i sgra gcan sbyangs/ brtsi lo'i rtsa ba gsal bar 'gyur/ gdong 'jug rim gyis spyi ltar bsgrubs/ yang na zla dag mig gis bsgyur/ mkha' dus chu bos thob pa dor/ lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba sogs// rtsa sgrub ji bzhin byas pa la// slog lo'i byed pa lo 'khor sbyangs// gong bzhin brtsi lo'i rtsa ba 'char// byed pa lo dbag blon pon ni// gang brtsi'i bar gyi lo grangs de// rang gi sgyur byed kyis bsgyur la// 'khor los so sor bsgril ba yi// slog lo'i byed pa lo 'phor sbyangs// brtsi lo gsar bar ston pa yin// rgyal byon la yang slog lo nas// gang brtsi'i lo grangs me yis bsgyur// ris bgos lhag ma gnas gnyis bzhag /de yis slog lo'i rgyal blon sbyangs/ brtsi bya'i lo de 'khrul med 'byung*// gang brtsi bar gyi 'das pa'i lo// slog lo'i sha ka'i lo la sbyangs// sbyang bar la ldang gyur pa na// kar myang stong 'jug lta'i// la grangs gzugs thig kyu mtsho dus// ri dbang bsnan sbyangs lhag ma la// dkyus ltar bsgrubs pas kar myang 'grub// de nas nyin zhag gza' lnga ni// zla dag mkha' mes bsgyur ba la// gnas gsum 'og ma rig mkha' ri// thob nor dang bar chu ros// thob pa do'i nor de yis// ster mar sbyangs pas spyi zhag 'grub// de yang chu ro ri mkha' ri'i// ji srid bar du rig pa yis// slog pas 'grub ba shes ldan dag

/sbyed par rtogs po rtsis 'go zug /chun las rtogs min gong dang mtshungs// nag rtsis skor 'go pa bdag rgyu// spar la sogs dhol btang dang*/ khyad med rtogs tshul lugs mang ba// sgra gcan thebs dang kun dga' dang*// dus dbyigs rten 'brel dbyangs gsal sogs// sa ris ri mos rtogs pa dang*// lkog gyur grangs kyi don rtogs pa// diṇḍi logs kyis dpangs tshad kyang*// grib mar brten nas shes pa dang*// rkyang pa'i grangs nas bsnan bsub pa// ma mthong rang gi mtha' tshun dang*// gzhan ma ri mo'i rig pa yis// 'khor 'das phran tshegs rtogs pa sogs// blun rmongs byis blo 'dzin pa rnams// ya mtshan dag tu mthong ba 'ga'// mchis kyang dpyod ldan tshogs rnams kyis/ dpyad tshes bzhad gad khrol ba'i rgyur// 'dug phyir bgod pa'i spob pa zhan// ces rtsis kyi bstan bcos nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor blo gsar kun dana'i 'dod 'jo las zhag gsum rnam par dpye ba dang rtsis 'phro spo ba zhag gsum gyi 'khor lo bud pa'i grangs stong par zhugs nas 'das ma logs lo ji tsam 'jug bcas bai dkar khol 'don gong 'og bsgril nas bkod pa'i parga bcu gcig pa'o/ dpal ldan dge tshogs du mas legs bskrun mtshan dpe'i bkod pa mi mthun med pa'i sku/ snyan 'jebs yan lag drug cu'i rang rang skad dang dbang*/ por 'jug pa tshangs pa'i gsung*/ rmad byung yon tan du ma'i gter gyur shes bya ji snyed mkhayen pa'i thugs/ srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan rje batshun zla ma mchog de sgo gsum gus pas slar yang 'dud// mkhyen rab phul byung legs byas phyung sngon skyes kyis nyer drangs pa'i/ mkha' la rabs 'phags mtha' klus shes phyi dkyil 'khor 'od stong can/ mi shes mun pa drung phyungs blo ldan pad tshal rgyas mdzad pa// 'jam mgon pā ra'i mtshan de bsam bzhin lag pad snying gar 'dzum/ gang de'i shes rab kha ba'i rul brtsegs las 'ongs shing*// gtsug lag 'jug sgor gting mtha' mi mngon zad mi shes// dpyod ldan klu dbang kun bsden gzhir gyur skar nag rtsis// bam dūr dkar po rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas gcig su/

lha sras mu ne'i ye shes sgyur 'phrul 'ongs shing*/ thugs kyi kumbha las 'thon bcos mchog /grwa phug lugs srol bdud rtsi'i rgyun bzang po// sngon med logs bshad mkha' pa'i gtsug tu sbrengs// 'di ni tshul bzhin sbyangs na smros ci 'tshal// yud tsam klags kyang rig lam shes bya'i gnas// rtogs shing gshad tshang mthong byed tsha zer gyis// mkha' pa'i grags thob yutpal 'dab brgya 'dzum// 'on kyang skar rtsis kun gsal ldo ba ru// 'dor byed chu 'dzin grangs kyi rab brtsegs pas// lag len rnams bkra rgyu skar rang 'od tshogs// 'grib 'di ma bzod lhag bsam dri bzhon gyis/ rtsis kyi bstan bcos shar ri'i phrag gong nas// nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di shar bas/ dpyod ldan zlo gsar yid kyis kunda'i 'tshal// 'dod pa 'jo byed tshul 'di de ring sbyin/ gang 'dir mos ldan ldan pa'i nyin byed dbang*// dbang po sgra 'dzin 'dzin pa'i 'dab brgya byed/ phyi ba'i legs bshad bshad sa sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ bcud ldan rkang drug ldan blo gsar dpal// legs byas dpyid kyi rgyal mo dar drag las// 'thon pa'i bsod nams dbyar skyes gzhon nu'i mgron/ mthu ldan sa brtol ljon shing ldem pa'i rtser// me tog 'bras bzang dpag med bar tu bkra// rgyal bstan rin chen chu gter cher 'phel bas// dar rgyal rlabs phreng srid rtser 'phyur ba dang*// de 'dzin skyes chen zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar// dam bca' bzhi ldan ngo bor rtag brtan gsol// 'jig rten bde ba'i chu khur dkar po las// smon tshig rlung bzhon dal bus bskyod pa'i tshe// bde skyi rdzogs ldan gru char rtag 'babs pas// 'gro kun gtsug phud dga' ba'i zlos gar bsgyur// lhag bsam sgrib braral rtsis gzhung a darasha// lag len bde ba'i gzugs brnyen 'char blo yang*// ma rtog log bshad g.ya' yis sbags srid na// mkha' pa'i spyan sngar bshags so byi dor 'tshal// bdag dang mar gyur 'gro ba mtha' dag kun// dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob pa dang*// rtsis gzhung nya rgyas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor 'di// nam yang nub med 'gro phan 'char bar shog

/rtsis phug lugs rtsis kyi legs bshad mkha' pa'i mgul rgyan baiḍūr dkar po'i dond shal dpyod ldan snying nor zhes bya ba mkhas pa rnams la yid bzhin gyi nor bu las kyang ches 'phags pa 'di nyid deng skabs 'das lo yang 'byung me zla ba'i grangs su son par kun gyi lo tshogs kyis ngal bar 'dzem pa'i lag len byed mi dkon pa dang*/ rang nyid sngar rang lo bcu bdun pa'i steng slob dpon mkhas pa'i dbang po nyin rdzong blo ma dkon mchog don 'grub chos dbang gi drung nas skar rtsis skor las lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga// rtsis phran sogs dang*/ sgra snyan bcas rigs gnas phran tshegs slob khul byas kyang sbyangs stobs gzhan pas ha cang go don lon pa zhing ma byung ba dang*/ gshis nang don bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi skabs su babs pa las tha snyad rig pa don mi che yang*/ deng skabs phyogs 'dir phyi nag rig gnas kyi rgyun phal cher nyams par brten/ slob 'bangs rjes 'jug rnams kyi mig ltos dang lag len sogs la phan par srid snyam/ rang lo sum cu par slob dpon de nyid kyi gdan tshab mdo sngags rigs lab rgya mtsho'i bdag nyid nyin rdzong khri pa karma chos dbyings lhun grubam dkon mchon chos dbang blo gros la snyan ngag le'u gsum ga'i dogs gcon dang sgra rtsis sdeb sbyor sogs gzhi blor sogs gzhi slob bgyis shing*// lhag tu 'das lo spo tshul sogs zhib tu mnos pa'i rang lugs rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhan pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba rje chos kyi grags pa'i dngos slob paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa de nyid rab byung bcu bzhi'i sna tshogs chu rtar 'das lo spos pa'i tshe/ slob dpon dam pa nyin nas bai dkar skar rtsis skor rnams kyang sna tshogs lor 'das lo spos pa'i lag len nyer mkhor rnams zur 'don zhig byung na legs tshul gsung ba ma zad/ rje bla ma mchog gi sku'i rigs su son pa gzigs mchod tan 'byung gnas kyis kyang nan tur chen pos bskul ma dang ri mo'i grogs bgyis par// bai dkor gzhung gi skar ri mo'i lag men mkho che skor khol phyung gi rtsis 'phro ma gtog gtogs tshig don por gzhag dang*/

sngon 'gro skor cur zad bsdus shing*// gza' lnga khyimpazhag ma*/ dbugs skang khyim 'pho ldog gnyis ri phag dang snyig dus kyi ma hā paṇḍi ta mtshur phu rgyal tshob chos dpal bzang pos rgya rtsisagasar 'gyur mdzad pa'i dugs sgang mo rnams gsar dus bcug ste bar yid chu rtar 'das lo spos pa'i rtsis dkyi bstan bcos nya rgyas bla dkyil 'khor blo gsar kunda'i 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di yangaca dpal o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa nyin dha na ko sha'i mtsho glong du rab byung padma'i sbub las sku bltams pa'i tsha ston gyi lo/ 'phags pa'i yul du bhā nu hā ra/ mahā tsi napa'i rgyal khab chen por gya shin/ ston 'grel ba'i nyi byed ste shing pho yal ga'i ri dwags kyi lo/ 'byung ba lta la dbang pa'i kha ral/ bkra shis klung*/ pho brang gling dgur dgra lha'i me long gnas lo 'bras ldan gyi dus/ khrums kyis nya ba'i zla ba nyin mor spyod pa rags pa bu mo'i khyim dus spyod cing rgya rtsis dgun ra shing phag zla ba'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa dang po ste/ dus 'khor ba'i dbyangs lam/ gsal byed nam la/ 'byang ba sa/ 'dod yon dri /dbyangs 'char ba'i lugs kyi dbyangs o/ gsal byed ba 'byang ba nam mkha'/ 'dod yon sgra/ gnyis ka'i dar gud smin pa/ res gza' chu shes dbang po/ skar ma mdza' bo'i lha dang dga' mgur spyod pa'i 'phrod lang tshe sbyor ba/ 'phrod chen yid/ sbyor ba mdza' bo bstan chos rgyal mtshan 'jigs med 'phrin las phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sne 'am badha' spod sogs la sogs thos pa cung zad byas pa kun bshad kyi ming tshangs sras dgyis pa'i 'dzum mdangs rab 'byams shes bya'i dkyil 'khor blo ldan snang ba gsal byed rig pa'i dpa' bo zhes 'bod pas dpal 'bri gung gi phrong mi 'gyur rdo rje'i spo'i bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims phun tshogs 'khyil par gzhung ka tas 'gro ba rnams ma gtogs sug bris bgyis pa'i thog ma'ie glegs bam dus sor mo'i 'dus byed bsgyur ba po mang yul sgang sngon gyi chos mdzad no no dkon mchog bstan pa sde 'di bgyi dge ba'i mthu la brten nas nam mkha'i khams dang mnyam pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang dam pa thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig
/sarba maṅgal lam/ zhu dag par yod/

(pha) ༄༅// rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru kā ma de wa maṇḍa lā ya/ rnam pa kun ldan sna tshogs yum gyi mtshams spyin gsar par mgrin 'khyud pa'i/ mi 'gyur mchag gica bde pa'i ros gang ind+ra nī la'i sa 'dzin gang*/ lha sngags ye shes dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag gcig pur yongs grub pa/ dpal ldan bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo rgyud mdzad de la 'dud/ rnam dag chos dbyings mkha' la rtag gzims kyang*/ ma lus 'gro la brtse ba'i gom stabs kyis/ rab 'byams zhing kun ye shes sku gcig gis/ cig car rol mdzad 'dzam mkhon dpa' bos skyongs/ mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba'i ro/ skal bzang dka' ba'i dga' ston du/ rtsol bshad yongs 'du'i dbang po mchog /chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams la 'dud/ gsung rab nags lung sdug por rgyu/ legs bshad kundha'i rgyun bzang sbyeng*/ tshangs spyod e n+ya'i bla gos can/ bshes gnyin drong tshogs rnams rgyal/ rnam dag rgyud sde'i mtsho las 'ongs/ rnam 'gyur legs bshad 'od brgyas mdzes/ rnam dpyod rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i/ rnam mang rtsis kyi nyin byed spro/ sngon 'gro bya ba'i rim pa n-i/ bri bgrang snon pa g.yas nas bya/ bgod bsgyur 'brid pa g.yon nas bya/ bsgyur byed thig le gral la 'grod/ bgod byed thig les mas mtha' dgag sgyur byed stongs na bsgyur bya dbye/ 'di ni grogs med dang lag mig 'khrigs bgrod phyogs/ sbyor ba mtshe ma gnyis yin no/ 'jig rten dus dang yon tan dang*/ me dang rtse mo can ni gsum /chu gter rgya mtsho chu bo dus/ sde pa rig byed zung ldan bzhi/ 'dod ldan 'byung ba mda' dbang po/ phung po rnams ni lnga la 'jug /mtshams dang ro dus bro ba drug /ri gling gza' thub drang srong bdun/ klu sbrul nor lha nor dbyig brgyad/ bug gter rtsa gza' srin po dgu /phyogs dang yul pa sgra sgrog bcu/

dbang phyug drag po bde byed dang*/ bde 'byung 'phrog byed bcu gcig go /nyi ma nyin byed khyim bcu gnyis/ lus med myos byed 'dod bcu gsum/ shed bu srid pa yid ma nu/ bcu bzhi'o tshes ni bco lnga nyid/ rgyal po mi bdag bcu drug go /skyon nyes bco brgyad rgyal nyer bzhi/ de nyid nyer lnga 'khor lo dang*/ skar ma rgyu skar nyer bdun yin/ so dang gnyis skyes sum cu gnyis/ chu tshod dbyug gu drug cur brjod/ lo yi tha snyad brjod ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i stod 'grel las// rab byung rnam byung dkar po dang*/ rab myos skyes bdag aṅgi ra/ dpal gdong dngos po na tshod ldan/ 'dzin byed dbang phyug 'bru mang po/ myos dpa' bo khyu mchog dang*/ sna tshogs nyi ma sgrol byed/ sa skyong mi bzad thams cad 'dul/ kun 'dzin ga'al ba rnam 'gyur dang*/ bong bu dga' ba rnam rgyal nyid/ rgyal ba myos byed gdong ngan dang*/ gser 'phyang rnam 'phyung sgyur phyed dang*/ kun ldan 'phang ba dge byed dang*/ mdzes byed khro bo sna tshogs dbyig /zil gnon spre'u phur bu dang*/ zhi mthun mong 'gal byed dang*/ yongs 'dzin bag yod kun dga' dang*/ srin po me dang dmar ser can/ dus kyi pho nya don grub drag /blo ngan rnga chen khrag skyug pa/ mig dmar phro mo zad phyed do/ byi ba la sogs bcu gsum lo/ shin me sa lcags chu lnga po/ phe maur phyi ste sbyar ba las/ drug cu tham pa 'byung ba yin/ khyim dang la ba'i tha snyad ni/ dpyid 'bring nag pa lug gi khyim/ dpyid tha pa ga glang zhes bya*/ dbyar ra snon zla 'khrigs pa ste/ dbyar 'bring chu stod karka ṭa/ dbyar tha gro bzhin seng ge zhes/ ston ra khrums stod bu mo'i khyim/ ston 'bring tha skar srang zhes brjod/ ston tha smin drug sdig pa ste/ dgun ra mgo yi nya ba gzhu/ dgun 'bring rgya zla chu srin no/ dgun tha ma chu ni bum pa ste pa nga dpyid rang dbo zhes nyi khyim mo/

dus kyi 'khor lo'i lugs la ni/ dpyid zla 'bring po lo mgo yin/ tshes kyi rnam gzhag 'di lta ste/gcig nas bzung ste gnam gang bar/ dga' bzang po rgyal ba dang*/ stong pa rdzogs pa lan drug 'khor/ nyi zla dmar lhag phur sangs spen/ res gza' bdun yin dgre gcan dang*/ dus ke tu gsum bsnan pas/ gza' bcu yin no de dag gi /mig gi rnam grangs bshad pa ni/ me sbyin skyes dang tshe zer can/ padma'i gnyen dang ku mud dgra/ rta bdun rgyal po 'od stong can/ nam mkha'i nor bu rta ljang can/ nyin byed nyin mo'i dbang phyug rnams/ nyi ma'i mig gi rnam grangs so/ mtshan mo'i mgon po rgyu skar bdag bsil zer can dang kun mud gnyen/ rgya mtsho skyes dang 'od dkar can/padma'i dgra dang ri bong 'dzin/ zla ba'i ming gi rnam rnam grangs so/ bkra shis sa skyes dmar po 'khyig /gzhon nu lus dpar pa lha'i bu/ yan lag dpar dang dmag dpon rnams/ mig dmar ming gi rnam grangs so/ zla skyes zla sras zla ba'i bu/ lha mtshams skyes sogs lhag pa'i ming*/ phur bu zla ma lha'i bla ma/ blo ldan sgra mkhan blon po'i/ pa sangs khu ba nab so skyes/ sbyin skyes dkar po lha min blon/ spen pa gnyis skyes nyi ma'i bu/ zhi 'gro dal bar 'gro zhes zer/ dgra gcan skabs gsam 'jigs byed dang*/ srid gsum rnam rgyal nyi zla za/ drag po'i gzugs can mig sman mdog mjug mar me dang dus me zer/ mjug ring du ba ke tu dbal/ gza' rnam 'dren pa zhes brjod do/ de nas skar ma'i tha snyad ni/ tha skar bra nye smin drug dang*/ snar ma mgo lag nabs so rgyal/ skag chu gre dbo me bzhi dang*/ nag pa sa ri sa ga dang*/ lha mtshams snrubs chu stod dang*/ chu smad gro bzhin mon dre dang*/ mon gru khrums stod khrums smad dang*/ nam grub rgyu skar nyer bdun te/ gro bzhin dang ni byi bzhin zhes/ bgrangs na nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'byung*/ 'jig ten grags pa'i tha snyad la/

tha skar la ni dbyug pa dang*/ snar ma la ni bi rdzi zer*/ nab so rgyal la rgyal stod smad/ skag la kha dang mchu gre la/ rte chu zhes su 'bod/ dbo la khri dang me bzhi la/ bya ma nag par bya'i zer/ sa gnyis gnam mthong gong 'og lo/ lha mtshams lag sos snron gdu bu/ snrubs la sogs par chu gnyis la/ bre dang phul du 'dogs pa yod/ gro bzhin dang bye bzhin la/ bya pho bya gzhug zer ba'ang snang*/ mon gnyis la ni sgrog stod smad/ khrums gnyis se stod po smad dang*/ nam gru la ni shes sa zer/ de nas sbyor ba rnam sel dang*/ mja' ba tshes ldan skal bzang dang*/ bzang po shin skrangs las bzang dang*/ 'dzin pa pa zug rngu skrangs pa dang*/ 'phel ba nges pa kun 'jogs dang*/ dga' ba rdo rje grub pa dang*/ shin tu tung dang mchog can dang*/ yongs 'jogs zhi ba grub pa dang*/ bsgrub bya dge ba dkar po dang*/ pa dbang po khon 'dzin te/ sbyor ba nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ ba ba ba la ba kolba/ tai ti la dang gardzadza dang*/ ba ni dza dang baṣṭi ste/ 'pho ba'i byed pa bdun yin te/ bod skad gdab pa byis pa dang*/ rigs can til rung khyim skyes dang*/ tsheng pa 'jug phod can bya'o/ tshes gcig phyi cha nas bzung ste/ nyi shu dgu yi snga cha'i bar/ tshes zhag re la byed pa gnyis/ 'char bar 'gyur bar shes par bya/ shuṅku ni dang rkang bzhi klu/ ki stu gha na zhes bya ba/ nyer dgu'i phyi cha na bzung ste/ tshes gcig snga cha'i bar dag la/ 'char ba rtag byed bzhi zhes grags/ sngon 'gro bya ba'i rim pa dang tha snyad dang rnam grangs bstan pa'i skabs te lo'u dang po'o/ mkhyin pa'i gting mtha' mi mngon zhing*/ brtse ba'i rlabs 'phreng srid rtser 'phyo/ 'phrin las phyogs kyi mthar 'gro ba/ 'jam mgon chu gter dbang pos skyongs// dpal ldan rgyud kyi skyes mos tshal// dri med ma la ya can gyi/ dngos bstan yan lag lnga yi rtsis// legs bshad dri gzhon gsar pa spro// me mkha'i ragaya mtsho 'das lo ni// dag par bsgrub pa'i zhar byung du// ston pa'i 'khrungs lo la sogs dang*/

bstan pa'i gnas tshad shes 'don na// me mtsho dus mig lo tshogs la// rab byung ma nu'i nang tshan gyi// sna tshogs chu rta yan chad la// ro dang srid pa zla ba bsres// nyin stong bdun brgya don dgu yod// slar yang ji tsam 'das pa bsnan// mig dmar shing pho byi ba la// ston pa lhums su zhagus pa nas// da lta'i chu rta yan gyi lo// de la ri bong can gyis sbyangs// khro mo zhes bya glang la// 'gro ba'i nyi bltams pa'i lo// de la bu ga mig gis sbyangs// rnam rgyal zhes bya chu sbrul la// khab nas mngon par byung ba'i lo// de la ro yis sbyangs pa ni// sgyur byed pa mo phag lo la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brnyes pa'i lo// de las mda' dang rig byed 'phro// nyi sgrol byed pa shing spre la// dus kyi 'khor lo gsungs pa dang*/ ston pa mya ngan 'das pa'i lo// de la mkha' mkha' ro yis sbyangs// slar yang nyi sgrol shing spre la// 'jam mgon grags pa byon pa'i lo// de la mkha' mkha' zla bas sbyangs/ khrag skyug ces sa chu phag la// bsdus rgyud bsdus shing rigs ldan gyur// de la klu yi lo brgya sbyangs// nyi sgrol byed pa shing spro la// rgya mtsho rnam rgyal byin pa dang*// kla klo'i lor ni rab tu grub// de la mkha' mkha' zla bas sbyangs// rgya mtsho rnam rgya nyid kyi dus// de la mig dang klu yis sbyangs// mi bzad ches bya mi khyi la// rgyud kyi dngos bstan ji bzhin du// rgyal kas rtsis gzhi mdzad pa'i lo// de la zla ba mig lag sbyangs// rang byung zhes bya me yos la// dus 'khor 'phags yul dar ba'i lo// de la dus gzugs zla bas sbyangs// rang byung gnyis pa'i chu khag lor// klu sgrub slar yang gangs ljongs 'dir// mi yi srid bzung 'bri gung pa// 'jig rten gsum kyi mgon po 'khrungs// de la mig rtse yon tan 'phri// rab byung brgyad pa'i shing lug lor// rgyal dbang skyob pa gnyis pa che// kun dga' rin chen dpal bzang bltams// de la chu mes dman pa yis// rab byung dgra pa'i sa sbrul lor// zab gter sgo 'byed bka' rnying bltan// zung 'jug srol btod ratna 'khrungs// de la dus klus phrog pa na// rab bcu'i shing khams lug gi lor/

khyab bdag dharma kīrti bltams// de la zla bzang zhus pa yis// rab byung drag po'i me sprol lor// phyag na padmo'i sgyu 'phrul gar// dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po 'khrugs/ de la yid gzugs dor ba na/ rab byung myos byed lcags stag la// gru 'dzin dgyes dngos rigs kyi bdag /rje bcun padma'i rgyal mtshan bltams// de la me mig gis phral bas// bang med zhes pa chu glung lor/ kho bo dharma'i ming can btsal// de la bug zung 'brid pa na// rab yid sna tshadzogs chu rta'i lor// rtsis kyi bltan bcos 'di nyid kyi// rtsis mgo 'dzin pa'i lo grangs yin// bstan pa ji tsam gnas pa'i tshad// mi mthun rnam grangs mang na yang*// mdo lugs 'bul gyiṭīkka ru// lnga stong gnas par gsungs pa ni// don la gnas zhes mkhas rnam mthun// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo las// seng ge'i gdan can sum cu gnyis// lo grangs brgya brgyar chos ston par/ gsungs pa'i rigs pas sum stong dang*// nyis brgya bstan pa'i tshad du 'dod// slar yang drag po 'khor lo che'i// dus bzha'i mgo ni rtsom par byed// mi lo nyi khri chig ston dang*// drug brgya de yi tshad yin te// bcu gnyis gling re'i thob skal la// ston phrag re dang brgyad cha re// lho gling dbus ma'i rang lkal gyi// ston dang brgyad cha 'byung ba dang*// gong gi sum stong nyis brgya po// bsdoms pas stong khrag lngar 'gyur ba// mdo lugs dang yang shing tu 'grig /'di la snga ma spyir btang dang*// phyi ma stobs ldan 'khor lo che'i// dus bzhir dmigs kyis bkar nas gsungs// 'on kyang gnyis ka bdag can gi /ston pa'i bstan pa nyid du gcig /rgyal ba mya ngan 'das pa nas// da lta'i chu rta yan chad la/ lo ni nyis stong drug brgya dang*// gong b.ragayad 'das pa rang lugs te// chos rgyal drug dang rigs ldan ni// stobs po che yan nyid du shu tshal// de la nyis stong drug brgya yod// de lta'i rigs ldan ma 'gags pa// chos ston lo ni go brgyad 'das// de las gzhan du smra ba 'khrul// 'on kyang baiḍūr dkar po'i lugs// rnam gnon chos go lnga 'das// ma 'ogs ji tsam gnas pa ni/

rigs pa 'di las dpag par byos// de ltar rnam gzhag shes byas nas// da lta rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang*// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo// nyi mas bsgyur la nag pa sogs// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /'og ma chus bsgyur klu gzugs bsre// mkha' me zla bas thob pa'i nor// steng du byin pa zla dag go /zla dag de nyid gnas gsum bzhag /bar ma sogs bsgyur steng rim bzhin// zla ba nam mkha' me rnams bsres// 'og ma ros thob bar mar byangs// de la mkha' ros thab pa'i nor/ ston dus bsres ma ri bo bgo /lhag ma gza' yin no rnyed pa'i nor// stong du sbyin la klu lag gis// bgos lhag rim po zhes bya'o// zla dag gnas gsum steng ma mig /dgus ma drag pos bsgyur ba la// steng nas rim bzhin nam mkha' dang*// me rtse gter rnams sbyin byas la// 'og ma bu ga mes thob pa'i// nor gyi dubs ma sbyangs bya zhing*// mkha' ros bgos lhag cho tshod ste// rnyed pa sbyin 'khor los bgo /lhag ma skar ma'i gnas su nges// de yis nyi ma'i rgyu wa 'grub// gza' yi gnas su zla ba dang*// chu tshod gnas su mig me sbyin// cha shas zla ba rim sor mig /skar mar mig dang chu tshod du// drag po rab tu byin pa na// zla ba phyi ma'i rtsis gzhi 'char// gza' yi gnas su tshes grangs bsre// tshes der chu tshod gnas nas
