sbyangs// slar yang ril por sbyin par bya// de la rgya mtsho zla bas bgo /rnyed pa mnyam dang mi mnyam las// snron 'brid mtshan nyid shes par bya// rnyed pa med na'ang mnyam pa yin// lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*// 'byung dbang mda' chu mig gzugs// ldog pa dang bcas yid kyi gnas// gzugs dang 'dod pa dag la mda'// mig dang nyi mar phyogs zhes bya// me dang drag por tshes yin te// rgya mtsho phyogs la bu ga gzugs// mda' dang gter la zug 'grod pa// dus dang klu la rgyal ba ste// thub pa la ni de nyid do// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// logs spyad longs ma spyad pa bzung*// rkang bzung sngun mas cha shas bsgyur// dus nyis bgos pas thob pa ni// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*// yang lhag ros bsgyur thob pa dbugs// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyang*// de las gcig phab mkha' ros bsgyur// chu srang gis sbyangs de las slar// gcig phab ros bsgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs// lhag rnams gza' yi chu tshod man// snon dang dbri bar bya ba yin// tshes grangs gnas gnyis gong ma de// chus bsgyur 'og ma mes thob bsre// de la thob na mkha' ros bgo

/rnyed pa skar ma'i gnas su dang*// lhag ma chu tshod gnas su sbyin// 'og gis lhag ma nyi shus bsgyur// chu srang du byin nyi bar yin// de nyid gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar drug chu tshod zhes lnga sbyangs// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la sbyangs// bsnan yin ni mi kyang rung*// 'khori phyed lhag na dor bar bya// lha ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'byang ba me dang zla bas bgo /rnyed pa nyi ma'i rkang pa bzung*// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams sgyur// mda' yon thob yang dag dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*// yang lhag ros bsgyur thob pa dbugs// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyang*/ de las gcig phag mkha' ros spel// chu srag gis sbyangs lhag ma nas// gcig phab ros bsgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs// lhag ma gza' nyi'i longs spyod du// 'khor phyed der bsnan ma dor sbyangs// de yi gza' nyi rnams par dag /nyi ma dag pa gnas gnyis bzhag /gcig gis skar mar tshes grangs sbyin/ tshes grangs logs bris drug gis bsgyur// de la gza' yi chu tshod sre// thob na mkha' ros bgo bar bya// rnyed pa skar ma'i gnas nas sbyangs// lhag mas chu tshod sbyang bar bya// gza' yi chu srang dbugs dag gis// skar ma'i srang dbugs sbyangs bar bya// gza' dang bla nyi skar ma'i gnas// ri dang 'khor sol bgos bar bya// lhag ma gza' dang rgyu skar gyi// rnam par dag pa mngon su 'char// nyi zla bsres pa sbyor ba ste// tshes grangs mig sgyur zla bas sbyangs// thub pas bgos lhag byed pa'o// gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa ste// rgyud kyi dngos bstan ji bzhin du// yan lag lnga ni bshad zin to// ye shes lnga ldan zla ma la// yan lag lnga yis gus btud nas// byed pa'i dbang byas yan lag lnga'i// zhi rtsis gnas lnga la bar bya// rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang tshad gyi// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo// nyis bsgyur nag sogs 'das zla bsres// gnas gnyis 'og ma mig gis bsgyur// bu gas spras la mda' ros bgo

/rnyed pa steng sbyin zla dag go /zla dag gnas gsum steng rim bzhin// gzugs dang zla me mkha' dbang bsgyur// steng mar nam mkha' bar gter 'byung// 'og tu stong pa rtse mo bsres// mkha ro ri bos bgo /lhag ma tshes gza'i rgyu wa kaḥzla dag gnas gnyis mig dang*// 'og ma gzugs kyis bsgyur ba la/ steng drag 'og mar bug ri brgyan// 'og ma dus nyis bgos pa'i lhag /cha shas yin no thob pa'i nor// steng du sbyin la klu lag gis// bgos lhag ril bu'i rgyu wa kaḥzla dag gnas lnga steng rim bzhin// mig phyogs klu dbang zung phyogs bsgyur// steng nas thig so dus mtsho dang*// nam mkha' khyim bsres 'og nas yar// 'dod pa dus dang mkha' ro dang*// thig ro 'khor los bgos pa'i lhag /nyi ma'i rgyu wa rnam par dag /rang rang sgyur byed byin pa na// zla ba phyi ma'i rtsis bzhi 'char// bug mda' chu tshod yon tan srang*// rig byed dbugs rnams tshes kyi sgyur// gza' yi rgyu war gnas mtshungs sbyin// ril por tshes gzhugs ma nus bgo /rnyed pa mnyam dang mig mnyam las// snon 'brid mtshan nyid shes par bya// rnyed pa med na'ang mnyam pa yin// lhag la zla ba'i rkang pa bzungs// 'byung dbang mda' chu me mig gzugs// ldog pa dang bcas yid kyi gnas// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pa sdom// gzugs dang 'dod pa dag pa mda'// mig nyir sphyogs ter me drag tshes// rgya mtsho phyogs la bu ga gzugs// mda' dang gter ma mig lag dang*// dus dang klu la rgyal ba ste// bug par de nyid ma zin thig /rkang pa snga mas cha shas sgyur// ma zin rkang pa dang pos bsgyur// dus nyis thopa pa yang dag dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*// de lhag ros bsgyur thob pa dbugs// yang lhag yid bsgyur thob pa cha// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las gcig phang drug cur bsgyur// chu srang gis sbyangs lhag ma nas// gcig phab drug sgyur dbugs kyis sbyangs// de las gcig phang ma nur bsgyur// cha shas kyis sbyangs lhag ma rnams// gza' yi longs spyod dag la ni// mnyam byin mi mnyam phrog pa yis// res gza' bar pa legs par grub// rig byed chu tshod zla mig srang*// dbugs mda' 'dod chu bu ga rnams// tshes kyis bsgyar la nyi rgyur sbyin// de yis nyi ma bar pa 'grub// nyi bar gnas gnyis gcig la ni// skar drug chu tshod zhes lngas sbyangs// ma lngang 'khor lo bsnan la sbyang*// 'khor lo bsnan nam ma bsnan yang*// 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// lhag ma'i skar gnas mkha' ros sgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// mda' yon zlas thob nyi rkang bzu// dus dang chu gter ri bong 'dzin// ldog pa dang bcas ros yi gnas// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pa sdom// gzugs mdar ro ste mig chur phyogs// me la drag po ma zin thig

/rkang pa sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// ma zin dang posabasgyur ba la// rang rang 'khor lo steng du dril// de la mda' yon zlas thob pa// yang dag rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// 'og gi srang bcug thob pa srang*// lhag ma ros bsgyur dbugs bsres nas// bgos thob dbugs yin yang lhag de// 'dod bsgyur cha bsres thob 'dod cha// rkang mtshams ma 'das chu tshod bsre// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod sbyang ba sogs// zla ba'i myur bzhin du bya// de ltar 'phri bsna gang byas kyang*// gza' nyi bar pa'i longs spyod du// 'khor phyed dor bsnan ma dor dbrog /de yi gza' nyi rnam par dag /nyi dag gnyis bkod gcig gi ni// dbyug gur mtsho dbang tshes bsgyur byin// tshes 'khyud zla ba'o de nyid la// res gza'i chu tshod man chad kyis// sbyangs pas res 'grogs zla ba dag /nyi zla bas pa sbyor ba dang*// tshes grangs mig bsgyur zla bas dman// thub pas bgos lhag 'phyi byed de// de las gcig 'phri snga byed de/ ༈ /grub mtha'i dbang du sbya pa yis// zhib pa'i yan lag lnga rtsis ni// phyogs 'dir grags pa gtsor byas nas// zhal lungs mkhan po'i lugs bzhin brjod// rang byung yid kyi nang tshan las// sna tshogs 'das lo nyi mas bsgyur// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag /log ma mig bsgyur 'dod yon bsre// dbang ros bgos rnyed steng mar brgyan// tshes zla rnam par dag pa'o// zla dag gnas lnga steng nas gzugs// zla me mkha' mda' thig 'byung mtsho// dbang po chu gter srid pa yis// bsgyur la steng nas gzugs tshes dang*// dus mtsho 'khrigs pa mig 'dod yon// rgya mtsho mda' me 'bul ba'am// yang na 'byung ba rig bye chu// 'dod pa 'jig rten ma nu dang*// rtse mo 'byur mes pa yis// ma lngang rang rang 'khor lo bsnan// ri mkha' ri dang thub ro dang*// dus dang mkhar ro mkha' ro ris// bgos lhag gza' yi rtse ba yin// zla dag gnas gnyis steng ma mig

/'og ma bse rus bsgyur ba la// steng dug 'og mar mda' ro bsres// yang na mi bdag gzugs ro 'phri// dus nyis thob pa steng du sbyin// de dag klu lag gis thob dor// lhag ma cha shas ril por nges/ zla dag gnas lnga steng nas mar// mig phyogs klu dbang gzugs dang ni// ri zla bsgyur la steng nas rim// dus mig bug mtsho dma' 'byung dang*// me bug sbyin nam yang ni ni// man mkha' phyogs mtsho thabs shes dang*// nor 'byung sbyangs la ri ro dus// mkha' ros mkha' dus 'khor los bgo /lhag ma nyi ma'i rtsa ba yin// de la sgyar byed byin pa na// zla ba phyi ma'i rtsis gzhi 'char// bug mda' chu tshod yon tan srang*// dbugs mtsho cha shas mi bdag rnams// tshes sgyur gza' yi rgyu war sbyin// ril por tshes byin ma nus bgo /rnyed pa snon 'brid mtshan mar bzhag /lhag mas zla ba'i rkang pa bzung*// 'byung dbang mda' chu me mig gzugs// ldog bcas srid pa'i gnas su 'gyur// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pa sdom// rkang pa sngun mas cha shas sgyur// dus nyis thob pa yang dag dbyug /lhag ma mkha' ros bro ba dang*// ri mkha' ris sgyur dus nyis bgo /srang dbugs cha shas gnas su brtsegs// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma mdas na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'dasapa yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las rim bzhin phab sbyangs pas// gza' yi chu tshod man chad la// rnyed pa mnyam sbyin mi mnyam dbrog /de yis gza' phyed dag pa yin// rig byed chu tshod zla mig srang*// dbugs mda' me mtsho'i cha shas rnams// tshes bsgyur nyi ma'i rgyu war sbyin// de yis nyi ma phyed dag 'gyur// nyi ma bar pa gnas gnyis kyi// gcig la skar drug zhe lngas sbyangs// yang na skar ma mda' dang ni// chu tshod dus kyis sbyang ba ni// zhal lung mkhan po'i khyed chos yin// 'o na dpal ldan rgyud rgyal las// dus kyi rgyu skar rkang sa gsum// bcas pas sbyang bar gsungs pa la// dngos su 'gongs par mi 'gyur grangs// de ltar lugs gang phyed kyang*// sbyang dus ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan// sbyangs kyang 'khor phyed lhag na dor// ma dor lho bgrod dor na byang*// lhag ma skar gnas mkha' ros spel// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan sa// mda' yon zlas thob nyi rkang bzung*// dus dang chu gter bong can// ldog bcas bro ba'i gnas su 'gyur// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma pyad pa sdoms// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// rang 'khor dril ma mda' yon zlas// thob pa yang dag rgyu ba yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// srang bcug thob pa chu srang ngo*// de lhag ros bsgyur dbugs bsres la// thob pa dbugs yin lhag ma de// ri ros bsgyur thob cha shas so// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyangs// de las rim bzhin phab sbyangs pa// gza' nyi bar pa'i logs spyod du// 'khor phye dor bsnan ma dor dbrog

/des ni gza' nyi rnams par dag /nyi dag gnas gnyis gcig la ni// dbyug gur mtsho dbang tshes bsgyur sbyin// gza' yi longs spyod dag gis ni// skar ma'i longs spyod sbyang bar bya// de yis bla ba'i skar ma dag /nyi zla gnyis bsres sbyor ba ste// tshes grangs mig spel bse rus dman// ri bos bgos lhag byed pa'o// chu gter las ni kun phan ma// 'dab stong dbus nas sbrang rtsi bzhin// blo gros mo ma bsrubs pa las// legs bshad mar gyis snying po spro// de nas lnga bsdus myur rtsis kyi// gza' nyi cha shas re'u mig gi /sgrub tshul gzhan du shes byas nas// mgyogs ster man ngag 'di lta ste// nyi ma lugs gi khyims sleb pa// phal cher nag pa'i nang dus 'byung*// shol tshe zla ba sngun ma yi// dbo zla'i nang du 'byung ba'ang srid// de gnyis gang rigs nyi rgyu la// nyi ma'i rtag longs rigs pas sbyin// 'khor lo phud pa'i lhag ma la// skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod du// gcig gnyis gsum bzhi'i bar du gzung*// de mtshungs gza' yi rtag longs kyang*// gza' yi rgyu bar sbyin par bya/

dang nyi ma'i spyi nor ni// rags pa yin no de tsam zhig /byin pas 'dod 'grub pa'ang byed// phri bzhi khy-im drug spyi nor ni// sngar gyi nyi rags gnas gsum bzhag /dus chu zlabs so sor bsgyur// rang 'khor dril la skar ma'i gnas// mda'o na zla bas ma thog pa// nor gyi gnas su thig le bri// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// thob 'dod cha yin gnas lngar brtsegs// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur srang gzhug /thob pas srang yin yang lha de// ros bsgyur dbugs bsres thob pa dbugs// lhag ma 'dod bsgyur cha bsres la// thob 'dod cha yin gnas lngar brtsegs// dus chul zla ba'i 'bras bu ste// skyes bu gsum zhes de la bya// de nas gza' nyi rags pa ste// gnas drug bkod la kha byang gdab// drug pa'i skyes bu 'khrig kar la// 'bri zhing gzhad dang chu srin snan// chu 'bras glung dang seng geras sbyangs// sdig bum gnyis la sbyin par bya// gzugs 'bras lugs dang mor dbrog /da dang srang la byin pa yis// khyim drug spyi nor ma par dag /de nas re'u mig 'dzin tshul ni// gang rtsi zla ba'i nyi rgyu la// gang rtsi tshes rtag longs sbyin// nyi ma'i longs spyod rags pas 'phri /mthun par gyur la mtshan ma gdab// de log gza' dang nyi ma la/ khyim dang mthun pa'i spyi nor sbyin// de yis nyi ma rnam par dag /cha shas gang la babs pa yi// ril por tshes bsres ma nus bgo /rnyed pa gnyis dang mi mnyam brtag /lhag ma'i grangs dang mthun pa yi// zla rkang sdoms pa'i re'u mig /gza' la sbyin dor byas pa yis// gza' tshes rnam par dag pa 'char// nyi dag gcig la mtsho dbang tshes// bsgyur sbyin gza' longs dag gis sbyangs// sbyor byed la sogs gzhung bzhin bya// phra rags spyi nor sgrub pa yi// ri mo'i dal ba spangs nas ni// myur mgyogs legs bzad 'di long zhag /gza' gcig chu tshod bcu gcig dang*// cha srang bzhi bcu dbugs gnyis rnams// snga ma'i gza' longs rags pa la// byin pas phyi ma'i spyi nor 'char// chu srang bcu bdun 'dod cha gnyis// snga ma'i nyi longs rags pa la// 'phri bas phyi ma'i spyi nor 'byung*// de nas kyim drug spyi nor nor ni// de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu rnams// snga ma'i khyim drug nor la// gza' la bsnan cing skar ma la// 'phri bas phyi ma phyi ma yis// spyi nor bskal pa'i bar du 'char// tshes mtshams 'tshol ba nas bzungs ste// mgyogs ster byed tshul sngar dang mtshungs// gzhan yang snga lo'i li thu la// phyi lo'i nges pa 'char ba dang*// tshes zhag snga ma'i gza' skar la// phyi ma'i gza' skar sgrub tshul logs// dgos pa chung phyir 'dir ma bkod// rgyu kyis dngos bstan byed rtsis gnas gsum ma dang de la cung zad zhib pa gnas lnga ma dang shin tu zhib pa grub dbang du byas dang de dag gis mgyogs ster la sogs pa yan lag lnga gsal bar byas pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o/

chos dbyings legs bris lam la gnas/ stong nyin snying rje'i 'bar 'jag gis srin zhi 'thar gyur nyi zla za/ don gyi sgra gcan la btud nas// kun rdzob sgra gcan gsal bar bya// zla ba phyed pa'i sgra gcan ni// zla ba dag pa phug mes brgyan// mig bsgyur nye stong gzugs mig bsres// mkha' dus chus rnyed dor ba'i lhag /'khor los bsgyur la mkha' dus chus// bgos thob skar ma'i gnas su bzhag /lhag ma mkha' ros mkha' dus dang*// dus dang me mig gis bsgyur ba// sngar bzhin bgos pa'i rnyed nor rnams// chu tshod gnas su rtse mo dang*// srang la gzugs me dbugs su gcig /me mig cha ru bu ga gzugs// zla ba phyed kyi rtags longs te// snga ma'i rtse bar byin pa na// phyi ma'i rtse ba dag par 'char// chu tshod bdun dang chu srang gnyis// dbugs gsum cha shas bco shas bco lnga rnams// zla ba re re'i rtag longs te// mkha' me lags pa bgo byed yin// dgra gcan rtse ba mi dgos par// gdong mjug ri mo 'char 'dod na mkha' dus chu bo dor lhag des// mkha' dus chu bo nyid ma sbyangs// lhag ma 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs// gong bzhin byas pas dgongs 'grub cing*// 'khor phyed bsres pas 'jug ma dag /tshes re'i dgra gcan rtogs 'dod na// bug mes brgyan pa'i zla dag de// mkha' mes bsgyur la tshes grangs bsre// mkha' mkha' bu ga ros rnyed dor// lhag ma skar mas bsgyur ba la// mkha' mkha' bu ga ros thob skar// de lhag mkha' ros la sogs pas// rim bzhin bsgyur thob rtsa ba ste// gdong mjug ri mo sngar dang mtshungs// chu srang ma nu me mig 'char*// nyi ma tshes tshe'i rtag longs yin// 'di yi rtsa ba mi dgos par// gdong mjug rtog par 'dod pa na// mkha' mkha' bu ga ros dor ba'i// lhag ma bgod byed nyid la sbyang// 'khor lo sa sogs rim bsgyur zhing*// mkha' mkha' bu ga ros bgos pas// gdong dag mjug ma sngar bzhin no// 'di re mig 'dzin tshul ni// zla dag nam mkha' rgya mtshos spris// mkha' mi lag pas rnyed pa dor// lhag mas rtse ba'i re'u mig 'dzin// gong ma nya dang 'og ma stong*// de bzhin rtsis gzhi gang la yang*// zla dag legs sgrub sgra gcan gyi// rtsis 'phro gang yin bsres pa la// mkha' me lag pas dor lhag gis// rtsa ba'i re'u mig 'khrul med zin// tshegs chung don che'i man ngag yin// mun can 'char dus rtogs 'dod na// gdong dang nyi ma dag pas sbyang// sbyang dus ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan// lhag ma nam mkha' khyim gyis bsgyur// de la tshu tshod mig bsgyur// bsre gsum rnam rgyal dus sbyor te// gzhan dus g.yas g.yos dang gdong*// yod pa'ang rtsod pa las rgyal ba'i// srid gsum rnam rgyal dus sbyor yin// de phyir gyu ba kun spangs nas// rgyal bar 'dod pa 'di kho na// bzung bar bya ba nges pa'o/

'on kyang dbyangs 'char las 'byung ba'i/ mdung dang mdung chen sbyor ba dang*// sol dud 'khyud pa'i 'phrod la sogs// rgyud 'grel rtsis la sbyor mod na'ang*// mkhas pa snga mas legs par 'akag /srag gcan gyi rtsis 'phros dang bcas pa bshad pa'i skabs te le'u gsum pa'o// ston nyid mdzes ma'i 'khri shing gis// legs 'khyud bde chen pā ka ra// mkha' khyab thugs rje'i grib gsil can// srid zhi'i gdung skob de la bdud// lo bdag gza' yin sgrub tshul ni// sna tshogs la sogs 'das pa'i lo// gnas gnyis steng ma mkha' mkha' chus/ bsgyur ba 'og lams 'phri ba'i lhag /ri zla me thog gza' yi gnas/ lhag ma mkha' ro mkha' ro dang*// ros bsgyur ri zla me yis bgo /thob nor chu tshod chu srang dbugs// lhag ma ri zla me yi cha// steng nas rtse mo lag mig dang*// bug mda' chu dang mtsho ri mig /sbyin la 'og nas ri zla med// dus dang mkha' ro mkha' ro dang*// sa 'dzin gyis dor lhag ma de// byed pa'i lo yi 'pho ba ste// rgyud kyi dngos bstan 'di yin no// yang na lo bdag gnas lngar bkod// gzugs tshes gzugs me ri bong can// zla nyis bsgyur la gong bzhin du// rtse ma lag mig la sogs sbyin// ri zla me sogs bgos pa'i lhag /gong dang mtshungs pa'i ri mo yi// rnam grangs yin no shes ldan dag /lo gza' snga ma dag pa la// gzugs tshes gzugs me ri bo can// zla ba nyi ma gnas mtshungs su// byin pas phyi ma'i nges pa 'char*// zla bdag gza' yi sgrub tshul ni// lo 'pho'i gza' dang chu tshod gnyis/ khyim gyis grangs su bkod byas la// zla ba thub dbang lug la ste// ste pa me mda' gling ma'o// 'khrigs par zla ba rig gzugs dang*// rig byed me dbang karka ṭa// bse mig lag seng ge ste// chu gter rgyal ba bu mo la// srang la bro ba gzugs dbang dang*// ri bong ri mtsho sdig pa'i 'ong*// yon tan mi bdag gzhu la ste// chu gter ri chu srin la// bum par dus dang rig byed dang*// man mkha' mig dbang nya la'o// de dag go rim bzhin du bya// 'og ma mkha' roes bgos pa'i nor// steng du byin la ri bos bgo

/lhag ma khyim gza'i rnam paro dag /snga lo'i khyi gza' dag pa la// gza' gcig chu tshod bco lnga ni// byin pas phyi ma'i nges pa 'char khungs me log ga' rgyal blon ni// sna tshogs 'das lo me yis bsgyur// gnas gnyis steng mar thabs shes dang*// 'og mar 'dod yon bar tu sbyin// gnyis ka ri bos phyi ba'i lhag /steng rgyal 'og ma blon po ste// gr+yal blon gyis bsgyur ba'i phyir// 'og ma'i 'bras bu gatsho zhes zer// de nas dbugs sgang khyim sleb sogs// bu yig nang bzhin 'god par bya// nag zla'i mda' ro'i lhag ma de// ros bsgyar 'dod pas thob pa'i nor// tshes yin lhag ma bcu gsum cha /lnga cha'i gnas 'dzin thig bcas pa/ khyim sleb sgrub pa'i tshald du 'god /gang grub gza' nyi'i rgyu wa la/ 'dod pa'i nor mthun rtag longs dang*// bcu bdun cha dang cha yis// re'u mig sbyin pa'i khyim slob shar/ khyim sngon dbub bo 'gro dgos pas/ khyim tshad thub mig chu bo yis// dbri ba'i dbugs tshad 'phyugs med la/ khyim bzhin rtag longs sogs sbyin pas// dbugs thob 'char zhing de'i tshed la// tshes par nyin zhag 'dod 'char ro// sbyin nam yang na khyim tshad la// bkris me gzugs rim sbyin na// sgang tshad ri mo 'char ba yin// der bsdun rtags longs bcu gsum cha// lnga cha bsre ba gsum ka mtshungs// rtsi sgrub gza' nyi tshes sogs la// tshad med re'u mig 'di sbyin pas// dbugs sgang khyim sleb so sor 'char// ldog gnyis snron dang mgo zla ba'i/ khyim tshad tshes par ri bod dang*// 'dod char mig dang snga char mtsho// sbyin pas tshad kyi ldog gnyis dang*// ri ṣi brgyad pa'i dbugs tshad yin// phag zhag lho bgrod phyogs rig byed// bsres pa'i 'khrul med tshad rnams dang*// mthun pa'i rtag longs 'dod pa'i cha// lnga bcas pa so so yi// rgyu war sbyin pas tshad rnams 'char// tshegs med don chen 'di nyams long*// lo dang zla ba'i bdag po'i gza' dang dbugs sgang khyim slebs sogs bstan pa'i le'u bzhi pa'o// ind+ra nī la'i ni tsū la// gser gyi 'khyi shing gzhon nus 'khyud// lhan skyes bde ba'i gar stabs can// phan bde'i grib bsali gang des srungs// nyin zhag skyed tshal nyams dga' bar// rgyu skar parmo la chags pa// drang srong bung ba'i rol rtsed kyi// ngo mtshar ri ma'o dga' ston spro// zla ba dag pa mkha' mes bsgyur// de la gang rtsi'i nyin zhag sre// gnas gsum bar 'og thub pa yang*// bug ri bse ru bsre bar bya// 'og ma ri mkha' ris bo pa'i// rnyed pa rab byin chu ros bgo

/thob pa'i nor gyi steng ma sbyang*// lhag ma mig gsal zhing yin no// gnas gnyis bzhag pa'i phyogs gcig la// thub pas bgos lhag tshes de yi// res kyi gza' dang mthun nam lta// ma mthun na ni gcig la sogs// snon 'brid byas la mthun par bya// gza' lnga spyi yi gsal zhag go /de nas so so'i don du ni// bkra shis dus bug lag pa bsre// yang na gzugs gter me yis sbyangs// zla skyes gsal zhag brgyas bsgyur la// bkra shis mig klu bro bas brgyan// yang na srin dus bug zla phrog /bla ma bug klu mig gis spra// yang na srid mtsho mkha' chus 'phro /dkar po gsal zhag phyogs kyis bsgyur// bu ga stong pa nyi ma 'bul// yang na lto 'gro me phyogs zhus// dal 'gro 'dod yon rgyal ba sbyin// yang na zla zung dbang phyogs dbri// de la rang rang dkyil 'khor ni// sa skyes kyi ni ri klu ri klu ro// ri bug ri klu zla ba'i bu// so me rgya mtsho bla ma'i'o// khu ba ri dang rgyal ba mig /dus mtshams ri phyogs nyi ma'i bu// so sos bgos rnyed dor ba'i lhag /'khor los bsgyur la sngar bzhin bgo /rnyed pa skar mo' lhag ma ni// mkha' ros bsgyur thob chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur thob srang*// yang lhag ros bsgyur thob pa dbugs// drag gsum dal ba bar pa dang*// zhi gza' gnyis kyi rkang 'dzin no// drag gsum dal ba de nyid dang*// zhi gnyis la ni nyi bar dag /gnas gnyis byas pa'i phyogs gcig la// rang rang skyes khyi sbyang bar bya// phyed bcas bu ga dmar po ste// phyed bcas mi bdag lha mtshams skyes// lha yi bla ma nyin byed dang*// lha mi blon po bro ba ste// zhing 'gro la ni nyes pa dor// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la dor// 'gor lo'i phyed lhag sra yang dor// dor na rim min ma dor rim// snon dang dbri ba shes par bya// lhag ma skar gnas mkha' ros bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'byung ba med dang zla bas bgo

/rnyed pa dal ba'i rkang pa bzung// sa skyes de nyid nyes pa ri// zla skyes mchog dang ri bo me// sgra mkhan bde byed bu ga me// mda' mtsho zla ba nag po skyes// zhi 'gro mig lag tshes mtshams te// snga mgo bzlog bcas ro yi gnas// rkang pa lnga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyod longs ma pyad pa bsdom// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// rang 'khor dril la mda' yon zlas// thob pa rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// 'og gi srang bcug thob pa srang*// de lhag ros bsgyur dbugs bsres bgo /thob nor dbugs su shes par bya// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod dag la sbyang*// de las gcig phang drug cus bsgyur// srang gi sbyangs lhag gcig phab pa// ros bsgyur dbugs kyi sbyangs lhag rnams// /phyogs gcig la ni sbyin dor bya// de yi dal ba dag par 'gyur// myur bar dag par bya ba'i phyir*// drag gsum dal dag gnas gnyis kyi// gcig gi nyi ma bar pa sbyang*// zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin longs spyod la// rang rang dal ba dag pas sbyangs// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnal la sbyangs// bsnan pa yin ni min kyang rung*// 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// dor na rim min ma dor rim// lhag mas myar ba'i rkang pa bzung*// sa skyes rgyal ba me mig gsum// gzugs mig gnyis dang skyon tshes drag /rtse mo'i rtse bar dbang phyug dang*// sbrul me mkha' klu me 'byung ngo*// zla skyes mi bdag gnyis dang tshes// shed bu myos byed bde 'byung ri*// 'byung ba nam mkha' 'o rtse bar mtsho// dbang phyug mkha' mig nol lag dang*// rgyal mtsho me ru shes par bya// bla ma phyogs phyogs bu ga sbrul// dus mtshams 'khrigs pa 'od dkar can// rtsa bar me dang dus bu ga /drag po mi bdag thub pa'o// lha min blon po de nyid gsum// rgyal ba gnyis dang mig lag gnyis// skyon tshes lho'i rtse bar ro// mkha' me srin bug me ri'i// dal 'gro dus mda' 'byung ba dang*// rig byed chu bo mig lag mkha'// rtse bar mig dang rig byed mda'*// bro ba klu dang yon tan no// de ltar rim pa lugs 'byung dang*// rim min lugs las ldog par 'dzin// rkang pa snga ma phyi ma'i char// longs spyad longs ma spyad pas sdom// rim min rkang 'dzin dag pa la// chu tshod sum cur longs mtshams nas// rim min gnas skabs thams cad du// 'phral rtsis dag cang sla thabs su// chu tshod mkha' me sbyin par bya// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// rang 'khor dril la mkha' ros bgo

/rnyed pa rgyu ba'i chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// chu srang bsres nas mkha' ros bgo /rnyed pa srang yin lhag ma de// ros bsgyur dbugs bsres mkha' ros bgo /thob pa dbugs su shes par bya// rkang pa'i mtshams ni ma 'das na// chu tshod gnyis po bsre bar bya// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod sbyang ba sogs// sngar bzhin byas pa'i longs spyod rnams// rang rang dal ba dag pa la// rim snon rim pa min pa la dbri// dbri bar ma sdang 'khor lo bsnan// yang na dbri byas dbri dbred dbri// ldog tshul dngos su ma gsungs kyang*// 'di skabs gza' rnams phyir bzlog pa// mig skar gyi ni grub pa'i phyir// don la thob bcas mkha' rnams bzhed// des ni myur ba rnam par dag /rim pa'i phyi rkang tha ma dang*// rim rin snga rkang dang po la// chu tshod mkha' mer longs pa yan// mkha' mes bgod pa khyed par yin// lhag spen gnyis kyi rkang bzung ni// sngun ma stong par babs pa'i tshe// sgyur byed stobs pas bsgyur bya dbri// de phyir lhag srubs rgyu ba yi// longs spyod med par shes par bya// rim pa'i snga rkang myur 'gros shar// rim pa'i phyi rkang dal 'gros lho// rim min snga rkang 'khyog 'gros nub// rim min phyi rkang 'byung 'gros byang*// gza' lhag dang ni phur bu gnyis/ myur 'gros dus su stobs dang ldan// bkra shis dang ni mjug ring dag /'khyog po'i 'gros la stobs su brjod// pa wa sangs dang nyi ma'i bu// dal 'gro'i dus su rtobs ched zhing*// 'gros gzhan la ni stobs kyis dman// 'di dang lnga bsdus gnyis ka la// dbugs las zhib par rtse ba ni// rgyud 'grol nyid las gsal kha med// mkha' sa sbyang phyir sngon rabs kyi// mkha' pa rnams kyi bshad pa yin// dbugs las zhib par ma rtsis kyang*// gza' 'dzin la sogs mngon sum la// 'khrul pa med pa'i 'bras ster ba// tshad ma nyid las gsal kha med// tshad ma nyid kyi bar tu grub// drang srong lnga yi rkang rtsis 'di// mkha' pas rgyud don bsdus nas 'dzid// de slar kun gyis rtogs bya'i phyir// dag gsal yi ge'i lam du bkod// tshogs gnyis chu yi gter las 'khrungs// mkhyen gnyis 'dab brgya ci yang bzhad// brtse chen thugs rje'i zil mngar can// 'jam mgon pad dkakhar bzhad dare 'dud// de nas slang srog lnga'i// zhib rtsis grub pa'i mtham 'dir gsal// sna tshogs 'das lo nyi mas bsgyur// 'das zla bsres la gnas gnyis bzhag

/'og ma mig bsgyur nyer spyod 'bul// mda' ros bgos thob stong du bsre// tshes zla rnam par dag pa'o// zla ba dag pa mkha' mes bsgyar// de la gang rtsi'i tshes grangs bsre// tshes zhag grangs yin nyin zhag tu// bya phyir de nyid gnas gsum bzhag /bar 'og ri mtsho me nyi ma// bsres la 'og nas rim mkha' ris// bgos thob bar mar bsre bar bya// de la rgyal mtsho ros thob pa'i// steng mar sbyangs pa'i lhag ma de// gza' lnga pī yi nyi ma yin// mi gsal gsal ba'i zhag tu sgrub// so so'i sgos zhag bya ba'i phyir// bkra shis gter bug lag pa bsre// zla skyes spyi zhag brgyas bsgyur la// gzugs me 'od dkar ri bos brgyan// bla ma nam mkha' bug mig bsnan// sbyin byed bla ma phyogs kyis bsgyur// bkra shis me dang nyi ma sbyin// nyi bu rgya mtsho de nyid spras// de la rang rang dkyil 'khor ni// sa skyes dkyil 'khor ri klu ro// ri bug ri klu zla ba'i ba// lha yi bla ma so me mtsho// lha min blon po ri rgyal mig /dal 'gro dus mtshams ri phyogs kyis der lhag so sa'i skos zhag yin// rang rang sgos zhag 'khor los bsgyur// de la rang rang dkyil 'khor gyis// bgos bas thob pa skar ma'o// lhag ma mkha' ro mkha' ro dus// dkyil 'khor gyasi ni rim bzhin bsgyur// sngar bzhin bgos thob chu tshod dang*// chu srang dbugs dang dkyil 'khor cha// drag gsum dal ba bar pa dang*// zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin longs spyod yin// drag gsum dal bar de nyid dang*// zhi gnyis nyi ma bar pa dag /gnasaganyis byas pa'i phyogs gcig la// rang rang skyes khyim basbyang bar bya/ khyed bcas bu ga bkra shis te// phyed bcas bu ga zla ba'i sras// sgra mkhan nyi ma khu ba dus// nyi ma'i bu la nyes pa dor// ma lngang 'khor lo bsnan la sbyang*// sbyangs rjes 'khor phyed lhag na dor// dor lhag skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// mda' yon zla thob dal rkang gzung*// sa skyes de nyid nyes par ri// phyogs ri rtse mo zla ba'i bu// bla ma bde byed bu ga me// dkar po mda' mtsho 'od dkar can// mig lag tshes mtshams nyi ma'i bu// ldog pa dang bcas ro yi gnas// snga phyi spyad dang spyad bya sdom// rkang pa sngun mas hag rnams bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob yang dag dbyug

/lhag ma mkha' ro la sogs pas// rim bzhin bsgyur la sra sogs bsre// mda' yon zla thob srang sogs yin// rkang mtshams ma 'das chu tshod bsre// 'das na yang dag rgyu ba yis// rkang pa'i chu tshod sbyang bar bya// rim bzhin phab sbyangs lhag ma rnams// rang rang dal bar gcig sho la// 'khor phyed bsnan ma dor dbri// de yi dal ba rnam par dag ༈ /myur bar dag par bya ba'i phyir// ga gsum dal dag gnas gnyis kyi// gcig gis nyi ma bar sa sbyangs// zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin longs spyod la// nyi ma dag pas sbyang ba'am// yang na dal dag phyogs gcig gis// rang rang rkang 'dzin sbyangs bar bya// ma ldang 'khor lo bsnan la sbyang*// 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// dor na rim min ma dor rim// lham mas myur ba'i rkang pa bzung*// bkra shis rgyal ba me mig gsum// gzugs mig gnyis dang skyon tshes drag /me'o rtse bar dbang phyug dang*// klu me mkha' klu me mda'a'o// zla bu mi bdag gnyis dang tshes// ma nu 'dod pa drag po ri// mda' mkha'o rtse bar rig byed drag /mkha' mig nor lag mtsho me'o// zla ma phyogs phyogs bu ga sbrul// dus mtshams mi bzugs rtsa bar me// dus bug drag po mi bdag ri'o// nyi ba dus mda' 'byung chu mtsho// mig lagamakha'o rtse bar mig /mtsho mda' dus klu yon tan no// snga phyi phos dang ma zo sdom// rkang bzung sngun mas lhag rnams bsgyur// rang 'khor dril la mkha' ros bgo /rnyed pa yang dbyug chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ro dus dang ni// dkyali 'khor gyasi ni rim bzhin bsgyur// chu srang logs rim bsres la// mkha' ros thob pa srang sogs yin// rkang mtshams ma 'das chu tshaud bsre// 'das na 'og mas gong ma sbyangs// de la gcig phab mkha' ros bsgyur// srang gis sbyangs sogs sngar bzhin bya// de ltar grub pa'i longs spyod rnams// rang rang dal ba dag pa la// rim par snon cing rim min dbri

/ma ldang 'khor lo snon pa'am// phan tshun ldog nas sbyang bar bya// des ni myur ba rnam par dag /ma dor ma brkal myur 'gros shar// ma dor brgal ba dal 'gros lho// dor la ma brgal 'khyor 'gros nub// brgal zhing dor ba 'byung 'gros byang*// gza' lngu'i'agros bzhi zhes bya'o// de nas slar yang srang lnga'i// re'u mig chen mo'i mgyogs ster gyi// lag len go bder bshad par bya// grub mtha' bzhin dus bsgyub pa yin// zla ba dag dag pa mkha' mes bsgyur// de la gang rtsi'i tshes grangs bsre// tshes zhag grangs yin drag gsum gyi// rkang 'dzin gzhi dang zhi gnyis kyi// dal ba dag pa'i gzhi yin no// tshes zhag grangs de gnas gsum bzhag /bar 'og ri mtsho me nyi ma// sbyin la 'og ma rig mkha' ris// rnyed pa bar byin chu ros bgo /thob pa'i nor gyi steng ma sbyangs// lhag ma gza' lnga'i pyi zhag steng*// mig gza' gnyis kyi rkang 'dzin gzhi// de nas so so'i don du ni// rang rang rtsi 'phro bsre bar bya// bkra shis gter bug lag sbyin// bla ma nam mkha' bug mig bsre// nyi bu rgalaya mtsho de nyid brgyan// de la rang rang dkyil 'khor ni// sa skyes dkyil 'khor ri klu ro// bla ma'i dkyil 'khor so me mtsho// dal 'gro'i dus mtshams ri phyogs kyis// bgos thob dor ba'i lhag ma yis// rang rang dal dag re'u mig bzung*// 'dzin tshul kha byang re mig dang*// grangs mtshungs de nyid mi mtshungs na// bzung bya nyung ba de bzung ngo*// grags mtshung des dag ma mtshungs pa'i// mang khyad ka ka'i thob bzhin du// spyi nor re'u mig byin pa yis// drag gsum dal ba rnam par dag /gnas ni skar dbyung srang dbyug srang dbugs dang*// bug mig lag pa bkra shis te// bug mig lag pa bkra shis te// bla ma gzugs dus me yi cha// me klu me mda' nyi ma'i bu'i// cha shas dag tu shes par bya// zhi gnyis don du gsal ba'i zhag

/zla skyes mkha' mkha' gzugs kyis bsgyur// zla me 'od dkar ri bo bsre// khu ba phyogs bsgyur klu me nyi// bsres la sog so'i dkyil 'khor ni// lhag pa ri bug ri klu dang*// pa sangs ri rgyal mig thob dor// lhag ma zhi gnyis skos zhag yin// de la brgyad dang bcu yis ni// so sor bgoras pa'i nor gyis// so so'i rkang 'dzin re'u mig dang*// lhag mas spyi nor re'u mig bzung*// rkang 'dzin re'u mig gang zin la// spyi noral gang zin byin pa yis// zhi gnyis rkang 'dzin rnam par dag /gnas ni skar dbyug srang dbugs dang*// ri bug ri klu lhag pa'i cha// dkar po bug mtsho rir shes bya// zla ba dag pa mkha' mes bsgyur// gang rtsi'i tshes grangs bsres pa na// tshes zhag yin no de nyid kyang*// 'dod bsgyur chu gter ri mtsho bsres// chu mig klu mtshos rnyed pa de// lhag ma 'dod pas phye ba yis// nor gyi drag gsum rkang 'dzin dang*// zhi gtis dal dag thun mong zin// lhag mas gsum ga'i thun mong gi /spyi nor re'u mig zin par 'gyur// de ltar gnas gsum re'u mig la// spyi nor re'u mig byin pa yis// gongam drag gsum rkang 'dzin dang*// bar 'og lhag sangs dal ba dag /gnas na skar dbyug srang dbugs dang*// ri ro'i ru shes par bya// de nas drang lhag skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur// chu tshod bsres pa'i grangs kyis so// grangs mtshungs de nyid mi mtshungs na// bzung bya'i re'u mig grangs nyung ba'o// de ltar gang zin re'u mig la// grangs mtshungs des dag mi mtshungs na// chu tshod bsres pa'i grags kyis so// grangs mtshungs des dag mi mtshungs na// ka tho bzhin du mang khyed kyis// rkang longs chu tshod bsgyur byas la// rim dang rim man gnyis ka la// rkang mtshams ma 'das sbyin bya zhing*// 'das ni dbri ba shes par bya// de ltar bsgrub pa'i skar dbyug srang*// rang rang dal ba dag pa la// rim snon rim min dbra bar bya// gal te bri bar ma ldang na// 'khor lo bsnan nam yang na ni// sbyang byas sbyong byed la sbyangs bas// drang srong lnga yi myur ba dag

/rim pa'i snga rkang shar la phyi rkang lho// rim min snga rkang nub la phyi rkang byang*// rim bzhin myur dal 'khyog dang 'byung 'gros te// gza' dbang bgrod bas 'gros bzhin ldan pa'i tshul// de ni nyin zla gdong mjug dang*// gza' lnga gnas pa'i phyim shes ched// rang rang skar ma mkha' ros bsgyur// 'og gi chu tshod steng du bsre// mda' yon zlas thob 'das pa'i khyim// lhag rnams po so'i char 'gyur phyir// nyi lhag sangs gsum me rims bsgyur*// rang rang 'khor los ste du dril// rgyal ba mes thob 'das pa'i zhag /mig dmar bug mig lag pas bsgyur// mkha' mtsho mdas thob 'das pa'i zhag /spen pa me klu me mdas bsgyur// mkha' gzugs klus thob 'das pa'i zhag /zla ba phyogs mkha' mig gis bsgyur// tshes me ri drag gis thob zhag /phur bu gzugs dus me 'is bsgyur// sgra gcan mda' ri 'byung bas bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob 'das pa'i zhag /mda' yon zlas thob 'das pa'i zhag /gdong mjug gnyis ni ma 'ongs zhag /bgos lhag so sor mkha' ros bsgyur// sgra gcan mda' ri 'byung bas bsgyur// mda' yon zlas thob 'das pa'i zhag /gdong mjug gnyis ni ma 'ongs zhag /bgos lhag so sor mkha' ros bsgyur// so sos thob pa chu tshod yin// lhag ma mkha' ros bsgyur ba la// 'og gi srang bcu thob pa srang*// yang lhag ros bsgyur dbugs bsres la// thob pa dbugs yin de lha rnams// so so'i bgos byed kyis bsgyur bar// 'og gi cha bsres thob pa cha// de rnams rang rang khyim der 'das// mdong mjug ma 'ongs pa yin phyir// mda' ri 'byung bar sbyangs pa'i lhag khyim der 'das pa'i zhag yin no// nyi lhag sangs gsum mkha' me'i zhag /dbyug gur nyer lngar sbyang bar bya// mig dmar rim mda' dbyug tshes sbyangs// spen pa ri bug klu zhag dang*// dbyug gu phyogs la sbyang bar bya// phur bu gzugs dus me zhag sbyangs// zla ba zhag mig dbyug skyon dang*// chu srang dus chu dbyug mtshor sbyangs// lhag rnams khyim der ma 'ongs tshad// de yang zhag ni nyid zla dang*// dgra gcan tshes zhag dang sbyar zhing*// gza' gzhan nyin gzhag dang sbyar ba// byed pa sla ba'i ched du'o// de ltar gza' rnams khyim gang du// gnas tshul brtags nas gza' 'grems bya/

༈ /blo gros sprin tshogs thos pa'i glog 'phreng can// legs bshad dbyar gyi rnga sgra cher sgrogs pa'i// gza' dbang bgrod pa gsal byed char gyi rgyun// blo gsal zhing sa dga' ba'i dga' ston lags// drang srong lnga'i dal myur gyi cho ga byed pa'i dbang dus byas pa'i rgyud kyi dongs bstan dang grub mtha'i zhib rtsis re'u mig gi mgyogs ster dang bcas pa gsal bar byas pa ste le'u lnga pa'o/ ༈ /dus dang dus can spros pa'i tshogs// dus gsum dus med phyogs rgya cher// mchog tu sdom mdzad dus 'khor lor// dus kun tu ni phyag bgyis nas// nang gi dus sbyir rtogs bya'i phyir// phyi yi dus sbyor bshad par bya// thog mar nyi ma khyis rnams su// 'pho ba'i nges pa rtogs sla ba// skar mig dbyug tshes lug gi tshad// rim byed mkha' me glang du brjod// ro dang zhe lnga 'khrigs pa yin// dgu dang nam mkha' karka ṭa// drag po bco lnga seng go'o// bcu gsum sum cu bu mor dran// tshes dang zhes lnga srang yin zer// nor zla stong pa sdig pa go /nyi shu bco lnga gzhui yin snyam// zung mig mkha' me chu srin mthong*// rgyal ba mda' chu bum par grags// 'khor lo nyi ru shes par bya// khyi gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa yi// mtshan nyid dag ni bstan pa yin// dus sbyor so so'i nyin tshad ni// nya dang bu mo sum cur mnyam// lug dang seng ge sum chu gnyis// glang dang sbal pa sum cu bzhi// 'khrig pa'i nyin tshad so drug go /srang dang bum pa rnyed brgyad dang*// chu srin sdig pa nyi shu drug /gzhi yi nyin tshad rgyal ba'o// de rnams mkha' ror 'phri ba'i lhag /rang rang mtshan mo'i tshad du 'gyur/ ༈ /dus sbyor so so'i srang tshad ni// nam mkha' zung nyi yi tshad// man mkha' rig byed mtshe ma lug /stong pa nor lag glang yin te// nam mkha' gnyis skyes 'khrig pa yin// mkha' dang dus me karka ṭa// nam mkha' mtsho seng ge ste// bu mo la sogs zlog par bya// rang rang nas brtsams khyim drug gi

/chu bsdoms pas nyin tshad dang*// phyi ma'i khyim drug bsdoms pa yis// mtshan mo'i chu tshod nges par 'char/ ༈ /da ni 'das pa'i khyim zla dang*// nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib zhib brtag phyir// nyi ma'i dal ba bar pa gang*// mkha' ros bsgyur la chu tshod bsra// mda' yon zlas thob khyim zla grangs// lhag ma mkha' mes bsgyur ba la// chu srang lag pas bgos thobs gzhug /thobs pa 'das pa'i zhag yin te// chu tshod sogs kyang sbyar bar bya de ni don gyi khyim 'pho dang*// don gyi 'das zhag nyid du brjod// 'das zhag steng nas klu yis sbyang*// ma ldang khyim nas phab la sbyang*/ khyim yang 'khor lo rdzogs na bsnan// lhag ma'i khyi grangs gang yin pa// 'das pa'i khyim grangs gang yin pa// 'das pa'i khyim zla'i grangs yin zhing// zhag ni ngo thog rang gis khyim// de ni byed pa sla phyir yin// klu yis 'phriba'i zhag lhag gang*// chu bsgyur mkha' ros thob pa'i nor// chu tshod yin no lhag chu srang*// byed pa sla ba'i khyam de yi// gzhu sogs byang bgrod nyin mor sbyin// 'khrig sogs lha bgrod nyin mor der// des ni nyin mo'i tshad 'char zhing*// mkha' ror 'phri lag mtshan mo'i tshad// nyin mtshan 'phel 'grib de yis rtogs// 'das pa'i zhag grangs gang yin pa// rang rang chu srang gis bsgyur la// mkha' mes thob pa 'das pa'i srang*// de yi rang gis srang tshad la// 'phri lhag khyim de'i ma 'ongs pa'i// chu srang yin no shes ldan dag /da lta'i nyi khyim dang por byas// nam langs thur grib nyer gcig bar// dang po'i khyi shar bdun pa nub// bcu gnyis tshe na gnyis pa shar// nyin gung tshe na gsum pa shar// bcu la bzhi pa nyi shur lnga// nyi nub tshes na drug pa shar// mtshan ma'ongs cha shas 'diyis shes// cu zad rag pa'i zhing par na// rgya mtsho chu dang zla ba la// nyi dang bu mor dus sbyin zhing*// lugs dang seng ge rang par bzhag

/glang dang sbal pa dbyig gis dman// 'khrigs pa la ni nyes pa sbyangs// srang dang bum par bcu yang sbyin// sdig gzhu gzhu chu srin khyim gyis spras// thub shing grib bcas kyi thob pa// chu tshod lhag ma drug cus bsgyur// bgos thob srang yin dbugs kyang bya// snga dro 'das zin phyi dro lus// de yis nyin mo'i tshad la sbyang// lhag ma snga dro 'char rgyud dang*// phyi dro shar zin 'das pa yin// 'das pa'i chu tshod mkha' ros bsgyur// rang gi ma 'ogs chu srang gi// thog ma byas nas sbyangs pa las// gang du ma ldang tatkā la// de nas bgrangs pa'i bdun pa ni// nub pa'i dus sbyor yin shes bya// lug nya'i srang tshad snga nur byed pa'i dgongs pa'o// lug sogs drug la rim pa dang*// srang sogs drug la bzlog pas dbri// 'dir 'das zhag steng nas klus sbyang ba ni zhag de sum cur ma longs skyi bar du da lta'i zhag tu sgro btags nas rang khyim dang mtshungs par 'dzin pa ni nyi ma gzhi khyis du sleb nas grub rtsis ltar na zhag brgyan na dgun nyi ltog pas klus sbyangs pa yin la/ byed pa'i dbang du na zhag bco lnga tsam ldog pas de ltar na 'das zhag steng nang bco lngas dbri dgos par grubo/ de'i phyi lho byang bgrod pa'i mtshams nges bzung nas sbyin dor gyi nges bzung sla ba'i ched du klu'am tshes kyis sbyang ba yin no/ nyin mtshan kyi tshad sogs dbyangs 'char ltar byas pa yin la// de la lug gi srang tshad nya'i srang dzad sogs su snga nar dgos pa dang*// dbyar dgun gyi nyi ma karka ṭa dang chu srin gyi khyim du mi bzlog cing ston dpyid kyi nyin mtshan mnyam pa'ang/ lug srang gi khyim du mi 'byung ba sogs mngon sum khyi grub pa'i phyir khyim ri snga nur yin no/ ༈ /dus sbyor gcig dang phyed pa dang*// sum cha dgu cha bcu gnyis cha// sum cu'i cha yi bye brag rnams// shes par gyis shig lha mdzes ma// 'phri ba'i lhag ma sum cus bsgyur// de la tatkāl chu srang gis// bgos pas thob pa cha shas yin// lhag ma drug cus bsgyur ba la// chu srang gis thob dbyug gu yin// yang lhag drug cus bsgyur ba la// chu srang gis thob chu srang yin// de lhug drug bsgyur thob pa dbugs// tatkāl cha shas dbyug srang dbugs// dus sbyor gyi ni gnas lngar bzhed/

dus sbyor thog mar gzhag pa'i phyir// tatkā la ni sum cus bsgyur// 'og gi cha shas steng du gzhug /de yang drug cus bsgyur byas te// 'og gi chu lod steng du bsre// mkha' mkha' nor dang gzugs kyis bgo /thob pa dus sbyor gcig pa ste// tatkā la dang bye brag med/ ༈ /dus sbyor phyed pa lta ba'i phyir// cha shas drug cus bsgyur ba la// 'og gi chu tshod dang ldan pa// 'di ni kun gyi bgo bzhi'o/ ༈ /mkha' mkha' bu gas bgos pa la// 'di nas sum cu'i cha shas bar// phyed pas lhag nas gcig sbyin bya// 'dir rnyed gnyis las mang mi srid// gcig gi bdag po nyi ma ste// gnyis kyi bdag po zla ba yin/ ༈ /de nas sum cha brtags pa ni// spyi nor mkha' mkha' ro yis bgo /rnyed pa gsum las mang mi srid// gcig ni tatkā la yin te// gnyis byung tatkāl nas bgrangs lnga// gsum byung dgu pa'i dus sbyor bshad// gang yin bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung*// de nas dgu cha brtag par bya// spyi nor mkha' stong mig gis bgo /rnyed pa dgu las mang mi srid// tatkāl nas bzung dgu cha brtag /gang yin bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung*// de nas dgu cha brtag par bya// spyi nor mkha' stong mig gis bgo /rnyed pa gdu las mang mi srid// tatkāl nas bzung dgu cha brtag /gang yin bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung*// lug seng gzha rnams lug nas bgrang*// chu srin bu mo glung rnams ni// chu srin nas ni bgrang bar bya// 'khrigs pa bum pa srang rnams ni// dang po srang nas grangs gzung ngo*// karka ṭa dang sdig pa nyi// karka ṭa nyid thog mar gzhag /bcu gnyis cha la sngar bzhin du// spyi nor nam mkha' tshes kyis bgo /rnyed pa khyim las lhag mi srid// tatkal nas bgrangs gang yin gyi// bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur// sum cu'i cha la spyi yi nor// mkha' ros bgos pa'i nor du// sum cu las ni ming mi srid// mig dmar spen pa phun bu dang*// lhag sangs dbus su rim par bzhag

/lnga dang lnga dang brgyad bdun lnga// g.yas dang g.yon dus bgod par bya// lug sogs mi mnyam rim pa g.yas// glang sogs mnyam g.yon rim min bgrang*// dbus kyi bdag po'i 'bras bu 'byung*// da ni de yi bgos byed bshad// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i dbugs// nyi mas phye nor 'pho chen gcig /de la rim bzhin lag pa dang*// me dang bu ga nyi ma dang*// mkha' mes thob nor rim pa bzhin// mkha' mes thob nor rim pa bzhin// dum bu so so'i dkyil 'khor 'gyur// 'di dag dbyangs 'char ji bzhin las// cung zad yul 'di'i mngon sum dang*// mthun par byas nas bshad pa yin// dus sbyor gyi nges pa dbyangs 'char ltar bshad pa ste le'u drug pa'o/ ༈ /gsung rab rgya mtsho'i dbus na gnas// mkhas mang gser ri'i 'phreng bas bskor// yon tan bang rim gyis 'dzes pa'i// sngon med lhun po de la 'dud// de nas nyi ma zla ba la// sgra gcan mjug pa gsal bya ste// nyi ma gnas pa'i khyim dang ni// tshes logs 'phog 'grib legs brtags nas// dang po nyi 'dzin brtags pa ni// gnam gang nyi ma dag pa dang*// gdong dang dus me gang nye brtag /gdongs gis 'dzin par 'gyur ba na// sgra gcan gdong gis nyi ma sbyang*// skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod du// nga lnga'i bar du 'dzin pa yin// gal te nyi mas gongs sbyangs na// skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod kyang*// gcig nas lnga bar phal cher 'dzin// dus ri klu dang na po la// cung zad 'dzin srid lhag na min// nyi mas mjug ma sbyangs pa na// skar gnas stongs pa gzhir bzhag la// chu tshod nga lnga'i bar du brtag /gal te mjug mas nyi sbyangs na// skar gnas stongs zhing chu tshod ni// mda' yi bar du phal cher 'dzin// dus ri klu la sum cha dang*// dgu nas bcu gsum bar dag tu// bzhi cha tsam zhag 'dzin par ni// 'dod pa yod de brtag par bya// de ltar 'dzin pa'i gnad rig nas// gsar bu nges pa skyes ba'i phyir// gdong gis 'dzin tshe nyi dag la// sgra gcan rtsa ba bsre bar bya// rang rang 'khor los steng du dril// 'khor lo'am phyed longs na dor// de dang gong gis lhag ma gnyis// phan tshul gcig gis gcig sbyangs pas// gnas bzhi'am gnas gsum stongs na 'dzin// mjun gis 'dzin tshes nyi dag dang*// 'das pa bsres la lhag mar sbyin// rang 'khor dril ma 'khor lo'am// 'khor phyed lhag na dor bar bya// gnas kun stongs na 'dzin para'adod// nyi bul bsre ba'i ngal ba 'di// rgyu dang 'grel par bshad pa med// mkha' rlom mgo bo rmongs pa'i phyir// mkha' pa sngon mas dpe mkhyud mdzad// gzhan dag dpyad pa med par ni// nyi 'dzin rtogs thabs zab mor 'khrul// sbyang byang sbyor byed gog log cing*// lhag mnga' shin tu ma gyur kyang*// gnas bzhi'am gnas gsum nges par stongs// de tshe 'dzin ni mi 'dzin pa'i// nges bzung ji ltar bya ba smos// gzhan yang nyi dag gnas gsum bzhag

/so so'i dbyug gur chu bo sbyin// dang por mun can 'das pa bsre// gnyis par 'khor bsre gdong gis sbyangs// gsum par phyed bas mjug gis dbri// skar ma'i gnas nas 'khor lo'am// 'dod pa dor bas thig gsum shar// the tshem med par 'dzin par 'dod// 'di yang sbyi tshul ma log dang*// log kyang sbyang lhag nyung du yi// dbang du byas kyi gzhan du min// gdong gis 'dzin tshes nyi ma mang*// mjug 'dzin de las ldog pa dgos// phan tshun bzlog par gyur pa na// lhag ma mang tshes 'dzin mi 'gyur// sbyang bya sbyor byed ma log na// lhag ma mang yang 'dzin pa mthong*// nyi ma dang ni zhi gza' gnyis/ khyim gcig tshogs sam tshogs su nye// nyi zla'i rna cha dag pa zhes/ chung ngur 'dzin tshe mongan par dka'// sbyangs lhag chu tshod stongs sam gcig /shar tshes 'dzin pa dka' zhes zer// chu tshod stongs kyang bzung ba ni/ kho bo'i myong bas lebs par grub// nyi rkang dus la spyod pa dang*// gzhu srin 'khrig kar khyim bzhi la// nyi ma gnas par gyar ba na// cha ni chung bar 'dzin zhes zer// che chung ji tsam 'dzin pa ni// sbyangs lhag chu tshod chu srang du// brgyad dang ni shu'i bar du ni// ril por 'dzin no chu tshod dgu// chu srang mkha' mtsho' bar dag tu// bcu gnyis cha gcig ma gtogs 'dzin// chu tshod bcu dang chu srang stong*// dgu cha ma gtogs 'dzin par 'gyur// dbyug srang bcu gsum nyi shu la// bzhi cha ma gtongs 'dzin pa yin// mi bdag mkha' mtsho bar du ni// sum gnyis 'dzin no chu tshod du// nyi shu lus na khyed lhag tsam// nyer gsum nyi shu'i dbyug srang la// phyed 'dzin yin no chu tshod du// nyer drug chu srang bzhi bcu la// phyed bas cung chung dbyug gu ni// so gnyis shar tshes sum cha 'dzin// dbyug srang so brgyad nyi shu la// bzhi cha gcig gi zhed drug dang*// bzhi bcur drug cha gcig 'dzin no// cha tshod nga lnga lus pa'i tshes// nyi ma'i bcu gnyis cha gcig 'dzin/

༈ /gzhan yang ri mo'i rnam grangs ni// sbyang lhag chu tshod bdun phyin la// phyogs steng bdun las mang ba na// 'byung ba byi la mkha' ror 'phri// lhag ma nyis bsgyur mkha' ros bgo /nor la me bsres 'dzin pa'i cha// re res bcu gnyis cha re sgrib// me dus bu ga nyi rnams// bzhi cha phyed dang bzhi gsum ril// 'dzin par 'gyur ro som nyi spongs/ ༈ /yang na sbyangs lhag chu tshod de// mda' yis bgos pa'i rnyed pa la// gzugs sam mig byung ril por sgrib// gsum thob drug cha ma gtogs 'dzin// bzhi la phyed 'dzin lnga thob na// phyed pas cung chung drug gsum cha// bdun thob drug cha brgyad brgyad cha// dgu nas bcu gcig bar dag tu// dgu cha bcu cha bcu gcig cha// re re sgrib par 'gyar ba yin/ ༈ /yang na lag len myong grub ni// gdong gis nyi sbyangs lhag ma des// mkha' ros 'phro lhag mda' yis bgo /thob pa'i nor la gang byung de// nyi ma'i cha ni 'dzin pa'i grangs// de yis nyi ma la 'phri ba'i// lhag ma mi 'dzin pa yi cha// nyi mas dus me sbyangs pa'i lhag /mkha' ror 'phri lhag mda' yis bgo /thob pa'i grangs la gang byung de// nyi ma'i cha ni mi gdong 'dzin la snga ma snams dang khyad med cing mjug 'dzin la 'di kho na nges pa 'dug pas lag tu long dang bslu bar mi 'gyur ro/ 'dzin te// de yis nyi ma sbyangs pa'i lhag /'dzin pa'i cha yin 'khrul pa med// nyi ma'i cha ni bcu gnyis so/ ༈ /yun ni sbyangs pa'i lhag ma des// zhag gi dbyug gu drug cur sbyangs// lhag ma mda' yis thob pa'i nor// 'dzin pa'i yul yin ril 'dzin tshes// chu tshod bcu gnyis bar du ste// de bzhin cha re dbyug gu rer// mnyam pa'i rigs mda' kun la snun/ ༈ /mdor na dang po'i sbyangs lhag dang*// bar du thig le bzhi shar dang*// tha mar yul la brtag bya ste// sbyangs lhag shin tu nyung ba dang*// thig le gnas bzhir shar ba dang*// yul ni chu tshod bcu gnyis su// longs sam longs nye ba na// som nyi longs la lung bstan byos/

༈ /dus ni tshes kyi longs byed pa'i tshes la 'di snams dgos/ grub mthar nur ster lu ba med spyod la// ston dpyid mnyam tshe 'dod pa dang*// mthar thug gnyis la mi bdag sbyin// lhag ma zla ba brgyad po la// shed bu tshes dag snon pa ni// hor zla bcu gnyis pa la bco lnga dang po la bcu gcig gsum pa la bcu gcig bzhi pa la bcu sogs de bzhin du har zla drug pa dang bcu pa la bcu sogs bdun pa dang dgu pa la bcu gcig ster ba yin no/ 'phel zhing 'grib pa'i rim pas shes// nor bcas tshes kyi dbyug ga dag /zadang pa'i mtshams su 'dzin par 'gyur// tshes longs ji tsam nyung bzhin du// gling 'dir mthong shes che ba yin// ha cang logs spyod mang ba na// 'jig rten grags pa'i tshes gcig gi /snga dro nyi ma 'dzin pa mthong*/ ༈ /phyogs ni gdong gis nyi sbyangs sam// nyi ma dus me sbyangs pa na// nyi phyed lho nub mtshams nas 'dzin// phyed gong lhor nyi phyed 'og la// nub la nye ba'i phyogs nas so// dus mes nyi ma sbyangs pa'am// nyi mas gdong la sbyangs pa na// nyin phyed rung lha'i phyogs nas te// phyed gong byang nye phyed 'og dus// nub la nye ba'i phyogs nas 'dzin// shar nas nam yang ma min no// yang na nyi ma lhor 'grod tshe// rlung gi phyogs la nye ba dang*// byang du bgrod tshe bden bral la// nye ba'i phyogs nas 'dzin no zhes// dus zhags shākya dbang phyug gsum// gzhan dag de la ldog steng gdong ma mdar nag dang*// dus me la ni dmar ser ro// dum 'dzin nag cig phyed 'dzin sngo// gsum gnyis kham la rim 'dzin tshe// lcags bsreg pa yi mdog dang mtshungs// rgyu skur mgo lag steng gdongs la dmar nag dang*// dus me la ni dmar ser re// dum 'dzin nag cing phyed 'dzin sngo// gsum gnyis kham la rim 'dzin tshe// lcags bsres pa yi mdog dang mtshungs// rgyu skar mgo lag steng gzung na// nam mkha'i mdangs la 'gran par 'gyur/

༈ /de nas zla ba 'dzin tshul ni// zla ba rdzogs pa'i longs spyod ma// tshes gza'i chu tshod man chad bsre// yang na tshes longs ma sbyangs pa'i// nya yi tshes 'khyud zla ba dang*// sgra gcan gdong mjug gang nye gnyis// mang la nyung gis sbyangs pa'i lhag /skar gnas stongs shing chu tshod ni// nga lnga'i bar du brtag par bya// de bas mang na 'dzin mi 'gyur// cha ni sbyangs lhag chu tshod la// 'byung bas bgos pa'i thob nor du// gzugs mig me mtsho ril por sgrib// mda' shar drug cha gtogs 'dzin// ro la sum gnyis ri la phyed// klu la sum cha bug drug cha// phyogs la brgyad cha drag po la// bco lnga cha gcig 'dzin par 'gyur// yang na sbyangs lhag cha tshod de// klu lag gis bsgyar mkha' ros bgo /rnyed pas de nyid la sbyangs shing*// de lhag des kyang tshes la sbyang*// sbyang du ma ldang ril por 'dzin// ldang na slar yang lhag ma des// tshes la sbyangs lhag gang byung ba// grangs rnyed zla ba'i cha 'dzin te// zla ba tshes kyi char rtse'o// 'di ni cung zad rags par mngon// yang na lhag ma bdun phyin la// phyogs dang bdun las mang ba na// mda' bsres de yi mkha' raur dbri// lhag ma nyis bsgyur mkha' ros bgo /nor la me bsres 'dzin pa'i cha// khyim dang dbang phyug ril por 'dzin// phyogs la dkar cha mngon tsam lus// srin po mtshams dang 'jig rten la// bzhi gsum khyed dang bzhi cha gcig /de yi 'gros kyis shes par bya/ ༈ /yun ni ril por 'dzin pa'i tshe// chu tshod bcu gnyis bar du ste// phyed la drug sogs rigs pas dpyad// dus kyang nyi ma ji bzhin du// nor byin bcas pa'i tshes longs la// dus de'i nyin mo'i dbyug gus dbri// lhag ma mun mtshams nas bzung ste// de rnyed grangs bdas mtshams su 'dzin/ ༈ /phyogs ni zla bas gdong sbyangs sam// dus mes zla ba sbyangs pa na// nam phyad byang shar phyed gong byang*// phyed 'og shar la nye ba nas// gdong gis zla ba sbyangs pa'am// zla bas mjug sbyangs nam phyed nas// shar lho nas 'dzin phyed gong shar// phyed 'og lhag la nye ba nas// rgya skar bdag po sgrib par byed// phan tshun mnyam par 'gyur pa na// nam phyed shar gyi phyogs nas te// srid la dbang ldan nam smad me// nub nas nam yang 'dzin mi srid// gang bzung phyogs nas grib ma mdzad/

kha dog nyi ma'i skabs dang mtshungs// de ltar bshad pa de dag kyang*// zhib mo'i dbang du byas mod kyi// da dung shes par bya ba yod// 'dzin pa'i nges pa rnyed na yang*// rang gnas nyin sribs gar gtogs dang*// de yang ri la nye ring dang*// ri yang shar nub mtho dma' dang*// ri klung sa khad yangs dog dang*// lung pa'i shar nub lho byang dang*// lho byang nyi zla'i bgrod mtha' dang*// skabs de'i nyi zla 'char nub pa// legs par brtag pa gnad du che// tshes logs 'phel dang gdong 'dzin dang*// cha cher 'dzin tshe byur ba dang*/ tshes longs 'grib dang mjug 'dzin dang*// dum 'dzin bum par 'dzin pa ni// bshad pa bzhin du myong bas grub// byed rtsis lhag chad yod kyang 'dzin/ khyad par gnam gang chad pa'i tshe// tshes gcig la ni 'dzin pa mthong*// grub mtha'i 'artsis la nya stong dag /chad na nyi zla mi 'dzin pas// de phyir tshes kyi lhag chad sogs// zhib mor dpyad de mi 'khrul ba'i// nges pa rnyed nas smra bar byos// 'di dag re re'i don la yang*// rnam pa du mar legs dpyad nas// phal cher ri mas gtan la phan// de phyir 'khrul pa med snyam sem// nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi man ngag bar tu gsal bar byas pa ste le'u bdun pa'o/ ༈ /rdo rje'i nyi ma bden don bcu gnyis ldan// rdo rje'i zla ba de nyid bcu drug rig /rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul rnam pa nyi shus chub// rdo rje'i slob dpon mchog dngos grub de rgyal// gang gi byin rlabs nyi ma'i khu ba ni// zan brgyar 'thungs pa'i blo gros 'dab brgya pa// rnam dpyod spobs pa'i 'dzum dkar bzhad pa las// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i dga' ston tshar du dngar// grags 'byor lang tsho'i khur dman yang*// mkhas la 'os pa'i legs bshad gtam// sngon rab mdzangs pas ma myangs pa'i// dga' ston 'di 'dra yukyis bskrun// de las byung dang des mtshon pa'i/ kha ba dung dang kunda ltar// dkar ba'i bsod nams gang mchis pa// des ni srid gnas lus can kun// tshogs gnyis chu klung 'bul sdud cing*// mkhyen gnyis rin chen kun gyi bdag

/bden gnyis gangeng kas mdzis pa yi// rnam grol klu dbang de thob shog /ces rtsis kyi bstan bcos pad dkar bzhid pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba 'di yang lha sngags ye shes thams cad kyi khyab bdag dpal 'bri gung pa chen po gsang ba sngags kyi rig pa 'dzin pa chos kyi grags pa 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes snyan par grangs pa de'i zhabs rgyul spyi bos blangs pa'i byin rlabs kyi mthu kho na dang rtsis gzhi rtsoms zhig par rjes su gnang ba thob pa la brten nas mnga' ris stod du skyes pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi 'du 'dzis dben pa'i bsam gtan dang rjes su mthun pa'i bsti gnas rin chen brag gi bla brang du sbyar du sbyar ba dge legs su gyur cig /slad nas rab byung bcu gcig pa 'di nyid rang gi nang tshan me stag 'das lor bsgyur zhing*// gzhan rnam dpal ldan bla pa dkon lhun nyid kyi ljags sgrigs sor bzhag pa yang 'bri ban bha dras so/ ༈ gdod nas 'gyur med thabs mchog bde chen sku// shes rab stong nyid zung 'jug ye shes che// dang po'i sangs rgyas khyab bdag dus 'khor dang*// dbyer med rje btsun bla mar mgos phyag 'tshal// ji snyed shes bya'i tshos kyi chu gter cher// rmad byung mkhyen rab rlabs 'phreng mi zad pa// spro mkha'as gnas lnga rigs pa'i paṇḍi ta// dkon mchog lhun grub mtshan snyan dad pas bsngags// gang gis mkhyen daspyod las mthon skar rtsis kyi// gzhung bzang dpa ma dkar po bzhad pa'i phyir// zab don gsung gi nyin byed 'di shar tshe// blo ldan chu skyes 'dab brgya bart+sa par byed// 'dor byed grangs kyi ngas dub chu 'dzin gyis// lag len rgyu skar gtso bo sgrib pa'i tshe// lhag bsam dri gzhon shugs kyis slar bsam nas// rang lugs rtsi gzhung ri dwags rnam par bkra// 'dis mtshon rab dkar dge tshogs dun rgyu bhaḥ brtson 'grus dbyug gus bskul ba'i legs bshad sgra/

blo ldan thos 'dzin bdun rtsir 'gyur ba dang*// 'gro kun duḥkha'i gnyid las grol gyur cig /de ltar rtsis kyi bstan bcos dpar dkar bzhad pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta paṇa chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi ljogs sgrigs tshig don phun sum tshogs shing lag len khyer bde ba 'di nyid rgyal bdang dkon mchog 'phris bzang pos bar byung bcu cig pa'i mtha' zad pa me stag la 'das lo spos pa gnang 'dug kyang*// deng skabs 'das la brgyad nga po drug skor 'gro ba bcas 'dor byed grangs kyang ngal dub la brten pa'i rtsis pa rnams kyis lag len cher byed kyin mi 'dug par// des na rang lugs rtsis kyi bstan 'di nyid nyams pa'i rgyur mthong nas 'bri gung pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sngar rang lo bcu bdun pa sa sbrul lor slob dpon mkha' pa'i dbang dkon mchog don grub chos dbang gi drug nas/ byed grub lnga bsdus sgra bcan/ rtsis phran myur rtsis bskal li skor dang*/ mtshur lugs kyi gza' lnga dus sbyor sogs bslab sbyangs bgyis kyang*// na tshon stabs ha cang go don mtha' chod zhig ma byung ba/ slar yang chu lug lor slob dpon de nyid kyi gdan tshab nyin rdzong khri pa karma chos dbyigs lhun grub las bskyar gsos kyi'adas lo spo tshul sogs zhib tu dpyad de rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i sna tshogs chu rtar spos bstan rtsi cung zad bsnan// dbugs sgang khyim slebs ri phag ldog gnyis bcas gsar du bcug cing*/ gzhung tshig dngos paṇa chen gyi gsung por bzhag bgyis te dpal 'bri gung pa'i pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi gzims sbug tshe dbang dga' 'khyil du bris pa'i shog thog tu 'bebs pa po ni dge slong gu ṇa kā ra'o/ shu bham/ ༈ /dngul gdung lta babs mthong grol chen mo dang byin rlabs dpal 'bar zung gi lo rgyus mdor bsdus brjod pa dad pa'i me tog ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /rmad byung don gnyis lhun grub sangs rgyas gtso// lung dang rtogs pa'i gter gyur dam pa'i chos// rig dang grol ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun bcas// mchog gsum thugs rjes phun tshogs bkra shis stsol// rgyal ba'i bstan la ston pa gnyis pa mchog

/'phags pa'i yul gyi slob dpon klu zhabs nyid// gangs can rdzogs 'dir nges don bstan pa'i bdag /mgon po 'bri gung pa der phyag bgyi'o// rdam byung snying stobs dri gzhon gsar pa yis// gdul bya'i 'gro 'di'i tshwa gdung bar 'phrog pa// 'jigs rten kun la phan pa'i dbang phyug mchog /gang dang dbyer med rje bcun parmar 'dud// phyag na sher rab ral gri rnon po yis// rmongs pa'i dra ba thams cad gcod mdzad pa// bstan pa'i 'khor lo ngur smṛg 'dzin pa'i tshul// chos kyi rgyal mtshan de la cis mi 'dud// srid dang zhi ba'i dge laigs kun gyi mdzod// phan bde'i dpal ster yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal// bka' brgyud bla ma'i grags pa gdugs dkar can// srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar du 'khor der bsngags// mtha' yas stong pa chen po'i gar mkhan ma// mi 'gyur bde ba'i sgyu rtsal drug cu'i mdangs// gnyis med gnyis su 'char ba'i sgyu ma mkhan// dpal ldan 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog des skyongs// bar 'jigs stangs ziral ltar nag khros pa'i sku// rag gdangs gnam pa'i zhal gyi hom khung du// rab 'bar ljags kyi lcags dgra bgegs kun// rab bkug brlag mdzad ye shes mgon pos bsrungs// dpal ldan rgyal ba kun yum rnal 'byor ma// ma tshogs kun gyi gtso mo ḍākki'i rgyal// rgyal bstan yang snying bsrung ba'i mthu mnga' zhing*// zhing 'di'i lha mchog chos kyi sgrol mar 'dud// gzi brjed nyi ma'i snang bas mi 'gos shing*// phun tshogs dpal 'byor char rgyun rtag 'bab pa'i// sngon med nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya// 'gyed mkhas rnam thos sras des shis par mdzod// 'og min khang gsar yang dgon gtsug lag khang*// mi 'gyur lhun grub bkra shis bde ldan gyi// ngo mtshar rten mchog mthong grol chen mo dang*// byin rlabs dpal 'bar zung gi lo rgyus rnams// dkar 'jam shing gi ma ma'i yol go'i nang*// tshig don ngo mtshal skye ba lnga ldan pa'i/

yid ches yi ge'i ri mo g.yas 'khyil dung*/ thos 'dzin dpyid du sgra dbyangs 'dir 'khrol lo/ zhes snyan 'gyur shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus te/ de yang 'jig rten na sngon yang sgron skal dang*/ mun bskal grangs med bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig 'das shing*/ slad du'ang 'byung bar 'gyur ba las/ da ltar gyi sgron me'i bskal pa mchog 'di bskal pa bzang po zhes pa ste/ 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon par gsungs pa las/ bzhi par gyur pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub par 'khrung zhing mngon byang chub pa'i tshul bstan te/ de yang ston pa des chos kyi 'khor lo rim pa gsum mam bcu gnyis su bskor zhing*/ yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i rjes su bka' bsdu ba mdzad pa rnams las kyang brtsams te 'phags yul rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bstan pa ches cher rgyas par bstan 'dzin yang ston pa nyid kyis mdo rgyud nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs las lung bstan cing thub dbang nyid kyi sprul pa rtsod med yongs su grags pa 'phags mchog klu grub nyid byon zhing yod med kyi mtha' gnyis las 'das pa'i zab mo dbu ma'i bstan bcos chen po rnams brtsams/ dgung lo drug brgya'i bar bstan pa'i bya ba chen po mdzad nas re zhing bde ba can du gshegs shing*/ de la sogs pa'i paṇa grub bsam gyi mi yab pa byon/ de lta bī bstan pa rin po che bde kha ba can gyi rdzongs su dar ba'i tshul ni/ lha mo dri ma med pas zhus pa'i mdo las/ nga yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas la nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar gyi yul du dam pa'i chos bar 'gyur ro// zhes lung bstan pa ltar lo grangs de snyed song ba na dubs 'gyur 'chang nas bod lul 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar ba yin cing*/ de yang thugs rje chen po dang sgrol mas byin gyis rlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus pa'i phru gu gdong dmar sha zan gyi rigs la mi'i rgyal khams su gyur pa'i bod spyi'i rgyal po mang pos bskur ba'i brgyud las rgyal po dmag brgya pa'i sras rje gnya' khri btsan po nas bzung rgyal rab po gnyis kyi bar du byon pa rnams rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa sha stag dang*/

khyad par phyag na padma mi'i srid pa'i zlos gar can chos rgyal srong btsan sgam pos ra sa 'khrul snang gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa dang*/ rgya bal nas sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i shākyi mu ne dang*/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs spyan drangs// bod du yi ge'i bsrol btod/ de nas lau go dgu ma 'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan sku bltams nas mkhan slob gnyis spyan drangs te zan g.yangs mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs zhing lo paṇa du ma gdan ste rgyal bstan rim par dar ba'i mdo sngags bshad bsgrub kyi tshogs 'phel zhing rgyas po 'gyur la/ sgos su sgrub brgyud rin po che'i bstan pa ni rje mar mi yab sras nas lhag par gsal zhing*/ bye brag rje sgam po chen po nas bka' phyag chu bo nyis 'dres zhes phyag par du gyur pa sogs las kyang nang gses kyi bka' brgyud ji snyed cig 'phel ba thams cad kyang sangs kyi bka' tha ma nges pa don yi 'khor lo'i tshogs dang rgyal tsham byams pa'i rgyu bla ma sogs dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa rnams don gyi gtan la dbab pa gtso bor mdzad pa sha stag yin pa sogs nas/ bod yul 'dir yang bstan pa snga phyir dar ba de dag sngon 'phags yul du ji ltar de bzhin las kyang mod mi dman pa ltu'i bshad grub kyi bsrel 'dzin pa ni da lta'i bar du bsam gyi mi khyab cing*/ de las skabs 'dir brjod bya'i snying por gyur pa mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po'i bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin byon pa'i tshul ni/ de yang bcom ldan 'das kyi ye shes 'ongs su rgyal pa'i mdo las/ ma 'ongs pa dag rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ri rgyud du// mi yi 'dren pa rgyal ba chos kyi rje// rin chen dpal zhes bya ba 'byung 'gyur te// mi mchog de ni 'jig rten khams su grags// nga yi bstan la bya ba byed par 'gyur// zhes dang 'phags pa klu grub mya ngan las 'da' khar/

nyan thos ratna ā ka rar// 'di nas mi lo lnga brgya 'das pa na// byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs su// 'bri zhes bya ba'i bstan pa la// dge slong rin chen dpal gyi ming bzung nas// nga rang gi rtags dang mtshan ma bor bar yong*// zhes sogs lung bstan pa ltar// klu zhabs dam pa nyid spyir mi zad brgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rol gar 'khor ba ma stong bar rgyun mi chad kyang*/ bye brag gangs can pa rnams dang*/ khyad par byang 'bri gung gi 'gro ba rnams theg pa chen pos 'dul ba'i rigs can du gzigs te rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen dpal zhes 'ongs su grags pa de nyid kyi gdung rigs ni bod mi'u gdong drug gi nang tshan 'gru las brgyud pa dpa' bo so gad/ lha ma'i bu mo dang mnyam par rol ba'i sran nam mkha' nas bsgyur ba'i bsgyur ra gnal sbyin dkar por grags pa de las gdung rabs bdun pa'i thog tu rje rin po che nyid mod khasams grong khyer bcung ngur sku bltams/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal phag mo grub pa dang mjal bas bu chen gdugs thog pa lnga brgya'i nang nas nyid kyi gdan sar 'os pa dge bsnyen sa bcu par lung bstan/ zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos 'dzod rgya mtsho rnams bum pa gang byo'i tshul du mnos shing thugs nyams su bstar bas ji lta ji snyed thams cad ji bzhin mngon du gyur cing*/ phag grub dang sgam po'i gdan sa yang legs par bskyangs mthar/ rje phag mo gru pa'i slob ma mi nyag sgom rin gyi mthel gyi gnas gzhi phul ba bzhes te gling rin po che 'di nyid 'debs par mdzad pa yang sprin chen po'i mdo las// ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i 'tha' ma la// byang phyogs pa yi phyogs cha ru// 'bri zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su// rin chen dpal zhes bya ba yi// bde bar gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ ma rgyud dngos grub las// 'das pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad// ma 'ongs byon pa byams pa mgon// da ltar bzhugs pa shākya thub// kun gyi mtha' ni rin chen dpal// zhes dang*/

mdo las ma 'ongs pa'i dus byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi rgyud/ 'bri sgang rta 'chag ces bya bar dge slong rin chen dpal zhes pa 'dus pa 'uphal phrag bdun gyi dubs su nga'i bstan pa nyin mor byed pa zhig 'ong gi /zhes dang*/ padma bka'i thang yig las/ zhing khams rnam dag chos 'byung 'bri zhes par: sngags kyi ting 'dzin brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor ni: don dam ye shes dgongs pa mnga' brnyes pa: sngags bdag rin chen dpal zhes bya ba 'byung : zhes sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas gsungs pa'i bla ma rin po che 'di nyid kyi thel byang chub gling btab gnas 'di bya rgod phung po'i ring dang khyad par me cing nyid kyi yon tan kun tshang bar zhagal gyi bzhes shing 'dari tshe'i dus byas pa'i srog chags sbur yan chad kyang ngan song du mi gtong ba dang*// bla g.yel du phyin pa tsam yang don dang ldan pa'i dbu bsnyung bzhes pas lung pa bzho zhes phu shar dang mda' nub tu blta ba gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub cing sa gzhi padma 'dab brgyad gdal la ba'i lte bar 'bras kyi phung po sprungs pa lta bu'i ri rgya 'phan bzang lhun chags pa'i ngogs su rgyal ba gr+ya mtsho blti gnas rnam par mdzes pa'i lha bzhi tshang zhing dgra bzhis dben sa bkra shis pa'i rtag brgyad rang byung du bkra ba/ mdun na chu bo chen pos nā gardzu na zhes pa'i rang sgra 'byin pa// ri 'di nyid du bsgrub pa'i chu mig brgya rtse brgyad mi chad par 'bab pa// zla ma yi dal sangs rbayas sems rnam mchod pa'i yul du spyin ltar bstabs pa// lha klu gnod sbyin sogs mchod byed kyi skye dgu rul phran ltar gtams pa// bsil ba tshal dang mi gnyis pa'i dur khrod chen po dang bcas par// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung dregs byed thams cad rlung ltar 'tshub 'phrin las bzhi bar med du bsgrub pa ste mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs shing byin brlabs rmad du byung ba'i gnas 'dir chos kyi seng ge'i khri chen por sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpal 'jig rten gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba/

mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po rin chen dpal gyi zhabs zung bkod de 'dus pa khri phrag bar nges pa don gyichos kyi 'khor los smin cing grol bar mdzad// rgya dkar nag sogs 'dzam gling na che ba'i rgyal po rnams kyis bkar ba ma zad tshangs pa dang brgya sbyin sogs lhag klu gnod sbyin dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten kun gyis kyang mchod pa dang bsod nams kyi zhing du gyur cing*/ ngo mtshar gyi matag sum cu so bdun sogs rmad byung gi mdzad pa blo'i yul las 'das pa bstan nas dgung lo don lnga par mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du gshegs pas dbe gshegs dri med dkar por gyur rjes/ rje 'di nyid kyi 'jigs med chos kyi seng ge'i khri chen por gdan sa dang po mkhan chen gu ra ba sogs nas bung gdan mu tig gi 'phreng ba lta bu mtshar du dngar ba byon pa las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun 'phags dpal brtsegs kyi rgyal po sa bcu'i dbang phyug sems dpal chen po spyan ras gzigs kyi tshul bzung nas gang la gang 'dul gyi 'gro ba'i don du bkod bgrangs 'das ston pa'i nang tshan kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su/ mes dbon rnam gsum gatsho rgyur gyi bod chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnams dang*// 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas la sogs pa'i gdul bya'i khams dang dbang por 'tshal pa'i sku'i bkod pa ji snyed pa dang*/ khyad par 'bri gung 'dir rje skyob pa rin po che'i skabs rin chen byang chub sogs/ gdan rab gsare gyi 'phreng bar yang srid rim par brgyud mthar/ rab 'byums rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bkra shis gsum ldan rtsa ba'i zla ma tshaman brjod par dka' ba rje btsun bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan 'jigs med 'phris phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde dang*/ sngon 'das pa'i dus de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu'i rigs mchog dang*// da ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs mos par rab tu dga' ba'i snying po nor bu rin chen brtsegs pa'i rgyal po nyid ma 'ongs pa na rdzogs pa'i sangs mgon po katsan tu gzigs zhes bya bar 'gyur bas na/

zla gsang 'dus pa'i tand+ra'i le'u dru cu pa las/ nga ni dus gsum 'byung ba'i sku// sangs rgyas kyi sngon du 'byung*// nga ni dus gsum phyis kyi 'byung*// ma 'ongs bstan pa'i snying por 'byung*// nga ni dus gsum da lta 'byung*// da lta mngon du 'gyur ba'i lha// zhes rgyas par gsungs pa'i de ltar rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs ni dus gsum mngon par sangs shing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yab yum spyi mes lta bur gyar kyang*/ zhing 'dir bskal bzang rnam 'dren shā kya'i rgyalo pa'i bsnyan la rgyal ba'i sras kyi mthu bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu zur phud lnga ldan nyid 'gro ba'i don du 'phags bod kun la spyil pa'i skyes mchog bgrang yas kyi sku'i skyes ba du ma dang*/ khyad par mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po rin chen dpal gyi drung spyan snga grags 'byung du gyur cing*// slar yang lha babs skyu ra'i gdung las rdo rje rin chen sogs sku'i yang srid du ma'i mthar rje btsun zla ma mtshungs med mchog sprul bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde bcas dam pa zung*/ yab sras dang bla res slob res kyi tshul du byon cing da res kyi skabs 'dir yab sras gdan 'dzom gyis gdul bya'i khams dang dbang por 'tsham pa'i mdo sngags chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po bskor nas skal ldan du ma thar lam la 'god cing dwags brgyud bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres kyi bstan pa rin po che 'od zer brgya pa'i snang ba ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i skabs re zhig na/ myang 'das chen po bam po bzhi pa las/ rigs kyi bu nga ni 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir yang dang yang mya ngan las 'das pa bstan kyang*/ mthar yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ma yin te// so so skye bo dag gi de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par bgogs par zad do snyam ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni mthar zad pa ma yin pas mi 'pho ba'i chos can du rigs par bya'o/

zhes 'chi 'pho dang mya ngan las 'das pa gtan nas med kyang gdul bya rnams smin par bya phyir/ sgyu 'phrul las ma rig smin mdzad 'dul ba'i phyir/ 'byung nas mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ zhes dang gsares 'od le'u gnyis pa las/ sems can yongs su smin mdzad phyir// yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar ston/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dpal ldan bla ma dam pa gtis ka nges don du rdo rje'i sku la skye 'jig mi mnga' yang*/ rtag par 'dzin pa rnams chos la 'askul ba sogs thabs la mkha'as pas dran dang shes bzhin du/ rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang mtshan yi zad ces pa me khyi dbo zla'i nang zhag nyi shu bar khyad las med pa na rjes kyi re zhig gzugs sku rags pa'i za ma tog bdag sogs gdul bya'i tshogs gnyis kyi rten du bzhag nas chos sku 'od gal bde ba chen po'i klong du thim tshul bstan pa ni sangs rgyas rnams kyi mdzad pa yin la// 'di la nges don du bsags sbyangs kyi spros pa dben kyang*/ thugs kyi dgongs pa zag pa med pa bstan 'gro'i don du rdzogs pa dang*/ drang don du bdag cag rjes 'jug rnams dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi tshogs gnyis kyi sa bon bskrun cing zhing 'dir bstan 'gro'i mgon du mchog gi sprul sku gsal dwangs myur phebs kyi ched du ma zad/ las brgya'i bam po nyer brgyad par/ ston pa 'khor ba 'jig 'jig rten du byon te/ zhes pa nas phung po lhag ma med pa mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas kyang rgyal po mdzes pa'i sku gdung la mchod pa byas te// zhes sogs sku gdung gi 'gro don mdzad pa dang*/ mdo sde skal bzang las/ sku gdung ni ril po gcig tu'o/ rgyas par 'gyur ro*/ zhes pa ltar de bzhin gshegs pa rnams mya ngan las 'das nas sku gdung gi 'gro don rgya cher mdzad par gsungs ltar bdag cig gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag zung gi sku gdung dang ring bsrel gyis 'gro don mdzad pa skabs su ches pa'i las kyi mtha' brjod pa'i mdo las/

sprul pa mdzad pa sngon bstan phyir/ mchod rten brgyad du sku gdung bzhag /zhes gsungs pa ltar gdung khang rten 'brel gyi sgo du ma mtshon phyir dri ma med pa'i mdo nas dbe gshegs chos sku mchod rten b.ragayad gsungs pa kun mkhyen bu ston dang*/ brag nag pa dpal ldan legs dbang gi mdzad pa/ rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi grags pas legs par bkral ba'i yig cha las/ ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i gnas yangs pa can gsal ldan du lha'i dbyar gnas mdzad yum la chos gsungs/ snga dro dgag dbye mdzad phyi dro nam mkha' las babs nas pheb dus gsal ldan dad pa can gyi bzhengs pa'i lha babasam/ yang na sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i mched rten du grags pa phyag tshad sogs 'phrul pa'i dri ma dang bral ba 'di nyid rje zla ma dam pa zung gi bya grub ye shes kyi ngo bor dbang bskur ba sgom pa'am 'phris kyi bdag nyid chen po phyag mdzod dkon mchog don yod kyi khur bzhes gatsho bor gyur pa'i las byed khung 'brel tshang mas lhag bsam gcig bsgril kyi kun nas blang ste/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nang tshan thams cad 'dal zhes me phag dbo zla'i dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba gnyis pa yan lag lnga'i 'bras bu dge ba'i nyin dbu 'jug par/ rgyu rtsa'i do dam dang thig tshad bzo bkod sogs mgo pa bdag la bgyis dgos phebs pa bzhi dwang len zhus te sbrel zlar lde 'char dkon mchog dang*/ rang zhabs kyi dkar bzo dbu che chung bying mi bdun bal bu dbu mdzad shing rta maka rang dang an dza bcas brdung 'phrul la mkhas pa gnyis dang*/ phra bzo mkhas pa gnyis bos te khyon bal bod kyi bzo bo bcu gsum dang*/ ri mo ba sgar grwa byams pa tshe ring*/ shing bzo dbu mdzad mgon po/ dbu chung rtse grwa smin grol byings mi gsum bcas khyon lnga'i bzo grwa btsug pa'i dngul gdung rin po che mthong grol chen mo dang*/ byin rlabs dpal 'bar bcas sku tshad thog gnyis ma gsare gdugs zung bcas sdebs su bzhengs pa'i kun 'dzin ces pa sa pho byi ba'i lor lha babs zla ba'i mgor ha lam grub par/

sku gdung rin po cho dang lhan cig gza' tshes dge ba'i nyin gdan pa chen po 'bri thel byang chub gling du gdan drangs pa dang chab cig skyabs mgon rgyal tsham rgyal tshab lho sprul rin po che chibs kha bskyod pa'i zla ba de kha'i tshes nyin/ snga lo rje dbon phyag zur rin chen mchog ldan ngag dang*/ sde mgron dkon mchog ye shes zung gi lhag bsam dung dang kudna ltar ches dkar gyi sgo nas rgyu rtse dang do dam phyogs mtshungs bdag gir mdzad pa'i mchod sdong bzhugs yul ka ring drug thig khang dang bcas thog tshad gsum pa sgo khang ka gnyis kyi rgya khyon 'khor pa bcas nyer rmang bting nas bzung tshon rtsi bar gyi bgyi bar 'os pa gang na ci yod gtong phod kyi sug pa ring por skyong ba'i bsra brtan dngos dag phun sum tshogs ka kun gyi spyod yul du gyur pa 'di nyid bskrun par mdzad cing*/ rab gnas mnga' dbul skabs mi 'gyur lhun grub bkra shis bde ldan gyi gtsug lag khang zhes mtshan gsal ba ga la ba der bgegs bskrod sngon 'gro bas rten 'brel gyi sgo du ma dang bcas bzo rigs rnams 'dus te mtshod sdong chen mo'i skar gnon dgos rigs kyi mgo brtsam pa nas bzung*/ thog ma 'di nyin nas sa 'dzin shing bsgrigs dang*/ 'og tu 'chad rgyu bzhin gzungs rnams yas 'dzeg yas bsgrigs rim bzhin bgyis pa'i bum smad bsgrigs bsdun/ de sngon nas saku gdung rin po che sbyangs khrus sngon du 'gro bas rgyu sde bzhi bsgril gyi bzang gos dmar por po na'i snying po'i gnas yig so sor phul te ka ci sman dri bzang pos sbrag dkris shing dar gos du ma phul bas/ 'jam dpal gshin rje bshed kyi dkyil 'khor du bskyed chog grub pas/ skabs 'dir bum nang du gdan drangs te ras bris kyi padma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol nas gur las/ rdo rje dril bu lag par sbyin/

mgo bor dbu rgyan bkon par bya/ zhes la ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gdung mchod yul lha'i ngo bor grub pas/ bzang gos las grub pa'i stod g.yogs smad g.yogs dang*/ rje gong ma na rim gyi dbang chas gras pha rgyud nas gsungs pa'i shel rgyan sku drog zhu rigs lnga dar dbyangs stod rgyan smad rgyan phyag zhabs kyi gdub bu dang*/ rje nyid kyi rgyun mchod snam sbyar sogs longs spyod sku 'khor los bsgyur ba'i sku chas rnams phul zhing*/ phyag tu dhor dril dang mgul phur/ phyag phreng rin chen du mas spud pa'i mgul rgyan phreng ba/ sku dpang dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i spyod/ sku mdun du thugs dam gyi gtso bo 'jam dpal dus dgra'i dbang po'i mchod gtor sman rags mchod pa dang*// spungs kar gyi gang ba'i snod sogs ji snyed rtsis rgyud nas gsungs pa'i rten 'brel gyi dgos gal rnams kyang tsharang ba dang*// mtha' skor du chu nyer spyod dngos su tshar bzhi dang*/ bum pa'i nang log 'khor mar chu gnyis nyer spyod/ 'dod yon lnga sgeg brgyad/ rig ma bcu drug sogs mchod rdzos 'dzin pa'i lha mo rnams kyi bris sku dang*/ bkra shis rtag rdzas rin chen bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i bye brag mtshar du dngar ba bkod cing*/ gzungs kyi rim pa la yang rje chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa rig bsrel lnga'i bzhugs tshul tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho bzhin 'khrul med phyag len gyi brgyan te nyams su blang ba la yang*/ 'dir sku gdung rin po che'i stams srog zhing gyus gcig gi ma bde ba'i lhu gsum du byas shing*/ srog shing gi gnas yig dang sngags rnams mtshal gyi lha'i ye ge sha stag dang*/ rnam rgyal dang*/ dri med 'od kyi sngags la sogs pa rtsanye mod dang*/ thugs ka rtsa bar gzhug rgyu rnams so so tshar lnga bcu re dang*/ chos 'khor gzungs sogs grangs gong bzhin srog shing la legs par dkris/
