srog shing 'bul dus klag par bya ba dri med 'od kyi mchod rten rab gnas kyi sngags dang bcas srog shing phul nas/ de yang chos kyi sku'i ring bsrel/ yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel/ chos kyi ring bsrel/ sku gdung gi rig bsrel/ sku bal gyi ring bsrel te rnam pa lnga las/ gtso bor gyur pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rje bla ma bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan mchog gyi sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po dang mtshungs pa ma nyams hril por bzhugs pa sku gdung ring bsrel dngos dang*/ yungs 'bru ltu'i rig bsrel la/ ston pa shākya thub pa'i 'phale gdung*/ sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi ring bsrel/ sras dar ma mod sde'i dbu klad las 'khrungs pa'i ring bsrel/ rje 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i ring bsrel/ rje rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po'i 'phel gdung*/ rje bcun chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi 'phel gdung rnams bzhugs so/ sku bal ring bsrel bzhugs pa'i tshul la thog mar// sangs rgyas dang*/ dgra bcom pa sha ri'i bu mo'u 'gal gyi bu/ 'char ka rnams kyi snam sbyar/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi tshems/ byang chub kyi shing siṅga gling gi dgra bcom pa'i tshems dang*// snam yar bcas pa dang thub pa'i bstan pa la bshad sgrub gnyis las/ bka' brgyud rin po che spyi'i dam rdzas la rje lilli pa chen pos 'og min mkha' 'gro 'i gsang mdzod nas spyan drags pa'i dam rdzas rol pa chen po gter byon/ paṇa chen nā ro ta pa'i snyan rgyan/ lha brag mar pa'i tshems ber seg ge 'gying bsnal gyi dum bu yum bdag med ma'i na bza'/ nā ro'i phyag ḍam gyi cod paṇa mkhro stong gi skra las bya pa phyis rje mar pas bod du bsnams pa/ bdag med ma'i tshangs skra dang bsres te phyog dar phyag dar gyi 'dzas mdzad pa mar mi yab sras thun mong gi gsol zhal phye ma/

rje mi la'i ral gu mnyam med dwags po'i dbu skra/ 'gro mgon phag gru'i tshems/ gsol zhal dum bu/ phya'u'i dum bu bcas/ dwags po bka' brgyud kyi snying por gyur pa don brgyud 'bri gung pa chen po zhes chos ltar bcos pa rnams kyi bsre slad dang bral zhing mi dbar khyis ma chod pa grub thob mu tig tsar la brgyud pa ltar byon cing khyad par bcu gsum bar du ma bsgom sangs rgyas kho na 'byon par grub dbang padma 'byung gnas kyi lung bstan pa 'bri gdan chen mo rang gi byin rlabs bskor la rje skyob pa rin po che'i tshems kyi dum bu/ dbu skra sku 'gags spyan snga grags 'byung gi phyag sen dang na bzang phya'u/ gcung rin po che'ipdabu skra na bza' bcu gnyis pa rdo rje rin chen gyi gdung rus/ nyer brgyad pa rdo rje rgyal po'i phyag 'phreng bzhugs gdan/ nyer gnyis pa chos kyi rgyal po'i gdung rus na bza'/ chos rgyal rin chen dpal bzang gi gdung rus shangs tshal dbyangs rin chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dbu skra/ rje kun dga' rin chen gyi dbu skra /dbu zhwa rin chen phun tshogs kyi dbu skra tshogs/ sku sha mgul ru ba'i lung phyag 'phreng*/ snam sbyar zhabs phyag tshams pa spur ras/ des bsgrub pa'i bde 'dus chos sman /paṇa chen dpal gyi rgya mtsho'i gdung rus/ rin chen rnam rgyal gyi gdung rus/ yab chos rgyal phun tshogs kyi sku me brdug ma/ gdung rus/ dbu skra/ sprar ras phyag phreng mgul khug shangs phyis bka' brgyad chos sman/ nā ro bkris phun tshogs kyi phyag 'phreng*/ gdung rus/ dbu skra gdung thal des bsgrub pa'i bde 'dus sman sgrub/ rje chos dbyings rang grol dbu skra gdung rus na bza' gdung tsha gdung thal shang tshal rgyal bdang thams cad mkhyen pa dharma ki rti'i sku sngags chas dus kyi dbu skra/ rab byung dus kyi dbu skra/ gdung rus gdung tsha sprur ras shang phyis tshems phyag sen chibs sga'i a 'jogs/

rdor phreng tshar gnyis kyi nang mchod ril bu 'phel ba/ bka' dgongs kyi sgrub chen gnang ba'i chos sman rigs mang ba/ skye bdun sgrub ril*/ rje ratna nas chos kyi grags pa yin gyi zhal ngo na rim gyi phyag dreg can be'u bum gyi tshas/ dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po'i dbu skra na bza' shang phyis sku tshal dbu g.yang*/ sku sha gdung rus/ gdung thal gdung tshwa spru ras rnyan ra bka' dgongs nas bsgrub pa'i chos sman/ yig drug sgrub ril/ rje chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu lo/ na bza' sku tshal gdung rus gdung thal gdung sol gdung tshwa na bza' 'bu ras gzan/ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi dbu lo/ na bza' sne mang*/ gdung rus mdung tsha/ dam pa zung gi bsgrub pa'i bka' brgyad chos sman/ rje bcun chos kyi nyi ma'i dbu lo bub/ na bza' gos ras mang ba/ phyag 'phreng sku sha me brdug ma/ gdung rus gdung tsha/ des bsgrub pa'i bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi sman sgrub/ bla ma nor bu rgya mtsho'i sgo nas bsgrub pa'i badzra sgrub ril/ thugs rje chen po rgyal lugs kyi sgo nas bsgrub pa'i yig drug ril bu/ rje bla ma dam pa nyid kyi dbu lo bub gsum/ gdung tshwa dang*/ gdung chabs ril bu phon che ba/ ljags bsnyen grangs mang song ba'i phyag phreng bho dhi rtsi cha tshang*/ zhal 'don phyag dpe la tshan bcu bskor phyag dreg shin tu che ba/ phyag ḍar phan bcas sku dreg byin can/ gsol zhal /gsol dkar chos kyi nyi ma'i rnam thar smad cha'i zin bris phyag bris ma/ snyan rwa gzhan yang sku'i nye dpyad byin can tshogs/ dar gos dang ras cha'i rigs kyi na bza' phoran che ba bcas dang*/ rnying ma'i bskor la o rgyan rin po che'i dbu skra/ zab ber chos sman gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems dkar dmar/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra/ za hor rgyal po gtsug lag 'dzin gyi gdung rus rig 'dzin shrī singha'i chos sman/

mkhan po bho dhi sa twa'i tshems kyi dum ba/ chos rgyal khri srong gi phyag 'phreng*/ zab ber bai re'i dbu skra /gter ston o rgyan gling pa'i sku sha/ dre med lhun po'i sku sha/ kun skyong gling pa'i phyag ngar*/ mnga' bdag myang gibade 'dus shog ser/ khro nag shog ser/ sras padma dbang chen gyi sku sha/ ratna gling pa'i shog ser// padma las 'brel stsal gyi shog ser// bsam gtan gling pa'i shog ser/ sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter shog /klong chen pa'i gdung rus/ grub thob me long rdo rje'i tshegs/ thang stong rgyal po'i dbu skra/ mnga' ris paṇa chen padma dbang rgyal gyi dbu skra/ bdud 'joms rdo rje'i dbu skra/ tshems dbu zhwa/ 'phreng mgo gter ston gyi dbu skra/ shog ser/ rigs 'dzin gter bdag gling pa'i shog ser/ gter byon dam rdzas/ des bsgrub pa'i chos sman dang*/ gdung rus chos rje gling pa'i shog ser dang*/ gter byon nam rdzas mang ba/ gdung rus spur ras/ dbu skra des bsgrub pa'i chos sman/ bya khyung pa shes rab dpal/ dpal 'bar dbang phyug /chos rgyal bkris/ ngag dbang padma/ padma bstan 'dzin rnams kyi gdung rus dang*/ ngag dbang sadma'i dgongs 'dus spyi bsgril dung mthon pa'i phyag 'phreng dhog /byang bdag bkris stobs rgyal/ byang sprul padma 'phrin las gnyis kyi chos sman rnams so/ bka' dam pa'i bskor la/ jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdung nag shangs tshal sag dril gyi nang dar/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyi gdung*/ rngog lo tsā ba'i dbu skra/ pu to ba chen po'i thugs/ zhang sha ra ba'i dbu skra/ bya 'chad kha ba'i na bza'*/ se spyil bu'i snam sbyar rnams dang*/ gzhan yang dpal chen rga lo tsa ba'i gdung*/ sku sham kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i snam sbyar/ bu ston rin chen grub kyi na bza'/ ma gcig lab sgron gyi na bza' mkhro bsod nams dpal 'dren gyi dbu klad/ zhang sum thog pa'i dbu skra/

rgyal dbang rgod tshang pa'i dbu skra/ grub chen o rgyan pa'i gdung*/ karma chos dbyings rdo rje'i phya'u/ ye shes rdo rje chos dbyings rdo rje mi bskyod rdo rje dbang phyug rdo rje/ byang chub rdo rje rnams kyi na bza'/ zhwa dmar chos grags kyi phyag 'phreng lung*/ zhwa dmar drug pa'i dbu skra/ tre bo chos kyi snying po'i dbu skra/ chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dbu skra/ sgam po bkra shis rnam rgyal gyi gdung rus/ sprur dar nor bu brgyan pa'i dbu lo/ gdung rus bzang po rdo rje'i gdung rus/ 'brug pa padma dkar po'i gdung rus/ gdung tsha mi pham dbang po'i na bza' spur dar/ mi pham bkris blo gros kyi na bza' dbu lo/ lho pa phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi dbu skra/ drung pa rin chen dpal gyi dbu skra/ mkhan chen byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi dmu skyes/ mkhan chen rnam 'joms gdung*/ yongs 'dzin sangs rin chen gyi dbu skra/ bla ma rin po che ba log pa'i dbu skra/ sku gdun pa ngag dbang ye shes grub pa'i gdung*/ lho 'phris rnam rgyal gyi dbu lo na bza'/ gdung rus dbu g.yang phyag 'phreng lho chos kyi rgya mtsho dang*/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mgar chos kyi nyi ma bcas kyi gdung rus/ gzhan yang skam tshang*/ 'brug pa/ stan lug bka' brgyud snying khung gi dam rdzas dang sku bal ring bsrel sogs nyi snyed pa dang*/ rgya gar bal po/ bod yul sogs kyi gnas chen gnas phran du ma'i sa rdo chu shing sogs 'dzem cha ba dang*/ sku rten gras/ rje btsun dam zung gi phyag tsha phyag nas ma'i gras/ 'od dpag med gatsho 'khor gsum pa gsum slob dpon che chung brgyad/ spyan ras gzigs bcu gcig zhal lnga*/ phyag bzhi pa gsum/ 'jam dbyangs che chung brgyad/ tshes dpag lnga/ sgra mi nyan pa lnga*/ mi 'khrug pa gcig dhor sems che chung drug /rta mgrin phyag dhor gnyis lnga re/ lcags sdig yang bzlog re re/ sgrol dkar sngon so so lnga re/

seng gdong ma lnga/ mgon po a phyi rnam sras rnam rai/ rje zla ma mchog gi gdung tshwa dang gdung chab la sman dang rin po che'i rigs sogs bsres pa'i spar sku/ slob dpon gatsho 'khor gsum pa drug cu re dgu /sman bla mched bcas dgu/ rnam rgyal ma bcu gcig bcu gcig zhal nyer bzhi/ gshin rje yang bzlog po gcig tsha bdag nyer gnyis bcas dang*/ gser zangs lam ma mkhar rag gi sku gras/ thub dbang gi sku che chung bcu gnyis/ byams pa'i sku gnyis/ rdo rje 'chang gcig sgrol dkar sngon gnyis/ tshe dpag med gcig 'jam dpal gcig phyag dhor zhi drag gnyis/ mkha' 'gro gnyis/ phag mo gcig padmasam bha gcig chos kyi nyi ma'i sku gcig stag lug thang pa'i sku gcig bla sku gnyis bde mchog mkha' 'gro brgyad gras/ spyan ras gzigs dhor sems mar me mdzad/ mgon po yab yum/ thub dbang dzhi kṣiṃ sku gcig rnam snang lcags sku gcig gsang 'dus tsham dan gyi sku gcig mi la'i dho sku gcig sman 'jig gyi sku'i gras/ sman 'jig gyi sku gras slob dpon sku tshab byin can/ blon dpon padma sam bha/ spyan ras gzigs sman bla grol dkar thub dbang*/ smi ti phyag tsha'i bde mchog chos rgyal phun tshogs/ dkon mchog rin chen kling chen pa'i sku byin can rnams dang gsung rten gras/ chos saku chos kyi ring bsrel bskor/ thog mar bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bul la/ mgon po 'bri gung pa'i gdan gdung rtogs pa byin brlabs don gyi brgyud pa'i rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum so so tshar lngabacu re phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ nā ro'i chos drug rje 'bri gung pa chen po'i zab chos/ bde mchog ska lo lha lnga/ bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa/ dgongs pa yang zab yang bzlog me'i spu gri/ khro chu gu ru drag po drang srong log tri/ gtsug tor dgu pa/ mi 'khrug pa/ so thar mkhan brgyud/ dpal mgon phyag bzhi/ a phyi chos kyi sgrol ma'i brgyud rim sogs so so tshar bris pa gsum re dang*/

bde mchog po par ma dang*/ gzhan mtshan sngags bsdus pa/ sangs rgyas rab bdun/ sangs rgyas stong dang*/ rigs lnga'i gzungs/ rnying ma'i bla brgyud/ gnas brtan rnams tshar lnga bcu re dang*/ badzra gu ru sum khri lnga stog bzhi brgya bcu gsum/ dhor phreng bla med skyus gcig tu byas pa nyis brgya/ dbyangs gsal bde mchog lha lnga drug cu pa ma brgyud bskor gnyis med dus 'khor ma rgyud kha sbyor dhor sems ye shes mkhro dgyes dhor tshon can bdag med ma ku ru kulle/ rdo rje bdud rtsi ma hā ma ya thod pa bde mchog phag mo gang ma bzhi gur sgrol sgyu dra gur rigs bsdus 'khor lo sgyur drag gsang 'dus 'jam dhor gsung 'dus mi bskyod pa rdo rje hūṃ mdzad dgra nag dhor dbyings chos dbyings gsung dbang*/ gtsug dgu 'od zer spyan ma gzungs grwa lnga ston phrag nyi shu lnga sa sher snyong pa ma rgyud kha sbyor dhor sems dgyis dhor bcas so so tshal lnga bcu re 'jam dpal zhi khro so so tshal brgyad cu re/ bka' brgyad gtso bod dgu cig dril cig stong nyis brgya dgu bcu go bzhi /pha rgyud phreng bdun dang*/ gsang 'dus dgongs 'das yang zab gshin rje/ logatri khro chu nā raka he ru ka'i yig brgya ma rgyu ye shes thig le/ ye shes snying po/ phyag chen thig le/ gnyis med mtshan brjod 'jam dpal gdong drug gtum po khyung sham gzungs chen bzhi gtsug tor dri med gzungs thung gtsug dgu kun rigs dhor dbyings ye shes thig le gdung dkar rnying ma sna tshogs rnam snang mi bskyod rig 'byung 'od dpag med don grub spyan ma ki gos dkar mo sgrom khams gsum rnam rgyal phyag dhor spyod rgyud skor dril ba 'od zer dri med sumbha ni phyag dhor gos sngon bya rgyud ra dril sngags so so tshar lnga bcu re/ sman bla'i gzungs sum brgya/ sme brtsegs drug brgya lo byon chig stong stong dgu brgya lnga bcu/

rab gnas sngags rigs gsum so so nyis stong sum brgya brgyad cu/ mchod rten bye ba'i gzungs gso sbyongs sangs rgyas bar bdun gso sbyong mdo gzugs sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa/ spyan ras gzigs kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad/ shes rab bskyed pa'i sngags sdig pa zhi bar byed pa'i sngags byams pa'i mtshan bagr+ya rtse brgyad pa bdag bsrung ba'i sngags nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtse brgyadapa kun tu bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ phyag dhor gyi mtshan rtsa brgyad pa/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi mtshan brgya rtse brgyad pa/ 'jam dkyi gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ thos thams cad kyi yum gyi sngags bdud bskrag par byed pa badzra pa ṇi don zhag phar byin drug sogs/ nor byaragayal pa gzhal med khang gi gzung*/ yangs pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa /sgrol ma'i snying po sgrol ma'i brgya rtse brgyad pa sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyobs/ sdang ba thams cad zhi bar byed pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba rims nad rab tu zhi ba sangs rgya bcu gnyis pa'i mdo sngags sher phyin ke'u shi ka bcings grol gza'i g.yu 'phags pa rten cing 'bre 'byung gi snying po*/ rnam par snang mdzad 'od kyi rgyal po /rgyal ba'i bla ma las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyong ba/ bde ldan 'jam dpal zhag nas gsungs pa rnams kyi sngags rnams so so lnga bcu re/ wa gi shwa ra nyis khri nyis stong sum brgya so lnga*/ 'jam dpal gyi smed btsug pa dang*/ spyan ras padma cod pa tshul khrims rnam dag dug sel ma sgrol mas dam bcas pa nor bu gr+yas pa'i gzungs sangs rgyas kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las grol ba/ 'jam dbyangs smra seng 'jam dpal gyi sdig pa zad par byed pa'i gzungs rnams lnga bcu re/ 'jam dpal zhi ba bzhi brgya dang brgyad/ a ra tsa chig khri chig stong bzhi bagr+ya bzhi bcu yig drug chig 'bum chig khri bzhi stong bdun brgya

spyan ras gzigs yin bzhin 'khor lo'i rtse sngags/ spyan ras gzigs ha ya ghṛ ba'i snying po/ dmyal ba sogs 'jigs bagr+yad grol ba/ bar ched sel ba bde ba can du skye ba bde ba can du 'gro ba'i lam bstan pa/ 'chi med rnga sgra rnams lnga bcu re/ tshes gzungs bzhi stong bdun brgya don brgyad/ yang dbyangs gsal brgya yig brgya dgu brgya drug cu/ ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya sum brgya lnga bcu/ sor 'brang drug brgya lnga bcu ye shes mgon po gtso 'khor bagr+ya dang lnga bcu/ bstan srung dbyings phyug ma brgya dang lnga bcu/ dpal mgon bdun cu dang rnam sras rnams lnga bcu re rigs pa phug ron rgyas pa drug stong bdun brgya lnga bsdus pa bdun brgya lnga bcu/ 'dod gsol spyi khyi par ma rgyas bsdus gnyis so so lnga bcu re dang*/ 'di skabs 'bri stag sngar nas thugs nang dkar ba ma tshad da res skyabs rje dam pa zung dang thugs yid gcig 'dres su gyur pa bcas dpal stag lung pa chen po ngag dbang bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi 'byung gnas mchog gi ljags brtsoms srid zhi'i legs tshogs 'grub pa'i smon lam tshigs bcad 'dod 'byung yid bzhin tshar gsum dang*/ tshig lhug bla ma yi dam sangs byang sems chos srung nor sogs sde mtshan so sor tshar gsum re/ yig drug bzang 'phrul ma bcas dang*/ chos kyi bskor bskal bzang tshar lnga brgyad stong pa lnga rnying ma'i brgyud mi la'i mgur 'bum bstan dgongs ma ṇi bka' 'bum 'akab gdams pha chos bu chos/ dwags po mthar brgyun/ dgyes dhor bskor gsang 'dus dus 'khor rang byung rdo rje'i bka' 'bul nā raka dong sprug rje 'phrin las bzang po'i rnam thar smad cha dor grub chos kyi rgyal po'i ljags brtsoms kyi zin bris phyag bris ngo ma bcas rnams so so pod re/ brgyad stong pa tshar lnga gzungs bsdus gnyis mongan rtogs rgyan lnga gral lnga drug tog gzungs lnga

gsar 'od bcu thar then gnyis sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum gsum bde mchog rgyud gnyis dri med bshags rgyud gnyis skal bzang rgyan 'phreng drug dhor gcod gnyis sdud pa gnyis bka' thang sher brag bco lnga sde lnga lnga bcas dang thugs rten bskor pad sprun rgya gar ma gnyis bka' dam mchod rten gcig gter phur gcig khyad par gnas chen du ma'i pa dho sne 'dus sman dar rin po che'i rigs sogs bsres par rje btsun bla ma dam pa'i spur tsha dang gdung chab sogs mang bar grub pa'i tshwa tshwa mchod brgya ma che ba bdun cu don gsum/ chung ba gcig bcas de ltar nang gzungs tshar mar sngon nas rtsa gsum bdag bum la brten pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa gnad smin song grub pa de dag so so gnas ma 'chol zhing ma 'khrug ma 'dzings ma log pa bar mtshams rnams su/ tsā ri gter sgrom rwa bsgreng sogs gnas ched du ma'i shing sna dar ras kyi tshas dang bcas legs par bkang bas sengs dbar rnams su dre bzang gi phye ma dang sman spos kyi phur mas bar mtshams med pa gtams pas dam zhing mkhregs bca' ga lag tshags mthon zhing yid gzhung pa byas pa'i mtshams dar sogs song rjes*/ sreng khrir dpal bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa gnod sbyin pho mo'i 'khor lo kun mkhyen bu dang rgyal dbang chos kyi grags pa'i phyag len gyi rgyun ltar mdzod gos ser po rgyu bzang kha rer bris pa bskyod bsdim bsgrub pa zhag bdun sngon du 'gro bas zhagal sbyar zhing*/ dar ser pa'i na bza' bcas bzhugs su gsol ba'i 'og tu/ lnga mtshan lngas gatsho bor gyur pa'i po nā'i dong rtse dang*/ thig po sil ma dngul khogs rtse che chung dang g.yang ṭam gyi rigs mang ba pha lam pad rag mar gad bai ḍār ya g.yu byur mu tig mu men sbur len sogs nor sna'i rigs dang*/ dza ti'i me thog dang bzang po drug gis gtsos pa'i dug rigs spangs pa'i sman ji snyed/

rgya dkar nag gi gos dar sna tshogs/ nang mdzod kyi gtsos kha btags sne mang*/ ras cha'i rigs/ ḍā ru dhor dril ting bshags sbub bsil dung la sogs par rol cha/ maṇḍal gtor cha ting sogs mchod cha'i bya brag shing 'bras st+ra khams sogs 'bras ba'i rigs bur sbrang ka ra/ ja mar thud dang 'bru rigs sor mdor na 'jig rten na srid pa'i pa'i 'dod dgu lus can rnams kyi nyer bar logs spyad byar gyu pa'i dngos po yod de cog ma tshang ba mde pa ras dkar gyi bsdums te byung bur bkang zhing*/ khyed par bkra shis bum gter nor bum gter nor bum gnod yi ga'u thod sgrub sogs nor lha'i bcas ji snyed dang*/ de dag gi bar mtshams su 'dod gsol rgyas bsdus po po lnga bcu brgal ba gzhug cing rgyu dang che chung gong gi gnod sbyin 'khor lo dang mtshungs pa'i dgyes 'khor dang*/ zhabs sdom 'khor lo zhabs dar sogs thams cad kyang dpyad gsum dag pa'i gzhung dang phyag len gyi rgyun ma nyams par bzhugs shing*/ de 'og 'khrug rtsod dang mtshon gyi skal pa zhi ba'i phyir me mda' dang gri mtshon gyi rigs mang du mjug pa sogs 'khrul pa'i dri ma dang bral zhing gong ma'i bzhed srol rnam par dag pa byas so/ ༈ /de ltar sku gdung rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i ring bsrel lngas byung bur bka' ba'i mchod sdong chen po mdzes khyed kyi rin chen dang po gnyis pa dag gi yongs su spel mar byas pa la/ sa 'dzin gser zangs las grub rdo rje'i 'phreng ba khor yug kun tu spras shing*/ theg sk+sa dang po dngul gyi g.yogs pa'i shar gyi blo 'bur dbus su bsgyur shel dmar po gru bzhi de'i g.yas g.yon du ma brdzus kyi dam gzugs cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du shes ljangang gru bzhi cha/ glo 'bur de'i g.yas kyi dbus su dwangs shel sngon por gru bzhi/ de'i ges bsgyur shel sher dmar po dam gzugs/ g.yon du shel dam ja kha

blo 'bra g.yon nges dbus su drangs shel po grub bzhi// de g.yas shel dam ja kha dang g.yon du bgyur shel dmar po/ lho'i glo 'bur dbus lel smug gru bzhi/ de'i g.yas g.yon du blug g.yang dam gzugs cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ja shel grub bzhi cha/ glo 'bur de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su shel sngon gru bzhi cha/ byang gi blo 'bur dbus su bsgyur shel dmar por gru bzhi/ de'i g.yas g.yon du mu brdzus kyi dam gzugs/ de'i g.yas g.yon du shel ljang gru bzhi cha/ glo 'bur de'i g.yas g.yon du shel smug gru bzhi cha bcas de dag thams cad gser skongs sha stag dang*// them sk+sa gnyis pa gser zangs kyi pad ma'i 'khor mar gnas shithem sk+sa gsum pa dngul gyi g.yogs pa shar gyi glo 'bur dbus su gser ljang gi gra skag por gsum gru bzhi g.yu gru dkar sha stag gis bsgrigs pa'i dpa dbyibs bkra ba/ de'i g.yas g.yon du g.yang tre'u ngo ma'i dam gzugs cha dang*/ de'i g.yas g.yon du dwangs shel sngon po gru bzhi cha/ glo 'bur de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis ka'i dbus su bsgyur shel dmar po gru bzhi cha/ de so so'i g.yas g.yon du shel dam ljang gu cha/ lho glo 'bur dbus su ma na ho dngos rtse brtsegs pa'i dbyibs kyi dzom rnams su g.yu phra yod pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du shel dam khra bo cha/ de'i phan tshun dwangs shel sngon po gru bzhi cha/ glo 'bur de'i g.yas g.yon gnyis su shel smug gru bzhi cha/ byang gi glo 'bur dbus sum ma na ho sgor mo/ de'i g.yas g.yon du shel dam mar khu mdog cha de'i g.yas g.yon du shel sngon gru bzhi cha/ glo 'bur de'i g.yas g.yon du shel smug gru bzhi cha bcas de dag thams cad gser bkong ma sha stag dang*/ seng khri bzhi 'khor ma dngul dang*/ phyogs rer gser zangs kyi gru khyad pa ṭa rgyas bsdus drug re/ shar gyi pa ṭa drug gi mtshams 'dzin g.yu'i pad bsgrigs gru nar bsgyur shel dmar po'i lte ba can/

lho byang gi sa ṭa'i tshams 'dzin rnams dwangs shel sngon po gru bzhi gsare gyi bkong ba bcu/ phyogs bzhi sgo khyim rnams nang mtshal shun gyi dzes pa/ shar gyi sgo khyim dbus mar gser zangs las grub pa'i gr+yal chen yul 'khor bsrung bzhengs sku dar dpyangs khrab rmog gis mdzes pa/ srog zhu'i mtshams 'dzin byi ru g.yu rkyang gi phra dgu/ sku dpang rdzi spra gyi mig gnyis g.yu cang gis byas pa/ phyag g.yon zhi wam chu srin mgo can gr+yud dang pags mal dngul gyi byas pa/ g.yas pas bskul byed 'dzind pa/ 'od kor gser zangs pa ṭa'i nang du g.yu'i pad 'dabs bsngags bzos drung cu re lnga// de'i phyir byi ru rgyal sran tsham nas/ bod sran tsam gyi bar bagr+yad dang sum cu tham pa/ pa ṭa'i g.yas g.yon gyi war gnyis la gr+ya mu tig rtse sor gsum pa chad dang*/ byi ru kham bu tsam cha la gsare skongs can*/ glong 'bur de'i g.yas g.yon du gser zangs kyi phrog byed dbang po ske rgyan dngul gyi g.yer kha can cha/ de phyir gser zangs kyi pa ṭa 'bu bsgril nyis na cha/ mdun gyi glo 'bur zung gnyis su/ dngul gyi bum pa gsegyi dwa phyed dang shing los brgyan pa/ g.yu byin gyi phra chung bcu drug re yod pa'i kha nas mthong pa'i g.yu bsgrigs kyi ka bar 'brug dang me thog 'khril ba'i rdzi spar 'degs pa/ lag na 'dod yon thog pa cha*/ de'i phyi zur gnyis su dngul bum gong mtshungs kyi kha nas mthon pa'i byi ru bsgrigs ma'i ka la/ pa ṭa me tog 'khril ba'i steng mkha mkha' lding dbang po dung 'bud cing rdzi khyung 'degs pa'i tshul can cha/ lho'i sgo khyim la gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal chen 'phags skyes po sreg zhu dar dpyang snyan rgyan gyi mdzes pa g.yu byir gyi phra lnga phyag gnyis ral gyi 'dzin pa/ 'od kor pa ṭar byi ru rgya sran tsam nas bod sran tsham gyi bar dhog brgya dang nyi shu rtse brgyad/

de'i g.yas g.yon sgo khyim du gsare zangs kyi gnyis mthung bdang po cha/ de'i phya gser zangs pa ṭa 'bu bsgril nyis ldan cha/ glong 'bu g.yas g.yon du shel bum dmar po las mthon pa'i gsare zangs kyis pa ṭa me tog spol ba'i ka ba/ mgor bsgyur shel dmar po gser skongs yod pa cha/ rgyab grur gser zangs kyi pa ṭa phyed pa'i ka ba 'dzom rgyan shel sngon gsare skongs ma/ nub kyi sgo khyim du gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal chen spyan mi bzang srog zhu dar dpyang snyan rgyan gyi mdzis pa/ g.yu byir gyi phra lnga phyag g.yas sbrul zhags dang*/ g.yon mchod rten 'dzin pa/ g.yas g.yon gyi sgo khyim du gser zangs kyi mgyogs 'gro cha/ byang gi sgo khyim du gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal chen rnam thos srog zhu dar dpyangs snyan rgyan gyi mdzes pa/ g.yu byin gyi phra lnga*/ phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan dang*/ g.yon ne'u le 'dzin pa/ 'od kor pa ṭar rgya sran tsham nas bod sran gyi bar dhog bagr+yad dang nyi shu rtsa lnga de'i g.yas g.yon gyi sgo khyim du gsare zangs kyi gtsug ldan cha/ de'i phyi gser zangs pa ṭa 'bu bsgril nyis ldan cha/ glo 'bur g.yas g.yon du shel bum dmar po las mthon pa'i gser zangs kyi pa ṭa me tog spol ba'i ka bgor bsgyur shel dmar po gsare skongs yod pa cha/ rgyab grur gser zangs pa ṭa phyed pa'i ka ba 'dzom rgyan shel sngon gser skong ma/ ba gam dang po dngul las byas pa'i shar gyi glo 'bur dbus su phra gdan gser zangs pa ta sgu mthil gzugs bal bar g.yu dngul bkod ma che legs/ de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru st+ra kha tsam gsare gyi skong ldan cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du phra gdan gsar zangs pa ṭa phyed pa la bar g.yu dngul skong ma cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru star kha chu ba tsam gser gyi skong cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du phra gdan gser zangs pa ṭa phyed pa la bar g.yu dngul skong ma cha/

de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru star kha chung ba tsam gser gyi skong ldan cha/ gru gnyis phra gdan gsare zangs pa ta phyed par g.yu grub se dngul skongs ma cha/ lho'i glo 'bur dkyil du bar g.yu dngul skongs ma gsare gyi phra gdan can/ de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru kham bu tsam gser skongs can cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du g.yu gru se dngul skongs gser gyi phra gdan can cha/ glo 'bur g.yon gyi dkyil du bar g.yu dngul skong gser gyi phra gdan can de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru kham ba tsam gsare gyi bkong ldan cha/ glo 'bur g.yas kyi dkyil du g.yu gru se dngul skong gser gdan can/ de'i g.yas g.yon du 'phyong dmar leb mo gser bkong can gnyis/ byang gi blo 'bur dbus su g.yu gru se dngul skong gser gdan can legs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru kham rlon tsam gser skongs can cha/ de'i g.yas g.yon du g.yu gru dkar dngul skong gsare gdan can legs pa gnyis/ glo 'bur g.yas kyi dbus su bar g.yu dngul skong ma gsare gdan can/ de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru kham bu tsam gser skong ma cha/ glo bur g.yon du g.yu gru se dngul skong gser gdan can/ de'i phan tshun du 'phyong dmar leb mo gser skong ma gnyis bcas dang*/ ba gam gnyis pa gser zangs pa dpa kyi 'phreng bas bskor zhing*/ bdag gsum pa'am pad chen du grags pa 'khor ma dngul las grub pa me tog 'khor rgyug 'phrul bskrol shin tu legs pa mdun gyi me tog rnams kyi steng rdzas brgyad cha bdun sogs kyi stong rdzas brgyad cha bdun sogs kyi bkra ba/ 'di'i shar gyi glong 'bur gyi dbus su gser skongs la bsten pa'i g.yu gru dkar dang byi ru kho na las grub pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo byi lte de phyiragayu 'dab brgyad/ de'i phyir g.yu'i rtsibs brgyad dang*/ rtsibs chen byi rus byas pa/ de'i phyi g.yu'i pad 'dab kyi bskor zhing*/

phyi rol phyogs mtshams su byi lte g.yu 'dab kyi bskor ba brgyad/ de'i g.yas g.yon glo bur gru gnyis su gser skongs la brten pa'i g.yu byir gyi sna tshogs rdo rje phyed pa g.yu lte byi ru'i 'dab ma can mthar g.yu'i sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ de phyir byi ru'i nas 'dra 'dzom rnams su g.yu dpa dang gser thig dho rje'i rwa gseng gnyis su mi men dang nya lcib kyi bkag pa spus legs cha/ de'i phan tshun gru chen gnyis su gser skongs la brten pa'i lte ba spos shel dang de'i phyogs mtshams su g.yu 'dab drug byi 'dab brgyad mu men 'dab ma bzhi de'i phyari g.yu'i rte po/ de phyir byi ru'i 'dab ma/ de phyir g.yu'i babs gzugs 'khor ma tshams rnams su byi ru'i pad chung dang bcas sprus legs cha/ lho'i glo 'bur gyi dbus dngas shel sngon po gru bzhi ling gzhi ma gser skongs gzhi gdanam babs gzugs bsgrigs ma 'bu bsgril dpa 'dab mas bcad pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du shel ljang phra skongs gong mtshungs phyed pa gnyis/ rgyab grur shel dmar skongs gong mtshungs nub kyi blo 'bur dbus su rag skongs skor mo g.yu dho 'chal bsgrigs legs pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du gong mtshungs phyed pa re/ glo 'bur gyi g.yas g.yon du gong mtshungs sgor mo chung ba cha/ byang gi glo 'bur dbus su/ dwangs shel sngon po gru bzhi ling bzhi ma gser skongs gzhi gdan babs gzugs bsgrigs ma bdu bsgril pad 'dab kyi bcad pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du le ljang bkong mtshungs phyed pa gnyis/ rgyab grur shel dmar bkong gong mtshungs bad chen steng gser zangs kyi 'khor mas g.yogs pa dmangs dngul dang kha bad rags la su sra tiṣṭha'i mañtsha 'phrul ma tsha gser can/ shar gyi skas 'og nor g.yu gru dkar gsare bkong ma che legs de'i g.yas g.yon du byi ru kham skam tsam gsare gyi bkod ldan cha/ glo 'bur g.yas kyi dkyil du g.yu gru dkar gsare 'jang gi skongs pa 'dzom la g.yu phra chuca ba bcu drug

de'i g.yas su g.yu gru dmar gser 'jang skongs pa'i phra gdan la dpa rags chung ngu dgu/ g.yon du g.yu gser 'jang gi bkong ldan/ glong 'bur g.yon gyi dkyil du g.yu gru dkar gser skong ma phra gdan la g.yu phra che chung sna tshogs yod pa/ de'i g.yas su g.yu ga gser bkong spus legs/ g.yon du g.yu gru dmar gser 'jang gis bskongs pa'i phra gdan la pad rags chung du nyer gcig /glo 'bur phan tshun gnyis kyi dkyil du gser 'jang brdung gi pad 'dab mar gad kyi lte ba la pad rag 'khor phyi nang gnyis la dhog sum cu yod pa cha/ de gnyis g.yon dang g.yas su g.yu dmar mthe bong tsam gser 'jang gi bkong gi bkong ldan gnyis byi ru kham bu tsam gser gyi bkod ldan gnyis/ lho'i sk+sa 'og tu gru se dngu bkong gser gdan ma de'i g.yas g.yon glo 'bur gnyis la g.yu gru se dngul skong gser gdan ma gnyis/ de'i phan tshun du g.yu gong mtshungs gnyis/ nub kyi glo 'bur dbus su g.yu gru se gser bkong ma gcig byang gi sk+sa 'og tu g.yu gru dkar dngul bkong gser gdan ma che legs/ de'i g.yas g.yon glo 'bur gnyis la g.yu gru dkar dngul bkong gser gdan ma che legs// de'i g.yon g.yon glo 'bur gnyis la g.yu gru dkar dngul skong gser gdan ma legs pa gnyis/ de'i phan tshun du g.yu gru se dngul bkong gser gdan ma gnyis bcas dang*/ dmangs dge'i steng nasabatsug pa'i shar dang lho byang bcas la gsare zangs kyi sum skas them pa bco lngas mdzes shing*/ shar gyi skas them zhe lnga la rer g.yu byir gyi phra gsum bsgrigs spel ba'i khyon phra brgyad dang sum chu so lnga/ sk+sa ru'i 'dzin rdo rje phyed pa dang*/ ru 'degs bcas la g.yu byir 'dres pa'i phra brgyad re/ skas ru bzhi'i rtser g.yu nor gzugs ste g.yu bum gyi dbyibs su bsgrigs pa'i rtse byi ru'i tog sprus legs gser 'jang gis skongs pa bzhi/

lho'i skas them zhe lngar g.yu byir 'dres pa'i phra gong grangs dang mnyam pa skas ru bzhi rtse g.yu bsgrigs nor gzugs gsare 'jang gis skongs ldan/ byang gi skas them zhe lngar phra dang skas ru lho dang mtshungs pa/ bang rim bzhi dngul gyi g.yogs pa'i so so'i kha pad rag la rigs pa phug ron dang rab gnas sngags rgyas bsdus ye dhar lañtsa 'phrul ma tsha gser can/ shar gyi bang rig bzhi'i glo 'bur skas kyi g.yas g.yon dang*/ glo 'bur phadzan tshun bcas pa dpyad bcu drug la/ bkra shis rtags bgyad gzhi g.yu'i lo 'gugs byi ru'i me tog can bcu'i dbus byi ru'i me tog 'dab ma lnga pa brgyad kyi steng du/ g.yu byir mu men mu tig shel rigs sogs kyi spel mar grub pa'i 'khor lo dung dpal be'u gdugs rgya mtshan padma bum pa gser nya bcas kyi dbyibs bsgrigs ma gser bkong la brten pa spus legs/ yang g.yu'i ne'u sing gsum 'dzom bcu re byi ru re/ byi ru'i me tog sum 'dzom lnga re yod pa'i steng du g.yu byir mu men sbur len dung shel rigs sogs spel ba'i/ me long ghi wang zho dur wa dung li khri yungs dkar bcas bkra shis rdzas brgyad gzugs bsgrigs ma spu legs bcas bkra shis rdzas rtags bcu drug gi mngon par bkra zhing lho'i bang rim bzhi'i glo 'bur gyi skas g.yon dang*/ de'i phan tshun bcas la g.yu gru se/ bar g.yu gru dkar bcas che legs bcu drug la dngul skongs gser gdan yod pa/ bang rim bzhi'i steng dang*/ bum pa bre dang*/ bre kheb rnams dungal gyi g.yogs pa/ bum gdan padma dang*/ sa ṭa sked 'ching stod smad bab gzugs dkyil du 'jam dpal zhi drag gi bsnyen sngags lañtsha dang*/ dra ba dra phyed bcas rnams zangs 'phrul tsha gser bzo sgros kyi 'phags pa dang*/ sgo khang chen mor 'phags pa phyag na padmo mi 'i zol la ston pa rgyal dbang dkon mchog ratna'i thugs dam rten rje bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i gser sku rkang khru gang grags tsam/

sgo rgyan chen mo nang 'od zare pa ṭa dang*/ de phyir sa ṭa rim pa gsum ldan ==========// tshogs dang rgyal tshab byams pa'i rgyud bla ma sogs dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa rnams don gyi gtan la dbab pa la gatsho bor mdzad pa sha stag yin pa las/ khyed par du gyur pa 'bri gung bka' brgyud du grags pa yang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ye shes yongs su rgyas pa'i mdo las/ ma 'ongs pa dag rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ri brgyud du/ mi yi 'dren pa rgyal ba tshos kyi rje/ rin tshan dpal zhes bya ba 'byung gyur te/ mi mchod de ne 'dzin rten khams su grags/ nga yi bstan la phya ba byed par 'gyur te/ mi mchod de ni'ajig rten khams su grags/ nga yi bstan la bya ba byed par 'gyur/ zhes dang ma gr+yud dngos grub las/ 'das pa'i sangs mar me mdzad/ ma 'ongs phyon pa byams pa mgon/ da ltar bzhugs pa shākya thub/ kun gyi mtha' ni rin chen dpal/ ces sogs lung du ma bstan pa ltar/ dpal mgon 'phags pa klu grub dam pa nyid spyir mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i rol gar 'khor ba ma stong bar rgyun mi chad kyang*/ bye brag gangs can pa rnams dang*/ khyad par bya 'bri gung gi 'gro ba rnams thegs pos 'dul ba'i rigs can du gzigs te 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen dpal zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid gdung rigs bod mi'u gdong drug gi nang mtshan 'gru las brgyud pa dpa' bo po gad ces pa'i/ lha'i bu mo dang mnyam par rol ba'i sras nam mkha' nas sgyur bar skyu ra gnam sbyin dpar por grags de las gdung rabs bdun pa'i thog yul mdo khams kyi pa'i cha 'dan stod tsong ngur/ yab rnal 'byor pa rdo rje rgyal po dang yum rag shi bza' gnyis kyi sras su chu mo phag gi lo la sku bltams/ rwa bsgreng bsgom chen sogs bsten par mdzad cing rlung mo cher bsgrub pa la bzhugs skabs dpal phag mo bzhugs skabs dpal phag mo gru pa'i snyan pa gsan nas bod du byon/

'gro mgon phag gru mjal ma thag 'khor thams cad de rig rdzagos so gsungs bu chen gdugs thog pa lnga brgya'i nang nas nyid gdan sar 'os pa 'in zhes gsung gi dbugs dbyung zhing gdams pa ma lus pa gnang zhing smra bcad dang 'dag sbyar kho nar bzhugs/ 'gro mgon rin po che mya ngan las 'da' rjes phag gru'i gdan pa bskyangs shing bzhugs pa'i tshe bla ma'i zo 'og gi 'bol 'di skyur la byang 'bri gung du song zhes lung bstan byung zhing*/ gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das kyi mdo las/ ma 'ong pa'i dus byang phyogs nas byang phyogs kyi brgyud/ 'bri sgang rta 'chag ces bya bar dge slong rin chen dpal zhes pa 'dus pa 'bum phrag bdun gyi dbus su nga yi bstan pa nyin mor byed pa zhig 'ong gi zhes dang*/ sprin chen po'i mdo las/ ma 'ongs lnga brgya'i mtha' ma la/ byang phyogs pa yi phyogs char ru*/ 'bri zhes bya ba'i zhing khams su// rin chen dpal zhes bya ba yi/ bde bar gshegs pa 'byung bar 'gyur/ zhes dang thang yig las zhing khams rnam dag chos 'byung 'bri 'bri zhes par/ sngags kyi ting 'dzin brnyes pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ don dam ye shes dgangs pa mnga' brnyed pa/ sngags bdag rin chen dpal zhes bya ba 'byung*/ sogs mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan pa'i thog tu bas te 'bri gung du phebs/ 'gro mgon phag gru'i slob ma mi nyag sgom rin gyi thel gyi gnas gzhi phul bas byang chub kyi gling rin po che 'di nyid btab/ gnas 'di bya rgod phung po'i ri dang khyad par med cing de nyid kyi yon tan kun tshar bar zhal gyi bzhes shing 'dir tshe'i dus byas pa'i srog chags grog sbur yan chad kyang ngan song du mi gathong ba dang*/ bla g.yel du phyi pa tsam kyang don dang ldan pa'i dbu snyung bzhes/ 'dus pa khri phrag byar nges pa don gyi chos kyi 'khor los smin cing grol bar mdzad/ rgya dkar nag sogs 'dzam gling na che ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi bkur ba ma zad/

tshangs pa dang brgya sbyin sogs lha klu gnod sbyin dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi mchod pa dang bsod nams kying du gyur/ ngo mtshar ba'i gtam sum po bdun sogs rmad byung gi mdzad pa blo yi yul las 'das pa bstan nas dgung lo don lnga par mngon par dga' ba'i zhing du gshegs bde gshegs dri med dkar por gyur to/ de ltar bla ma rin po che 'di nyid kyi gdan pa chen po byin rlabs rmad du byung ba'i gnas chain rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i bsti gnas 'dir rab byung bcu bzhi'i nang mtshan me khams 'khor lo'i sna can gyi lor btab pa'i nang mtshan kha ba can gyi rgyal mkhas su mes bdon rnam gsum gatsho bor gyur pa'i 'od chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnams dang*/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs sku bkod pa ji snyed cig dang*/ khyad par 'bri gung 'dir skyob pa rin che'i skabs thub pa bsod snyoms pa'am rin chen byang chung sogs dang*/ gdan rabs rin po cher kha ba dang*/ chos dbyings rang grol sogs sku'i yang srid rim par brgyud mthar/ rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs rigs dang dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma mtshan brjod par dka' ba rje bcun bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan 'dzigs med 'phris phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i snge zhes bya ba'i gdung khang ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i gnas yangs pa can gsal ldan du lha'i dbyar gnas mdzad yum la chos gsungs snga dro dgag dbye mdzad phri dro nam mkha' las babs nas phebs dus gsal ldan dad pa can gyi bzhengs pa'i lha babs sam yang na sum chu rtsa gsum lha'i mchod rten du grags pa cha tshad sogs rgyal dbang chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa thig rtsa'i dgongs don dpyis phyi pa bgyis pa'i bum nang du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i sku gdung rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po dang mtshungs pa ma nyams hril por bzhugs shing*/

dar zab kyi nab bza'i rigs dbu lo gdung rwa gdung tshwa gdung chab ril bu/ phyag 'phreng zhal 'don phyag dpe phyag ḍar 'phan bcas/ gsol dkar gsol zhal snyan rwa sogs sku'i nye dpyad sku drag ma byin can sne mang dang*/ gzhan yang ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i 'phel gdung*/ sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi ring bsrel/ sras dar ma mdo sde'i dbu klud las 'khrungs sa'i ring bsrel/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i ring bsrel/ rje rin chen phun tshogs dang*/ rje btsun chos kyi rgyal po bcas kyi 'phel gdung*/ mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang*/ shā ri'i bu mo mo 'gal/ kud dga' 'char ka sing gha gling pa bcas kyi sku chos dang snam sbyar gyi dumbu byang chub shing dang ma/ sangs rgyas glang po'i gdung*/ byang chub sems dpa' chos 'phags kyi 'tshems/ o rgyan yab yum gyi dbu skra byang sems/ zab ber chos sman/ tilli pa chen pos 'og min mkha' 'gro gsang 'gro gsangs mdzod nas spyan drangs pa'i dam rdzas rol pa chen po// paṇa chen nā ro'i snyan rgyan/ lho brag mar pa'i 'tshegs/ ber seng chen bgying bsnol gyi dum bu/ yum bdag med ma'i na bza'/ mar mi yab sra mthung mong gi gsol zhal/ rje mi la'i ral gu/ mnyam med dwags po'i dbu skra/ 'gro mgon phag grub 'tshem/ gsol zhal phya'u'i dum bu rje skyob pa rin che nas bzung dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bar gyi 'bri gung gdan rabs rim byon gyi dbu lo/ sku sha phyag 'phreng na bza' sogs dang*/ gzhan yang sel med cing grub mtha' ris su ma chad pa'i dam rdzas nang rten khyed par du 'phags pa sne mang dang*/ gu ru'i sku tshab/ gser dngul zangs li ma mkhar rag sogs kyi bla ma yid dam sangs rgyas byang sems sku byin can mang ba/ chas sku'i ring bsrel bla ma brgyud pa dang rgyud sde bzhi'i lha'i gzungs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ji snyed par la btab pa so so stong phrag brgal ba tsam dang*/

bka' bagr+yud gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar mgur 'bum mdo 'dus brgyud sogs kyi glogs bam du ma dang*/ pad sprungs rgya gar ma dang*/ bka' gdams mchod rten/ gter phur gdung tshwa las grub pa'i tshwa tshwa mchod brgya ma dang mchod brgyad bcas grangs mang*/ rgya dkar nag bal bod sogs kyi gnas chen du ma'i sa dho chu shing sogs 'dzom che ba/ seng khrir dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnod sbyin 'khor man ngag dang ldan pa/ gnod sbyin ga'u bum gter dang*/ rin chen nor sna'i rigs sman 'bru dar zab mkho dgu'i 'byor pas rab tu bltams shing phyir gser dngul spel mas legs par g.yogs shing bzo khyad du ma dang bcas pa'i dung g.yas 'khyil dang pha lam pad rag mar gad nal ind+ra ni la g.yang tri'u g.yu byir sbur legs mu len sogs rin chen du ma'i phra rgyan gyi spud pa'o/ sgo khyim du rje btsun dkon mchog ratna'i thugs dam rten du bzhengs pa jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i gser sku byin can rnying ma khang nas gdan drangs pa dang*/ pa ṭa'i sgo khang chung du rnams la/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs/ gtsug tor can/ thams cad skyob/ 'khor ba 'jigs/ gser thub/ 'od bsrung/ shākya thub pa bcas/ sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi sku bcas bzhugs shing dbu thog tu gser gdugs la/ 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed yang bzlog me'i spu gri gur khang ma'i lugs kyi dkyil 'khor 'bur du dod pa ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i dngul gdung rin po che mthong grol chen mor grags pa lags so/ 'di'i g.yon du bzhugs pa ni/ sngon 'das pa'i dus de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangasargyas klu'i rigs mchog dang*/ da ltar rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mos pa rab tu dga' ba'i snying po nor bu rin po che brtsegs pa'i rgyal po nyid ma 'ongs pa na rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mgon po kun tu gzigs zhes bya bar 'gyur bas na/

zla gsang 'dus pa tant+ra'i le'u drug bcu pa las/ nga ni dus gsum 'byung ba'i sku/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sngon du 'byung*/ nga ni dus gsum phyis kyang 'byung*/ ma 'ongs bstan pa'i snying por 'byung*/ nga ni dus gsum da lta 'byung*/ da lta mngon du gyur pa'i lha/ zhes sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs ni dus gsum mngon par sangs rgyas shing*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yab yum spyi mes su gyur kyang*/ zhing 'dir skal bzang rnam 'dren shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan la rgyal ba'i sras kyi mthu bo 'jam dpal gzhon nu zur phud lnga ldan nyid 'gro ba'i don du 'phags bod kun la sprul pa'i skyes mchog bgrang yas kyi sku'i skye ba du ma dang*/ khyad par mgon po 'bri gung pa chen po rin chen dpal gyi drung du spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas dang*/ slar yang lha babs skyu ra'i gdung las rdo rje rin chen dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po rin chen phun tshogs/ rgyal dbang chos kyi grags pa sogs gdan rabs gser gyi 'phreng ba yang srid rim par brgyud mthar rje btsun bla ma mtshungs med mchog gi sprul pa'i sku bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i sde zhes bya bas gdung khang 'di yang sum cu rtsa gsum lha'i gnas su yum la chos gsungs shing*/ dbyar zla ba gsum du bzhugs par mo 'gal chen pos bskul nas grong khyer gsal ldan du lha las babs pa'i cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe gsal ldan rnams kyi bzhengs pa'i lha las babs pa'i mchod rten 'di'i bre bum mtshams su rje bla ma'i dbu thod me brdugs ma bum hril du byon pa de nyid rin po che'i za ma tog tu bcug ste bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ gzhan yang dbu lo/ dar ras kyi na bza'i rigs dang*/ sku tshal/ gdung tshwa/ gdung thal/ gdung chab ril bu/ thugs dam phyag des/ phyag 'phreng*/ phyag ting*/ gsol dkar/

gsol zhal/ mgul ga nang zhugs cha tshang sogs sku'i nye dpyad sku drag ma byin can dang*/ 'phel gdung ring bsrel sogs kyi mtshon bsrel rnam pa lnga dang*/ sku gsung thugs rten byin can bcas kyi rnam grangs dang seng khrir gnod sbyin 'khor lo nor lha'i rten dang nor sna'i rigs sogs mkho dgu'i yo byad ji snyed dang spyir gser dngul gyi g.yogs pa'i bzo bkod dang phra rgyan gyi rigs la sogs gdung 'bum mthong grol chen mo nyid dang rnam dbyer med cing*/ sgo khyim du mnyam med nyi ma'i gnyen gyi gser sku byin can gser khang sbug nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ pa ṭa'i phrod kyi sgo khyim mdun la rje dkon mchog 'phrin las don grub chos kyi rgyal po'i thugs dam rten/ rdo rje 'chang*/ tilli/ nā ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ sgam po pa/ phag gru bcas kyi sku brnyan byin can bzhugs shing*/ dbu thog tu gser gdugs bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa 'chi med rnga sgra'i dkyil 'khor 'bur dod bcas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i gdung 'bum byin rlabs dpal 'bar du grags pa lags/ 'di'i g.yon du bzhugs pa'i byang chen gser dngul las grub pa g.yu byir mu tig sbur len shel rigs kyi phras spud pa 'di ni 'phags pa'i yul gyi slob dpon hūṃ kā ra dang*/ bram ze sa ra ha la sogs pa'i sku'i sgyu 'phrul bod yul 'dir lha sras dge ba'i dpal dang*/ khu ston sogs mang du brgyud pa'i mthar dpal 'bri gung pa chen po bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma 'phrin las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde zhes bya ba'i sku'i bskyed ma'i phyi brten du bzhengs pa 'di'i nang du ston pa shākya'i rgyal po'i 'phel gdung gi dbus/ ring bsrel lnga dang*/ rje nyid kyi phyag brkos ma sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku nas 'bru re las grub pa ngo mtshar ba bcu phrag gcig dang nyag ma lnga la sogs pa sku gsung thugs rten byin can/

seng khrir gnod sbyin bang mdzod nor lha'i bca' gzhi 'khor rdzas sogs rgyud kyi dgongs don ma 'phyugs pa rje nyid kyi rab tu gnas pa sogs byin rlabs gzi bod 'bar ba 'di pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi tshom chen bka' brgyud pho brang du bzhugs pa phyis 'dir gdan drangs pa lags/ gdung rten mthong grol chen po'i g.yas kyi kun rar bzhugs pa'i bka' 'gyur ro cog rnying rgyud dang bcas pa 'di/ gangs can lha gcig phyag na padma gang 'dul thabs kyi chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sogs/ rgyal po blon po/ skyes chen/ grub thob/ dge slong*/ sngags pa/ skyes phral sogs kyi sprul pa du mas 'gro don dpag med mdzad cing*/ tsā ma ri'i mgon du nges don snying po'i bstan pa spel ba la snyengs pa mi mnga' ba rgyal dbang dkon mchog 'phrin las bzang po'i thugs dam rten du mthing shog la gser dngul spel mas bzhengs pa rje nyid kyi rab gnas mdzad pa byin rmad du byung ba lags/ gzhan yang rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rtogs brjod dpag bsam khri shing bris thang chen mos gtsos bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems chos srung bcas kyi bris sku yang mang du bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang mi 'gyur lhun grub bkra shis bde ldan du grags pa 'di la mos gus rtse gcig bgyis na/ skye ba 'dir yang tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas shing yid smon gang btab 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug rnam mkhyen go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ba ni/ mdo sde rnams las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang mchod rten la mos pas mchod pa sogs kyi bsod nams lan gcig ma yin pa gsungs te/ gsal rgyal gyi zhus pa las/ dkon mchog gsum phyir mi rnams gang dadag gis/ 'phags pa dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor byas pas ni/ rkang lag ser mo drwa bas 'brel ba dang*/ yan lag thams cad kyang ni skyon med 'gyur/ zhes sogs rgya cher bstan pa'i phyir mos bdun rtse gcig pas phyag dang*/

mchod pa/ sdig bshags/ yi rang sogs legs par mdzad nas/ mgon po byams pas/ yongs su bsngo ba khyad par can/ de ni byed pa mchog yin no/ zhes gsungs pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ de 'dzin skyes bu'i tshogs rnams zhabs brtan cing*/ phyogs bcu rgyam ba sras bcas kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa/ bstan rtsa dge bdun gyi 'dus sde 'phel zhing sdom gsum chos spyod bcu la brtson pa dang*/ 'jig rten khams su nad mug 'khrug rtsod zhi zhing bde skyid rdzogs ldan ltar 'gyur ba/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad myur du rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang mngon du gyur cig snyam pa'i thugs bskyed yang dag pa zhu 'tshal/ phyag 'tshal ba dang === rnam dag gangs ri ltar dkar === dge ba 'di yi skye ba === de ltar 'og min khang gsar mi 'gyur lhun grub bkra shis bde ldan gyi rten bshad mdor bsdus 'di bzhin rje yab sras kyi gzims 'gags rnam dpyod blo yi 'jug sgo yangs pa dkon mchog mthar phyin gyis bris zhes bskul ma gnang bar/ dpal 'bri gung pa'i grwa rigs tha shal ba ratna gu ṇa kā ras bkod pa/ sarba maṅga laṃ/// /

༄༅// rang lugs cho ga chos spyod bskang gso sogs kyi bla brgyud kha 'gengs bzhugs so/ ༄༅/ na mo gu ru/ 'dir rang lugs kyi chos spyod dang cho ga bskang gso sogs kyi brgyud rim kha skong 'god pa la/ thog mar chos spyodanas bka' brgyud spyi bstod kyi/ 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ zhes pa'i mjug /gru 'dzin dgyes dngos rje btsun padma'i mtshan/ lha sras slar sprul chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ byin rlabs gter mdzod rtsa ba'i bla ma bcas/ 'brel tshad don ldan gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ de ltar bka' brgyud sogs dang*/ zab lam brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs rigs rnams kun gyi/ dkyil 'khor kun gtso chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ bka' drin 'khor med padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs/ don gnyis mthar phyin mnga' ba khyod= gsol ba 'debs so= brgyud pa 'dzin no= mdo sngags chos kun mkhyen pa'i nyin byed dbang*/ mi shes mun sel 'gro ba'i ded dpon che/ khyab bdag bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ dran mchog don ldan rtsa ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs/ rim gnyis zung 'jug mnga' ba sogs dkyus ltar la med dang rtsa ba'i bar du bcug na 'grig rigs kun ma'i chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /rang rig skye med chos sku'i nam mkha' la/ 'gags med rang rtsal longs sku'i me shel khams/ gnyis med 'od zer sprul sku padma'i mtshan/ gsol ba 'debs= sgrub rgyud rin chen 'byung gnas khyon yangs su/ nges don zab gsang nor bus 'gro kun la/ 'dod dgu stsol mdzad dharma dhwa dza'i zhabs/ gsol ba = rang rig sogs dkyus ltar/ chos drug brgyud 'debs/ rigs drug bdag nyid kyi/ chos kyi nyi ma'i mtshan zhes pa'i mjug /'khor lo'i dbang phyug padma'i rgyal mtshan la/ gsol ba 'debs so= snang stong skye 'gags gnyis med ye shes che/ mngon gyur bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ bka' drin gsum ldan sogs dkyus ltar/

'gyur med rtag brtan gyi chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /sgrub brgyud yang snying 'bri bstan yid bzhin nor/ lung rtogs rgyal mtshan rtser 'god 'gro kun la/ don gnyis 'dod dgu'i char gyis tshim mdzad pa/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ mthar thug sogs dkyus ltar/ pad 'byung a ti ma'i kha 'gengs bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul gyi mjug gang gi thugs bskyed kun gsal khyon yangs su/ mtshan dpe'i snang brnyan 'od stong 'bar ba'i skur/ bstan nas sgrub brgyud pad tshal bzhad pa'i mgon/ padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol= bsod nams rgya mtsho'i mjug /rgyal kun thugs rje gcig bsdus pad dkar 'chang*/ gdul bya'i don du ngur smrig gar bsgyur ba/ bka' drin mtshungs rgyal dbang chos kyi rje/ padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol= 'phags pa'i yul gyi rig 'dzin hūṃ kā ra/ gangs ri'i ljongs su lha sras dge ba'i dpal/ slar yang sgrub brgyud bstan pa spel ba'i mgon/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la= sho lo ka gnyis bcug /rje gsum ldan gyi padma'i rgyal mtshan mjug /gnas rang rig bde ba chen po'i klong*/ bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal mtshan la= gnas spyi gtsug sogs dkyus ltar/ dam chos dgongs yang zab kyi sngon 'gro dal 'byor rten bzang gi ka dag spros bral ma'i chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug blo 'das snang bzhi'i zhing khams su/ gzhon nu bum sku'i pho brang na/ rje btsun padma'i rgyal mtshan la/ bdag yid= 'ja' lus= skye med chos sku'i zhing khams su/ 'gags med longs sku'i pho brang na/ sprul snang chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ bdag yid= 'ja' lus= ka dag rang byung gi gong mtshams/ lha sngags ye shes 'khor lo'i pho brang na/ rje btsun padma'i mtshan la gsol ba 'debs/ phung po= tshe 'dir= shar grol dbyings rig dbyer pho brang na/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ phung po= tshe 'dir= kun bzang bde chen gyi gong mtshams/

dam chos nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo/ dbye nas zab don gru char gyis/ 'gro kun myu gu smin mdzad pa/ bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan la/ mos= nges= rang= gsol ba= 'gyur med bde ba'i kun gsal ngogs/ stong nyid zung 'jug ri bong 'dzin/ 'gro tshogs kunda bzhad pa'i gnyen/ khyab bdag chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ mos= nges= rang = gsol ba 'debs so= bla sgrub brgyud 'debs rigs rnams ma'i gong mtshams/ phyag rgya chen po gdams pa'i gru char gyis/ skal ldan lhan skyes ye shes rdo rje yi/ myu gu smin mdzad padma'i rgyal mtshan la/ gsol ba= mdo rgyud mtha' bral chu gter chen po las/ zab don smin grol rgyun gyi 'gro kun gyis/ nyon mongs gdung sel chos kyi rgyal mtshan la/ gsol ba= gnas lugs sogs dkyus ltar/ zab lam 'pho ba'i brgyud pa'i rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i rje btsun zhes pa bstan 'dzin la bgyur ba'i mjug khyab bdag padma'i mtshan la= rje btsun dharma dhwa dza la gsol ba= drin can sugs dkyis ltar /thugs rje chen po'i gsol 'debs kyi dharma suryī 'jug /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin chen gling bzhi'i dbus/ yang snying sgrub bagr+yud mchog rab lhun po bzhin/ 'gyur med rtag brtan 'dzin skyong spel pa'i mgon/ padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la gsol ba= gr+yal kun yab gyur bstan pa'i 'gor lo nyid/ 'gro ngor bsam bzhin zur phud longs sku'i rgyan/ dor nas rnam gsum ngur smṛg sprul pa'i gar /bsgyur mdzad dharma dhwa dzar gsol= gang gis sogs dkyus ltar zung 'jug khyab bdag gi /bkrin gsum ldan chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs/ snying rje'i gter dngos rje btsun padma'i mtshan/ thub bstan= 'khor lo'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ gdams pa'i gter mdzod rtse ba'i bla ma bcas/ bstan pa'i dpal gyur sogs dkyis bzhin sbyar ro/ cho ga'i gras yang zab bskang ba'i chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /gru 'dzin dgyis dngos ngur smig sprul pa'i gar

/bsgyur mdzad padma'i rgyal mtshan thugs dam bskang*/ rig 'dzin hūṃ chen kā ra rlar sprul pa/ rje btsun dharma dhwa dza'i thugs dam bskangs/ zhes pa sbyar bde mchog bdud rtsi lag mchod skabs/ dpal ldan mgar chen pa'i/ zhal du oṃ=rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du = khyab bdag padma'i rgyal matsan gyi zhal du= mtshungs mde dharma dhwa dza'i zhal du= de nas dkyus ltar ༈ /bka' brgyad las byang sman mchod chos kyi nyi ma'i skabs 'khor lo'i dbang phyug chos yi nyi ma la/ rnam dag bdud rtsi'i dam rdzas/ ༈ /thugs rje sa= oṃ āḥhūṃ sarba= rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje yon tan rtsal/ bkrin gsum ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs/ bsgrub pa bka' brgyad sogs dkyus ltar/ ༈ /bde mgon gzhung gi rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ bkrin gsum padma'i gr+yal mtshan dang*/ 'khor lo'i mgon po dharma dhwa dza sogs/ dngos grub rtse ba dpal ldan zla ma'i zhabs/ sogs dkyus ltar ro/ mgon bagr+yud kyichos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /'khor lo'i dbang phyug padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du= mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du= dri rtsa ba'i dkyus lta ༈ /ma phyi'i lhug gsol gyi gong mtshams su/ khyab bdag bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan/ bkrin mnyam med chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs rtse ba dang bagr+yud pas bcas pa'i sogs dkyus ltar bya'o/ ༈ /gshin rje'i brgyud 'debs/ chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ bkrin mtshungs med rje btsun dharma'i mtshan/ skyabs gnas kun 'duso gas dkyus ltar ༈ /log tri'i brgyud 'debs/ rigs brgya'i chos kyi nyi ma la/ gsol ba 'debs so= 'khor lo'i mgon po padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ lha sras yang sprul thugs kyi rdo rje sogs/ dri med grub pa dkyus ltar dang*/ ༈ /sman mchod chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /bkrin gsum ldan phyag na parma dngos/

'khor lo'i dbang phyug padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ tshul 'dir grub brnyes dharma dha dza la/ sman mchod= rigs kun nas dkyilas bzhin= thugs rje chen po rgyal lugs brgyud 'debs kyi/ dkyil 'khor kun gtso chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs/ dngos sprul rje btsun padma sems dpa' la/ gsol ba= sku gsum bdag nyid chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ bkrin gsum ldan sogs gzhung ltar ༈ /bum sgrub byin 'bebs la/ chos kyi nyi zhabs/ 'dir gshegs= sgrub rdzas= rab 'byams rgyal kun spyal kun spyi gzugs 'khor lo'i mgon/ rje btsun bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan gang*/ 'dir gshegs= sgrub rdzas= pa ra hpa dngos mtshungs med dharma'i mtshan/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs dkyus du oṃ = bsangs brtan bde legs phun tshogs kyi/ bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dus chos kyi nyi ma dang*/ rigs kun bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs/ bka' bagr+yud bla ma'i sogs gzhung ltar sbyar ro/ phag mo'i cho cha dngos grub kyi 'dod 'jo zhes bya'i brgyud 'debs chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug /gzung 'dzin gnyis med phyag rgya'i pho brang nas/ padma'i rgyal mtshan zhabs la= rang sems = bla ma= 'khrul pa rang dag chos sku'i pho brang nas/ rje btsun dharma dhwa dzar gsol ba= rang sems = bla ma = ji lta ji snyed sogs dkyus ltar/ ༈ bdud rtsi lag mchod kyi chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du/ mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du= oṃ oṃ oṃ sogs dkyus ltar ro/ ༈ /a phyi'i bskang mdos kyi kha skong*/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du= sku bzhi'i bdag nyid padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du= bkrin gsum ldan dharma dhwa dza'i zhal du= khag gnyis dang yang rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma/ khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan/ rgyal dbang dharma dhwa dza/

dri can sogs dkyus ltar/ khag gnyis dang*/ drag mo'i dpal ldan mgar chen pa'i mjug /'khor lo'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan/ 'dren mchog mtshungs med chos kyi rgyal mtshan la sogs te drin can ba dang brgyud par dkyus bzhin/ ༈ /lnga ldan mtshan sngags don grub chos gr+yal mjug/ ratna shā pa na dhā ra dharma suryā shā sa na dhā ra dharma surya shā sa na dhā ra dhwa dza/ shā sa na dhā ra dharma dhwa dza/ rdo rje 'chang skyob pa rtse ba'i bla ma bcas bsgril ba/ badzra dhṛkra ratna shrī padma dhwa dza sogs sbyor/ lnga ldan brgyud 'debs bsdus pa'i surya'i zhabs mjug /sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rnye btsun padma'i mtshan/ 'khor lo'i mgon po dharma dhwa dza dang*/ bkrin gsum ldan po sogs/ ༈ /chos drug gi chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs mjug /rigs kun khyab bdag bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ lha sras yang srid chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs/ bka' drin mnya med khyab bdag bla ma sogs/ chos dril ba'i gdams pa'i nag gi brgyud 'debs don grub chos kyi rgyal zhes pa'i mjug der/ gsol ba= snying rje'i bdag nyid bstan 'dzin 'gro ba 'dul/ dam chos brgyud 'dzin dharma dhwa dza'i zhabs/ rigs brgya'i khyab bdag chos kyi nyi ma la/ gsol ba= dkyil 'khor kun gtso rje 'dzon padma'i mtshan/ sa ra ha dngos chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ gsol ba = zhes byor ༈ /phyag gr+ya zil gnon zhi bar bsgrub pa'i nang mchod skabs/ 'phrin las bzang po man gzhung ltar dang*/ de nas dkon mchog 'phris don grub kyi rgyal po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ dkon mchog bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dus gyi zhal du= mgar chen dharma suryā'i zhal du= rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i zhal du = khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po bstan 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan gyi zhal du= sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dharma dhwa dza'i zhal du= drin can ba'i bla ma sogs dkyus ltar/

༈ /lnga ldan dharma kirti'i zhal lung gi bla ma sku'i longs sku bsgrub pa'i skabs mtshan sngags ni chos grags yan gzhung ltar la/ ratna karma bi dza ya ratna karma bha dra artha si ddhi dharma rā dza ratna shā pa na gaḥbi na ya dharma sya dhwa dza/ dharma sya suryā shā sa na dhā ra padma dhwa dza shā pa na dha ra dharma sya dhwa dza bcas sbyar rdo rje 'chang skyob pa rtse ba'i bla ma bcas mtshan sngags sbrel ba ni/ badzra dh-ika ratna bhrī padma dhwa dza dharma dhwa dza zhes pa'i thog mthar sngar bzhin sbyaral bas mthus/ ༈ /rjes chos kyi grags pa'i bka' 'bum nas sman bla longs sku gtso 'khor lnga'i sgrub thams dngos grub bang mdzod kyi brgyud 'debs rje gong mas gnang mi 'dug kyang mi rung ba min phyir/ sman mo che dang ratna'i mtshan can dang*/ zhes pa'i mjug der bsod nams dbang po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/ rnal 'byor chen po ri khrod zhig po dang*/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan mnyam nyid rdo rje'i zhabs/ bhrī bha dri rje btsun byams pa'i mtshan/ paṇa chen mgon dpal ba la gsol ba 'debs/ 'gro don legs bzang sman bla don grub dpal/ chos kyi dbang phyug dharma kirti'i zhabs/ 'phrin las rnam rgyal karma bha dra dang*/ 'jam dbyangs don kun grub la gsol= chos kyi 'byung gnas nges legs bstan 'dzin dang*/ tshes dbang kun khyab chos dpal bzang po'i zhabs/ padma'i rgyal mtshan dharma dhwa dza sogs/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams sogs dkyus dang sbyar/ ༈ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs mchod phreng dbang bzhi rdzogs su bskur ba thar pa dam pa'i gru rdzing gi nang mchod/ dkon mchog rin chen kun dga' ratna dang*/ gnam lcags me 'bar chos rgyal phun tshogs zhabs/ bi dā ra ṇa chos kyi grags pa dang*/ rin chen rab 'phel karma bha dra'i zhabs/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan 'gro 'dul rje/ chos kyi rgyal mtshan dharma suryā dang*/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rje btsun padma'i mtshan/

dran mchog don ldan dharma dhwa dza sogs/ rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes sogs dkyus su snyegs pas mthus/ ༈ /tshe dpag lha dgu'i cho ga 'chi med mchog stsol gyi brgyud 'debs kyi chos kyi don grub bstan pa'i nyin byed la/ gsol ba 'debs so| mkha' pa'i sogs tshig gnyis dor ba'i mal du/ tshe dbang kun khyab chos dpal bzang po dang*/ khyab bdag padma dhā dza dharma'i mtshan/ rigs brgyu'i sogs dkyus ltar 'don/ thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtsho'i kha bsgyur/ padma'i rgyal mtshan chos sku 'gyur med zhal sogs dkyus dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba 'debs so= mjug rje btsun dkon mchog sogs dor tshab/ bsten 'dzin padma'i rgyal mtshan la= ratna karma bi dza la= sngags 'chang rdo rje yon tan la= rigs gtso bde chen rdo rje la= mtshungs med nam mkha' rdo rje la= dpal ldan padma segs dpal la= mgon po mi bskyod rdo rje la= kun 'dus snang mdzad rdo rje la= grub dbang rigs pa'i rdo rje la= thugs rje'i spyan rgyang nas dkyus bzhin sbyor bas mthus/ rje chos kyi grags par bsten pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor byin rlabs kyi rol mtshor la ldan bla ma padma'i mtshan bsgyur byas pa'o/ ༈ /chos kyi nyi mas mdzad pa'i bde mchog brgyud 'debs kyi dkon mchog kun 'dus chos kyi rgyal po dang*/ phyag na padma bstan 'dzin 'gro 'dul zhabs/ man ngag brgyud 'dzin khyab bdag mgar chen pa/ gsol ba 'debs= yan gzhung ltar la/ rdo rje 'dzin dbang chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ dharma dhwa dza rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ gsol ba= dngos grub mchog rtsol nas dkyus ltar/ gcod kyi brgyud rim gong 'og gsum ka'i/ rje btsun chos kyi nyi ma'i mjug khyab bdag padma'i rgyal mtshan gsol ba 'debs/ dran mchog chos kyi rgyal mtshan la= sbyar/ pad gling gu ru zhi ba'i brgyud 'debs kyi/

chos kyi nyi ma'i zhabs zhes pa'i mjug der/ rigs kun khyab bdag padma dhwa dza dang*/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal mtshan rje/ bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ gsol ba 'debs so sogs dkyus bzhin dang*/ drag po'i brgyud 'debs kyi kun bzang mtshan mjug /bka' drin gsum ldan padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ sku bzhi'i dbang phyug dharma dhwa dza sogs/ drag bsgrub brgyud pa'i sogs dkyus bzhin bya/ smyung gnas brgyud 'debs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma padma'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ bka' drin mnyam med dharma dhwa dza sogs//
